title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
summary: Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

AI.tldr: 基于编码智能体基础设施，在同步辐射X射线装置上对纳米颗粒超晶格实现自主实验，并通过完整对话记录审计决策溯源与认知分工。
AI.motivation: 闭环自主实验可加速科学发现，但实现成本高、门槛高；智能体系统有望降低门槛，然而在物理仪器上持续运行仍鲜有探索。
AI.method: 以大语言模型编码智能体为基础，锚定经校验的科学方法，在同步辐射光源上针对纳米颗粒超晶格，围绕人类设定的动态目标开展自主X射线实验；保留完整的人—智能体与智能体—智能体对话记录，用于重建决策溯源并刻画认知分工。
AI.result: 三次实验中，61–67%的消息涉及解释或判断；方法与科学类贡献占比从首个以搭建为主实验的46%升至后续实验的56–61%。溯源显示59–68%的错误纠正涉及多方参与，约半数决策纳入了其他参与者的输入。
AI.conclusion: 结果为多智能体科学系统的设计原则提供依据，并可启发智能体执行框架（harness）、模型训练及可及的自主实验研究。

title: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
summary: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve multimodal agents reveal that leading agents complete most analyses end to end but falter when an answer requires mapping from imagery. Further analysis shows that the record moves answers from prior knowledge to the pixels but not yet to the real change on the ground: when one satellite's data are altered, half of the right answers follow the alteration. EarthRecord thus provides a principled platform for measuring and advancing agents from pixels to land change.

AI.tldr: 提出 EarthRecord 基准，用原始多传感器卫星影像档案（Landsat/MODIS/VIIRS/Sentinel-2，四个十年、56 个站点）测试多模态智能体的地表变化分析能力，含 238 道题、十类任务及两项对照设计。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体已能用工具做复杂数据分析，但把数十年卫星影像转化为可靠地表变化分析的能力尚未被量化；现有基准要么基于精选/裁剪图像提问，要么直接提供预处理输入，缺失分析真正起点——原始多传感器档案。
AI.method: 构建基于 56 个站点原始记录的基准：四十年 Landsat、MODIS、VIIRS、Sentinel-2 数据，云掩膜与跨传感器协调交由智能体自行处理；设 238 道地表变化问题，覆盖十类分析任务；采用三类评分参照（全球产品留出参考、方法间一致性、目视解译）；并设两项对照：闭卷（移除影像记录）与仪器配对（篡改单一卫星数据而地面不变）。
AI.result: 评测十二个多模态智能体：领先者能端到端完成多数分析，但在需要从影像映射出答案时表现不佳；影像记录使答案从先验知识转向像素证据，但尚未真正对应地面变化——篡改单一卫星数据后，约一半正确回答随篡改而改变。
AI.conclusion: EarthRecord 为衡量并推进智能体"从像素到地表变化"的能力提供了有原则的平台。

title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
summary: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes. We introduce TopicScope, a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign a topic to every token, so that the label can change partway through a response. We train three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics. Across Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features extracted from prefill hidden states were able to generalise to decoding. We also found that the classifiers are robust to perturbations, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points when off-topic asides are inserted, topics are removed or sections are reordered. Ablations conducted to understand the contribution of the SAE revealed that classifiers reaching baseline performance without it were several times larger. Our findings show that compact topic monitors can be trained inexpensively in prefill and deployed during generation. More broadly, our work shows where SAEs are useful beyond safety classification. Our code, dataset and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mercity-AI/SAE-Guardrails and https://huggingface.co/collections/Mercity/online-guardrails-using-sparse-autoencoders-6ac602940468c62fefb2b9e8

AI.tldr: 提出 TopicScope 框架，基于 SAE（稀疏自编码器）特征训练因果式"话题分类器"，为生成过程中每个 token 打话题标签，支持回复中途话题切换；可在 prefill 阶段廉价训练并部署于解码阶段。
AI.motivation: 现有生成时激活监控器（activation-based monitors）仅被训练用于检测有害内容，且类别数局限于 2–3 类；缺少细粒度、多类别、可随生成过程动态变化的话题监控手段。
AI.method: 在 SAE 提取的特征上训练因果（token 级、因果对齐）话题分类器，使每个 token 均可获得话题标签；构建覆盖 7 个话题的合成多话题对话数据集；训练三种检测器架构；在 Gemma-3 1B/4B 上对比 prefill 隐状态特征与解码阶段的可迁移性；并做扰动鲁棒性测试与去除 SAE 的消融实验。
AI.result: 基于 prefill 隐状态所提特征训练的监控器可泛化到解码阶段；对插入离题内容、删除话题、段落重排等扰动表现稳健，macro-F1 最多下降 5 点；消融显示不用 SAE 特征而达到基线性能的分类器体积大数倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的话题监控器可在 prefill 阶段低成本训练、在生成期部署；拓展了 SAE 在安全分类之外的应用价值（代码、数据集与模型权重已开源）。

title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
summary: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides. Specifically, LandslideFM adapts to multiple visual tasks via a Source-Agreement Graduated Trust semi-supervised learning framework that leverages limited labeled data alongside abundant unlabeled data. Furthermore, predicted landslide regions provide explicit spatial guidance to a Vision-Language Model adapted through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling comprehensive landslide reasoning. To support training and evaluation in this domain, we also present LandslideVL, the first benchmark for intelligent landslide analysis, combining visual imagery and newly introduced textual prompts. Comprehensive experiments across public datasets and LandslideVL demonstrate that LandslideFM achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance. Most importantly, LandslideFM surpasses general-purpose VLMs in specialized landslide reasoning and scene analysis. Our code is released at https://github.com/wangshanwen001/LandslideFM.

AI.tldr: 提出首个统一滑坡基础模型LandslideFM，将视觉感知任务与滑坡情境解释相连，并发布首个智能滑坡分析基准LandslideVL。
AI.motivation: 现有智能滑坡检测模型多聚焦孤立视觉任务，依赖大量标注数据，且缺乏深度分析与场景理解能力。
AI.method: 1）采用Source-Agreement Graduated Trust半监督学习框架，利用有限标注数据与大量无标签数据适配多种视觉任务；2）将预测的滑坡区域作为显式空间引导输入视觉语言模型，并通过参数高效微调实现滑坡推理；3）构建LandslideVL基准，融合视觉影像与新引入的文本提示。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与LandslideVL上的实验表明，LandslideFM在定量与定性指标上均取得更优性能，且在专业滑坡推理与场景分析上超越通用VLM。
AI.conclusion: LandslideFM验证了"视觉感知+情境解释"统一建模范式的可行性与优势，LandslideVL为智能滑坡分析提供了标准化评测平台。

title: Maze Runner: Autonomous Maze Navigation with Line-Based Localization and Control Barrier Functions
summary: Maze navigation requires localization from sparse, repetitive geometry, planning through narrow corridors, and control that stays safe when the estimate or the map is wrong. We present Maze Runner, an open autonomy stack in C++ and ROS 2 that addresses these needs end to end on a simulated Husarion ROSbot XL with a 2D LiDAR in Gazebo. Perception extracts wall lines from each scan with RANSAC and total least squares, with per-line uncertainty. The same line front end feeds two estimators: an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) that localizes against a line map built from the maze mesh, and an EKF SLAM variant that builds the line map online. Planning runs online on an inflated occupancy grid with A* plus line-of-sight shortcutting, or with a forward-only Hybrid A*. A nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) tracks the plan while discrete-time Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) on world-frame LiDAR points keep the robot clear of walls and unmapped obstacles. The algorithms live in a ROS-free, unit-tested core library, and the whole stack builds and runs from a single reproducible environment. In simulation, the robot drives a 135 m route through the maze with 1.0 cm localization RMSE against the known map and 24 cm in SLAM mode, the planner returns a path in 6 ms, and the NMPC solves in 11.7 ms on average, never exceeding its 80 ms budget.

AI.tldr: Maze Runner：面向迷宫自主导航的C++/ROS 2开源自主软件栈
AI.motivation: 迷宫导航需从稀疏且重复的几何结构中实现定位、在狭窄走廊内规划，并在估计或地图出错时保持控制安全；现有方案难以端到端统一解决。
AI.method: 2D LiDAR扫描经RANSAC与总体最小二乘提取带不确定度的墙面直线；同一前端驱动两种估计器：基于迷宫网格构建直线地图的EKF定位，以及在线建图的EKF SLAM。规划在膨胀占据栅格上运行A*加视线捷径或仅前进的Hybrid A*；NMPC跟踪路径，并以世界坐标系LiDAR点上的离散时间控制障碍函数(CBF)保证安全。算法置于无ROS依赖、单元测试的核心库，整体可在单一可复现环境中构建运行。
AI.result: 仿真中机器人完成135 m迷宫路线：已知地图定位RMSE 1.0 cm，SLAM模式24 cm；规划耗时6 ms；NMPC平均求解11.7 ms，未超过80 ms预算。
AI.conclusion: 该栈在Gazebo仿真（Husarion ROSbot XL）中验证了感知-定位/建图-规划-控制的端到端可行性与实时性，并具备可复现、可测试的工程结构。

title: Uncovering the Blind Spots of OKS-mAP: A Unified Protocol for Occlusion, Joint-Angle, and Temporal Evaluation of 2D Pose Estimators
summary: The dominant metric for 2D human pose estimation, OKS-mAP, has three blind spots: it does not distinguish visible from occluded keypoints, does not measure joint-angle error, and is silent on the temporal stability of tracking-free per-frame inference. We propose a supplementary protocol with three modules: (M1) OKS-mAP stratified by ground-truth visibility, with Delta_occ = mAP(v=1) - mAP(full), quantifying how much the aggregate metric masks occlusion-specific differences; (M2) joint-angle error (RMSE/MAE/P95) plus knee-valgus detection consistency; (M3) frame-to-frame displacement, median-filter residual jitter, and jump rate, before and after OneEuro smoothing. We ran it on four datasets (COCO val2017, CrowdPose, OCHuman, PoseTrack18) and four models from two architecture families (YOLO11s-pose, an occlusion-domain fine-tuned variant, ViTPose-B/L), under a common detector-free oracle protocol and an open-source harness. Delta_occ is negative in every combination (-0.19 to -0.47): aggregate mAP overestimates occluded-scene performance in every tested combination. Joint-angle error is amplified in occluded layers; angle metrics reveal differences mAP cannot localize, e.g., the smaller occlusion-trained model significantly outperforming a larger transformer in occluded elbows. On PoseTrack18 val, raw jitter matched between the two YOLO models; pixel-domain OneEuro smoothing cut jump rates 9-10% at no matched-scope AP cost; residual jitter persists after detector removal; the transformer pair's jump rate is significantly lower; smoothing benefits replicate across architectures. Stratified mAP tracks full mAP closely (sign-consistency 1.0, 12/12), serving magnitude diagnosis rather than re-ranking; angle-metric difference vectors (especially knee) partially diverge, suggesting independent information. The protocol and harness are open-sourced, complementing rather than replacing OKS-mAP.

AI.tldr: 该文指出OKS-mAP在遮挡可见性区分、关节角度误差、时间稳定性三方面存在盲区，提出三模块补充评测协议并在四数据集四模型上验证：Δ_occ在各组合均为负(-0.19~-0.47)，角度指标能揭示mAP无法定位的差异，OneEuro平滑降低跳变率9-10%且无损AP。
AI.motivation: 主流2D人体姿态估计指标OKS-mAP存在三个盲区：不区分可见与遮挡关键点、不度量关节角度误差、对无跟踪逐帧推理的时间稳定性无反映。作者希望提供一个与OKS-mAP互补（而非替代）的补充评测协议，暴露聚合指标所掩盖的遮挡场景性能与角度、时序问题。
AI.method: 提出三模块协议：M1按真值可见性分层计算OKS-mAP，定义Δ_occ=mAP(v=1)−mAP(full)量化聚合指标对遮挡差异的掩盖程度；M2计算关节角度误差(RMSE/MAE/P95)及膝外翻检测一致性；M3在OneEuro平滑前后测量帧间位移、中值滤波残差抖动与跳变率。在COCO val2017、CrowdPose、OCHuman、PoseTrack18四数据集上，对两架构族四模型(YOLO11s-pose、遮挡域微调变体、ViTPose-B/L)采用统一的detector-free oracle协议与开源测试框架进行评测。
AI.result: Δ_occ在所有12个组合中均为负(-0.19至-0.47)，表明聚合mAP普遍高估遮挡场景性能；遮挡层角度误差被放大，角度指标能揭示mAP无法定位的差异（如较小的遮挡训练模型在遮挡肘部显著优于更大的Transformer）；PoseTrack18 val上两个YOLO模型原始抖动相近，像素域OneEuro平滑在同等范围AP无损失前提下将跳变率降低9-10%，去除检测器后残差抖动仍存在；Transformer对的跳变率显著更低；平滑收益可跨架构复现。分层mAP与全量mAP高度一致(符号一致性1.0，12/12)，适用于幅度诊断而非重排序；角度指标的差异向量（尤其膝部）部分发散，说明其携带独立信息。
AI.conclusion: 该补充协议与开源框架有效弥补了OKS-mAP在遮挡可见性、关节角度与时序稳定性上的盲区，其中分层mAP适合幅度诊断、角度与时序指标提供独立信息且平滑收益具跨架构可复现性，整体定位为对OKS-mAP的补充而非替代。

title: An ensemble of graph generative models for assisted history matching of the Brugge field case
summary: Assisted history matching remains non-unique because many geological realisations can reproduce equivalent production responses with substantial differences between individual well matches. This ambiguity increases when a field comprises several depositional settings and modelling strategies. The paper applied a graph autoencoder approach to history matching of a benchmark Brugge field that comprises different depositional zones. Each stratigraphic zone is modelled with its dedicated generative model that comprises a joint latent space for optimisation history matching loops. Graph-based generators operate directly on the active cells of the corner-point grid, so its irregular geometry is handled without conversion to a regular lattice. The optimisation search in the 160-dimensional joint latent space is done with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy. The multi-component objective function includes static well data mismatch, dynamic production mismatch, and a geological realism penalty based on the Decoder induced latent metric. Latent space diagnostics with topological data analysis are applied prior to history matching to test whether one generator is sufficient or whether a multiple generator formulation is required. The results show that the zone-based formulation gives coherent latent spaces, preserves the main porosity and permeability relations that vary from one zone to another, and supports history matching while keeping the solutions within the learned geological manifold. The matched models reproduce field oil and water production within the prior uncertainty range and provide a comparable well-level match to previously published Brugge studies based on Ensemble Kalman Filter, Particle Swarm Optimisation with principal component analysis of parameterisation, and Multiple Kernel Learning with Particle Swarm Optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文将图自编码器（graph autoencoder）引入Brugge基准油田的分层（zone-based）辅助历史拟合，每个沉积带训练专属生成器并共享联合潜空间，用CMA-ES在160维潜空间优化，并结合拓扑数据分析诊断潜空间结构。
AI.motivation: 辅助历史拟合存在非唯一性：多个地质实现可给出等效的产量响应，但单井拟合差异显著；当油田包含多个沉积环境和建模策略时，这种模糊性进一步加剧。作者希望在保持地质合理性的前提下，对这类多沉积带复杂油藏开展历史拟合。
AI.method: 1）采用图自编码器生成器，直接作用于角点网格的活跃单元，无需转换为规则格点，从而处理不规则几何；2）按地层带分别构建专属生成模型，并建立用于历史拟合循环的联合潜空间；3）在160维联合潜空间中以协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）进行搜索；4）多分量目标函数包含静态井数据失配、动态产量失配以及基于解码器诱导潜度量的地质合理性惩罚项；5）历史拟合前用拓扑数据分析对潜空间做诊断，判断单一生成器是否足够或需多生成器形式。
AI.result: 分带方案得到的潜空间连贯一致，保留了随带变化的孔隙度—渗透率主要关系，并使历史拟合解保持在所学地质流形内；匹配模型在先验不确定性范围内重现了油田油、水产量，井级拟合效果与已发表的基于集合卡尔曼滤波、粒子群优化+PCA参数化、以及多核学习+粒子群优化的Brugge研究相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于图自编码器的分带生成建模与联合潜空间优化，可在复杂多沉积油藏中实现兼顾地质合理性与拟合质量的历史拟合；潜空间拓扑诊断为生成器粒度选择提供了依据，结果与主流方法可比。

title: Tracing Psychometric Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? We address this question using a cross-persona paradigm across 14 model variants from two families (Llama 3 and Qwen 2.5, 0.5B-14B, base and instruct). Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. Across models, geometry strength is associated with behavioral amplification (r = 0.68, p = 0.008; partial r = 0.69 controlling for log size). To relate internal structure to output behavior, a matched activation-probing paradigm shows that probe slopes vary less than behavioral slopes (1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53). A synthetic control shows that ridge probing can inflate these slopes; after subtracting a baseline based on a reliability proxy from another analysis, adjusted slopes remain associated with behavior (r = 0.88). We term the measured probe-behavior gap readout attenuation. These results establish decodability and geometric alignment under the tested assays, without showing that the measured directions mediate the cross-persona answers.

AI.tldr: 论文以"跨人设范式"考察大模型是否在内部表征心理构念：14个Llama 3与Qwen 2.5变体（0.5B–14B，base/instruct）在给定一个心理量表的真实作答后预测其余六个量表。行为层面，大模型复现并放大人际跨量表相关；内部层面，仅较大instruct模型出现与人类相关矩阵对齐的对比方向几何，几何强度与行为放大相关（r=0.68）；探针斜率小于行为斜率，此差距被称为"读出衰减"。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：大模型是真正在内部分表征心理构念，还是仅仅生成在表象上与心理测量结构相似的输出？既有工作多停留在行为层面的一致性，缺乏对内部几何与"内部—行为"通路的联合检验。
AI.method: 1) 跨人设范式：以272名台湾大学生的真实量表作答为条件，模型预测另外六个量表，检验跨量表相关矩阵；2) 对七量表人类相关做测量衰减校正，检验放大效应是否稳健；3) 对比方向分析（contrastive direction）检验内部表征几何与人类相关矩阵的对齐；4) 相关/偏相关分析检验几何强度与行为放大的关系（控制log规模）；5) 匹配的激活探针范式比较探针斜率与行为斜率；6) 合成对照检验岭探针的斜率膨胀，并用基于另一分析的信度代理基线做校正。
AI.result: 较大模型复现并放大人际跨量表相关，且放大在校正测量衰减后仍存在。内部几何仅在较大instruct变体中对齐人类矩阵，base变体在该测定下对齐微弱。几何强度与行为放大显著相关（r=0.68, p=0.008；控制log规模后偏相关r=0.69）。探针斜率（0.52–1.53）系统性低于行为斜率（1.38–1.77）；合成对照显示岭探针会夸大斜率，扣除信度代理基线后校正斜率仍与行为相关（r=0.88）。
AI.conclusion: 在所测测定下，结果为"可解码性"与"几何对齐"提供了证据，但未证明所测方向中介了跨人设作答，即内部表征与输出行为之间存在"读出衰减"缺口；表征—行为通路仍未确立因果中介。

title: CAFE: Closed-Loop Autonomous Task Formulation and Execution without Instance-Specific Instructions
summary: Scene-driven robot autonomy requires selecting tasks from observations as well as executing them. We study scene-driven task formulation and execution under predefined cleaning, safety, and storage/organization categories, without instance-specific goals or action sequences. CAFE maintains online memory of objects, functional zones, and execution states. A rule-guided Trigger-LLM admits formulation from accumulated evidence; Draft, Complete, and Audit propose goals, resolve execution details, and check dependencies. Outcomes update memory for correction and subsequent discovery. Evaluation in 12 AI2-THOR scenes compares three backbones and task-complexity tiers using coverage, constraint, and execution metrics. Tri-LLM records higher GCR scores than the evaluated baselines across three backbones and task-complexity tiers. Controls examine completion, auditing, zones, feedback, triggering, and prompt examples. LimoCobot traces illustrate storage, cleanup, and recovery from a failed grasp. The study examines how shared scene state connects task discovery to execution and outcome-driven revision.

AI.tldr: 提出CAFE框架，在预定义清洁/安全/收纳类别下，无实例级目标与动作序列的情况下实现场景驱动的任务生成与执行；通过Trigger-LLM与Draft/Complete/Audit三阶段，将共享场景记忆与执行反馈闭环结合，在AI2-THOR 12个场景中取得更高GCR。
AI.motivation: 场景驱动的机器人自主性不仅需要执行任务，还需从观测中自行选定任务。现有方法多依赖实例级目标或预设动作序列，难以在仅有类别约束（清洁、安全、收纳/整理）时自主形成并落地任务。
AI.method: CAFE维护关于物体、功能区与执行状态的在线记忆。规则引导的Trigger-LLM依据累积证据判定是否启动任务形成；Draft、Complete、Audit三模块分别提出目标、补全执行细节、校验依赖关系。执行结果回写记忆，用于纠错与后续发现。评估在12个AI2-THOR场景中，比较3种骨干模型与多个任务复杂度层级，采用覆盖率、约束满足与执行指标，并进行消融控制（完成、审计、功能区、反馈、触发、提示示例），辅以LimoCobot真实轨迹案例。
AI.result: 在三种骨干模型与各任务复杂度层级下，Tri-LLM配置的GCR分数均高于所评估基线；消融控制验证了各组件作用；LimoCobot轨迹展示了收纳、清理及抓取失败后的恢复过程。
AI.conclusion: 共享场景状态是连接任务发现与执行的关键纽带，且结果驱动的记忆更新可形成闭环修正，支撑无实例级监督下的场景驱动任务生成与执行。

title: URL-Sim: Unified and Regulated LiDAR Simulation for High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity LiDAR simulation scenes from real-world driving logs is essential for cost-effective safety validation of autonomous driving systems. While simulators based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve realistic scene reconstruction, their large-scale adoption is limited by slow rendering speeds. Recent 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) approaches have improved rendering efficiency through explicit primitive representation and differentiable rasterization. However, existing 3DGS-based methods remain largely restricted to rigid vehicles and produce redundant primitives through unconstrained densification. To address these limitations, we propose URL-Sim, a unified and regulated dynamic LiDAR simulation framework. URL-Sim constructs a dynamic Gaussian scene graph that decouples the modeling of traffic participants, including vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists, enabling accurate reconstruction of heterogeneous dynamic objects within a single framework. It further introduces a regulated Gaussian densification strategy that ranks primitives with multi-dimensional importance scores and allocates Gaussians to the most critical regions while keeping the total primitive count bounded. Experiments on the Waymo and KITTI-360 datasets demonstrate that URL-Sim achieves higher quantitative accuracy and visual quality than existing baselines under comparable primitive budgets, and accurately recovers the geometry and poses of diverse dynamic traffic participants.

AI.tldr: URL-Sim：面向自动驾驶的统一、受调控的动态LiDAR仿真框架，基于动态高斯场景图与调控式高斯致密化。
AI.motivation: 现有NeRF类LiDAR仿真重建真实但渲染慢；3DGS类方法虽提升渲染效率，却多局限于刚性车辆，且无约束致密化产生冗余图元。
AI.method: 构建动态高斯场景图，解耦车辆、行人、骑行者等交通参与者的建模；引入调控式高斯致密化，用多维重要性分数对图元排序，将高斯分配至最关键区域并约束图元总数。
AI.result: 在Waymo与KITTI-360上，于相近图元预算下取得更高的定量精度与视觉质量，并能准确恢复多样动态交通参与者的几何与位姿。
AI.conclusion: 统一的动态场景图建模加受控致密化，可在有限图元预算内实现高质量、多类别动态LiDAR场景重建。

title: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Main Track, Poster
summary: Time-series classifiers deployed in risk-sensitive domains must be (1) accurate, (2) interpretable, and (3) able to abstain when evidence is weak. Existing methods do not deliver all 3 at once, and the obstacle is structural, rather than logistical. Meaningful temporal patterns cannot be defined without knowing segment boundaries, yet meaningful boundaries cannot be placed without knowing which patterns to expect. Existing approaches break this circularity by using fixed windows or expert-annotated vocabularies, thereby sacrificing at least one of the 3 properties. We introduce ConceptTime, which closes the loop through a single self-supervised signal. A frozen probabilistic forecaster predicts a distribution over the next observation at every timestep of the sequence. We call the mismatch between its prediction and the realized signal the predictive surprise. This signal both locates segment boundaries and characterizes each resulting segment through the forecaster. Segments are thus grounded by how they behaved relative to expectation, not by what they look like. These summaries cluster into a vocabulary of dynamical regimes that we call concepts. A lightweight head classifies from the concept sequence, and the distance to the nearest concept yields reliability by design. Across 17 public benchmarks, ConceptTime is competitive with state-of-the-art black-box accuracy, beats every interpretable baseline, and retains near-98% accuracy on Epilepsy with 1% of labels. It further remains competitive with softmax, prototype-distance, and SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++ on OOD detection and deletion faithfulness, without a single annotation, language model call, or domain expert. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sachithx/ConceptTime.git.

AI.tldr: 提出ConceptTime：用冻结概率预测器的"预测惊讶度"作为单一自监督信号，同时完成时间序列分段边界定位与段语义刻画，形成"动力学机制概念"词表，配套轻量分类头与基于概念距离的弃权机制，在17个基准上兼顾精度、可解释性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 风险敏感领域的时间序列分类器需同时满足三点：准确、可解释、证据不足时能弃权。现有方法无法三者兼得，且障碍是结构性的：有意义的时序模式需先知道分段边界，而有意义的边界又需先知道预期模式，形成循环依赖。已有方法用固定窗口或专家标注词表打破循环，但至少牺牲三项性质之一。
AI.method: 用冻结的概率预测器在每个时间步预测下一观测的分布，将预测与真实信号的失配定义为"预测惊讶度"。该信号既用于定位分段边界，又通过预测器刻画每一段；段摘要按"相对预期的行为"而非外观来表征。这些摘要聚类为动力学机制概念词表；轻量头部基于概念序列分类，并以到最近概念的距离作为可靠性/弃权依据。
AI.result: 在17个公开基准上，精度与SOTA黑盒方法相当，优于所有可解释基线；在Epilepsy数据集上仅用1%标签仍保持近98%精度；在OOD检测与删除忠实度上与softmax、原型距离及SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++保持竞争力，且无需任何标注、语言模型调用或领域专家。
AI.conclusion: ConceptTime通过单一自监督信号闭合"边界—模式"循环依赖，统一实现准确性、可解释性与弃权可靠性，概念由相对预期的偏差而非外观定义，为风险敏感场景提供了无需人工标注的端到端方案。

title: Graph Visualizations in Prompts for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: We study when and how multimodal input improves knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) in large vision--language models. Using a controlled evaluation over 1,500 WebQSP and CWQ questions and six VLMs within a fixed KGQA pipeline, we compare text-only prompting against text-plus-graph visualization at the per-question level and analyze performance changes as a function of reasoning complexity, model size, and image layout. Adding a graph image yields an average gain of 1.85 F1 points, driven by strong precision improvements on low-complexity questions (+4.65 F1). Mixed-effects and regression analyses show that these multimodal gains do not depend strongly on model scale, but are highly sensitive to graph layout: image-only settings sharply degrade performance, hierarchical Graphviz layouts outperform less organized renderings, and decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements. Taken together, the results indicate that visual prompting primarily aids KGQA by enhancing prediction precision in low-complexity contexts, provided that visual design respects cognitive and perceptual constraints. To optimize both accuracy and inference efficiency, we argue for adaptive visual prompting policies that selectively append diagrams to small, visually sparse subgraphs with well-structured layouts, avoiding unnecessary visual clutter and token overhead on complex queries. We conclude by relating these findings to a visual notation design theory, outlining how principled diagram encoding can guide future multimodal VLM prompting.

AI.tldr: 在固定KGQA流水线下对比纯文本与"文本+图可视化"提示，多模态增益平均+1.85 F1，主要来自低复杂度问题的精度提升（+4.65 F1），且高度依赖图布局；据此提出自适应视觉提示策略。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉-语言模型中进行知识图谱问答时，多模态输入何时、以何种方式带来增益，以及增益是否随推理复杂度、模型规模和图像布局而变化。
AI.method: 在1,500道WebQSP与CWQ问题上、使用六种VLM和统一KGQA流水线做受控评测，按问题级对比纯文本提示与文本加图可视化提示；采用混合效应模型与回归分析，以推理复杂度、模型规模、图像布局为自变量分析性能变化。
AI.result: 加入图图像平均提升1.85 F1，低复杂度问题精度提升显著（+4.65 F1）；增益与模型规模关系不强，但对布局高度敏感：仅图像设置性能急剧下降，分层Graphviz布局优于无序渲染，将大子图拆分为独立路径收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 视觉提示主要通过在小而稀疏、布局良好-structured的子图上提升低复杂度情境的预测精度；应发展自适应视觉提示策略，有选择地附加图示意以避免复杂查询上的视觉杂乱与token开销，并与视觉记号设计理论相联系。

title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
summary: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.

AI.tldr: RoboACE 是一个机器人对抗协同演化框架，在冻结基础模型的前提下，联合演化"课程"与"执行"两套 harness：课程侧依据能力证据提出挑战，执行侧给出可复用的修改，二者交替更新并以固定快照对比。
AI.motivation: 智能体虽能从执行反馈中改进技能、规划与恢复策略，但固定的练习来源使"寻找新弱点"的搜索停滞；而有效练习取决于智能体当前能力，因此选择练习的机制本身也必须可演化。
AI.method: 围绕冻结的基础模型构建双 harness：(1) 课程 harness 利用累积的能力证据提出有信息量的挑战；(2) 执行 harness 以可复用的修订回应，扩展执行能力。交替更新时固定一侧、更新另一侧；被接纳的挑战形成固定快照，用于公平比较执行侧的修订。初始条件为一组精简的 LIBERO 练习配置。
AI.result: 在四个 LIBERO 系列测评面板上，所得冻结部署优于所评估的控制器与智能体系统；在 LIBERO-PRO 上达到 74.0% 成功率，较初始部署提升 15.0 个百分点，较其 VLA 控制器直接执行提升 13.5 个百分点。案例研究记录了证据引导的练习选择、抽屉技能接地与控制器干预方面的变化。
AI.conclusion: 将课程生成与执行改进置于协同演化闭环，可在不微调基础模型的情况下持续发现并弥补弱点，显著提升冻结部署的泛化与控制性能。

title: Evaluation protocols for historical script classification: the cost of manuscript-level leakage and the role of soft labels
summary: A paleographer applies a script type classifier to unseen manuscripts. We measure how much testing on other pages of training manuscripts inflates accuracy. On VML-HP-ext (715 pages, 171 Hebrew manuscripts, 14 script classes) we compare page-level and manuscript-level splits. Page-level accuracy drops from 97% to 54% (59% at manuscript level), and is 39% on the official blind test set. The gap of 40 to 47 percentage points (pp) at patch, page and manuscript level is statistically significant and reproduces with ResNet18; on binarized patches (ink and background only) it is 34 to 42 pp, also significant. On unseen manuscripts the model is overconfident: mean confidence 70% against 54% correct pages; patch-level expected calibration error (ECE, mean gap between confidence and accuracy) rises from 0.065 to 0.444. Binarization leaves patch-level overconfidence but cuts it markedly at page level. Confidence still helps triage: in the more confident half of pages 67% are correct, 41% in the rest. Training on expert soft labels showed no evidence of an accuracy difference, though a small page-level loss cannot be ruled out. The predicted distributions are closer to the expert's assessment. ECE is lower at patch level (0.21 to 0.31) and in most runs at page level, but not significantly at manuscript level. Label smoothing (blurring the label, no expert input) also lowers ECE but comes no closer to the expert. Temperature scaling (post-training confidence correction) helps significantly only at patch level. On 97 pages of 16 manuscripts with mixed expert assessment, soft labels cut divergence from the expert by 22 to 30% (significant in four of five runs); the point estimate of accuracy is 16.5 to 23.7 pp below hard labels, but with 16 manuscripts the loss can neither be confirmed nor ruled out. We propose recommendations for the evaluation protocol; code will be released with the paper

AI.tldr: 在VML-HP-ext（715页、171份希伯来文手稿、14个书体类别）上，按页级划分评估时脚本分类器准确率97%，换到未见过的手稿后降至54%（手稿级划分59%，官方盲测集39%），差距40–47个百分点且统计显著；模型在未见手稿上明显过度自信，置信度可用于分诊，专家软标签主要改善校准与预测分布形态而非准确率。
AI.motivation: 古文字学家需将脚本类型分类器用于未见手稿，而常规随机划分会让同一手稿的其他页进入训练集，造成数据泄漏式的准确率高估。作者希望量化这种"同手稿其他页测试"带来的准确率虚高，并考察置信度校准、专家软标签等手段在真实泛化场景下的作用，进而提出更严谨的评估协议。
AI.method: 构建VML-HP-ext数据集并对比页级划分与手稿级划分；以patch、page、manuscript三个粒度计算准确率差距，用ResNet18复现，并在仅含墨迹与背景的二值化patch上重复实验。评估置信度校准：报告ECE、均值置信度与准确率差，测试二值化、温度缩放（后处理置信度校正）与标签平滑。另以专家软标签（含专家混合评估的97页/16手稿子集）训练，比较准确率、KL类散度、ECE及与专家判断的一致性。
AI.result: 页级准确率97%→54%（手稿级59%），官方盲测39%；三个粒度下差距40–47 pp显著，ResNet18可复现，二值化patch上34–42 pp仍显著。未见手稿上平均置信度70%对应54%正确率；patch级ECE由0.065升至0.444，二值化降低页级过度自信。较自信的一半页面正确率67%，其余41%。软标签未显示准确率差异（不能排除小的页级损失），但预测分布更接近专家评估，patch级ECE 0.21–0.31且多数运行页级更低，手稿级不显著；标签平滑也降低ECE但不更接近专家；温度缩放仅patch级显著。混合评估子集上软标签使与专家的散度降低22–30%（5次运行中4次显著），点估计准确率低16.5–23.7 pp但16份手稿不足以判定。
AI.conclusion: 现有页级随机划分严重高估脚本分类器的实际可用精度，手稿级（乃至盲测）评估才是可靠基准；未见手稿上模型过度自信但置信度仍可有效分诊。专家软标签与标签平滑主要改善校准与预测分布，而非提升准确率。作者据此提出评估协议建议并承诺公开代码。

title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
summary: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. However, its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query, making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. Notably, the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill GPU time at long context lengths. To address this bottleneck, we propose ADIndex, an Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing method for token-level sparse attention. ADIndex integrates three key components: (i) a layer-wise calibration strategy that adaptively accommodates cross-query retrieval overlap, motivated by our observation of pronounced inter-layer heterogeneity; (ii) a group-level distillation scheme that leverages this heterogeneity to efficiently train adaptive layer-wise group indexers, capturing salient retrieval signals from individual queries; and (iii) a low-latency inference strategy that reduces repeated full-prefix scans through token bank sharing within query groups while retaining query-specific refinement. Experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 demonstrate that ADIndex preserves near-lossless task performance on LongBench, LongBench v2, and RULER while delivering substantial efficiency gains over standard DSA, including prefill and decoding kernel speedups of up to 6.22x and 3.40x, respectively, at a context length of 256K across the layer-wise reuse configurations, as well as an end-to-end serving speedup of 1.54x at a context length of 128K.

AI.tldr: 提出 ADIndex，一种自适应、蒸馏驱动的索引方法，用于 token 级稀疏注意力，通过层间自适应校准、组级蒸馏与低延迟推理策略加速 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 的索引器，在长上下文下实现显著加速且性能近乎无损。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA）虽通过 token 级选择降低注意力计算成本，但其索引器仍需为每个 query 对整个因果前缀打分，使索引成为长上下文推理的主要延迟来源——在长上下文长度下索引器可占总 prefill GPU 时间的 50% 以上。作者还观察到显著的层间异质性，因此需要针对索引器本身进行优化。
AI.method: ADIndex 包含三个核心组件：(i) 逐层校准策略，基于层间异质性自适应处理跨 query 的检索重叠；(ii) 组级蒸馏方案，利用该异质性高效训练自适应的逐层组索引器，从单个 query 中捕捉显著检索信号；(iii) 低延迟推理策略，在 query 组内通过 token bank 共享减少重复的全前缀扫描，同时保留 query 特定的精化。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GLM-5.1 上，ADIndex 在 LongBench、LongBench v2 与 RULER 上保持近乎无损的任务性能；在 256K 上下文长度下，不同逐层复用配置实现最高 6.22x 的 prefill kernel 加速与 3.40x 的 decoding kernel 加速；在 128K 上下文长度下实现 1.54x 的端到端服务加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对 DSA 索引器瓶颈的自适应与蒸馏驱动设计，ADIndex 在保持长上下文任务性能近乎无损的前提下大幅提升 prefill、decoding 与端到端服务效率，为 token 级稀疏注意力的实用部署提供了有效方案。

title: Reinforcement Learning based control of Cancer Chemotherapy treatments
comment: Masters thesis at the National Taipei University. Received the IEEE Taipei Section, Best Masters thesis award in 2021
summary:
Reinforcement Learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years. Extending its scope from the traditional complex games such as Atari, Go, Pokeman, and Chess, reinforcement learning has caught researchers' attention on modelling real-life scenarios. Personalized medicine and the dynamic treatment regimen are two such preliminary research fields; researchers are focusing their mindsets currently. Estimating the optimal dynamic treatment regimens from the observational real clinical data is being popularized among the researchers, widening its scope towards more advanced versions of reinforcement learning algorithms.
  This research is about a research study that focused on reinforcement learning techniques that have been approached in the context of cancer chemotherapy treatments. Primarily this thesis addresses the result of the study by means of the state-of-the-art on reinforcement learning techniques used in generating the optimal policy for sequential treatments, including the existing online reinforcement learning approaches. Thereby a simulation for cancer chemotherapy via traditional Q-learning would be presented. Secondly, the study will extend towards using offline reinforcement learning in the optimal policy generation. Thus, the proposed solution follows a data-driven approach, which works on the real human colon cancer clinical data.
  The novelty of the proposed solution resides in the implementation of an offline reinforcement learning approach by means of a model-based architecture using the conservative Q-learning and the model-based offline policy optimization algorithm. As per the experimental results and the evaluations, it was revealed that the proposed Chemo RL model caters well the problem of cancer chemotherapy treatment scheduling and serves as a supportive model for the junior oncologists in deciding their treatment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述强化学习在癌症化疗序贯治疗决策中的应用，先以传统Q-learning构建化疗仿真，再针对真实结肠癌临床数据提出融合保守Q-learning（CQL）与基于模型的离线策略优化（MOReL类）的离线强化学习框架，用于生成最优化疗给药策略。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已从Atari、Go、国际象棋等复杂博弈扩展到个性化医疗与动态治疗方案等真实场景；从观察性临床数据中估计最优动态治疗方案（DTR）需求上升。化疗方案具有序贯决策特性，且临床试验数据难以在线探索，因此需要离线、数据驱动的方案，为经验不足的肿瘤科医生提供治疗决策支持。
AI.method: 首先梳理生成最优序贯治疗策略的最先进强化学习技术（含在线方法）；其次通过传统Q-learning实现化疗仿真验证可行性；随后转向离线强化学习，采用基于模型（model-based）架构，结合保守Q-learning（CQL）与基于模型的离线策略优化算法，在真实人类结肠癌临床数据上进行策略学习与评估。
AI.result: 实验与评估结果表明，所提出的Chemo RL模型能够较好地处理癌症化疗治疗排程问题，可作为辅助模型帮助初级肿瘤科医生制定治疗决策。
AI.conclusion: 离线、基于模型的强化学习为化疗剂量与给药时序优化提供了可行的数据驱动途径，具备临床决策支持的潜在价值；后续可进一步在更多真实数据集与安全约束下验证其泛化性与可靠性。

title: Robo-MLT: Dual-System Robotic Manipulation for Long-Horizon Medical Laboratory Tasks
summary: Reliable medical laboratory automation requires robots to complete entire workflows in protocol order while handling changes during execution. A robot may execute each motion correctly yet fail the workflow by confusing visually similar stages or stalling after human intervention. We present Robo-MLT, a dual-system framework that couples explicit workflow monitoring with learned action generation. A vision--language planner composes an ordered atomic-skill sequence from the protocol and the initial workspace observation. A multiframe execution monitor detects when the active skill has completed or become infeasible, then advances the workflow or triggers replanning. A skill-conditioned vision--language--action policy generates the manipulation trajectories, and an asynchronous runtime coordinates it with the monitor. We evaluate Robo-MLT against four policy baselines and a VLM-based monitor baseline on blood gas analysis and blood sample tube sorting, with 50 nominal configurations per method and 20 sample-removal configurations. Robo-MLT achieves task success rates of 82\% and 70\%, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 30 and 22 percentage points, respectively. After an operator removes the sample being handled, the system revises the remaining plan and continues processing the other samples. These results indicate that, under the evaluated conditions, explicit workflow monitoring makes long-horizon laboratory manipulation more reliable and recoverable.

AI.tldr: 提出双系统框架Robo-MLT，将显式工作流监控与学习的动作生成相结合，提升长时序医学实验室自动化的可靠性与可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 医学实验室自动化要求机器人按protocol顺序完成整个工作流，并能应对执行中的变化。仅保证单个动作正确并不够：机器人可能因视觉相似阶段混淆而失败，或在人工干预后停滞。
AI.method: 双系统框架：(1) 视觉-语言规划器依据protocol与初始工作区观测，生成有序的原子技能序列；(2) 多帧执行监控器判断当前技能已完成或不可行，从而推进工作流或触发重规划；(3) 技能条件化的VLA策略生成操作轨迹；(4) 异步运行时协调策略与监控器。
AI.result: 在血气分析与血样试管分拣两个任务上，与4个策略基线和1个基于VLM的监控器基线对比。每种方法50个标称配置、20个移除样本配置。Robo-MLT任务成功率分别为82%和70%，较π0.5分别高出30和22个百分点；操作员移除正在处理的样本后，系统可修订剩余计划并继续处理其他样本。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估条件下，显式工作流监控使长时序实验室操作更可靠、更具可恢复性。

title: Attribute-Evidence Learning with Multimodal Prompt for Generalized Category Discovery
comment: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Generalized category discovery (GCD) aims to discover novel categories from unlabeled data by leveraging limited labeled samples from old classes. Existing methods that rely solely on visual cues often neglect the multimodal nature of human perception, prompting recent approaches to incorporate textual information such as category tags and attributes. However, these approaches typically entangle global tags and local attributes within a shared global image representation, rendering attributes unreliable and potentially providing misleading cues that can drive the model toward incorrect predictions. To this end, we propose AptM-GCD, a novel multimodal framework that exploits apt textual guidance through attribute evidence learning and multimodal prompt reasoning. Specifically, we design an Attribute-Evidence Learning (AEL) mechanism that treats attributes as localized visual evidence rather than global category descriptors. By interacting attribute embeddings with patch-level visual tokens, AEL identifies reliable attribute-related regions and extracts discriminative local evidence, thereby reducing the impact of noisy or irrelevant attribute cues. Building upon the extracted evidence, we further develop a Multimodal Prompt Learning (MPL) mechanism to bridge local attribute semantics and global visual understanding. MPL converts fine-grained textual evidence into visual prompts and injects them into a multimodal prompt transformer, enabling attribute information to enhance category discrimination through contextual reasoning without enforcing direct global alignment between modalities. Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that AptM-GCD consistently achieves SoTA performance across both fine-grained and generic benchmarks. Moreover, the proposed framework exhibits strong generalization ability, delivering consistent gains under unimodal and class-imbalanced GCD settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 AptM-GCD 多模态广义类别发现框架，通过属性证据学习(AEL)与多模态提示学习(MPL)避免全局图文对齐带来的属性噪声，在六个数据集上取得 SoTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法依赖视觉线索，忽略人类感知的多模态性；引入文本（类别标签、属性）的方法通常将全局标签与局部属性纠缠在统一的全局图像表示中，导致属性不可靠并产生误导性线索，引发错误预测。
AI.method: 1) 属性证据学习(AEL)：将属性视为局部视觉证据而非全局类别描述符，通过属性嵌入与 patch 级视觉 token 交互，定位可靠的属性相关区域并提取判别性局部证据，抑制噪声/无关属性线索；2) 多模态提示学习(MPL)：将细粒度文本证据转化为视觉提示，注入多模态提示 Transformer，借助上下文推理增强类别判别，而不强制模态间直接全局对齐。
AI.result: 在六个数据集的细粒度与通用基准上均持续达到 SoTA；在单模态与类别不平衡 GCD 设置下也保持一致的性能提升，展现出较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以“局部属性证据 + 提示式上下文推理”替代全局图文对齐，是引入文本先验进行广义类别发现的有效范式，且具备良好的跨设置泛化性。

title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
summary: While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. Our results reveal that agent disagreement shifts the exploration burden from temporal complexity to spatial diversity, enabling efficient collective learning without explicit exploration.

AI.tldr: 该论文将联邦强化学习中的奖励异质性从"共识障碍"重新定义为"促进探索的结构性资产"，提出PF-UCBVI（实现线性加速）与PF-EFVI（纯贪婪、无需显式探索）两种算法，并证明奖励多样性充分时PF-EFVI可达到对数遗憾。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦强化学习假设环境同质，当各智能体目标（奖励函数）不同时，协作往往受阻。作者反其道而行：不把奖励异质性视为达成共识的难题，而将其视为驱动探索的资源，从而在个性化目标下实现高效集体学习。
AI.method: 1）PF-UCBVI：将共享动态与个性化目标解耦，在个性化联邦设定下使用置信上界值迭代实现高效学习；2）PF-EFVI：进一步去除显式探索奖励，采用纯贪婪的值迭代，依靠奖励多样性本身诱导状态-动作空间覆盖。
AI.result: PF-UCBVI 达到最优的线性（随智能体数量）加速；PF-EFVI 在奖励多样性充分条件下，无需显式探索奖励即可获得对数级遗憾界。
AI.conclusion: 智能体间目标分歧可将探索负担从"时间维度的复杂度"转移到"空间维度的多样性"，从而在无显式探索的情况下实现高效联邦学习，为个性化联邦强化学习提供了新的理论视角与算法框架。

title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Position Paper Track
summary: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. An analytic bound supported by the simulations shows that intelligence-driven speedup is capped by the ratio of competing intelligence levels regardless of task difficulty. The simulations also expose a fast-takeoff dilemma: a large intelligence-driven speedup multiplier materializes only when the hypothesis space is noisy, but the absolute timescale remains constrained by the time required for capability-critical tests, so a large multiplier need not imply rapid progress. Simulations also indicate that institutional chokepoints disproportionately slow down superintelligent agents when mandatory authorization delays are large relative to the negligible time these agents spend on unproductive search. We argue that the dominant safety levers are restricting control and enforcing knowledge boundaries rather than limiting intelligence alone, and this applies to agentic systems at any capability level. Purely digital domains weaken these bottlenecks, strengthening the case for architectures that intentionally "put physics in the loop."

AI.tldr: 论文提出“能力回路”（I KC+KC+C）框架，将AI智能体的现实影响分解为智能中介的发现、程序性技能与直接控制三条路径，并用NK适应度景观模拟与解析界证明：智能驱动的加速存在上限，主要安全杠杆是限制控制与知识边界，而非单纯限制智能。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体的快速扩散使治理问题紧迫；而既有“快速起飞”争论多把影响归因于“智能本身”，缺乏对智能、知识、控制三要素如何组合产生现实影响的细粒度拆解与可形式化检验。
AI.method: 1) 提出能力回路框架：IKC（智能中介的发现）+ KC（程序性知识/技能）+ C（直接控制）；2) 以经典快速起飞论证为压力测试，将其形式化为“合取条件”，即足以导致快速灾难性优势的联合充分条件；3) 将认知智能操作化为“假设选择效率”，在NK适应度景观上进行随机模拟，覆盖六个沿合取链展开的情景；4) 给出解析上界，并与模拟相互印证。
AI.result: 智能驱动的加速受竞争双方智能水平之比的封顶，与任务难度无关；“快速起飞悖论”：大加速倍数仅在假设空间嘈杂时出现，但绝对时间尺度仍受能力关键测试耗时的约束，故大倍数不必然意味着快速进展；制度性瓶颈（强制授权延迟）在延迟相对于超级智能体近乎可忽略的无效搜索时间足够大时，会不成比例地拖慢超级智能体。多数智能中介快速起飞条件实际依赖知识的快速获取或控制的获取，而非智能单独作用。
AI.conclusion: 主导性的安全杠杆是限制控制获取与强制执行知识边界，而非仅限制智能水平，且该结论适用于任意能力层级的智能体系统；纯数字域会削弱这些物理与制度瓶颈，因此支持有意“把物理放进回路”的架构设计。

title: ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration
summary: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. We evaluate ASPIRE on three measured systems: a mobile robot, a rotational system with dry friction, and a laboratory fermenter. Each system is tested with and without a description, in five runs per task. All 30 runs delivered valid models, at a cost of 0.96 to 3.38 US dollars per run. An assessment by the authors found that, for the 30 models recommended by the agent, one per run, the interpretation of the model and the documentation of its structure selection and parameter estimation fully satisfied 132 of 150 assessed items and partly satisfied 18. The most frequent discrepancy, found in nine models, concerned inaccurate or unsupported claims about model structure selection.

AI.tldr: 提出ASPIRE框架，由大语言模型智能体自主完成非线性系统辨识的方法选择与执行，从实测数据构造闭式非线性静态/动态模型，并在三个实测系统共30次运行中全部产出有效模型，成本0.96–3.38美元/次。
AI.motivation: 系统辨识需要专家决定辨识方法、融入先验物理知识并完成模型验证，门槛高、依赖人工经验，作者希望用LLM智能体替代或辅助这些专家决策环节。
AI.method: ASPIRE让LLM智能体选择并执行辨识方法；输入为实测数据，可选补充系统描述、模型预期用途及以形式化或自然语言表述的物理要求；每个模型输出参数、估计记录、各项的物理解释以及在智能体不可见测试数据上的误差；形式化物理要求由独立程序验证；支持自主模式与交互模式（智能体提问、用户追加分析与辨识轮次）。
AI.result: 在移动机器人、含干摩擦的旋转系统和实验室发酵罐三个实测系统上评估，每个系统分有/无描述两种条件、每种任务5次运行；30次运行均得到有效模型，单次成本0.96–3.38美元。作者自评显示，30个推荐模型（每次运行一个）在150个评估项中132项完全满足、18项部分满足；最常见问题是模型结构选择相关表述不准确或缺乏依据，出现在9个模型中。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可自主完成端到端非线性系统辨识并获得可用模型，成本与可靠性初步可接受；不足在于结构选择的论证质量，且评估为作者自评，需更严格的独立评测。

title: Partition, Refine, and Detect: Preserving Novel Category Capacity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) expects the model trained on base classes to recognize both base and novel classes at inference. Typical methods rely on CLIP-style vision-language embeddings, yet the learned space is often biased toward base categories, with limited effective capacity preserved for novel concepts. Such a base-dominated representation can compress novel semantics, leading to semantic collapse and mis-calibrated confidence at inference. To address this issue, we present PR-OVD, a partition-and-refine framework that explicitly reserves capacity for novel categories and strengthens category separation, while being seamlessly integrated into different detector architectures. Specifically, PR-OVD first performs coarse partitioning to build global divisions for base, novel, and an explicit background partition in both visual and textual modalities, preventing object-irrelevant embeddings from leaking into category-specific representations. It then applies category-level refinement within each partition to sharpen decision boundaries and alleviate the lack of fine-grained region-level pretraining in CLIP. To further provide reliable visual anchors for novel categories, we design a cognitively inspired Structure Prompt (SP) that encodes both egocentric attributes and allocentric context, facilitating stable partition-and-refine learning. Extensive experiments on two OVD benchmarks show that PR-OVD delivers an average 6.5\% proportional improvement on novel categories over the state-of-the-art methods. Notably, PR-OVD also benefits other open-vocabulary tasks, including segmentation and classification, further confirming its effectiveness and generality.

AI.tldr: 提出PR-OVD，一种"先划分再精炼"的框架：在视觉与文本模态中显式构建base/novel/背景三类全局分区，并在各分区内做类别级精炼，配合结构提示（SP）为新类提供可靠视觉锚点，缓解基类主导导致的语义坍缩与置信度失准。
AI.motivation: 现有OVD方法依赖CLIP式视觉-语言嵌入，但所学空间偏向基类，留给新概念的有效容量有限，基类主导的表征会压缩新类语义，导致推理时语义坍缩与置信度校准失准。
AI.method: 1) 粗粒度分区：在视觉与文本模态中为base、novel及显式背景建全局划分，阻止无关嵌入泄漏进类别专属表征；2) 类别级精炼：分区内锐化决策边界，弥补CLIP缺乏细粒度区域级预训练；3) 结构提示（SP）：认知启发式编码自我中心属性与他中心上下文，为新类提供稳定视觉锚点；框架可无缝嵌入不同检测器架构。
AI.result: 在两个OVD基准上，新类平均取得6.5%的比例提升（相对SOTA）；并迁移受益于分割、分类等其他开放词汇任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过为新类显式预留表征容量并进行分区精炼，可有效缓解基类主导的语义坍缩问题，且方法具通用性与架构可插拔性。

title: StatPrompt-LLM: A Lightweight Statistical Refinement for Foundation-Style Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting has recently seen a paradigm shift with the introduction of foundation-style models that adapt large pretrained language architectures to sequential data. However, effectively exposing fundamental temporal structures, such as trend, scale, and temporal dependence, to these models remains an open challenge, particularly when the available observations are limited. In this paper, we conduct an exploratory empirical study across different generations of forecasting architectures and propose StatPrompt-LLM, a lightweight statistical refinement of Time-LLM. StatPrompt-LLM augments the existing Time-LLM prompting mechanism with dataset-level statistical information and introduces a zero-initialised autoregressive bypass as a complementary linear forecasting pathway. We evaluate our framework on electricity and meteorological time-series benchmarks, including ETTh1, ETTh2, and Weather, under full-prefix and reduced-prefix configurations. Under the 10% reduced-prefix configuration, StatPrompt-LLM achieved lower in-sample prediction errors than Time-LLM, with unweighted average relative reductions across datasets of 40.2% in MSE and 21.4% in MAE. Full-prefix results were more dataset-dependent. Ablation analyses revealed relatively modest and dataset-dependent changes when selected additional statistical descriptor groups were masked within the combined architecture. Computational profiling indicated additional model parameters and runtime overhead relative to Time-LLM.

AI.tldr: StatPrompt-LLM 在 Time-LLM 基础上引入数据集级统计信息提示与零初始化自回归旁路，在缩减历史前缀（10%）设定下显著降低预测误差（MSE -40.2%，MAE -21.4%），但全前缀表现依赖数据集且带来额外参数与运行开销。
AI.motivation: 基于大预训练语言架构的时间序列基础模型难以有效表征趋势、尺度与时间依赖等基本时序结构，尤其在观测数据有限时更为突出。
AI.method: 开展跨代际预测架构的探索性实证研究；提出 StatPrompt-LLM——对 Time-LLM 的轻量统计化改进：在原有提示机制中注入数据集级统计信息，并引入零初始化自回归旁路作为辅助线性预测通路；在 ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather 上以全前缀与缩减前缀两种配置评估，并做消融与计算开销分析。
AI.result: 10% 缩减前缀下样本内预测误差低于 Time-LLM，各数据集未加权平均相对降幅为 MSE 40.2%、MAE 21.4%；全前缀结果更具数据集依赖性；遮蔽部分统计描述子组的消融显示变化温和且依赖数据集；计算剖析表明参数与运行时间相对 Time-LLM 有所增加。
AI.conclusion: 统计信息提示与线性旁路在数据受限场景下可有效增强 LLM 式预测器的时序结构感知能力，但收益非普适（取决于前缀长度与数据集），并以额外计算成本为代价，属于轻量、经验性的改进方案。

title: Tabular Foundation Models vs Tuned Gradient Boosting for Telecom Churn: A Profit- and Calibration-Aware Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables. Code, per-split predictions and reproducibility audit: https://github.com/ihpolash/tfm-churn-profit-audit (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24015719)
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict from a labelled context in a single forward pass. A recent benchmark reported that they decisively outperform tree ensembles for customer churn, but it compared them with untuned gradient-boosted trees (GBDTs) and scored only ranking metrics, while a retention campaign is judged in money. We re-evaluate TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 against Optuna-tuned GBDTs on five public telecom churn datasets over 10 seeded splits. We separate three questions: whether a model ranks churners well, whether that ranking earns more expected maximum profit (EMP), and whether its probabilities can drive a threshold policy. With a split-aware test and Holm correction over 20 pre-declared comparisons, TabPFN-3.5 earns significantly more EMP than the best tuned GBDT on Cell2Cell (1.9%) and Iranian (7.6%), and these two gains also hold against each of the three tuned GBDTs separately. On Orange it is ahead in all 10 splits (14.3%), but the gain is not significant after correction (Holm p = 0.155). The splits resample the same datasets, so these results do not stand for independent operators. TabICL v2, the earlier benchmark's leader, beats the best tuned GBDT only on Iranian, not all three of them, and underpredicts Orange churn by 2.1 points on a 7.3% base rate. On the datasets and splits where we tested them, a substantially larger tuning budget and a duplicate-aware split leave the main conclusions unchanged. Retuning the baseline cuts the earlier headline gap from 6.1 to 4.0 PR-AUC points without closing it. The licence of the TabPFN-3.5 weights we used (License v1.0), not scoring cost, is what stands between its gains and production use.

AI.tldr: 该论文在五个公开电信流失数据集、10个随机划分上，用Optuna调优的GBDT重新对标TabPFN-2.5/3.5/3.5-Fast与TabICL v2，并同时评估排序、期望最大利润(EMP)与阈值策略三类问题。经Holm校正后，TabPFN-3.5在Cell2Cell(1.9%)和Iranian(7.6%)上显著优于最佳调优GBDT；Orange上10/10划分领先(14.3%)但校正后不显著(p=0.155)。先前基准报告的"决定性优势"因未调优基线与仅用排序指标而被高估；调优基线将6.1 PR-AUC差距缩减至4.0点；TabPFN-3.5权重的License v1.0而非推理成本是落地障碍。
AI.motivation: 近期一项基准宣称表格基础模型(TFM)在客户流失预测上"决定性"优于树集成，但其基线为未调优的梯度提升树(GBDT)，且仅以排序类指标评分；而留存营销活动应以货币收益衡量。因此需要一个公平（调优基线）、面向利润（EMP）且兼顾决策阈值可用性的再评估。
AI.method: 在5个公开电信流失数据集上，使用10个带种子的划分，对比TabPFN-2.5、TabPFN-3.5、TabPFN-3.5-Fast、TabICL v2与经Optuna调优的三种GBDT。评估拆分为三问：排序质量(PR-AUC等)、期望最大利润(EMP)、概率能否支撑阈值决策策略。统计上采用划分感知的检验并对20项预声明比较做Holm校正；辅以更大调参预算与去重感知划分的稳健性检验。
AI.result: TabPFN-3.5在Cell2Cell(+1.9%)与Iranian(+7.6%)上显著获得更高EMP，且分别对三种调优GBDT单独对比亦成立；Orange上10/10划分领先(+14.3%)但Holm校正后不显著(p=0.155)。TabICL v2（原基准领先者）仅在Iranian上优于最佳调优GBDT，并非优于全部三种，且在7.3%基准流失率下对Orange低估2.1个百分点。加大调参预算与去重感知划分不改变主要结论；重调基线把原6.1点的PR-AUC领先差距缩至4.0点但未消除。各划分重采样自同一数据集，结果不代表独立运营方。
AI.conclusion: TFM相对调优GBDT的优势是数据集相关且幅度温和（1.9%–7.6%EMP，Orange不显著），远非"决定性"；原基准因基线未调优和只看排序指标而夸大结论。EMP与排序指标给出不同结论，需以利润口径评估。TFM落地的主要障碍是TabPFN-3.5权重的License v1.0而非打分成本，结论外推至独立运营商需谨慎。

title: DOBB: Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance under State Uncertainty and Heterogeneous Dynamics
summary: Learning-based decentralized collision avoidance must remain reliable under state-estimation uncertainty and heterogeneous agent dynamics. Existing methods typically address these factors through training-domain variation or by exposing uncertainty and capability estimates to the policy at runtime. However, both leave the policy to infer how these quantities should alter the physical separation required for safe interaction, which can couple collision-avoidance behavior to relationships learned from the training distribution. We introduce the Dynamic Oriented Bounding Box (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps the current state estimate, uncertainty, and agent-specific response characteristics into a dynamic, direction-dependent safety margin. We derive geometric features that jointly characterize the relative configuration and severity of interactions between agents' DOBBs, along with a reward function that preserves the physical interpretation of those interactions. Across four evaluation environments, DOBB achieves the lowest mean total failure rate of 2.6%. This performance persists under out-of-distribution shifts in actuation dynamics and state-estimation uncertainty, with collision-based failure remaining at or below 2.3% in every tested condition. We attribute this robustness to the geometric abstraction of the safety margin, which is less coupled to the specific uncertainty and actuation regimes encountered during training.

AI.tldr: 提出动态有向包围盒（DOBB），将状态估计、不确定性与智能体响应特性映射为方向相关的动态安全裕度，在四个环境中平均总失败率2.6%，分布外条件下碰撞失败率≤2.3%。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的去中心化避碰需在状态估计不确定性下保持可靠，且智能体动力学异构。现有方法通过训练域变化或将不确定性/能力估计直接输入策略，迫使策略自行推断这些量应如何改变安全间距，导致避碰行为与训练分布学到的关系耦合。
AI.method: 引入DOBB在线几何表示：把当前状态估计、不确定性以及智能体特有的响应特性映射为动态、方向相关的安全裕度；推导几何特征以联合刻画DOBB间相对构型与交互严重程度，并设计保持这些交互物理含义的奖励函数。
AI.result: 四个评估环境中平均总失败率最低为2.6%；在驱动动力学与状态估计不确定性的分布外偏移下性能保持，各测试条件碰撞类失败率均≤2.3%。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性归因于安全裕度的几何抽象，使策略与训练中遇到的具体不确定性和驱动机制耦合更弱。

title: Selective Surgical Action-Center Localization:Retaining Localization Gains through Supervised Scoring
summary: Surgical action-center localization requires both an accurate reference point and a decision about whether to report it. When frames with and without a reportable center are mixed, the benefit of improved localization depends on which correct candidates survive selection. We present a selective localization pipeline combining heatmap and coordinate supervision with a logistic-regression scorer. The scorer learns to identify predictions with a reportable center and a localization error within a specified tolerance. The internal evaluation uses 5,000 frames from 50 surgical sources, five source-grouped folds and two random seeds. Matched locator and scoring comparisons track correct candidates and their rejection. At an 80% acceptance quota per source and a tolerance of 0.10 times the image diagonal, our method retains 46.08 correct outputs per 100 inputs. The baseline locator with the same scoring approach retains 44.20. The gain is 1.88 (descriptive 95% source-paired bootstrap interval, 0.94 to 2.79). Under entropy-based selection, increased rejection of correct predictions offsets the higher supply of correct predictions on average. For the coordinate-supervised locator, supervised scoring reduces these rejections from 6.15 to 2.99 per 100 inputs. Evaluating retained correct outputs reveals whether a selection rule preserves or erodes an improvement in localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“选择性定位”流程：将热图与坐标监督的定位器与逻辑回归评分器结合，按来源在80%接受配额下筛选出误差在容差内且可报告的预测中心，并以“每100个输入中保留的正确输出数”衡量定位改进能否在被筛选后依然存留。
AI.motivation: 手术动作中心定位既需要准确的参考点，也需要决定是否报告该中心。当含可报告中心与不含可报告中心的帧混合时，仅提高定位精度并不必然带来收益，关键在于改进后的正确候选在筛选过程（拒绝机制）中能否存活。因此需要一个同时评估定位质量与选择规则的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建选择性定位流水线：定位器同时采用热图监督与坐标监督；在其上训练逻辑回归评分器，学习识别同时满足“存在可报告中心”且“定位误差在指定容差内”的预测。内部评估使用来自50个手术来源的5,000帧，采用五个按来源分组的折与两个随机种子；设置定位器与评分的匹配对照实验，追踪正确候选及其被拒绝情况；比较监督评分与熵-based 选择策略。
AI.result: 在每来源80%接受配额、容差为图像对角线0.10倍的设定下，本方法每100个输入保留46.08个正确输出，而采用相同评分方式的基线定位器为44.20，增益1.88（描述性95%来源配对bootstrap区间0.94–2.79）。在熵-based 选择下，对正确预测的更多拒绝在平均意义上抵消了正确预测供给的增加；对坐标监督定位器，监督评分将这类拒绝从每100个输入6.15次降至2.99次。
AI.conclusion: 对“保留的正确输出”进行评估能够揭示某条选择规则是保住了还是侵蚀了定位改进。提升定位精度本身不足以保证下游收益，评分器的选择行为会显著改变实际可用输出，故应以保留正确输出数为核心指标来联合评价定位与选择。

title: MADSNet: A Multi-Scale Axial-Attentive Dense Spiking Network for Spike Camera Image Reconstruction
summary: Spike cameras encode dynamic scenes into high-temporal-resolution binary spike streams for efficient high-speed vision. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process such signals with sparse and accumulate-only computation, existing SNN-based reconstruction methods are typically shallow and still lag behind ANN-based models in reconstruction fidelity. This paper proposes MADSNet, a Multi-scale Axial-attentive Dense Spiking Network for spike camera image reconstruction. MADSNet adopts a hierarchical spiking encoder--decoder, where a multi-scale spike stem extracts early features, axial spike attention captures long-range dependencies, a dense spiking bottleneck enhances feature reuse, and a spike-to-continuous decoder reconstructs continuous intensity images from spike-domain representations. Experiments on gray-scale and color spike reconstruction show that MADSNet outperforms SSIR by 4.3 dB PSNR and Spk2ImgNet by 1.94 dB on SREDS. Compared with Spk2ImgNet, it achieves about 15$\times$ lower latency and uses only about 1/40 of the estimated energy, demonstrating that carefully designed SNN architectures can improve reconstruction quality while preserving computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出MADSNet——一种多尺度轴向注意力密集脉冲网络，用于脉冲相机图像重建，在提升重建保真度的同时保持SNN的计算效率优势。
AI.motivation: 脉冲相机将动态场景编码为高时间分辨率的二值脉冲流以实现高效高速视觉；SNN可以稀疏、仅累加地处理此类信号，但现有SNN重建方法通常较浅，重建保真度仍落后于ANN模型。
AI.method: MADSNet采用分层脉冲编码器-解码器架构：多尺度脉冲stem提取早期特征；轴向脉冲注意力捕获长程依赖；密集脉冲瓶颈增强特征复用；脉冲到连续域解码器从脉冲域表示重建连续强度图像。
AI.result: 在灰度与彩色脉冲重建实验中，MADSNet在SREDS上较SSIR提升4.3 dB PSNR，较Spk2ImgNet提升1.94 dB；相比Spk2ImgNet延迟降低约15倍，估算能耗仅约1/40。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的SNN架构能够在保持计算效率的同时提升重建质量，说明SNN在脉冲相机高速成像重建中具备替代ANN-based方法的潜力。

title: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
summary: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. On LeaFBench, SetPrint consistently outperforms existing training-free black-box fingerprinting methods. Further analyses attribute these gains to both within-set relations and between-set correspondence.

AI.tldr: SetPrint：一种无需训练的黑盒LLM指纹方法，通过同时建模扰动响应变化集合的"集合内关系"与"集合间对应关系"来判定模型血缘，在LeaFBench上稳定优于现有无训练方法。
AI.motivation: 黑盒指纹需仅凭输出响应判断目标模型是否源自源模型。现有做法对每个查询施加扰动、比较两模型的响应变化集合，但只利用了其中一部分信息：或关注集合内各响应变化之间的关系，或关注两集合间同一扰动引起的响应变化对应性，未能同时充分利用这两类互补信息。
AI.method: 提出SetPrint，训练-free方法：(1) 将每个响应变化表示为相对于其所属集合平均变化的相对量（中心化/归一化），以刻画集合内关系；(2) 对由同一扰动在两模型上产生的响应变化进行跨集合比较，以刻画集合间对应关系；二者联合构成指纹判定信号，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在LeaFBench上，SetPrint一致地优于现有无需训练的黑盒指纹方法；消融/进一步分析表明性能提升同时归因于集合内关系与集合间对应关系两部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用集合内关系与集合间对应性是提升黑盒LLM指纹有效性的关键；SetPrint以无训练、简单可复用的方式实现该思路，并验证了两类信息的互补价值。

title: How Much of Your VLA Is kNN
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, accepted to the CoRL 2026 G2A/TAG workshop
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models now exceed 95% success on the LIBERO simulation benchmark, yet it remains unclear how much of this performance requires generalization beyond the training demonstrations. In this work, we show that retrieving nearby demonstrations and reusing their action chunks achieves a success rate of 91.7 % on LIBERO without policy training. Under LIBERO-Plus perturbations, retrieval shows the smallest drop of all evaluated policies. Across nine publicly available VLAs, fine-tuning mostly makes the vision-language backbone a better retrieval key, and the actions of the VLAs remain close to the demonstrations. In addition, we introduce Local Action Consistency (LAC), an offline metric that measures whether nearby observations in representation space are also associated with similar future actions. We show that LAC tracks the success rate of retrieval and can guide the training of a retrieval key. Our evaluation and source code are available at https://github.com/sereact/lerobot_knn.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出 LIBERO 上 VLA 模型超过 95% 的成功率很大程度上源于对训练示教的检索式复用而非泛化；仅用最近邻示教的动作块复用（无需策略训练）即可达 91.7% 成功率，并提出 Local Action Consistency (LAC) 离线指标来刻画表征空间近邻观测是否对应相似未来动作。
AI.motivation: VLA 在 LIBERO 仿真基准上已超 95% 成功率，但尚不清楚这一性能在多大程度上依赖对训练示教的记忆/近邻复用，而非真正的泛化能力。需要一种去训练化的基线来界定"检索可解释的性能上限"。
AI.method: 构建无训练检索基线：从训练示教中检索邻近样本并复用其 action chunk（kNN 式动作拷贝）。在 LIBERO 及 LIBERO-Plus 扰动下与九个公开 VLA 对比；分析微调对视觉-语言骨干表征（作为检索键）的影响及 VLA 输出与示教动作的接近程度；提出离线指标 LAC，衡量表征空间中近邻观测是否对应相似的未来动作，并用其指导检索键的训练。
AI.result: 检索基线在 LIBERO 上达 91.7% 成功率且无需策略训练；在 LIBERO-Plus 扰动下，检索方法的性能下降在所有评测策略中最小。九个公开 VLA 的微调主要使 VLM 骨干成为更好的检索键，其输出动作仍接近示教数据；LAC 与检索成功率呈良好相关性，可有效指导检索键训练。
AI.conclusion: LIBERO 上的高成功率存在明显的示教近邻复用成分，检索式基线是评估 VLA 必须报告的对照；LAC 为表征-动作一致性提供了可用的离线代理指标。代码与评测已开源（github.com/sereact/lerobot_knn）。

title: Trajectory-Regularized Distribution Distillation for One-Step Generation
summary: Distilling flow matching models for one-step generation generally follows two paradigms. Trajectory alignment supervises the student with the teacher's probability flow ODE, but its performance degrades under very small sampling budgets. Distribution matching directly optimizes the generated distribution, but estimating its reverse Kullback-Leibler gradient typically requires a separate network to track the evolving student score. We propose trajectory-regularized distribution distillation (TRD), which combines distribution-level and trajectory-level supervision through a momentum-mixture policy predicted in a single student forward pass. This policy serves simultaneously as a one-step generator, an estimator of the student's marginal velocity that removes the need for a second trainable network in distribution matching, and a closed-form time-dependent velocity field supervised along the teacher ODE trajectory. Experiments on SANA-1.6B and Stable Diffusion 3.5 show that TRD outperforms representative consistency and distribution matching baselines in generation quality and training efficiency for both one-step and few-step generation, with a trade-off in sample diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹正则化分布蒸馏（TRD），用单次前向预测的动量混合策略同时充当一步生成器、学生边缘速度估计器与闭式时变速度场，将分布级与轨迹级监督统一，在SANA-1.6B与SD3.5上于生成质量与训练效率上优于一致性蒸馏与分布匹配基线，但样本多样性存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型一步生成的两类蒸馏范式各有缺陷：轨迹对齐以教师概率流ODE监督学生，在极小采样预算下性能退化；分布匹配直接优化生成分布，但其反向KL梯度估计通常需额外网络追踪不断演变的学生得分函数，增加训练开销与复杂度。作者希望兼取二者之长而规避其短。
AI.method: 提出TRD框架，核心是学生单次前向即可预测的"动量混合策略"（momentum-mixture policy），该策略一物三用：(1) 作为一步生成器；(2) 作为学生边缘速度的估计器，从而在分布匹配中免除第二个可训练网络；(3) 作为沿教师ODE轨迹监督的闭式时变速度场。借此将分布级监督与轨迹级监督耦合于同一参数化中。
AI.result: 在SANA-1.6B与Stable Diffusion 3.5上的实验表明，TRD在一步与少步生成的生成质量和训练效率上均优于代表性的一致性蒸馏与分布匹配基线，代价是样本多样性上的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 分布匹配与轨迹对齐并非互斥，可通过统一的动量混合策略参数化实现互补；TRD在无需额外教师/辅助网络的前提下取得质量与效率优势，但需正视多样性下降的固有权衡，后续可针对多样性-保真度平衡进一步改进。

title: Third Eye: Beyond Immediate Gains in Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Does a useful self-update remain useful after the model updates again? Third Eye separates immediate performance from the outcome of a further native update. We evaluate five 3-8B backbones on math and code: 64 fresh runs, three candidates per run, and three continuations per candidate. Selection and final scoring use disjoint items. In the balanced Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B comparison, immediate-selected utility is near zero, but continuation reduces it by 1.78 percentage points (simultaneous 95% interval [0.68, 2.88]). Candidate-averaged immediate utility is already negative: selection partly accounts for the apparently neutral first step. Continuation also lowers utility for SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.1-8B; Qwen3-8B remains inconclusive. Target and out-of-distribution losses dominate retention changes. Matched recipe and recipient-donor controls identify neither a reliable mitigation nor a single mechanism. The results support evaluating persistent self-updates as adaptation transitions, with independent scoring and a no-update baseline, rather than interpreting immediate performance as their full value.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"Third Eye"评估框架，将自更新模型的即时性能与其再次原生更新后的持久效用分离考察，发现即时看似中性的自更新在后续更新后效用下降。
AI.motivation: 现有自更新（self-update）研究多以单次更新后的即时性能衡量其价值，但忽略了模型之后再更新一次时，先前更新的效用是否仍然保留，即"即时有用"未必等于"持久有用"。
AI.method: 在数学与代码任务上评估5个3–8B骨干模型；共64次全新运行，每次运行3个候选、每个候选3次延续（continuation）。选择与最终评分使用互不重叠的数据项（disjoint items），并设置无更新基线与候选平均口径；结合匹配配方及接收者-供体对照实验探查机制与缓解手段。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B平衡对比中，被即时选中的效用接近零，但延续后下降1.78个百分点（同时95%区间[0.68, 2.88]）；候选平均的即时效用已为负，说明选择过程部分解释了首步的"中性"表象。SmolLM3-3B与Llama-3.1-8B延续后效用同样下降，Qwen3-8B结论不确定。目标损失与分布外损失主导了保留率变化；匹配配方与接收者-供体对照既未找到可靠缓解方法，也未识别出单一机制。
AI.conclusion: 应将持久性自更新作为"适应转变"来评估，采用独立评分与无更新基线，而不应把即时性能视为其全部价值。

title: Agent Architecture Cost-Success Trade-offs: A Controlled Evaluation across Enterprise-Style SOPs
summary: Enterprises increasingly use large language model agents to execute standard operating procedures (SOPs): long, branching, tool-intensive workflows. Yet there is little controlled evidence for choosing among competing agentic architectures. Holding the model, tasks, and tools fixed and varying only the architecture, we compare four designs (a function-calling single agent, a skill-augmented agent, centralized multi-agent orchestration, and a triage swarm; eight arms) across 13 enterprise SOPs, and introduce a skill-definition quality rubric to build matched high and low-quality skill corpora. Three takeaways emerge. (1)~\textbf{There is no universal best architecture; the right choice is SOP-dependent.} On a given SOP, task success ranges from under $10\%$ on the hardest to near $100\%$ on the easiest; no architecture is statistically separable in aggregate, and added structure only plausibly pays off on complex, branching SOPs (a directional, not yet significant, trend). (2)~\textbf{Added architecture cost must be justified by a task-success gain.} Every coordinated arm (multi-agent or skill-augmented) spends $1.4$--$4.7\times$ the tokens and $2.6$--$5.8\times$ the latency of the single agent for gains that are usually small and rarely significant, making the single agent the efficient default; high-quality skills do lift success (to $73.1\%$ from $67.4\%$) while degraded skills fall below it. (3)~\textbf{Implementation quality outweighs the single- versus multi-agent choice.} A plausible multi-agent implementation loses to the single agent, yet a targeted redesign of it becomes the only arm to significantly beat the baseline ($75.6\%$ vs.\ $67.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 在固定模型、任务与工具、仅改变架构的受控实验中，对比四类agent架构（8个实验臂）于13个企业SOP；结论是：不存在普适最优架构，架构选择依赖SOP，额外架构成本须由任务成功率提升来证明，且实现质量比"单agent还是多agent"的选择更重要。
AI.motivation: 企业日益用LLM agent执行SOP（长流程、分支多、工具密集），但缺乏在竞争性agent架构间做选择的受控证据，实践中架构选型多为经验驱动。
AI.method: 控制变量实验设计：固定模型、任务与工具，仅变化架构；比较四种设计（函数调用单agent、技能增强agent、集中式多agent编排、triage swarm），共8个实验臂，覆盖13个企业SOP；并提出"技能定义质量评分量表"，据此构建高质量与低质量相匹配的技能语料库；以任务成功率、token消耗、延迟为主要指标，并以显著性检验判断差异。
AI.result: (1) 无普适最优架构：同一SOP上成功率从最难<10%到最易近100%，整体上无架构具统计可分性，增加结构仅在复杂分支SOP上呈方向性（尚不显著）收益。(2) 协调型臂（多agent或技能增强）token为单agent的1.4–4.7倍、延迟为2.6–5.8倍，收益小且少有显著性，单agent是高效默认；高质量技能将成功率从67.4%提升至73.1%，而劣化技能则低于基线。(3) 实现质量胜过架构选择：一个看似合理的多agent实现输给单agent，但经针对性重构后成为唯一显著优于基线的臂（75.6% vs. 67.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 架构规模化并非自动带来收益；应以SOP特性与成本-收益权衡为先，默认采用单agent，仅在复杂分支任务上审慎引入结构，并把投入重心放在实现与技能定义质量上。研究为"技能质量量表"与受控对比协议提供了可复用方法，但多架构优势仍属方向性证据，需更多SOP与重复实验验证。

title: Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control for Underactuated Upright Physical Assistance
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), October 2026. 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Many rehabilitation robots execute prescribed motions using reactive tracking controllers that do not explicitly incorporate the user's instantaneous human-ground interaction. This paper presents Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control (GRF-MPC), a framework for upright physical assistance. By integrating live GRF and center of pressure (CoP) measurements directly into a human centroidal dynamics model, GRF-MPC formulates a real-time quadratic program (QP) that optimizes assistive forces and moments over a receding horizon. We deployed GRF-MPC on the Robotic Upright Stand Trainer (RobUST) in an underactuated 4-cable configuration and evaluated it against a fully actuated 8-cable Cartesian impedance baseline in nearly 300 trials across six healthy participants. Across tasks spanning impulsive perturbations, lunge trajectories, and voluntary limits of stability, GRF-MPC reduced peak planar center-of-mass (CoM) error by 19.6% during perturbations, lowered trajectory tracking error by 24.1%, required 28.7% less net mechanical work, and permitted a 45.9% greater normalized voluntary excursion area. The underlying QP solves in under 1 ms, comfortably enabling 100 Hz replanning and demonstrating that incorporating live human-ground interaction into predictive control yields stronger, more transparent physical assistance with half the actuators.

AI.tldr: 提出GRF-MPC——将实时地面反力与压力中心测量融入人体质心动力学模型的预测控制框架，仅用4根欠驱动线缆即实现优于8线缆全驱动阻抗基线的直立辅助效果。
AI.motivation: 现有康复机器人多采用反应式跟踪控制器执行预设轨迹，未显式纳入用户瞬时的人-地交互信息，导致辅助力"盲目"、不透明且依赖高驱动冗余。
AI.method: 将实时GRF与CoP测量直接集成到人体质心动力学模型中，构建滚动时域上优化辅助力与力矩的实时二次规划（QP）；在RobUST平台的4线缆欠驱动构型上部署，并与8线缆全驱动笛卡尔阻抗基线对比，六名健康被试、近300次试验，任务含脉冲扰动、弓步轨迹与自主稳定极限。
AI.result: 扰动下平面CoM峰值误差降低19.6%，轨迹跟踪误差降低24.1%，净机械功减少28.7%，归一化自主活动面积增大45.9%；QP求解耗时小于1 ms，支撑100 Hz重规划。
AI.conclusion: 将实时人-地交互纳入预测控制，可在驱动数量减半的条件下提供更强且更透明的物理辅助，验证了GRF感知MPC用于直立康复辅助的可行性与实时性。

title: Evidence-Grounded Iterative Reasoning for the Diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases
summary: Overlapping imaging manifestations complicate the differential diagnosis of Diffuse Cystic Lung Diseases (DCLDs), while limited annotated data constrain supervised model development. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can integrate imaging and clinical information, but their diagnostic reasoning remains limited by incomplete volumetric perception and insufficient grounding in disease-specific evidence. We propose DCLDs-EIR, an evidence-grounded iterative reasoning framework coupling diagnostic hypothesis refinement with multimodal evidence acquisition and verification. Multiview renderings of predicted lung and cyst segmentations characterize global cyst distributions and initialize the differential diagnosis. Competing hypotheses guide axial CT inspection to identify local findings that, together with clinical context, inform retrieval from a disease-specific knowledge graph. Accumulated patient observations and retrieved knowledge are jointly assessed for diagnostic support and refutation to revise the diagnostic state. Updated hypotheses and unresolved distinctions guide subsequent inspection, forming a feedback loop between evidence acquisition and hypothesis verification. Multicenter evaluation demonstrates that DCLDs-EIR consistently improves diagnostic accuracy over baselines and enables traceable differential diagnosis through explicit links between diagnostic hypotheses, patient observations, and disease-specific knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出DCLDs-EIR——一个证据驱动的迭代推理框架，将诊断假设细化与多模态证据获取、验证耦合，用于弥漫性囊性肺疾病（DCLDs）的鉴别诊断。
AI.motivation: DCLDs影像表现重叠导致鉴别诊断困难，且标注数据有限制约了监督式模型的发展；多模态大模型（MLLMs）虽能整合影像与临床信息，但其诊断推理受限于体数据感知不完整以及缺乏疾病特异性证据支撑。
AI.method: 以预测的肺与囊腔分割的多视角渲染表征全局囊腔分布并初始化鉴别诊断；由竞争性假设引导轴位CT局部观察，结合临床背景从疾病特异性知识图谱中检索信息；将累积的患者观察与检索知识联合评估诊断支持与反驳以更新诊断状态；更新后的假设与未决鉴别点驱动后续观察，形成证据获取与假设验证的闭环反馈。
AI.result: 多中心评估显示DCLDs-EIR相对基线持续提升诊断准确率，并通过诊断假设、患者观察与疾病特异性知识间的显式关联实现可追溯的鉴别诊断。
AI.conclusion: 将假设细化与证据获取—验证循环耦合、并以知识图谱作支撑，可有效缓解DCLDs重叠表现与标注稀缺问题，同时提升诊断可解释性与可追溯性。

title: Multimodal Graph Learning: A Survey of Models, Benchmarks, and Frontiers
summary: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), in which nodes carry text, images, and other modalities while edges encode relations among entities, underlie e-commerce, social media, content platforms, and creative applications. Learning on MAGs has developed along two complementary lines: graph-centric methods redesign how modalities are fused, propagated, and connected within message passing, while foundation-model-centric methods pretrain transferable multimodal graph encoders or bring graph context into multimodal large language models for prediction and generation. In parallel, several benchmarks have appeared with different datasets and evaluation protocols. This survey takes an algorithm-centric and evaluation-grounded view of the field and makes three contributions. Modeling: we introduce a unified message-passing formulation and organize methods into five integration levels (feature, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation model), covering discriminative and graph-conditioned generative models; within this formulation we derive representative methods as special cases, compare their assumptions, expressiveness, and cost, and identify cross-modal sensitivity as a property that separates otherwise similar architectures. Datasets and evaluation: we review recent benchmarks, summarize their datasets and metrics, define model-independent descriptors (label homophily, average degree, clustering, and edge provenance), and map each evaluation protocol to the baselines it uses. Frontiers: we connect multimodal graph learning to AI agents, covering the multimodal graphs that agents perceive and remember and graph engineering, the practice of organizing agent workflows as explicit graphs; we then discuss open problems, concrete efforts for the community, and research directions, including when graph structure helps in the presence of strong multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该综述以"算法中心+评估导向"视角系统梳理多模态属性图(MAG)学习，提出统一消息传递形式化并把方法归为五个集成层级，同时整合数据集、评估协议与前沿方向。
AI.motivation: MAG广泛支撑电商、社交媒体、内容平台与创意应用；现有研究分化为图中心方法与基础模型中心方法两条互补路线，且已有基准在数据集与评估协议上各不相同，缺乏统一的算法形式化与评估对齐视角。
AI.method: (1)建模：提出统一的消息传递公式，将方法按集成层级分为特征、传播、拓扑、学习、基础模型五级，覆盖判别式与图条件生成模型，把代表性方法推导为该公式的特例，比较其假设、表达力与代价，并提出跨模态敏感性作为区分相似架构的属性；(2)数据集与评估：综述近期基准，汇总数据集与指标，定义与模型无关的描述符（标签同质性、平均度、聚类系数、边来源），并将各评估协议映射到其使用的基线；(3)前沿：连接AI智能体（感知与记忆的多模态图、图工程），并讨论开放问题与研究方向。
AI.result: 形成三级贡献体系：统一形式化框架及五级分类学、模型无关的数据集描述符与"协议—基线"映射表、以及与智能体和图工程相连的前沿议题清单（含强多模态基础模型下图结构何时有效的开放问题）。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为MAG学习提供了统一算法框架与评估对齐工具，指出跨模态敏感性等关键属性，并提出社区可落地的努力方向与未来研究议题。

title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled weight-space programming (WSP), which directly generates neural network weights without gradient-based optimization. However, extending WSP to physical problems remains challenging, particularly in achieving both solution accuracy and physical consistency. In this paper, we propose Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that extends WSP to solving partial differential equations by directly generating neural network weights and editing architectures based on governing equations and initial and boundary conditions.
