PtW introduces physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing, combined with iterative weight refinement from WSP, to improve solution accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization. Experiments on four PDEs, namely the heat, advection, Burgers', and Allen--Cahn equations, demonstrate lower solution errors than conventional physics-informed neural networks, while revealing limitations in satisfying the governing equations for nonlinear PDEs.

AI.tldr: 提出Physics2Weight (PtW)框架，将权重空间编程（WSP）扩展到偏微分方程求解：基于控制方程与初边值条件直接生成网络权重并编辑架构，无需梯度优化即可提升解精度与物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 大模型带来的权重空间编程可直接生成网络权重而无需梯度优化，但将其扩展到物理问题仍困难：难以同时保证解的精度与物理一致性（满足控制方程）。
AI.method: PtW包含三部分：(1) 物理约束提示（physics-constrained prompting）；(2) 物理引导的架构编辑（physics-guided architecture editing）；(3) 结合WSP的迭代权重精化。输入为控制方程及初边值条件，输出为直接生成的网络权重。
AI.result: 在热方程、平流方程、Burgers方程与Allen–Cahn方程四个PDE上，解误差低于传统PINN；但在非线性PDE上满足控制方程方面存在局限。
AI.conclusion: WSP可作为一种无梯度的PDE求解范式并具精度优势，但物理一致性（尤其非线性PDE的方程残差）仍是待解决瓶颈。

title: Latent Barrier Steering: Hierarchical Safety for Generative Planning
summary: We introduce Latent Barrier Steering (LBS), a hierarchical semantic-to-path framework for safe flow-matching-based generative planning. Existing control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filters for diffusion and flow-matching planners act locally on generated samples, either during sampling or after prediction. Such repair is effective for small violations, but can struggle when a new constraint blocks the whole selected behavior mode rather than merely perturbing it locally. LBS decouples behavior selection from path certification through two coordinated interventions: it first steers the generator's behavior latent toward rollouts with larger safety margin, then decodes the steered latent and applies a path-space CBF quadratic program (QP) only for residual violations. We show that latent steering increases the margin available to the path-space corrector, yielding finite-time recovery guarantees and reduced correction burden. Experiments across navigation and robot end-effector planning tasks show that LBS preserves safety while improving goal reaching and reducing correction burden compared with path-level safety filters.

AI.tldr: 提出分层语义到路径框架 LBS（Latent Barrier Steering），先在生成器的行为隐空间 steering 使 rollout 具有更大安全裕度，再对解码路径用 CBF-QP 处理残余违规，从而在流匹配生成规划中兼顾安全性与目标可达性。
AI.motivation: 现有用于扩散/流匹配规划器的控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器仅在采样中或预测后对生成样本做局部修正。此类修复对小幅违规有效，但当新约束整体阻断所选行为模式（而非局部扰动）时，局部修复难以奏效。
AI.method: LBS 将行为选择与路径认证解耦，采用两级协同干预：(1) 将生成器的行为隐变量朝安全性裕度更大的 rollout 方向 steering；(2) 解码 steering 后的隐变量，仅对残余违规施加路径空间 CBF 二次规划（QP）修正。论文进一步证明隐空间 steering 可增大路径空间校正器可用的裕度。
AI.result: 理论上给出有限时间恢复保证，并说明校正负担降低；在导航与机器人末端执行器规划任务上，与路径级安全滤波器相比，LBS 在保持安全性的同时提升了目标到达率并减少了校正负担。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义层行为 steering 与路径层 CBF 认证分层结合，LBS 缓解了纯局部安全滤波在行为模式整体不可行时的失效问题，为安全生成式规划提供了可证明的有限时间恢复能力与更高的样本效率。

title: TIB: Sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck for Multimodal Attribution beyond Alignment Assumption
summary: Multimodal (e.g. vision-language, in this work) attribution aims to interpret the models without access to ground-truth explanatory supervision. Existing multimodal attribution methods typically rely on paired modalities as proxy supervision, implicitly assuming that image-text pairs are semantically aligned. Information bottleneck (IB)-based attribution methods follow this general paradigm and instantiate it through a global sufficiency-compression objective. In realistic multimodal datasets, however, this assumption is frequently violated due to partial semantic misalignment and unreliable cross-modal correspondences. Through theoretical analysis, we show that, under such misalignment, information-bottleneck-based attribution objectives exhibit a structural limitation: by assuming equal reliability across all proxy supervision signals, they induce posterior over-contraction and forced explanations. To address this issue, we propose TIB, a sample-wise Tempered Information Bottleneck framework that adaptively modulates attribution strength according to cross-modal reliability, without assuming semantic alignment. Extensive experiments on controlled benchmarks and large-scale datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed approach, while also validating the identified failure mode.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态归因中"图文语义对齐"假设在真实数据中常被违背的问题，本文从理论上揭示基于信息瓶颈（IB）的归因目标在跨模态错配下存在后验过度收缩与"强迫解释"的结构性缺陷，提出样本级温度化信息瓶颈框架TIB，依据跨模态可靠性自适应调节归因强度，在受控基准与大规模数据集上验证了有效性并证实了该失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言归因方法普遍将图像-文本对作为代理监督，隐含假设配对模态语义对齐；而IB类方法通过全局充分性-压缩目标实例化该范式，等权信任所有代理监督信号。真实多模态数据中存在部分语义错配与不可靠跨模态对应，该假设常被违背，导致归因结果失真。
AI.method: 理论分析：在错配条件下证明基于IB的归因目标因假设所有代理监督等可靠而产生后验过度收缩（posterior over-contraction）与强迫解释（forced explanations）的结构性局限。方法：提出TIB（Tempered Information Bottleneck），一种样本级（sample-wise）信息瓶颈框架，不依赖语义对齐假设，按照样本的跨模态可靠性自适应地调节归因强度（温度化），替代全局统一的压缩-充分性权衡。
AI.result: 在受控基准（controlled benchmarks）与大规模数据集上的大量实验表明所提方法有效，同时实验验证了所识别的失效模式（IB归因在错配下的过度收缩）确实存在。
AI.conclusion: 多模态归因不应默认图文对齐；将可靠性建模引入IB目标、以样本级温度化替代全局等权压缩，可缓解强迫解释问题，为无真值解释监督下的多模态归因提供更稳健的范式。

title: Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
summary: Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出四阶段贝叶斯流程，将"线性探针准确性"拆解为可解码性、形状、归属与因果使用四项主张分别检验；在GPT-J、Llama 3.1、Pythia三个模型的两/三位数算术任务中，发现81%的形状为"继承"而非概念自有，且形状干预仅需≤5维即可保留约61%的探针干预效果。
AI.motivation: 线性探针常用于从大模型激活中读取螺旋、圆等几何结构，并常被当作"模型以此结构进行计算"的证据。但探针准确率混淆了四类独立主张（可解码、具备特定形状、形状归属于被探针概念、输出依赖该形状），单凭准确率会高估模型实际使用的计算结构，因此需要一个能将四项主张分离检验的框架。
AI.method: 构建四阶段贝叶斯流水线：阶段2在候选形状（螺旋/ribbon/圆环/环面等）间比较，仅当证据超过预设阈值时才选定最佳形状；阶段3预先指定一组相关概念并从表示中剔除，判定形状是"自有"（owned）还是"继承"（inherited）；阶段4对形状施加干预，检验模型输出是否因果依赖该形状。实证对象为GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B、Pythia 6.9B，任务为两位数加法与乘法。
AI.result: 几乎所有概念均可解码，但解码方向在概念间高度重叠；所有证据强的形状比较均选中ribbon（半径随数值变化的螺旋）或环面。在1,330个给出归属判定的单元中，19%为自有形状、81%为继承形状；自有与继承形状对输出的影响频率大致相当。形状干预在使用≤5个维度时仍保留约61%的全探针干预效应，而探针干预所需维度中位数为9。
AI.conclusion: 单一探针准确率会夸大模型实际用于计算的结构（大量"形状"实为继承自相关概念而非概念自有）。作者建议探针研究应以对四项主张的分别判定结果进行报告，而非仅报告一个准确率数字。

title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
summary: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). Building on this view, we introduce the Embodied Science Agent (ESA), which unifies digital intelligence with physical embodiment through three synergistic components: a Digital Agent that provides cognitive and experimental learnability via memory-based reasoning and Bayesian optimisation, an Embodied Agent that provides embodied learnability via generalisable instrument control, and an Embodied Unified Interface for seamless coordination. We validated ESA in autonomous wastewater treatment experiments, navigating over 200 million possible conditions. Through 15 continuous rounds, ESA raised the final solution transmittance from 82\% to 99.7\%, corresponding to a 98.5\% reduction in residual dye concentration and near-complete decolourisation, while its learned visuomotor policies generalised across varying instrument placements, a promising step toward next-generation SDLs for autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出"具身科学智能体（ESA）"，将数字智能与物理具身统一，在自驱动实验室中打通计算推理与物理实验的闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有自驱动实验室（SDLs）存在根本悖论：基础模型集成提升了语言表达 sophistication，却切断了物理接地（physical grounding）。将模型视为"离身规划器"、输出符号化工作流交由独立机器人系统执行，从架构上阻碍了具身实验直觉的形成。因此需要沿认知可学习性（学什么）、实验可学习性（在哪搜索）、具身可学习性（如何行动）三条相互依赖的轴嵌入"可学习性"，以闭合计算推理与物理实验的环路。
AI.method: 提出 ESA，由三个协同组件构成：①数字智能体（Digital Agent），通过基于记忆的推理与贝叶斯优化提供认知与实验可学习性；②具身智能体（Embodied Agent），通过可泛化的仪器操控能力提供具身可学习性；③具身统一接口（Embodied Unified Interface），实现两者的无缝协调。
AI.result: 在自主废水处理实验中验证，实验空间覆盖超 2 亿种可能条件。经 15 轮连续实验，最终解透光率由 82% 提升至 99.7%，对应残余染料浓度降低 98.5%，实现近乎完全脱色；所学视觉运动策略可跨不同仪器摆放位置泛化。
AI.conclusion: ESA 表明以具身可学习性重构 SDL 架构可有效闭合推理—实验闭环，是迈向下一代自主科学发现自驱动实验室的有前景的一步。

title: Incorporating World Models in Decision Making for Next Best View Selection in Active Sensing
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 Workshop "Do Robots Need World Models?"
summary: Efficient robotic 3D reconstruction requires selecting views that contribute new surface measurements with few physical captures. Pretrained world models can guide this choice, but a predicted surface may not produce valid depth measurements under the operating conditions of the deployed sensor. We present a deployment adaptation methodology for next-best-view selection that learns a sensor-return adapter from limited local calibration data while keeping the pretrained predictor fixed. The adapter estimates measurement dropout over each predicted surface, allowing the selection method to favor views likely to fill gaps in the measured reconstruction. In a real-robot experiment with a structured-light sensor, the adapted method achieves higher measured surface coverage with 60% fewer captures than nominal selection. The adapted method recovers a surface region that the nominal method repeatedly targets but fails to measure. These results suggest that robots can reuse pretrained predictive models while adapting their decisions to local operating conditions in data-scarce environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向部署的下一最佳视角选择方法：固定预训练预测器，仅用少量本地标定数据学习传感器回波适配器，估计预测表面的测量缺失，从而优先选择能填补重建缺口的视角；实机结构化光传感实验中以少60%拍摄次数获得更高实测覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 高效机器人3D重建需在少量物理拍摄下选出能带来新表面测量的视角。预训练世界模型可指导选择，但其预测表面在实际传感器工作条件下未必能产生有效深度测量，导致名义选择策略反复瞄准却测不到的区域。
AI.method: 部署适配方法：保持预训练预测器冻结，从有限本地标定数据中学习一个传感器回波适配器，对每个预测表面估计测量缺失（dropout）概率；将缺失估计纳入下一最佳视角选择，使选点倾向填补实测重建中的空洞。
AI.result: 在结构化光传感器的真实机器人实验中，适配方法相比名义选择在拍摄次数减少60%的情况下获得更高的实测表面覆盖率，并成功恢复出名义方法反复瞄准却始终测不到的表面区域。
AI.conclusion: 机器人可在数据稀缺环境下复用预训练预测模型，同时将决策适配到本地实际运行条件；只需少量标定即可修正模型预测与实际传感器回波之间的偏差。

title: PhysMoE: Fast Spatial Grounding with Single-Token Coordinate Representation in Modality-Decoupled VLMs
summary: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are backbones for robotic planning and manipulation. However, for coordinate prediction in grounding tasks, existing architectures suffer from two distinct bottlenecks: discrete tokenization disrupts spatial continuity with high decoding latency, while standard point regression fails on multi-contact affordances and irregularly shaped targets. To resolve these challenges, we propose PhysMoE, introducing three core contributions: (1) sharing lower layers for multimodal context while routing upper layers to specialized spatial (pixel) and linguistic (text) experts by physical modality, eliminating gradient interference; (2) encoding each coordinate as a single token by reusing the visual encoder's learned positional embeddings, injecting 2D spatial priors to natively align coordinates with visual features and ease training; and (3) differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) supervision on pointing, accommodating affordances and irregular geometries without costly mask decoders. Compared to the base model, PhysMoE achieves a 15.7% average gain and an 8.31x throughput speedup across 9 coordinate-based grounding benchmarks (trajectory, affordance, and localization), while preserving multimodal understanding and reasoning across 11 text-based embodied benchmarks.

AI.tldr: PhysMoE通过物理模态路由的混合专家结构、复用视觉位置嵌入的单token坐标编码与可微SDF监督，解决具身VLM坐标预测中的空间连续性破坏与不规则几何回归失效问题，在9个坐标接地基准上平均提升15.7%、吞吐提速8.31倍，并保持11个文本具身基准的多模态理解能力。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉语言模型是机器人规划与操作的主干，但其在grounding任务的坐标预测上存在两类瓶颈：(1) 离散token化破坏空间连续性并带来高解码延迟；(2) 标准点回归难以处理多接触可供性与不规则形状目标。
AI.method: 提出PhysMoE，包含三项核心设计：(1) 底层共享以建模多模态上下文，高层按物理模态路由至空间(像素)专家与语言(文本)专家，消除梯度干扰；(2) 复用视觉编码器已学习的位置嵌入，将每个坐标编码为单个token，注入2D空间先验，使坐标与视觉特征天然对齐并降低训练难度；(3) 在指向预测上引入可微Signed Distance Field(SDF)监督，无需昂贵的mask解码器即可适配可供性与不规则几何。
AI.result: 相较基座模型，PhysMoE在9个基于坐标的接地点基准(轨迹、可供性、定位)上平均提升15.7%，吞吐提速8.31倍；同时在11个文本型具身基准上保持多模态理解与推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 以模态专家路由、位置嵌入复用式单token坐标表示和SDF几何监督三者结合的架构，可同时兼顾坐标grounding的精度、几何表达力与推理效率，且不牺牲通用多模态理解，为具身VLM的空间输出提供了可扩展方案。

title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
summary: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (\ours{}), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbones under all seven non-empty objective combinations on five datasets with three seeds, and contrast fixed-model profiles with specialist portfolios. Rank comparisons connect imputation and prediction through numerical recovery and dependence preservation, and link generation to both through predictive utility; distributional fidelity follows different, sometimes opposing, rankings. Objective interventions show the largest pooled gains from including the recipient's own objective. Generation has the broadest coverage of positive pooled auxiliary effects, while prediction shows potential to improve imputation and synthetic-data utility, with responses that vary across backbones. Cross-addition effects reveal that objective benefits need not add and depend on the objectives already present. Fixed-model comparisons expose corresponding utility--fidelity trade-offs: some generalists surpass specialist portfolios on utility, while fidelity continues to favor specialization. Frozen foundation models show strong prediction and numerical point imputation, together with promising synthetic-data utility, highlighting their potential across all three tasks. These findings motivate unified tabular models that share useful conditional information while improving categorical reconstruction and faithful joint sampling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 One Table Benchmark (OTB)，覆盖 56 个数据集、46 个注册方法、20 个能力维度，在统一数据划分与显式任务契约下系统刻画生成、插补、预测三类表格任务的能力共享、目标交互与单模型通用性。
AI.motivation: 生成、插补与预测虽对应同一表格分布的不同查询方面，却长期被分别评估，导致三者共享能力、训练目标间的相互作用以及单一模型能否同时胜任三类任务均不清楚。
AI.method: 构建 OTB 基准（56 数据集、46 方法、20 能力轴，对齐数据划分与任务契约）；在对齐支持集上比较任务排名；在 5 个数据集、3 个随机种子上训练 5 个骨干网络的全部 7 种非空目标组合；对比固定模型能力画像与专家组合体；并评估冻结基础模型。
AI.result: 排名比较通过数值恢复与依赖保持联系插补和预测，通过预测效用联系生成任务，而分布保真度呈现不同甚至相反的排序；目标干预显示纳入接收任务自身目标带来最大合并增益，生成对辅助目标的正向合并效应覆盖最广，预测有潜力提升插补与合成数据效用且随骨干而异；跨目标叠加效应表明收益不可简单相加；固定模型存在效用—保真度权衡，部分通用模型在效用上超越专家组合体，保真度仍偏向专门化；冻结基础模型在预测与数值点插补上表现强，合成数据效用亦有前景。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持构建统一的表格模型：在共享有用条件信息的同时，改进类别重建与忠实的联合采样。

title: Monitoring One Channel Is Not Communication Control: Causal Evidence for Adaptive Reallocation of Joint Message--Route Codes
comment: 23 pages total: 8-page main paper plus 15-page supplementary material; 1 main-paper figure and 3 main-paper tables. Equal contribution. Code available at: https://github.com/SummerRainET2008/DRCB
summary: Monitoring a visible channel can change how learned agents communicate without removing why communication is useful. We test this distinction in an end-to-end game where a sender and receiver learn a discrete protocol and route policy without communication supervision. In two independent 20-seed batches, 20/20 and 19/20 protocols form. Online partial coverage increases shadow-route share over no monitoring by .701 [.574,.826] and .575 [.412,.737], while task accuracy remains .905/.913 and signed frozen message contribution remains .592/.563. Complete coverage removes most selective migration without removing communication. Frozen interventions, including a fresh pre-outcome confirmation, show that route is semantic: joint message--route shuffling changes .668 of receiver predictions and route alone retains .388 accuracy versus .25 chance. A corrected explicit-silence cost makes 18/20 policies fully silent and lowers mean sending to .050, but its strict complete-suppression gate fails because two seeds retain communication. Failed semantic-evasion and operational gates further bound the result. The evidence supports adaptive reallocation of a joint message--route code under partial monitoring, not open-world route discovery, emergent encryption, or a universal defense.

AI.tldr: 在端到端博弈中，可见信道监测不消除通信的功能性，但会使学习到的智能体把联合的"消息—路由"编码自适应地重新分配到路由通道（影子路由），任务准确率基本不变。
AI.motivation: 区分"监测是否改变通信方式"与"监测是否消除通信的有用性"这两个常被混淆的问题，检验在无通信监督条件下，可见性/监测覆盖度如何影响学习到的离散协议与路由策略。
AI.method: 构建发送方—接收方端到端博弈，双方在无通信监督下同时学习离散消息协议与路由策略；进行两组各20个种子的独立批次；对比无监测与在线部分覆盖、完全覆盖条件；采用冻结干预（联合消息—路由打乱、仅保留路由、结局前新样本确认）做语义性检验；并引入修正的"显式沉默代价"。
AI.result: 两组批次分别有20/20与19/20形成协议。在线部分覆盖相对无监测使影子路由占比提高 .701 [.574,.826] 与 .575 [.412,.737]，而任务准确率维持在 .905/.913，冻结消息的有符号贡献为 .592/.563。冻结干预显示路由具有语义性：联合打乱改变 .668 的接收方预测，仅路由即保留 .388 准确率（随机水平 .25）。修正的显式沉默代价使 18/20 策略完全沉默、平均发送降至 .050，但其严格"完全抑制"门槛因两个种子仍保留通信而未通过；语义规避与操作性门槛亦未通过。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持在部分监测下联合"消息—路由"编码的自适应重新分配，而非开放世界中的路由发现、涌现加密或普适防御；结果边界由失败的门槛检验明确限定。

title: Curie's Jarvis: Autonomous Robotic Chemistry Experiments from Printed Protocols
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Rumi Loghmani and Bozhang Song contributed equally
summary: A person running a bench experiment works from a printed instruction sheet, tells identical containers apart by the labels written on them, and looks at the bench again before each step. Lab automation usually works the other way around: the procedure is written as a script, and containers stand at fixed positions or carry fiducial markers. We present Curie's Jarvis, a system that lets a robot arm carry out a chemistry experiment on a bench set up for people. It reads the steps from a photo of the printed sheet, finds containers on an ordinary bench with no fixed positions or markers, tells identical-looking containers apart by reading their labels in four camera views, locates its target again before every step, and sets how each step is carried out, including its speed, from what is being handled. On a Franka Panda arm, Curie's Jarvis completed 5 of 5 runs of one protocol from a children's chemistry kit and 4 of 5 runs of another, with no human intervention, and in 160 locates on printed and handwritten labels it identified every container correctly. This brings robots a step closer to doing bench chemistry the way people do.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Curie's Jarvis 系统，使机械臂能够在为人设计的普通实验台上执行化学实验：从打印说明书的照片读取步骤、在无固定位置和无标记的台面上定位容器、通过四个视角读取标签区分外观相同的容器、每步前重新定位目标，并依据所处理对象决定执行方式（含速度）。在 Franka Panda 机械臂上，两个来自儿童化学套件的协议分别完成 5/5 与 4/5 次无人工干预运行；160 次打印与手写标签定位全部识别正确。
AI.motivation: 现有实验室自动化与人工作业方式相反：流程被写成脚本，容器置于固定位置或贴有基准标记（fiducial markers），难以适配为人布置的普通实验台。作者希望机器人像人一样工作——依照打印说明单操作、靠容器上的文字标签区分相同容器、并在每步前重新观察台面。
AI.method: 构建 Curie's Jarvis 系统并部署于 Franka Panda 机械臂：(1) 从打印说明单的照片中解析实验步骤；(2) 在无固定位置、无标记的普通台面上检测容器；(3) 融合四个相机视角读取标签，区分外观相同的容器；(4) 每个步骤执行前重新定位目标物体；(5) 依据所处理的对象自适应设定该步骤的执行方式，包括运动速度。
AI.result: 在 Franka Panda 上无人工干预完成两套儿童化学套件协议：其一 5 次运行全部成功（5/5），其二 4/5 成功；在打印标签与手写标签上共 160 次定位中，容器识别全部正确（160/160）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明机械臂可在面向人类的自然实验台上、依靠阅读说明书与容器标签完成化学实验流程，无需固定工位或人工标记，使机器人更接近以人类方式开展台面化学操作。

title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--group co-scaling framework that enables \(32\times\) and even effective \(64\times\) compression while preserving strong reconstruction, understanding, and generation performance. Since larger groups introduce intra-group dependencies that must be modeled efficiently, we analyze their impact on inference latency and generation quality and introduce a semi-autoregressive decoder that combines parallel feature computation with lightweight causal modeling. With these designs, our highly compressed models perform competitively with leading models across five representative text-to-image benchmarks (GenEval, DPG-Bench, PRISM, LongText-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench). At \(1024\times1024\) resolution, our model delivers a \(20\times\) speedup over prior discrete autoregressive models, generating each image in 2.5 seconds on a single NVIDIA H200. Together, these results show that highly compressed discrete representations can enable high-quality autoregressive generation at low latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GSTAR，基于乘积量化推导出"组大小应随单轴空间压缩因子平方增长"的缩放原则，实现32×乃至有效64×压缩的离散自回归图像生成，并以半自回归解码器兼顾质量与延迟。
AI.motivation: 离散自回归图像生成存在根本性权衡：长token序列能保持表征质量但生成慢；激进的空间压缩虽缩短序列却损失表征容量。作者希望打破这一权衡，在保留高质量重建与生成的同时大幅降低延迟。
AI.method: 1）基于乘积量化理论分析，证明在固定名义信息预算下，组大小（group size）应与单轴空间压缩因子的平方成正比；2）据此提出空间–组协同缩放框架GSTAR，实现32×乃至有效64×压缩；3）针对大组带来的组内依赖，分析其对推理延迟与生成质量的影响，设计半自回归解码器，将并行特征计算与轻量因果建模相结合。
AI.result: 在GenEval、DPG-Bench、PRISM、LongText-Bench、Qwen-Image-Bench五个代表性文生图基准上与领先模型性能相当；在1024×1024分辨率下单张NVIDIA H200上2.5秒生成一张图，较此前离散自回归模型提速约20×。
AI.conclusion: 高度压缩的离散表征能够在低延迟下支撑高质量自回归生成，说明空间压缩与组大小协同缩放是突破序列长度–表征容量权衡的有效路径。

title: Branch-and-Commit for Frozen RL Agents: When and Where to Spend Test-Time Compute
summary: Reinforcement learning agents are often deployed with policies that cannot be retrained or modified. In digital environments whose states can be copied and resumed, an operator has another option: sample several continuations from the current state, evaluate them, and continue from the endpoint of the selected branch. We call this procedure branch-and-commit. We study when it improves return, what produces the improvement, and where its computational budget should be spent. Across four environments, two frozen policies, five continuation verifiers, and a model-free selection rule, we find that the benefit of branching depends on dispersion: the difference between the best candidate return and the mean candidate return. Branching provides no benefit in low-dispersion settings, while increasing return by 12.8% in our main Craftax-Medium setting. Most of this gain comes not from selecting better actions, but from selecting among different stochastic realizations of the same action. Several competent verifiers achieve similar episode returns, suggesting that verifier quality is not the main constraint at our operating budget. Instead, computation is better allocated to states where useful dispersion is likely. On held-out seeds, gating branching using predicted dispersion retains 69% of the improvement from uniform branching while using 48% as many branching calls. These results characterize when branch-and-commit is useful and clarify what its gains represent.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究一种称为 branch-and-commit 的推理期部署方法：在可复制状态的环境中，从当前状态采样多条分支轨迹，评估后从选定分支端点继续。作者指出分支收益取决于"离散度"（最佳候选回报与平均候选回报之差），且收益主要来自在相同动作的不同随机实现间做选择，而非选更好的动作。
AI.motivation: 实际部署的强化学习智能体往往使用冻结的、无法重训练或修改的策略。在数字环境中状态可被复制与恢复，操作者因而多出一种不改变策略本身的选择：分支采样与择优继续。现有工作缺乏对这种推理期计算分配方式的系统性刻画，例如它何时有效、增益来源是什么、算力该花在何处，因此作者针对这些问题展开实证研究。
AI.method: 在四个环境、两个冻结策略、五种续接验证器（continuation verifier）以及一个无模型选择规则下开展实验。流程为：从当前状态采样多条续接轨迹，用验证器评估各候选回报，选择最优分支并从其端点继续执行。并以"离散度"（best 与 mean 候选回报之差）作为解释变量，分析分支收益的条件依赖，同时提出用预测离散度来门控（gating）分支调用，以决定计算预算的分配。
AI.result: 分支收益依离散度而定：低离散度场景下无收益；在主实验 Craftax-Medium 中回报提升 12.8%。增益大部分来自在同一动作的不同随机实现之间择优，而非来自选出更优动作。多种高水平验证器取得相近的回合回报，说明在本文算力预算下验证器质量并非主要瓶颈。在留出种子（held-out seeds）上，以预测离散度门控分支，可保留统一分支 69% 的改进，而分支调用次数仅为 48%。
AI.conclusion: 论文刻画了 branch-and-commit 的适用条件：其价值由状态处可用离散度决定，增益本质是对随机性的重采样式择优，而非策略层面的动作改进；因此计算预算应优先分配到预测离散度高的状态上。该结论为冻结策略的推理期算力分配与门控策略设计提供了明确指引。

title: IIT Patna at "ICPR 2026 TVRID Competition on Privacy-Preserving Person Re-Identification from Top-View RGB-Depth Camera"
summary: Privacy-aware person re-identification (Re-ID) from top-view cameras replaces frontal appearance with anthropometric shape, while depth sensing further reduces color-based identity cues. The ICPR 2026 TVRID competition evaluates this setting using 86 identities captured by four synchronized Intel RealSense D455 cameras with RGB and Depth streams across flat, ascent, descent, and oblique viewpoints. Performance is measured using mAP and CMC@1 across within-camera in/out, ascent-descent, and flat-oblique scenarios. The competition had 147 registered participants and 33 final submissions. Three teams from IIT Patna participated: 'abhinavkumar03' and 'sjkdgfhl_' ranked 5th and 7th among 31 ranked participants, and 'vivek katuri' reached 77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP on the RGB track. This paper presents the methods of the two top-10 teams. Methodology 1 (abhinavkumar03) achieves 93.51% mAP and 90.42% CMC@1 on Depth, ranking 4th of 28, while Methodology 2 (sjkdgfhl_) reaches 99.63%/99.35% on RGB and 86.26%/80.34% on Depth. Both substantially outperform the 57.19% track-average Depth mAP, with Methodology 1 yielding a 7.3-point gain over Methodology 2. These results demonstrate the importance of depth representation and supervision for privacy-preserving Re-ID.

AI.tldr: 本文报告 ICPR 2026 TVRID 竞赛中两支进入前十的 IIT Patna 团队方法：基于俯视视角与深度传感的隐私保护行人重识别（Re-ID）。方法一在 Depth 赛道取得 93.51% mAP / 90.42% CMC@1（28 队中第 4），方法二在 RGB 取得 99.63%/99.35%、在 Depth 取得 86.26%/80.34%，均显著优于 57.19% 的 Depth 赛道平均 mAP。
AI.motivation: 俯视相机 Re-ID 用人体形态学特征替代正面外观以保护隐私，深度传感进一步削弱颜色等身份线索；然而在该设定下如何构建有效的深度表征与监督信号仍缺乏系统性评测与基准。竞赛旨在建立该场景的统一评测平台并推动方法比较。
AI.method: 使用 4 台同步 Intel RealSense D455（RGB+Depth）采集 86 个身份，覆盖平地、上坡、下坡、斜视视角；评测指标为 mAP 与 CMC@1，涵盖同相机进出、上下坡、平地—斜视等场景。论文给出两支前十队伍的技术方案：方法一（abhinavkumar03，第 4/28）与方法二（sjkdgfhl_）。
AI.result: 竞赛共 147 人注册、33 份最终提交，31 名参与者进入排名。方法一 Depth：93.51% mAP / 90.42% CMC@1；方法二 RGB：99.63%/99.35%，Depth：86.26%/80.34%；另一队 'vivek katuri' RGB 达 77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP。两者均大幅超过 57.19% 的 Depth 赛道平均 mAP，方法一较方法二在 Depth 上高 7.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 深度表征与监督策略对隐私保护 Re-ID 至关重要，合理设计可在弱势模态（Depth）上取得远超基线的性能，并显著缩小与 RGB 通道的差距。

title: Force-Closure Condition for Cooperative Multi-robot Pushing of Rectangular Objects
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Published in CAOS 2026
summary: In cooperative object manipulation, the placement of pushing contacts determines whether force closure can be achieved and agents can generate arbitrary forces and torques on the object correspondingly. This study derives a necessary and sufficient closed-form condition for the planar force closure of a rectangular object, a common object shape in everyday settings, under four frictionless pushing contacts. For a rectangle of length $b$ and width $a$, force closure holds if and only if $(l_1+l_3-b)(l_2+l_4-a)<0$, where $l_1,l_2,l_3,l_4$ are the four edge contact locations. This condition is independent of the object's center of mass and is used to verify contact configurations before contact force allocation. When the condition is not satisfied, the signs of the two factors indicate which opposing contact pair should be adjusted. The condition and adjustment rule are then integrated into a full-pose trajectory-tracking framework as a geometric feasibility layer to demonstrate their use in control. Static wrench feasibility tests validate the proposed condition, while narrow-passage floating-body simulations show that maintaining a force-closure configuration reduces the RMS tracking errors in $x$, $y$, and unwrapped yaw from $12.05$ m, $18.11$ m, and $535.96^\circ$ to $2.24$ m, $2.66$ m, and $2.69^\circ$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 针对矩形物体在四个无摩擦推触点下的平面力封闭问题，本文给出充要闭式条件 $(l_1+l_3-b)(l_2+l_4-a)<0$，并将其作为几何可行性层嵌入全位姿轨迹跟踪框架。
AI.motivation: 协作操作中，推触点位置决定能否实现力封闭，即智能体能否对物体施加任意力与力矩。本文希望得到一种可在接触力分配之前快速校验接触构型的判据。
AI.method: 针对长 $b$、宽 $a$ 的矩形，在四个无摩擦推触点条件下，推导力封闭的充要闭式条件；条件不满足时，通过两因子符号指示应调整的对侧接触点对；将该条件与调整规则集成为全位姿轨迹跟踪框架中的几何可行性层。
AI.result: 静态力旋量可行性测试验证了该条件正确；窄通道浮动体仿真中，维持力封闭构型使 $x$、$y$ 与解缠偏航角的 RMS 跟踪误差分别从 12.05 m、18.11 m、535.96° 降至 2.24 m、2.66 m、2.69°。
AI.conclusion: 该充要条件与质心无关，可在线校验接触构型并指导接触调整，显著提升窄通道浮动体全位姿跟踪性能。

title: Instance-preserving graded semantic reporting for surgical action triplets
summary: Complete-or-reject reporting of surgical action triplets can discard a correctly identified instrument and action when the target is uncertain. We introduce instance-preserving graded semantic reporting, which separates instance selection from the choice of semantic detail. Each selected instance retains its predicted mask and labels while hierarchical correctness scores guide instrument (I), instrument-verb (IV), or complete instrument-verb-target (IVT) reporting. The utility-increment rule DELTA weighs the expected gain from finer reporting against its error cost. We compare three decision rules on 5,641 test frames from eight surgical videos using fixed predictions and scores. At the 10% development calibration target, DELTA retains correct partial reports for 80.0% of candidates rejected by a matched complete-or-reject baseline (5,329/6,662). Adding IV increases source-normalized weighted correct-report yield by 19.13 to 23.13 per 100 frames across all three rules relative to separately recalibrated I/IVT controls. Weighted reporting risk changes by -0.77 to +1.01 percentage points, with complete correct-triplet counts unchanged or reduced. Graded reporting makes partial surgical predictions available as localized descriptions, with an explicit trade-off between report utility and completeness.

AI.tldr: 提出"实例保持的渐进式语义报告"框架，将实例选择与语义细节选择解耦，用效用增量规则Δ在部分报告与完整三元组之间权衡取舍。
AI.motivation: 传统"完整或拒绝"（complete-or-reject）的报告机制在目标不确定时会丢弃已正确识别的器械与动作信息，造成信息浪费，需要一种能保留部分正确预测的报告方式。
AI.method: 将实例选择与语义细节层级分离：每个被选实例保留预测掩码与标签，用分层正确性评分决定报告器械(I)、器械-动词(IV)或完整器械-动词-目标(IVT)；引入效用增量规则Δ，权衡更精细报告的期望收益与错误代价。在8段手术视频的5,641帧测试集上，固定预测与分数，比较三种决策规则。
AI.result: 在10%开发集校准目标下，Δ规则使被匹配的完整或拒绝基线否决的候选中80.0%（5,329/6,662）保留为正确部分报告；相较分别重校准的I/IVT对照组，三种规则加入IV后每100帧源归一化加权正确报告产出提升19.13–23.13；加权报告风险变化为−0.77至+1.01个百分点，完整正确三元组数不变或下降。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式报告可将部分手术预测作为定位描述予以输出，在报告效用与完整性之间形成显式可调权衡。

title: The Shape of a Program: Path Signatures for Trace-to-Program Induction
summary: Synthesizing programs from execution traces is a fundamental challenge in algorithmic interpretability and the reverse engineering of complex systems. We bring a rough-path-theoretic perspective to program induction, treating execution traces as high-dimensional rough paths and encoding them with the path signature transform, a tool from stochastic analysis whose expectation provably characterizes the distribution of traces a program induces. On three program-induction domains, Karel, List, and RASP, our log-signature trace encoder outperforms LSTM, Transformer, and Fourier baselines in almost every setting, with its largest margins when training data is scarce. We further observe that the trace-to-program pipeline is naturally contractive: it often produces valid programs that are shorter than the ground truth. We turn this into a bootstrapping procedure that exposes redundancy in the ground-truth supervision without any external oracle, which we demonstrate on redundancy-injected versions of our datasets. Finally, the log-signature encoder induces a markedly more interpretable latent geometry than the baselines, in which the nearest neighbors of every state lie on its own execution trace.

AI.tldr: 将执行轨迹视为高维粗路径，用路径签名变换（log-signature）编码轨迹以进行程序归纳，在Karel、List、RASP三个域上优于LSTM/Transformer/Fourier基线，尤其在小样本下；并利用"轨迹→程序"管线的收缩性构建无需外部oracle的bootstrapping去冗余，同时获得更可解释的潜空间几何。
AI.motivation: 从执行轨迹合成程序是算法可解释性与复杂系统逆向工程的基础难题。作者希望为程序归纳引入粗路径理论视角，用随机分析中其期望可证明刻画轨迹分布的工具（路径签名）来编码轨迹，以提升归纳性能、数据效率与可解释性。
AI.method: 1）将执行轨迹建模为高维粗路径，并用路径签名变换编码，具体采用log-signature作为轨迹编码器；2）在Karel、List、RASP三个程序归纳域上与LSTM、Transformer、Fourier基线对比；3）观察到trace-to-program管线具有收缩性（常产生短于真实程序的合法程序），据此构造bootstrapping过程，在无外部oracle条件下暴露ground-truth监督中的冗余，并在注入冗余的数据集版本上验证；4）分析编码器的潜空间几何，检验近邻是否落在同一执行轨迹上。
AI.result: log-signature轨迹编码器在几乎所有设置下优于LSTM、Transformer与Fourier基线，训练数据稀缺时优势最大；bootstrapping在冗余注入数据集上成功揭示真实监督中的冗余；log-signature编码器诱导的潜几何显著更可解释——每个状态最近邻均位于其自身执行轨迹上。
AI.conclusion: 粗路径/签名视角为程序归纳提供了有效且数据高效的编码方案，并带来两个附加收益：利用归纳管线的收缩性可实现无oracle的监督去冗余，签名编码还产生高度结构化的可解释表示。该工作将随机分析工具与程序归纳问题相连接。

title: RBLA+: Efficient Rank-Specific LoRA Adapter Extraction for Federated Fine-Tuning with Heterogeneous Clients
summary: Federated fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces communication and computational overhead by training and exchanging compact trainable LoRA factors. Clients may use different LoRA ranks to meet adapter communication budgets and accommodate different local adaptation needs. The server must process these differences during aggregation and construct adapters at each client's rank for local training. We distinguish pre-aggregation alignment, which handles factor dimensions and scaling conventions before aggregation and rank-specific LoRA adapter extraction, which constructs client-sized pairs from the aggregated global model. Two common approaches to rank-specific extraction are direct rank truncation and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the dense update. Direct prefix truncation keeps the leading columns of one aggregated factor and the corresponding rows of the other. It is cheap but can increase reconstruction error. The dense SVD approach first forms the product of aggregated LoRA factors. It then decomposes this matrix and retains the leading singular components to construct adapters at the target rank. This gives the optimal rank-constrained approximation in Frobenius norm but incurs significant computational overhead. To address this trade-off, we propose RBLA+ as an extension of RBLA. It uses established compact QR/core-SVD decomposition to minimize Frobenius error for the extracted LoRA update without forming the dense update. It also accounts for client and server scaling conventions during upload and broadcast. Across vision and language tasks, RBLA+ improves accuracy over RBLA in multiple heterogeneous settings. In CPU benchmarks with synthetic adapters, RBLA+ has lower extraction time than the dense partial-SVD baseline. RBLA+ preserves each client's prescribed adapter size and per-round communication payload.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦LoRA微调中客户端使用异构秩的场景，提出RBLA+：基于紧凑QR/core-SVD分解直接从不形成稠密更新的聚合LoRA因子中提取目标秩适配器，在Frobenius意义下最小化重构误差，并统一处理客户端与服务器的缩放约定，兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 联邦低秩适配（LoRA）微调虽降低通信与计算开销，但各客户端可能采用不同LoRA秩以匹配通信预算与本地适配需求，服务器聚合时需处理维度与缩放差异，并为每个客户端构造其指定秩的适配器。现有秩特异提取方案存在取舍：直接前缀截断成本低但重构误差较大；稠密更新的SVD在Frobenius范数下最优但计算开销显著。
AI.method: 将问题拆分为聚合前对齐（处理因子维度与缩放约定）与聚合后秩特异LoRA适配器提取两部分。RBLA+作为RBLA的扩展，采用紧凑QR与core-SVD分解，在不显式构造稠密更新矩阵的条件下，对提取出的LoRA更新最小化Frobenius误差，并在上传与广播阶段统一考虑客户端与服务器的缩放约定。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务上，RBLA+在多种异构设置中相较RBLA提升精度；在使用合成适配器的CPU基准测试中，其提取时间低于稠密部分SVD基线。
AI.conclusion: RBLA+在保持每个客户端预设适配器规模与每轮通信载荷不变的前提下，实现了接近稠密SVD的秩约束近似质量，同时显著降低提取计算开销，缓解了精度与效率之间的权衡。

title: RaMOD: Moving-Object Detection from Raw mmWave Radar Cubes under Ego Motion
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides weather-robust sensing and direct Doppler measurements, yet automotive perception pipelines often reduce its output to sparse point clouds or two-dimensional projections, leaving raw range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) cubes underutilized. Ego motion induces Doppler responses from world-static structures, while Doppler wrapping aliases radial velocities, complicating moving-object detection and velocity estimation. We present RaMOD (Radar-based Moving-Object Detection), a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation from raw RAD cubes acquired by a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar. RaMOD explicitly estimates frame-wise ego motion and uses the estimated radar translational velocity to predict the Doppler region of world-static structures and suppress returns within it. It temporally encodes the suppressed cubes into multi-scale features to predict RAD-space boxes with class labels. For each detected object, it predicts radial and forward velocities under raw-Doppler and Doppler-unwrapped hypotheses, together with Doppler-wrapping probabilities. On our BRIDGE-Liv dataset, RaMOD outperforms all compared raw-radar methods across RAD-cube, RA, and RD detection settings, achieving 80.8% cube mAP at IoU 0.30, 15.7 percentage points above the strongest RAD-cube baseline. Velocity MAE is 1.128 m/s, with 99.87% Doppler-wrapping accuracy.

AI.tldr: RaMOD：基于原始RAD立方体的实时运动目标检测与速度估计框架
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达鲁棒性强且能直接测速，但车载感知多将输出降维为稀疏点云或2D投影，浪费了原始距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）立方体信息；同时自车运动使世界中静止结构产生多普勒响应，且多普勒卷绕会造成径向速度混叠，使运动目标检测与测速变得困难。
AI.method: 提出RaMOD框架：显式估计逐帧自车运动，用估计的雷达平移速度预测世界中静止结构的多普勒区域并抑制该区域回波；将抑制后的立方体时序编码为多尺度特征，预测带类别的RAD空间框；对每个目标在原始多普勒与解卷绕两种假设下预测径向与纵向速度，并输出多普勒卷绕概率。
AI.result: 在自建BRIDGE-Liv数据集上，RaMOD在RAD-cube、RA、RD三种检测设置下均优于所有对比的原始雷达方法，IoU 0.30下cube mAP达80.8%，比最强RAD-cube基线高15.7个百分点；速度MAE为1.128 m/s，多普勒卷绕判别准确率99.87%。
AI.conclusion: 直接从原始RAD立方体出发、结合自车运动补偿与多普勒解卷绕的建模方式，可有效提升运动目标检测与速度估计性能，验证了原始雷达数据的实用价值。

title: Preserving Cultural Records: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Visual-Prior Routing Network for Ancient Book Image Restoration
summary: Ancient books preserve invaluable cultural heritage, yet their images often suffer from complex degradations caused by long-term ageing, environmental exposure, and physical damage. Existing ancient book image restoration benchmarks are limited in scale and rely on simplified degradation simulations, which cannot fully represent real-world degradation patterns and restrict the generalization ability of restoration models. To address these challenges, we introduce AncBench, a large-scale synthetic paired benchmark containing 100K aligned clean-degraded image pairs. AncBench models realistic composite degradations through a comprehensive degradation pipeline that considers material ageing, paper texture variation, blur, staining, water-induced geometric distortion, and local occlusion. Furthermore, we propose AncRestore, a degradation-aware visual-prior routing network for ancient book image restoration. AncRestore first learns degradation representations from degraded images and then dynamically selects and integrates suitable visual priors according to different degradation characteristics. Guided by these degradation cues, a dynamic routing mechanism combines expert-wise and region-wise routing strategies adaptively adjusts the contribution of these priors across different regions, enabling the model to recover both global appearance and local text details. Extensive experiments show that AncRestore effectively suppresses composite degradations while preserving text structures and enhancing restoration quality against other methods, highlighting its application potential for intelligent ancient book image restoration in cultural heritage preservation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出大规模合成配对基准 AncBench（10万对干净-退化古籍图像）与退化感知视觉先验路由网络 AncRestore，实现古籍图像复合退化的高效修复。
AI.motivation: 古籍图像因长期老化、环境暴露与物理损伤存在复杂退化；现有基准规模小且依赖简化退化模拟，难以反映真实退化模式，限制了修复模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 AncBench：通过综合退化流水线模拟材质老化、纸张纹理变化、模糊、污渍、水致几何畸变与局部遮挡，生成大规模对齐配对数据。提出 AncRestore：先从退化图像学习退化表征，再按退化特征动态选择并整合合适视觉先验；引入动态路由机制，结合专家级与区域级路由，自适应调节各先验在不同区域的贡献。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AncRestore 能有效抑制复合退化，保持文字结构并提升修复质量，优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: AncBench 与 AncRestore 为古籍图像智能修复提供数据与模型支撑，展现其在文化遗产保护中的应用潜力。

title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.

AI.tldr: FaST 将离线强化学习的合成转移按链式法则分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励、终止五个阶段分别建模，在十二个 D4RL 基准上与 SynthER 效果相当但生成速度快 90 倍以上，并可通过固定状态重采样动作、按价值函数挑选最高优势动作实现"生成时即改进"的定向动作合成。
AI.motivation: 合成数据增强有望使离线强化学习摆脱固定日志数据集的规模限制，但主流基于扩散的生成器把转移元组 (s, a, s', r, terminal) 当作整体建模，导致任一因子无法被原生地单独重绘，限制了定向合成与条件查询的能力。
AI.method: 提出 FaST（Factored Synthesis of Transitions）：按链式法则把转移分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励、终止五个阶段，每个阶段用与其统计特性相匹配的估计器拟合；其中"动作给定状态"的显式条件可对同一状态重复查询，从而为每个生成状态采样 N 个候选动作，并用在同一数据上拟合的价值函数保留优势最高者。
AI.result: 在十二个 D4RL 运动与迷宫基准上，用 FaST 转移训练的 TD3+BC 与 IQL 达到与 SynthER 扩散基线相当的性能，生成速度提升 90 倍以上；Best-of-10 合成在 12 个 medium 与 medium-replay 设置中有 11 个超过真实数据训练（平均 +8.9 D4RL 分，最高 +28.4），并以远低于优势过滤 SynthER 的生成成本达到可比效果。在专家混合数据上两种机制同步退化。
AI.conclusion: 因子化分解在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低生成成本，并使优势引导的定向动作合成成为可能，把"事后过滤"转变为"生成中改进"；专家混合场景下的同步退化表明瓶颈在于优势估计本身，而非任一目标化机制。

title: BuySideFlow: A Point-in-Time Benchmark for LLM Agents in Investment Research
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate SQL and SQL--Python workflows for investment research, but ensuring point-in-time (PIT) validity remains challenging. Agents must enforce disclosure cutoffs and select the appropriate historical states and record versions throughout data retrieval and financial analysis. We introduce \textsc{BuySideFlow}, a benchmark of 408 practitioner-derived Chinese-language tasks spanning equities, funds, fixed income, and macroeconomics over a fixed snapshot from a licensed production financial database. We provide executable references and a taxonomy of temporal errors, pairing result checks with expert audits of executed workflows. We evaluate nine agent configurations on all tasks, with result accuracy ranging from 16.2\% to 36.8\%. An audit of 900 runs on 100 shared tasks confirms PIT violations in 193 of the 380 runs that pass result checks (50.8\%), showing that output agreement alone does not establish temporal validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BuySideFlow——面向买方投资研究中"时点有效性（PIT）"的 408 个中文实务任务基准，覆盖股票、基金、固收与宏观经济，基于授权生产金融库的固定快照；结果显示九个智能体配置的结果准确率仅 16.2%–36.8%，且通过结果校验的 380 次运行中有 193 次（50.8%）存在 PIT 违规。
AI.motivation: LLM 已能为投资研究生成 SQL 与 SQL–Python 工作流，但难以保证"时点有效性"：必须在数据检索与分析全过程中落实披露截止日约束，并选取正确的历史状态与记录版本。若仅以最终输出是否匹配来评估，容易掩盖时序错误，因此需要一个可诊断、可审计的专用基准。
AI.method: 构建 BuySideFlow 基准：408 个由从业者提炼的中文任务，跨 equities/funds/fixed income/macroeconomics 四类，数据取自授权生产金融数据库的固定快照；提供可执行参考解（executable references）与时间性错误分类法（taxonomy of temporal errors）；评估采用"结果校验 + 对已执行工作流的专家审计"双重机制；对九种智能体配置在全部任务上评测，并对 100 个共享任务上的 900 次运行进行人工审计。
AI.result: 九种智能体配置的结果准确率区间为 16.2%–36.8%；在 100 个共享任务的 900 次运行审计中，通过结果校验的 380 次运行里有 193 次存在 PIT 违规，占比 50.8%。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭输出一致性（output agreement）无法确立时序有效性；PIT 违规普遍存在于"看似正确"的运行中，需将过程级审计纳入评估体系，并推动智能体在检索与分析环节显式建模披露时点与记录版本。

title: Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty
summary: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式解释助手，用于对概率不确定性下行星漫游车路径规划结果进行事后解释，并支持在用户指定条件下重跑规划器以比较备选方案，从而提升规划的可追溯性与可信度。
AI.motivation: 行星漫游车在概率不确定性下的轨迹规划是多目标优化问题，目前由科学团队人工迭代求解与验证；任务规划期间时间线与约束频繁变化，使人工流程变得不切实际。采样类规划器（如MCTS）虽可加速，但其输出缺乏对支撑每份规划的科学目标的可追溯性，科学团队难以验证。此前工作将LLM用于规划决策回路内部，存在信任问题。
AI.method: 将LLM用于"规划后解释"而非决策回路，以避免直接影响规划器决策、提升信任度。框架由两部分组成：一是受NASA VIPER任务启发的仿真器；二是基于ReAct范式的可查询接口，可调用经筛选的动作工具与检索函数，使模型用领域词汇解释规划器轨迹，并按用户指定条件重跑规划器进行方案对比。在包含方案比较、可行性与信息查询三类问题的查询库上评测。
AI.result: 90.9%的助手回答与规划器输出保持忠实（faithful）；相比同一LLM在无工具访问的零样本提示下，提升近65%。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的系统具备为不确定性感知的漫游车通行（traverse）提供可信可解释性的潜力；事后解释范式配合工具调用（ReAct+检索）可显著提升解释的忠实度。

title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
summary: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.

AI.tldr: GTAGym/GTAVBench：面向GTA V任务的评测与强化学习环境，含103个在线任务（9类）与47个图像射击任务，支持并行测试与引擎状态自动判定；最优配置在GTAVBench-AGI上达70.9%总体准确率，LoRA RL可将原生任务成功率由15%提升至23%。
AI.motivation: AAA游戏为智能体的感知、推理与控制提供了丰富测试平台，但任务结果通常难以自动验证，往往依赖人工标注，更难用于强化学习训练。作者希望构建可自动判定、可并行评测且可直接用于RL的AAA游戏任务环境。
AI.method: 提出GTAGym环境与框架，评测基准GTAVBench源自GTA V主线任务，重建103个在线任务（9个任务族）及47个基于游戏图像的射击/狙击任务；通过Web服务器提供在线环境与评测接口，支持截图+键鼠动作的并行测试，并基于引擎状态自动检查任务结果。设置GTAVBench-AGI分支：指令仅出现在首张截图中，并由框架自动压缩交互历史。另提供可扩展生成器，在固定模板与用户指定参数范围/选项集合内采样，批量生成3D与图像射击环境，附带自动奖励与终止信号用于RL。评测6个前沿LLM，并对Qwen3.8-27B在生成的徒步导航任务上做LoRA RL。
AI.result: GTAVBench-AGI最优配置总体准确率为70.9%，但空中导航、规避与拦截类任务仍较困难。LoRA RL提升域内性能，并可迁移到域外任务类别，原生GTA V任务成功率由15%提升至23%。
AI.conclusion: GTAGym将AAA游戏任务评测与RL训练统一在可自动验证的框架内，证明了所生成任务上的强化学习可带来跨类别的可迁移收益；剩余瓶颈主要在空中导航与对抗性规避/拦截任务。

title: Permutation-Based Pre-trained Model Merging via Reciprocal Orthogonality
summary: Ito et al. (2026) showed that sufficiently wide, independently trained neural networks can exhibit linear mode connectivity (LMC) with softmax temperature calibration, even without permutation. LMC means that a low-loss linear path connects the models' parameters. This behavior is explained by layerwise exponentially weighted connectivity (LEWC), whereby each merged layer outputs an exponentially weighted sum of the original models' corresponding representations, yielding ensemble-like predictions. However, prior work observed LEWC with substantial widening, such as 8192 units per hidden layer for MLPs and $16\times$ width for VGG-11, raising the question of whether such widths are necessary. We therefore search for permutations that encourage reciprocal orthogonality (RO), which suppresses interference between each model's weights and the other model's representations. This allows both models' computations to coexist in the merged network, promoting LEWC at smaller widths. We formulate the search as independent layerwise quadratic assignment problems and approximately solve their continuous relaxations using Frank--Wolfe. Experiments show that our method facilitates LMC with less width expansion. It also merges models trained on different data distributions, where weight matching, which maximizes weight similarity through permutations, struggles. The merged predictions approximate those of a logit ensemble of the original models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过搜索诱导"互正交性"(reciprocal orthogonality, RO)的置换，使两个独立训练的神经网络在较小宽度下即可实现线性模式连通(LMC)，并复现集成式预测。
AI.motivation: Ito等(2026)发现足够宽的网络无需置换即可实现LMC，其机理为逐层指数加权连通(LEWC)；但这需要极大加宽(如MLP每隐层8192单元、VGG-11达16倍宽度)。作者质疑这种宽度是否必要，并注意到既有工作仅靠加宽才观察到LEWC。
AI.method: 将置换搜索形式化为逐层独立的二次分配问题(QAP)，通过Frank–Wolfe算法近似求解其连续松弛。优化目标是抑制一个模型的权重与另一模型表示之间的干扰(即促进RO)，使两模型的计 coexisting 于合并网络中，从而在更小宽度下促成LEWC。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在更少的宽度扩展下即可实现LMC；还能合并训练于不同数据分布的模型——这是以最大化权重相似度为目标的weight matching难以处理的情形；合并后的预测近似于原模型logit集成的输出。
AI.conclusion: 通过以RO为目标的置换搜索，可显著降低LMC与LEWC所需的宽度膨胀，并拓展模型合并至跨分布训练模型的情形，合并结果保持集成级预测性能。

title: TrustMod-SM: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Trustworthiness of LLMs in Social Media Content Moderation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong potential for social media content moderation, but their trustworthiness beyond overall accuracy remains underexplored. We introduce TrustMod-SM, a benchmark of roughly 29,000 instances across eight datasets, to evaluate LLM moderators on five dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, robustness, and context integrity. Evaluating 16 open-weight models (0.5B-284B parameters, spanning text-only and vision-language architectures) and one closed frontier model, we find persistent trustworthiness gaps. Higher detection accuracy often coincides with greater demographic disparity, and models frequently comply with concealment or exaggeration prompts, assign high confidence to wrong predictions, rarely escalate ambiguous cases, and struggle to separate hate speech from counter-speech or reclaimed language (especially below 8B parameters). Scaling does not uniformly resolve these issues, and no single model excels across all five dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出 TrustMod-SM 基准（约29,000条实例、8个数据集），从可信性、公平性、安全性、鲁棒性和上下文完整性五个维度评估LLM内容审核器；评测16个开源权重模型（0.5B–284B，含纯文本与视觉语言架构）和1个闭源前沿模型，发现准确率与人口群体差异性正相关、模型易受隐瞒/夸大提示操控、错误预测高置信、对歧义案例极少升级处理、难以区分仇恨言论与反击言论或回收语言，且规模扩展不能统一解决这些问题。
AI.motivation: LLM在社交媒体内容审核中展现出较强潜力，但已有研究主要关注总体准确率，对其在准确率之外的“可信赖性”缺乏系统考察。作者希望建立一个统一基准，从多个可信维度揭示LLM审核器在实际部署中可能存在的隐患。
AI.method: 构建TrustMod-SM基准，覆盖8个数据集、约29,000条实例，设定五个评估维度：可信性（trustfulness）、公平性（fairness）、安全性（safety）、鲁棒性（robustness）与上下文完整性（context integrity）。在此基础上评测16个开源权重模型（0.5B–284B参数，涵盖纯文本与视觉语言架构）以及1个闭源前沿模型，并进行跨维度的比较与规模效应分析。
AI.result: 发现持续存在的可信赖性差距：更高检测准确率往往伴随更大的人口群体间差异；模型常顺从隐瞒或夸大类提示；对错误预测赋予高置信度；很少对歧义案例进行升级处理；在区分仇恨言论与反击言论或回收语言方面表现薄弱（在8B参数以下尤为明显）；规模扩展并不能一致地缓解上述问题；没有任何单一模型在五个维度上均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 仅以总体准确率衡量LLM内容审核器是不充分的，其公平性、鲁棒性和上下文理解等方面存在系统性短板，且难以通过简单扩大模型规模解决。需要多维度的可信赖性基准与针对性改进，才能支撑LLM安全地用于社交媒体内容审核。

title: Does Haptic Connection to a Healthy Partner Improve Motor Learning in Chronic Stroke? A Pilot Study of Robot-Based Dyadic Training
summary: Purpose: Robot-based haptic dyads, where two users exchange forces through robots, have been proposed for robot-assisted neurorehabilitation. This intervention could increase motor learning by promoting motor variability, providing an implicit communication channel, and facilitating social interaction. Despite the potential benefits, few studies have investigated robot-based haptic dyads for neurological populations, and none have included a comprehensive clinical assessment. Design/Methodology/Approach: We present a pilot study investigation of individuals with chronic stroke learning a complex tracking task in solo and dyad conditions. Prior to training, participants completed a battery of cognitive, motor, and sensory assessments. We assessed changes in key kinematic outcomes including tracking error, distance traveled, mean absolute power, and sample entropy. We also performed a correlation analysis of clinical scores with baseline tracking errors. Findings: Baseline tracking error was strongly correlated (r > 0.6) with lower cognitive scores and higher motor scores. Only the solo group demonstrated lower tracking error at assessment (Δ = -5.33, 95%CI [-10.25, -0.40], p = 0.027), but this result was tempered by the removal of an outlier participant. Neither group demonstrated clear retention. The dyad group showed significantly elevated performance, effort, and movement complexity during training. Research Limitations/Implications: The selected task was too difficult to reveal learning for either group, which may be related to its high cognitive demand. Sample size and stroke heterogeneity were also limitation. Originality/Value: Dyadic training increased movement complexity and effort, which are associated with better motor learning. Clinical characteristics such as lesion location, cognition, sensation, and chronicity may influence potential benefits of dyadic training.

AI.tldr: 一项针对慢性卒中患者的机器人触觉双人（dyad）训练试点研究：比较单独与双人条件下复杂追踪任务的学习效果，并结合认知、运动、感觉临床评估。
AI.motivation: 机器人触觉双人训练被认为可通过促进运动变异性、提供隐性沟通通道和增强社交互动来提升运动学习，但针对神经系统人群的研究极少，且缺乏全面的临床评估。
AI.method: 试点研究。慢性卒中被试在单独与双人条件下学习复杂追踪任务；训练前完成认知、运动、感觉成套评估；测量追踪误差、移动距离、平均绝对功率、样本熵等运动学指标；并对临床评分与基线追踪误差作相关分析。
AI.result: 基线追踪误差与较低认知得分、较高运动得分强相关（r > 0.6）；仅单独组评估时追踪误差下降（Δ = -5.33, 95%CI [-10.25, -0.40], p = 0.027），但剔除一名离群被试后该结果不再稳健；两组均无明确保持效应；双人组在训练中表现出显著更高的表现水平、努力程度与运动复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 双人训练提升运动复杂度与努力程度，二者与更好的运动学习相关；病灶位置、认知、感觉与病程等临床特征可能影响双人训练的潜在获益。任务过难（高认知负荷）、样本量小及卒中异质性为主要局限。

title: MICRO: A Surgery-Phase Retinal Image Rigid Registration Benchmark and One-Step Frequency-Structure Similarity Registration Learning
summary: Precise multimodal retinal image rigid registration (MRIRG) is essential for aligning cross-modal vessel structures, offering critical guidance for ophthalmic surgery. Despite its significance, the advancement of MRIRG is hindered by the lack of publicly available multimodal retinal image rigid registration datasets spanning various ophthalmic surgery phases (e.g., preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative). To address this issue, we introduce the MICRO dataset, a large-scale MRIRG benchmark, comprising 1,365 cross-modal retinal image pairs with standardized annotations across all ophthalmic surgery phases. Moreover, existing deep registration methods achieve competitive MRIRG results via a two-step segmentation-then-detection framework, but segmentation quality heavily constrains their performance. We argue that this dependency stems from an implicit need for keypoint topology constraints, which have not been exploited for MRIRG through a one-step registration framework. Inspired by the above analysis, we propose a novel One-step Frequency-Structure Similarity Registration (OFS2Reg) learning framework for MRIRG that leverages the potential of cross-modal vessel structure similarities to construct keypoint topology constraints under a shared detection network. To be specific, OFS2Reg applies a well-designed frequency-guided structure preservation descriptor to construct coarse keypoint topology constraints in descriptors by highlighting significant vessel structures. Additionally, we develop a new cross-modal vessel structure similarity learning method that refines cross-modal keypoint topology constraints to precisely align pixel-level cross-modal vessel structures by leveraging cross-modal vessel structure similarity priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MICRO大规模多模态视网膜图像刚性配准基准数据集（1,365对跨模态图像，覆盖术前/术中/术后各阶段），并提出一步式频域-结构相似性配准框架OFS2Reg，通过关键点拓扑约束实现跨模态血管结构精确对齐。
AI.motivation: 多模态视网膜图像刚性配准（MRIRG）对跨模态血管结构对齐及眼科手术导航至关重要，但研究推进受限于两点：一是缺乏覆盖眼科手术各阶段（术前、术中、术后）的公开多模态配准数据集；二是现有深度配准方法依赖"先分割再检测"的两步框架，性能受分割质量严重制约。作者认为这一依赖源于对关键点拓扑约束的隐式需求，而该约束此前未被通过一步式框架加以利用。
AI.method: （1）构建MICRO数据集：大规模MRIRG基准，含1,365对跨模态视网膜图像及覆盖全部手术阶段的标准化标注；（2）提出OFS2Reg一步式频域-结构相似性配准学习框架，在共享检测网络下利用跨模态血管结构相似性构建关键点拓扑约束；（3）设计频率引导的结构保持描述子，通过突出显著血管结构在描述子层面构造粗粒度关键点拓扑约束；（4）提出跨模态血管结构相似性学习方法，借助跨模态血管结构相似性先验细化关键点拓扑约束，实现像素级血管结构的精确对齐。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体定量实验结果，仅声明OFS2Reg通过一步式框架结合频域结构保持描述子与跨模态血管结构相似性学习，能够构建并细化关键点拓扑约束，从而实现精确的像素级跨模态血管结构对齐，并声称在MICRO基准上具备竞争力（具体指标需参见正文）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时贡献了数据集与方法：MICRO填补了覆盖眼科手术全阶段的多模态刚性配准公开基准空白；OFS2Reg以一步式框架替代分割-检测两阶段范式，通过频域结构描述与跨模态结构相似性先验显式引入关键点拓扑约束，缓解了对分割质量的依赖，为MRIRG提供了新范式。

title: Explanation-Aware Fairness Beyond Output Parity: Joint Output-Attribution Regularization for Medical Image Classification
comment: Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027. Under review
summary: Output-level fairness does not constrain whether demographic groups rely on similar predictive contributions in representation space. For a nonlinear encoder with a linear head, we show that outcome-conditioned output score disparity equals the signed sum of feature attribution differences across subgroups by allowing small prediction gaps to arise through cancellation effect. We test whether an attribution disparity penalty complements output-level equalized odds based fairness surrogates. Across 960 DINOv2-LoRA models on HAM10000 and Harvard-GF datasets for gender and race fairness, attribution augmentation increases utility-fairness trade-off performance for hypervolume in six different settings with paired 95% confidence intervals and relative gains of 1.49-10.57%. Under a predefined utility constraint, augmented model families also achieve 9.0-38.7% lower equalized odds difference, lower attribution disparity, and reduced cancellation ratio while preserving predictive utility. These results support attribution fairness as a complementary explanation-aware constraint on output fairness.

AI.tldr: 该文指出输出层公平性无法约束不同人群是否依赖相似的预测贡献，提出以特征归因差异度量公平，并在DINOv2-LoRA医学影像模型上验证归因公平惩罚可互补输出层均等几率约束。
AI.motivation: 输出层面（output-level）的公平性约束并不能保证不同人口群体在表示空间中依赖相似的预测贡献。本文关注"抵消效应"（cancellation effect）——各特征归因差异相互抵消时，输出分数差异可能很小，从而掩盖了组间解释层面的不公平。
AI.method: 对"非线性编码器 + 线性头"结构，从理论上证明：在允许小幅预测差距通过抵消效应产生的前提下，结果条件化的输出分数差异等于各子群体特征归因差异的有符号求和。在此基础上，在输出层均等几率（equalized odds）公平代理损失之外，额外引入归因差异惩罚（attribution disparity penalty），在HAM10000与Harvard-GF数据集上针对性别与种族公平性训练并评估960个DINOv2-LoRA模型。
AI.result: 在六种设置下，归因增强均提升了效用-公平权衡的超体积（hypervolume）表现，配对95%置信区间下相对增益为1.49%–10.57%；在预设效用约束下，增强后的模型族取得9.0%–38.7%更低的均等几率差异、更小的归因差异与更低的抵消比率，同时保持预测效用。
AI.conclusion: 归因公平可作为解释感知（explanation-aware）的补充约束，与输出层公平性共同作用，提升效用-公平权衡并削弱抵消效应，支持将其作为输出公平性的互补约束。

title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model
summary: Energy-based models (EBMs) assign a scalar energy to every joint value of the observed and predicted variables. In decision models, the prediction is chosen from a finite list of options provided with each input. Inference then reduces to comparing the energies of the options, and training lowers the energy of the correct option relative to the others. A complete decision must also account for the possibility that no option is acceptable. However, the energies learned by a standard EBM define only relative compatibility: adding the same input-dependent quantity to all energies leaves the predictions, the Gibbs distribution, and the usual training losses unchanged. The model therefore has no learned reference level against which to decide whether any option fits. We propose ZeroPoint, an EBM that makes the empty answer a state of the model with energy zero for every input. This fixed state provides an explicit reference for the energies of all listed options, whose non-negative depths measure their compatibility with the input relative to the empty answer. The options and the empty answer share one distribution, in which an option at zero depth receives no probability. The decision to select an option or to abstain is thus part of ordinary inference, trained with the negative log-likelihood loss, rather than a separate rejection rule. The energy function is a small multilingual encoder that reads the input together with all the options and is invariant to their order. Ablations show that most of the benefit comes from training with examples in which no option fits. With the same encoder and data, the fixed zero separates inputs with and without an acceptable option slightly better than a learned rejection class and clearly better than a thresholded softmax, while leaving the choice among options unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ZeroPoint，将“空答案”设为能量恒为零的模型状态，为所有候选选项的能量提供显式参照，使“选择或弃答”成为由负对数似然统一训练的普通推断，而非独立的拒绝规则。
AI.motivation: 标准 EBM 只刻画相对兼容性：给所有能量加上同一输入相关的常数不改变预测、Gibbs 分布与训练损失，因此模型缺乏用于判断“是否存在任何可接受选项”的学习参照水平，无法内在地支持弃答（abstention）决策。
AI.method: 定义空答案为对任意输入能量恒为零的固定状态，候选选项能量以非负“深度”度量其相对空答案的兼容性；选项与空答案共享同一分布，零深度选项概率为零；弃答决策纳入常规推断并以 NLL 损失训练。能量函数为小型多语言编码器，同时读取输入与全部选项且对选项顺序不变。
AI.result: 消融表明大部分收益来自“无选项适配”的训练样本；在相同编码器与数据下，固定零点在区分有无可接受选项的输入上略优于可学习的拒绝类，并明显优于阈值化 softmax，同时不改变选项之间的选择。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入固定零点作为能量参照，EBM 可统一建模兼容性判断与弃答决策，无需额外拒绝规则即可获得更优的取舍边界，且保持原有排序行为不变。

title: PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots
summary: Task-driven design of soft robots requires the consideration of factors such as geometry, morphology, material properties, and actuation, resulting in a large and complex design space that is challenging to explore. Computational optimisation methods leverage signals from simulation to iteratively improve designs to achieve task objectives. However, these methods typically demand high computational load for both optimisation and simulation. We present PneuGen, an agentic co-design framework for soft robots that leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to search over the soft robot design space efficiently. A designer agent proposes design programs from a parametric component library, and a separate critic agent analyses simulation diagnostics and recommends targeted revisions. Fitted module response models provide reusable physical priors relating geometry and pressure to deformation. Design programs are automatically validated and converted into finite-element simulations, enabling iterative evaluation. Across grasping tasks on primitive shapes and challenging objects, as well as shape-matching tasks that require multi-directional planar and 3D deformation, the proposed framework significantly outperforms prior computational optimisation baselines. Ablation experiments also highlight the utility of the critic agent and the module response model in facilitating efficient design. We additionally demonstrate the agent-generated soft robot designs in real-world shape-matching and grasping tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PneuGen——一种基于大语言模型智能体的软体机器人协同设计框架，通过"设计智能体+批评智能体"在参数化组件库上搜索设计程序，结合模块响应模型提供的物理先验与有限元仿真迭代评估，在抓取与形状匹配任务上显著优于传统计算优化基线，并完成真实验证。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人的任务驱动设计需同时考虑几何、形态、材料属性与驱动方式，设计空间庞大且复杂，难以有效探索。现有计算优化方法依赖仿真信号迭代改进设计，但优化与仿真两端计算负担都很重。
AI.method: PneuGen框架：1）设计智能体（designer agent）从参数化组件库中提出设计程序；2）批评智能体（critic agent）分析仿真诊断信息并给出针对性修改建议；3）拟合的模块响应模型提供可复用的物理先验，将几何与压力映射为形变；4）设计程序自动校验并转换为有限元仿真，实现迭代评估。
AI.result: 在基础形状及挑战性物体的抓取任务、以及需要多方向平面与3D形变的形状匹配任务上，该框架显著优于此前的计算优化基线；消融实验表明批评智能体与模块响应模型对提升设计效率均有贡献；并展示了智能体生成的软体机器人设计在真实形状匹配与抓取任务中的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM智能体与物理先验、仿真验证相结合，可高效探索软体机器人设计空间，兼顾设计性能与计算效率，并具备从仿真到真实世界的可迁移性。

title: SpatialSR: Spatial Resolution-Centric Pipeline for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution
summary: Although remote sensing image arbitrary-scale super-resolution (RSI-ASSR) methods support reconstruction at arbitrary or continuous scales, they predominantly condition on the relative scale factor and have not sufficiently investigated the absolute spatial resolution itself as a reconstruction prior, thereby disregarding the inherent spatial context of objects, which frequently leads to spatial-related distortions and compromised performance in downstream remote sensing applications. To address these challenges, we introduce SpatialSR, a SRe-centric arbitrary-scale RSISR method that leverages the spatial resolution (SRe) of remote sensing images (RSI) as an essential prior for super-resolution reconstruction. Distinct from existing SR methods, SpatialSR aims to restore high-resolution remote sensing images with a target SRe (typically set to 0.1m/pixel to align with the metadata of commonly used downstream task datasets). Specifically, we design a Spatial Resolution Estimation Module (SREM) to estimate the SRe of low-resolution (LR) images, thereby dynamically determining the required arbitrary scaling factor. Next, we employ a pretrained SRe-to-image diffusion model to extract SRe-specified texture-style codes, which are further incorporated into a carefully designed Resolution-aware Style Consistency Module (RSCM) to constrain the SRe-aware texture consistency of reconstructed images. Furthermore, to overcome the high computational expense inherent in diffusion-based SR methods, we wrap the iterative diffusion process as a Trajectory Consistency (TC) loss, which enables comparable reconstructed texture quality of the generative model in SpatialSR within a single step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed SpatialSR achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on commonly used RSISR and downstream (image classification and segmentation tasks) datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialSR，以遥感图像绝对空间分辨率(SRe)为先验的任意尺度超分方法，实现目标SRe(如0.1m/pixel)重建，并达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI-ASSR方法仅以相对尺度因子为条件，未将绝对空间分辨率本身作为重建先验，忽视目标固有空间上下文，导致空间相关失真并损害下游任务性能。
AI.method: 设计空间分辨率估计模块(SREM)估计LR图像SRe并动态确定缩放因子；用预训练SRe-to-image扩散模型提取SRe特定纹理风格码，经分辨率感知风格一致性模块(RSCM)约束纹理一致性；将迭代扩散过程封装为轨迹一致性(TC)损失，实现单步重建。
AI.result: 在常用RSISR数据集及下游图像分类、分割数据集上取得SOTA性能，且单步即可获得可比的生成纹理质量。
AI.conclusion: 以绝对空间分辨率为核心先验的SRe-centric范式可有效提升任意尺度遥感超分的空间一致性与下游适用性。

title: Continuous-Time Set-Transformers for Asynchronous WiFi-IMU Indoor Localization
summary: Indoor localization commonly combines WiFi received signal strength indicator (RSSI) fingerprints with inertial measurements. However, these sensor streams are sampled asynchronously at different rates; therefore, observations rarely align in time and may be missing or stale. Most existing methods resample the data onto a shared clock and process each modality using a separate branch. We instead present a continuous-time transformer that represents observations as an unordered set of timestamped tokens. Each token encodes its measurement, modality, and elapsed time since acquisition. A single attention block jointly fuses information across modalities and time, avoiding both resampling and modality-specific branches while remaining invariant to token order. During training, we randomly mask entire modalities and individual observations, enabling the model to operate under missing or outdated inputs. We validate the modality-specific encoders on their respective benchmarks and evaluate the fused model on both simulated and real datasets, including a crosssession dataset collected on unseen days. The proposed approach improves upon an open WiFi fingerprinting baseline under cross-session drift, remains competitive with learned fusion and dead-reckoning baselines, and degrades gracefully as observations become missing or stale. These results suggest that a single continuoustime transformer provides a practical framework for indoor localization from asynchronous sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种连续时间Transformer，将异步采样的WiFi RSSI与惯性观测表示为带时间戳的无序token集合，用单个注意力块联合融合跨模态与时间信息，实现免重采样、免模态分支的室内定位，并在缺失/过期观测下平滑退化。
AI.motivation: 室内定位常融合WiFi RSSI指纹与惯性测量，但两类传感器异步、采样率不同，观测难以在时间上对齐，且可能缺失或过期；现有方法多先重采样到统一时钟，再用独立分支分别处理各模态，引入误差与冗余结构。
AI.method: 构建连续时间Transformer：每个token编码测量值、模态标识及自采集以来的时间间隔，构成无序集合；单一注意力块同时跨模态、跨时间融合，保持token顺序不变性；训练时随机掩蔽整个模态与单条观测，以增强对缺失/过期输入的鲁棒性；各模态编码器在对应基准上单独验证，融合模型在仿真与真实（含跨会话）数据集上评估。
AI.result: 在跨会话漂移下优于公开WiFi指纹基线，与学习式融合及航迹推算基线相当；随观测缺失或过期程度增加性能平滑退化；模态编码器在各自基准上亦得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 单一连续时间Transformer可作为异步多传感器室内定位的实用框架，无需重采样与模态专用分支。

title: Seeing Is Not Believing: Counterfactual Lesion Erasure Teaches a Small Medical Vision-Language Agent to Report Only What the Image Shows
comment: 28 pages, 1 figure, 13 tables. Preprint v1.0; reader study in progress. Code, data recipes, pre-registrations and per-view outputs: https://github.com/bhaskargurram-ai/medscope
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) often report a finding because the question names it; standard benchmarks miss this. From public segmentation datasets we build counterfactual views without manual annotation: the lesion erased by inpainting, a same-shape control edit elsewhere, and unedited lesion-free images. The evidence sensitivity gap (ESG) is the rate of absent-or-refer answers after erasure minus the rate after the control edit; it is zero for a model that ignores the image or reacts to both edits alike. MedScope-4B (Qwen3.5-4B, LoRA, image tools) was trained on label-derived trajectories, selected by a pre-registered rule and tested once against nine frontier and six open VLMs; four pre-registered checks then probed the mechanism. On 507 internal cases across five imaging types, MedScope-4B reached ESG 0.758 and claimed an erased lesion in 9.6% of cases, against 0.27-0.47 and 41-62% for the frontier models (all p<0.001), without significant loss of accuracy on real lesions. Without counterfactual views ESG fell to 0.279+-0.107 (three seeds); the effect replicated on MedGemma 1.5 4B and two unseen inpainting tools. At four external centres the advantage held but frontier models detected more real lesions; on a fresh external test MedScope-4B detected 0 of 48 pneumothorax films, with net utility below gemini-4-argon's (-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23]). Matching the control edit was not shown to matter; over three seeds no fresh-external ESG advantage over removal-based DPO was established; a paired-view consistency objective did not beat a matched-compute control, while that continuation alone cut erased-lesion claims on unseen tools at every seed, at a cost in sensitivity at one. Training on erased and edited images gives a small model an evidence-gated disposition that prompting does not give frontier models; it does not improve perception, and rare critical findings need coverage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据敏感性差距"(ESG)指标,用无需人工标注的反事实视图(修复擦除、同形状对照编辑、无病变图)衡量医学VLM是否"见到问题才报病变";经标签派生轨迹训练的MedScope-4B(4B参数)ESG达0.758,远超前沿模型,但真实病变检测能力未提升,罕见危急病变覆盖不足。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型常因提问中提到某病变就报告该发现(即"提问驱动"而非"图像驱动"),而现有标准基准无法捕捉这一失效模式。作者希望构建无需人工标注的评估手段,并探索训练能否赋予模型"先看证据再作答"的倾向。
AI.method: 从公开分割数据集构建三类反事实视图:修复(inpainting)擦除病变、在别处做同形状对照编辑、以及未编辑的无病变图像。定义ESG=擦除后回答"不存在/无法判断"的比例 − 对照编辑后回答该比例;模型若忽略图像或对两类编辑反应一致,则ESG为零。以Qwen3.5-4B为基座、LoRA、带图像工具,在标签派生轨迹上训练得MedScope-4B,按预注册规则选模、仅测试一次,与9个前沿模型和6个开源VLM对比,随后用四项预注册检查探析机制(消融反事实视图、跨模型/工具复现、外部中心测试、DPO与配对视图一致性等对照目标)。
AI.result: 507例内部测试(5种成像类型)上,MedScope-4B的ESG为0.758,仅9.6%情况下虚构已擦除病变;前沿模型ESG为0.27–0.47、虚构率41–62%(均p<0.001),而真实病变准确率无显著下降。去掉反事实视图训练后ESG降至0.279±0.107(3个种子);效应在MedGemma 1.5 4B及两个未见过的修复工具上复现。四个外部中心上优势保持,但前沿模型检出更多真实病变;新外部测试中MedScope-4B对48张气胸片检出0例,净效用低于gemini-4-argon(-0.36 [-0.50, -0.23])。机制检查:匹配对照编辑未见必要性证据;三个种子上相对基于移除的DPO未建立稳定的新外部ESG优势;配对视图一致性目标未优于等算力对照,但该续训本身在所有种子上降低了未见工具下的虚构病变陈述,代价是某一种子上敏感度下降。
AI.conclusion: 在擦除与编辑图像上训练可使小模型获得"证据门控"的作答倾向,这是提示工程无法赋予前沿模型的能力;但该方法并不改善感知能力,罕见危急病变仍需专门覆盖。ESG是一个无需标注、可复现的基准指标。

title: AHEADance: Anticipatory Humanoid Dance from Streaming Audio
summary: A humanoid that dances to streamed music must commit each motion chunk before it has heard the music that chunk accompanies, and must continue from motion it has already committed. We present AHEADance, a robot-native streaming dance generator executed on a humanoid robot by a whole-body tracker. ListenAhead conditions each chunk on heard music and a frozen music model's forecasts of the coming music, aligned to their target times and weighted by reliability. The forecasts carry the timing of upcoming beats almost as well as the actual future; with them, the generator is better synchronized with the music and concentrates more motion energy at its song's beat frequency. Commit Forcing trains continuation from the model's own committed chunks, updating both the latent history and the decoded boundary of the next chunk; it reduces low activity from 83.5% to 10.3%, the level of real dance. Three music evaluators, each validated on real G1 dance, test synchronization, song and style. On a physical Unitree G1, it dances while the music plays and comes to rest when it stops, without a fall. Project page: https://ihcr.github.io/AHEADance

AI.tldr: AHEADance 是一个面向人形机器人的流式舞蹈生成框架，通过“预测未来音乐”与“从自身已提交动作续写”两项机制，实现边听边跳、节拍同步、音乐停止即停的实时全身舞蹈。
AI.motivation: 流式音乐驱动的类人机器人舞蹈存在根本矛盾：每一段动作必须在听到其所对应的音乐之前就已提交，且必须从已提交的动作自然延续。这要求同时解决"未来音乐不可见"与"自回归误差累积/低活跃"两个问题，而现有离线生成方法无法满足实时部署需求。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 机器人原生流式生成器 + 全身跟踪器（whole-body tracker）在实体人形上执行；(2) ListenAhead：以已听音乐与冻结音乐模型给出的未来音乐预测共同条件化每个动作块，预测按目标时间对齐并按可靠性加权，从而提前获得未来节拍时序；(3) Commit Forcing：以模型自身已提交的动作块训练续写，同时更新潜在历史与下一块的解码边界，缩小训练与推理的分布差距。
AI.result: 未来音乐预测所携带的节拍时序几乎与真实未来相当；使用后生成动作与音乐同步性更好，运动能量更集中于歌曲节拍频率。Commit Forcing 将低活跃段比例从 83.5% 降至 10.3%，接近真实舞蹈水平。三个音乐评估器均在真实 G1 舞蹈数据上验证，分别测试同步性、歌曲匹配与风格。在实体 Unitree G1 上，机器人随音乐起舞、音乐停止即静止，全程无摔倒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将"未来音乐预测"与"自提交动作续写训练"结合，可有效支撑人形机器人的实时流式舞蹈生成，并在实体平台上实现同步、连贯且安全的边听边跳行为。

title: Just Image Transformers with Late-Stage Pixel Refinement
summary: Recent work on latent-free diffusion transformers has demonstrated the feasibility of training image generators without a latent VAE. This avoids compression artifacts from the VAE and simplifies the training pipeline. In particular, JiT showed that even a standard transformer can be trained to generate images when the model is trained to predict the final image ($x$-prediction). Even though JiT unlocks training efficiency comparable to latent models, it still suffers from reduced image quality likely arising from modeling the image as a collection of large patches. In this work, we revisit JiT and show that adding simple convolutional pixel-pathway layers in a post-training phase significantly improves generation quality. Moreover, we show that the added pixel-pathway does not need to be active in the early denoising stages, and can be activated as late as in the last $20\%$ of the denoising process. Our experiments on ImageNet@256 show improvements compared to the original JiT results, achieving an FID of $1.78$ (from $2.34$ with corrected sampling), without using additional losses.

AI.tldr: 在JiT（无潜空间扩散Transformer）的基础上，通过后训练阶段引入卷积像素通路层，并在去噪后期（最后20%）才激活该通路，即可显著提升生成质量，ImageNet@256上FID由2.34降至1.78。
AI.motivation: 无VAE的潜空间扩散Transformer（如JiT）虽避免VAE压缩伪影、简化训练流程并获得与潜空间模型相当的训练效率，但因将图像建模为若干大patch集合，生成质量下降。作者希望在不引入额外损失、不改变原训练范式的前提下弥补这一质量差距。
AI.method: 重新审视JiT的x-prediction训练方式，在后训练（post-training）阶段向模型注入简单的卷积像素通路（pixel-pathway）层以增强细粒度像素建模；并发现该通路无需在早期去噪阶段启用，可延迟到最后20%的去噪步才激活。
AI.result: 在ImageNet@256上相较原始JiT结果（修正采样后FID 2.34）取得改进，FID达到1.78，且未使用任何额外损失函数。
AI.conclusion: 轻量卷积像素通路配合后期激活是一种低成本、即插即用的后训练增强手段，可有效提升无潜空间扩散Transformer的图像生成质量，说明大patch建模带来的细节损失可在去噪后段被针对性补偿。

title: INTENT: Out-of-Sample, Out-of-Time, and Cold-Start Evaluation on User Event Sequences
comment: 4 pages + references and appendix. Accepted at the MFMB workshop at ACM ICAIF '26 (non-archival). Code: https://github.com/kthaisociety/intent
summary: Banks now train foundation models on ordered sequences of customer events such as transactions, app sessions, and authorizations. Deployed, such a model predicts forward in time, often for customers and merchants absent from training, yet each is evaluated on private data, so no two can be compared. Public benchmarks for such sequences rarely test a period the model has not seen; recommendation studies usually hold out each user's last events instead. We present INTENT (INTEraction, Novelty, and Transfer evaluation for next-action prediction), a public benchmark that scores a model in seven cells defined by whether the user, the period, and the target item appeared in training. An audit of 59 public dataset families retains five datasets; the most common defect is the lack of a calendar timestamp that orders events. No date lies within the time span of all five datasets, so each is split at its own cutoff, chosen by one rule fixed before any model is evaluated. Summed over the datasets, every cell holds at least 111,769 users. In reference results the cell determines the best model: a transformer leads on seen items after the cutoff but scores zero on new items, a variant that embeds item metadata helps mainly on MicroLens, and repeating the user's last item leads on new items in four of five datasets. This parameter-free control also shows that on three datasets most of the score lost after the cutoff reflects changed behavior rather than the model. The pipeline, the cutoff rule, and the per-cell user counts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公开基准 INTENT，用"用户/时段/目标物品是否在训练中出现"的七个格子来评测下一行为预测，并审计筛选出五个含日历时间戳的数据集。
AI.motivation: 银行等机构在客户事件序列上训练基础模型，部署时需向未来预测、且面向训练中未见的客户与商户；但各机构只能用私有数据评测，结果无法横向比较。现有公开基准很少测试模型未见的时间段，推荐研究通常只留出每个用户的最后若干事件。
