AI.motivation: 幼儿早期是社交学习的关键期，意义通过注视、手势与身体接触建构；但现有多模态视频理解基准以成人对话驱动式交互为主，此类非言语社交交互长期缺乏评估。此外，数据缺失之外，粗粒度评测范式将基础感知与高阶推理混为一谈，阻碍了针对性模型改进。
AI.method: 构建NEST基准：人工标注的短片段（~12s）视频，覆盖自然环境、文化语境与发展阶段的多样性；设计组合式评测图式，将原子交互线索逐层组织为上下文、行为、人际、开放式描述四个递进推理层级；对多个SOTA视觉语言模型进行广泛分析，并通过领域自适应策略评估其现实应用可行性。
AI.result: VLM呈现明显的性能塌陷：虽具备较强的上下文识别能力，但在精确的行为线索与人际线索解码上存在显著差距；失败可归因于特定偏差，包括后果接地能力不足与时间敏感性较差。
AI.conclusion: NEST为幼儿期社交落地的通用人工智能提供了严格测试平台，为后续针对性模型改进与领域自适应研究奠定基础。

title: Structured Kernel Surrogate Models for Multimodal Attribution
summary: We study the problem of cross-sample modality attribution, which involves measuring how one modality in one sample affects the learning outcome in other multimodal samples. This problem is crucial in a multimodal system because a data modality (such as a text description) may be redundant for one sample (a self-explanatory image), but the same data modality would otherwise be uniquely informative for another sample, or informative when combined with other modalities. Prior work focuses on influence estimation at the level of one sample, and it remains an open question how one should capture the interactions across both samples and modalities. To capture scenarios like the above, we propose structured kernel surrogate models, which are surrogate mappings from both samples and modalities to the prediction outcome when they are trained together. We design an algorithm, SKS, which applies kernel ridge regression with a structured, compositional kernel on the selection states of individual samples and modalities. Specifically, the kernel function multiplies kernel-based similarity scores between every pair of data modalities for one sample and a pair of two samples. Additionally, we design a gradient-based estimation algorithm to efficiently estimate the structured kernel surrogate model. We evaluate our approach on two multimodal benchmarks, spanning a range of data modalities including satellite images, road networks, text, audio, and tabular data. We find that SKS achieves $57.8$% higher correlation with the true prediction outcomes than existing methods. In downstream data selection, SKS improves the average accuracy by $1.93$% over baselines. Models with data selected by SKS have lower Hessian traces, indicating a flatter loss surface. Using SKS to select satellite images identifies road segments, where accident scenes commonly occur, as opposed to background images.

AI.tldr: 提出跨样本模态归因问题及结构化核代理模型SKS，用组合核岭回归建模样本与模态间的交互影响，估计精度、下游数据选择与模型平坦性均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态影响估计仅停留在单样本层面，无法刻画"同一样本内模态之间的交互"与"跨样本之间的交互"。而同一模态对某样本可能冗余（如自解释图像配文本描述），对另一样本却可能是唯一信息源，或需与其他模态组合才具信息量。如何同时捕获跨样本与跨模态的交互仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出结构化核代理模型：将样本选择状态与各模态选择状态映射到联合训练时的预测结果。算法SKS以核岭回归实现，采用结构化组合核——核函数由两部分相乘构成：(1) 单样本内每一对数据模态之间的核相似度；(2) 一对样本之间的相似度。并设计基于梯度的估计算法以高效求解该结构化核代理模型。
AI.result: 在两个多模态基准（涵盖卫星图像、路网、文本、音频、表格数据）上，SKS与真实预测结果的相关系数比现有方法高57.8%；下游数据选择任务平均准确率提升1.93%；经SKS选出的数据训练后Hessian迹更低，即损失面更平坦；用于卫星图像选择时可定位事故常发路段而非背景图像。
AI.conclusion: 跨样本模态归因可通过结构化组合核代理模型有效刻画，样本与模态的联合选择状态可被核方法压缩表示；该归因不仅能提升预测结果估计与数据选择性能，还带来更平坦的损失面与可解释的选样行为。

title: Activation-Guided Graph Retrieval for Cognitive Memory Reconstruction in Language Model Systems
comment: Architecture and analysis preprint; no benchmark measurements. Companion research essay and revision notes: https://achiral.ai/research/activation-guided-graph-retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented language model systems generally select context by query-conditioned relevance. We argue that long-lived AI systems require a second operator: activation-conditioned memory availability. We specify an architecture in which request and goal cues seed an authorized memory graph, activation and fan attenuation allocate a bounded traversal frontier, retrieved entities recursively emit cues, and a typed evidence graph is reconstructed before generation. The specification yields five architectural consequences about candidate selection, traversal control, graph regularization, evidence reconstruction, and reinforcement. We derive implementation-level cost estimates and define ablations, failure conditions, and a reproducible evaluation protocol. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if a simpler graph reranker matches full traversal on causal and temporal recovery under equal budgets. This architecture-and-analysis preprint reports no benchmark measurements. If the claim holds, retrieval returns the evidence path that makes a memory available, not only a ranked list.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"激活条件的记忆可用性"作为检索增强语言模型的第二个算子，并给出一套作者称之为"架构与分析型"的设计规范：由请求/目标线索播种授权记忆图，通过激活与扇出衰减分配有限遍历前沿，检索实体递归发出线索，最终重建类型化证据图再生成。文中未做基准测量，只推导成本估计、消融方案、失效条件与可复现评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统仅以查询条件相关性选择上下文，作者认为长生命周期AI系统需要额外的"激活条件记忆可用性"机制，即记忆能否被当前激活状态调用，而非仅看与查询的相关性。
AI.method: 方法为架构规范与理论分析：请求与目标线索为授权记忆图播种；激活与扇出衰减界定有界遍历前沿；检索到的实体递归发出新线索；生成前重建类型化证据图。据此得出候选选择、遍历控制、图正则化、证据重建与强化五方面架构推论，并给出实现级成本估计、消融实验、失效条件及可复现评估协议。无实证基准测试。
AI.result: 无基准测量结果。作者给出成本估计与评估协议，并设定可证伪条件：若更简单的图重排器在同等预算下能在因果与时间恢复上匹敌完整遍历，则核心主张被收窄或证伪。
AI.conclusion: 若主张成立，检索应返回"使某段记忆可被调用的证据路径"，而不仅是一个排序列表。当前工作为架构与分析预印本，尚待实证检验。

title: From Egocentric Human Video to Robot Manipulation in the Era of Embodied Intelligence
summary: Egocentric human video (EHV) records close-range hand-object interaction (HOI) and the temporal structure of everyday activities, offering a potentially scalable source of experience for robot manipulation. Using this experience for robot control requires recovering useful supervision without recorded robot actions and accounting for differences in morphology, viewpoint, and action space. We define Ego2Robot learning as the process of learning or adapting robot manipulation policies from EHV, organized into four learning paradigms: explicit embodiment transfer, explicit action and task supervision, egocentric video representation pretraining, and latent action and dynamics modeling. The four paradigms differ in what they derive from human video: robot-format demonstrations, interpretable supervision, visual representations, or predictive models of actions and dynamics. For each paradigm, we trace what EHV information is extracted, how robot policies use it, and when the additional data is required. Besides, we review the benchmark datasets that cover EHV, robot demonstrations, and synthetic and simulated resources. This paper links EHV data's contribution to the task information preserved and the robot-specific grounding used during training or deployment. Finally, we identify challenges in physical feasibility, agent coordination, in-context adaptation, controlled evaluation, and predictive control.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇综述，提出"Ego2Robot learning"概念，系统梳理从第一人称人类视频（EHV）学习机器人操作策略的四类范式、数据来源与基准，并指出未来挑战。
AI.motivation: EHV记录了近距离手-物交互与日常活动的时间结构，是机器人操作经验的潜在可扩展来源；但缺乏机器人动作标注，且存在形态、视角、动作空间的差异，因此需要明确如何从中提取有效监督。
AI.method: 定义Ego2Robot learning并划分为四种范式：显式具身迁移、显式动作与任务监督、第一人称视频表征预训练、潜在动作与动力学建模；对每种范式分析所提取的EHV信息、机器人策略的使用方式及所需额外数据，并综述涵盖EHV、机器人演示、合成与仿真资源的基准数据集。
AI.result: 建立了将EHV数据贡献与"任务信息保留程度"及"训练/部署中机器人特定grounding"相联系的分析框架，并对四类范式的信息来源与适用条件作了对照。
AI.conclusion: 该文指出物理可行性、智能体协调、上下文内适应、受控评估与预测控制五方面的挑战，为后续从人类视频到机器人策略的研究提供路线图。

title: Rethinking Evaluation for Video Capsule Endoscopy: Validation Protocol, Source-Video Diversity, and Cross-Dataset Shift
summary: Automated video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, limited source-video diversity, and variations in image appearance across datasets. Although deep learning models have demonstrated promising performance on established benchmarks, their reliability under different validation protocols and external dataset shift remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce DMSNet, a deformable adaptive multi-scale edge-guided attention network integrating adaptive multi-scale feature fusion, deformable lesion refinement, edge-guided attention, and sparse feature selection. We benchmark DMSNet against 18 representative convolutional, transformer-based, and pretrained vision architectures on Kvasir-Capsule under random frame-level and source-video-disjoint validation protocols. We further identify source-video overlap between the original training and test splits and evaluate model performance on both the complete test set and a source-video-disjoint subset. Under random frame-level validation, DMSNet achieves an MCC of 0.442 $\pm$ 0.020 on complete test set and 0.456 $\pm$ 0.037 on the source-video-disjoint subset. On the external CV2024 dataset, ConvNeXt-Tiny achieves the highest MCC of 0.207, while performance degrades substantially across architectures relative to in-domain evaluation. We further investigate source-video diversity using a per-class cap of 200 training frames. With the total training-set size held fixed, increasing the maximum source-video coverage from four to eight improves MCC for 17 of 19 evaluated architectures. Overall, these findings demonstrate that model rankings and classification performance depend substantially on evaluation protocol, training-source diversity, and cross-dataset shift, emphasizing the need for source-aware validation and rigorous external evaluation of VCE classification systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DMSNet（可变形自适应多尺度边缘引导注意力网络），系统评估VCE分类在随机帧级与源视频不交叉两种验证协议下的可靠性，并揭示源视频重叠、训练源视频多样性与跨数据集偏移对结论的影响。
AI.motivation: VCE自动分类面临严重类别不平衡、源视频多样性有限、跨数据集图像外观差异大等挑战；现有深度学习模型虽在基准上表现良好，但其在不同验证协议和外部数据集偏移下的可靠性尚缺乏清晰认识。
AI.method: 提出DMSNet，集成自适应多尺度特征融合、可变形病灶细化、边缘引导注意力与稀疏特征选择；在Kvasir-Capsule上与18种代表性CNN、Transformer及预训练视觉架构对比，采用随机帧级与源视频不交叉两种协议，并识别原训练/测试划分中的源视频重叠，在完整测试集与源视频不交叉子集上分别评估；另在外部CV2024数据集测试，并以每类200帧上限控制训练集规模，考察源视频覆盖数（4→8）的影响。
AI.result: 随机帧级验证下，DMSNet在完整测试集MCC为0.442±0.020，在源视频不交叉子集为0.456±0.037；外部CV2024上ConvNeXt-Tiny取得最高MCC 0.207，各架构相对域内评估显著退化；在训练集总量固定时，将最大源视频覆盖从4提升至8使19个架构中17个的MCC提升。
AI.conclusion: 模型排序与分类性能显著依赖评估协议、训练源多样性与跨数据集偏移，VCE分类系统需要源感知验证与严格的外部评估。

title: XAI-Driven Confidence Estimation for OOD-Resilient Runtime Prediction
summary: Machine learning-based resource management (RM) models degrade under out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs at runtime, yet existing approaches in the literature rely on a single global error margin that is overly conservative and fails to distinguish reliablepredictions from catastrophic failures. We propose Lightweight Runtime EXplainability (LEX), the first post-hoc XAI framework for input-specific runtime confidence estimation in ML-based RM. LEX clusters the embeddings of the training input space using a Gaussian Mixture Model and associates per-cluster prediction error bounds to input samples, enabling fine-grained runtime confidence signals without retraining. Evaluated on a state-of-the-art LSTM-based IPS forecasting model on Intel Alder Lake, across 34 benchmark applications, LEX achieves ~94% containment on unseen workloads and produces ~17% tighter per-input confidence bounds than global baselines. With its negligible runtime overhead, LEX advances the field by providing explainable and reliable input-specific confidence signals of ML predictions, thereby making ML-based resource management resilient to OOD at runtime.

AI.tldr: LEX 是首个面向机器学习资源管理（RM）的事后（post-hoc）可解释AI框架，通过高斯混合模型对训练输入嵌入聚类，并为每个簇分配预测误差边界，从而在运行时提供输入特定的置信度信号；在Intel Alder Lake上对LSTM的IPS预测模型、34个基准应用进行评估，实现约94%的未见工作负载包含率、比全局基线紧密约17%的每输入置信边界，且运行时开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 机器学习资源管理模型在运行时遇到分布外（OOD）输入时性能会退化，而现有方法仅依赖单一的全局误差边界，过于保守，且无法区分可靠预测与灾难性失效，缺乏细粒度、可解释的运行时置信度评估手段。
AI.method: 提出 LEX（Lightweight Runtime EXplainability）框架：用高斯混合模型（GMM）对训练输入空间的嵌入进行聚类，再将每个簇的预测误差边界与输入样本关联，无需重新训练即可在运行时给出输入特定的细粒度置信度信号；评测对象为Intel Alder Lake上基于LSTM的IPS预测模型，覆盖34个基准应用。
AI.result: 在未见工作负载上达到约94%的包含率（containment），每输入置信边界比全局基线紧约17%，且运行时开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: LEX 为ML预测提供可解释且可靠的输入特定置信度信号，使基于机器学习的资源管理在运行时对OOD输入具备韧性，推动了该领域的发展。

title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at IEEE CogMI 2026 (regular paper)
summary: Failure taxonomies for LLM reasoning are increasingly reported as measurements: papers state what fraction of a model's errors fall into named categories, then compare those fractions across models. We show that for one such category the reported fraction is largely a property of the measurement procedure. We defined Compositional Collapse (a model notices a required sub-part of a problem, then drops or misapplies it) and measured it across twelve models and eleven languages on a public multilingual math benchmark (2,316 graded records). First, 50.1% of failures carry evidence for more than one category, so the reported plurality depends on the order in which the classifier tests them: reversing two tests moves it in eleven of twelve models, and across all six orderings Collapse's share spans 26.4% to 76.4%. Second, agreement collapses for the category but not for the task. Native speakers of all eleven languages judged 179 transcripts, agreeing with our inspector at kappa = 0.932 on answer correctness but only kappa = 0.093 on Collapse. A second native speaker per language re-rated 142 items; on 121 determinate pairs the two humans agree with each other at kappa = 0.659, while each agrees with the inspector at kappa <= 0.094. Re-running the same inspector model with the human instructions verbatim raises kappa against Human 2 from 0.147 to 0.636, so the gap is largely attributable to the prompt, not the model. Third, the inspector labels Collapse 1.81 times as often as native speakers, but only 1.17 times once a defective benchmark item (a deleted clause in the Bengali and Chinese translations) is excluded. We recommend four cheap checks before comparing failure-mode rates across models: report label co-occurrence, permute the tie-break, validate on a shared independent sample, and audit systematic disagreements.

AI.tldr: 论文指出大模型推理失败类型学的"比例"指标在很大程度上是测量流程的产物而非模型属性：Compositional Collapse 的占比在六种判定顺序下跨度达 26.4%–76.4%，且分类标签的人类一致性极低（κ=0.093），远低于任务本身正确性一致性（κ=0.932）。
AI.motivation: 近年大量工作把"某类错误占模型全部错误的比例"当作可比较的测量量，跨模型比较失败模式分布。作者质疑这一做法：若该比例主要由分类流程（标签共现、判定顺序、prompt、缺陷题目）决定，则跨模型比较缺乏效度。因此需要量化"测量流程"对报告比例的贡献。
AI.method: 定义新失败类别 Compositional Collapse（模型识别到题目所需子部分却丢弃或误用），在公开多语言数学基准上对 12 个模型、11 种语言、2,316 条已评分记录进行测量，并做三项检验：(1) 标签共现与六种判定顺序排列下的占比区间；(2) 11 种语言母语者标注 179 条转录，与自动 inspector 比较 κ，并对 142 条做双人二次标注；(3) 用人类指令原文重跑同一 inspector 模型，并剔除缺陷题（孟加拉语、中文译文删句）后重估比例。
AI.result: 50.1% 的失败样本同时携带多个类别证据；交换两项测试即在 12 个模型中 11 个改变"最大占比类别"，Collapse 占比在全排列下为 26.4%–76.4%。人类与 inspector 在答案正确性上 κ=0.932，在 Collapse 上仅 κ=0.093；两名人类彼此 κ=0.659，而各自与 inspector 的 κ≤0.094。改用人类指令原文后，对 Human 2 的 κ 由 0.147 升至 0.636。inspector 标注 Collapse 的频次为母语者的 1.81 倍，剔除缺陷题后降至 1.17 倍。
AI.conclusion: 失败模式比例（至少对该类别）应视为测量流程的属性。跨模型比较前应执行四项低成本检查：报告标签共现、置换判定顺序/平局规则、在共享独立样本上验证、审计系统性分歧；同时提示 prompt 设计而非模型能力是 κ 差距主因。

title: An IoT Based Approach for Platform Independent Positioning Service
summary: KAIST Indoor Localization System (KAILOS) was introduced in 2014 and became one of the world-first complete indoor positioning solutions. It is mainly based on the WiFi signal to estimate location and provide positioning service via mobile application that has many restrictions by the Operating System. This study proposes an extended architecture of KAILOS to make use of the IoT device for removing the barriers of the mobile-app-based approach and conveniently providing indoor positioning service. Design of the IoT device that contains hardware and software is also presented. Via this study, we prove that the IoT-based approach is promising and can be a crucial feature to widen applications of indoor localization services.

AI.tldr: 提出KAILOS的IoT扩展架构及配套IoT设备（含软硬件设计），以摆脱移动App受限的束缚，便捷提供室内定位服务，并验证该IoT方案具有前景。
AI.motivation: KAILOS自2014年提出，是基于WiFi的完整室内定位方案，但依赖移动应用，而移动操作系统对应用有诸多限制，构成服务落地的障碍。
AI.method: 在KAILOS原有架构基础上设计扩展架构，引入IoT设备替代移动App作为定位与服务载体，并给出该IoT设备的硬件与软件设计。
AI.result: 通过所设计的IoT设备验证了基于IoT的室内定位途径可行且具前景，可作为拓展室内定位服务应用场景的关键特性。
AI.conclusion: IoT化架构可消除移动App方式的多重限制，是推广室内定位服务应用的有价值方向。

title: Adaptive Residual Quantization for Memory-Efficient Temporal Action Segmentation
summary: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) is commonly trained on large banks of pre-extracted frame features, but storing and replaying those features becomes a practical bottleneck for long-form video, especially in incremental TAS where past-task data must remain available to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Recent TAS replay and condensation methods reduce this burden, but they rely on dense frame-wise annotations and allocate storage through fixed segment-level structures, limiting their flexibility for long procedural videos whose frame complexity varies substantially over time. We introduce Adaptive Residual-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (ARQ-VAE), a compact and label-free memory representation for TAS features that learns a discrete residual quantization of frame-level video features and then adaptively truncates the residual chain on a per-frame basis, retaining only the residual prefix that best reconstructs each frame feature. This yields a practical compact feature memory that does not depend on frame-wise labels and can therefore support multiple TAS settings with the same stored representation, while a lightweight fine-tuning stage further improves reconstruction quality for the truncated codes that are actually retained. Across standard TAS benchmarks, ARQ-VAE achieves a substantially improved storage-performance trade-off over prior replay and condensation baselines. On Breakfast, our final representation reduces training-set storage from 28 GB for the original I3D feature bank to 10 MB while retaining strong downstream segmentation performance; with ASFormer, it achieves 71.5 Edit and 51.2 F1@50 in the supervised setting. We further show that the same label-free memory remains effective for incremental and unsupervised TAS. We position ARQ-VAE as a practical memory representation for TAS and a promising direction for broader dataset condensation applications.

AI.tldr: 提出ARQ-VAE，一种无需逐帧标签的紧凑特征记忆表示：对帧级视频特征做离散残差量化，并按帧自适应截断残差链；在TAS基准上大幅改善存储-性能权衡（Breakfast训练集存储从28 GB降至10 MB）。
AI.motivation: TAS通常依赖大规模预抽取帧特征库，长期视频下存储与重放成为瓶颈；增量TAS需保留旧任务数据以缓解灾难性遗忘，负担更重。现有回放与数据集蒸馏方法依赖稠密逐帧标注，并以固定分段级结构分配存储，难以适应帧复杂度随时间显著变化的长流程视频。
AI.method: ARQ-VAE：学习帧级视频特征的离散残差量化表示，并逐帧自适应截断残差链，仅保留最能重建该帧特征的前缀残差；随后用轻量微调阶段提升被实际保留的截断码的重建质量。整体表示与逐帧标签无关，可复用于多种TAS设定。
AI.result: 在标准TAS基准上，存储-性能权衡显著优于既有回放与蒸馏基线。Breakfast上训练集存储由原I3D特征库的28 GB降至10 MB，仍保持较强分割性能；监督设定下配合ASFormer取得71.5 Edit与51.2 F1@50。同一无标签记忆在增量与无监督TAS中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: ARQ-VAE可作为一种实用的TAS记忆表示，并为更广泛的数据集蒸馏应用提供有前景的方向。

title: Audited Gradients, Anchored Policies: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Flow Control
comment: 46 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables. Code and result files: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/joint_mbrl-D1EC/
summary: Feedback controllers for flows are expensive to design, since each candidate must be evaluated with a high-fidelity solver. Differentiable surrogates reduce that cost, but they also introduce a failure mode that prediction error cannot detect. Policy optimization uses the derivative of the objective with respect to the action, which we call the action gradient and which can be computed either through the surrogate or through the high-fidelity solver. Optimization through the surrogate uses only its action gradient, and a surrogate can follow the flow trajectory closely while misestimating this derivative. The surrogate action gradient is compared against a central finite-difference estimate from the high-fidelity solver on held-out states, under acceptance criteria fixed before the comparison, and we call that comparison an audit. A low-dimensional feedback law is then fitted to the surrogate action gradient when the surrogate passes the audit, and to the solver estimate when it does not. This law initializes a neural policy, and a quadratic penalty holds the policy near it during optimization. The proposed approach is validated on four test cases. The resulting controllers outperform or match a model-free baseline, while using 3 to 156 times fewer high-fidelity solver interactions across the four test cases. One surrogate predicts the objective at correlation 0.9996 but its action gradient at only 0.459, so prediction accuracy does not identify a usable surrogate. Another surrogate, whose action gradient agrees with the solver estimate at correlation 0.996, makes the objective 0.52% worse when the policy is optimized through it without the anchor penalty, so an accurate gradient alone does not provide a working controller. Finally, a surrogate that passes the audit at one fixed action fails it around the actions the deployed controller applies, so a pass is local.

AI.tldr: 提出对可微代理模型的"动作梯度审计"：在留出状态上比对代理动作梯度与高保真求解器中心差分估计，通过则以代理梯度拟合低维反馈律，否则用求解器估计；该反馈律作锚点约束神经策略优化。四个算例上性能不劣于无模型基线，高保真交互减少3–156倍。
AI.motivation: 流场反馈控制器设计昂贵，每个候选控制器都需高保真求解器评估；可微代理虽降低成本，却存在预测误差无法察觉的失效模式——代理能紧密跟随流场轨迹却严重误估目标对动作的导数（动作梯度），仅靠预测精度无法辨别代理是否可用于策略优化。
AI.method: 1) 定义动作梯度（目标对动作的导数），可经代理或高保真求解器计算；2) 在留出状态上，将代理动作梯度与求解器中心有限差分估计比较，事先固定接受准则，称此为"审计"；3) 审计通过则以代理动作梯度拟合低维反馈律，未通过则改用求解器估计拟合；4) 以该反馈律初始化神经策略，并在优化中用二次惩罚将策略约束在其附近（锚点惩罚）。
AI.result: 四个算例中所得控制器优于或持平无模型基线，高保真求解器交互次数减少3–156倍。诊断性证据：某代理目标预测相关0.9996但动作梯度相关仅0.459，说明预测精度不能识别可用代理；另一代理动作梯度相关0.996，但无锚点惩罚直接经其优化会使目标恶化0.52%，说明梯度准确本身不等于可用控制器；通过某一固定动作审计的代理，在部署控制器实际动作附近反而失败，说明审计通过是局部的。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度不足以判定代理能否用于策略优化，须显式审计动作梯度；且梯度准确亦非充分条件，需以基于反馈律的锚点约束稳定优化。审计结论具有局部性，应在部署相关动作区域内评估。所提流程在显著降低高保真交互成本的同时保持控制性能。

title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
summary: Effective teaching requires reasoning about the learner as well as the task, a capacity that Theory of Mind describes as inferring another agent's latent state from its behavior. We ask whether a stronger LLM teaches a fixed student better when it applies this principle. The student is an LLM agent acting through a harness that fixes its tools, context, and action budget, so a procedure that helps one model can exhaust the budget of another. We introduce Student-Aware Teaching (SAT). The teacher builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about the student's limitations, tests these hypotheses with diagnostic probes, and writes reusable skills for the diagnosed failures. A skill enters the library only after it raises success on matched development tasks. With Claude-Sonnet-5 teaching DeepSeek-V4-Flash, SAT reaches 86.46% task success across four primary runs, leading both a profile-free teacher with the same framework (81.04%) and the untaught student (75.00%) in each run. Removing the analytical learner model lowers both prediction and success, and under misleading learner profiles none of the 48 candidate skills passes admission. When DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Gemini-3.8-Flash exchange libraries, each performs better with its own. Saved libraries keep average gains of up to 11.1 points after the teacher leaves. The benefit depends on a student that can follow instructions and a deployment route that delivers them.

AI.tldr: 提出Student-Aware Teaching（SAT）框架，让强LLM教师基于学习者建模（经验画像+局限假设+诊断探测）为学生LLM撰写可复用技能，技能须经开发集验证方可入库；在固定学生（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）上使任务成功率由75.00%提升至86.46%，教师撤离后技能库仍保留最高11.1个百分点的增益。
AI.motivation: 有效教学不仅需要理解任务，还需推理学习者状态（心智理论：从行为推断他人潜在状态）。学生是受工具、上下文与动作预算约束的LLM智能体，同一教学程序对某一模型有效，可能耗尽另一模型的预算，因此需要"学生感知"的教学方法而非通用提示优化。
AI.method: SAT由教师LLM实施：构建学习者模型，将经验画像与关于学生局限的假设配对；通过诊断探测检验假设；针对已诊断的失败撰写可复用技能；技能须在匹配的开发任务上提升成功率才被接纳进技能库。实验设定为教师Claude-Sonnet-5、学生DeepSeek-V4-Flash，设置四个主运行，并与同框架但无画像的教师、未受教学生对比；同时进行学习者模型消融、误导性画像压力测试与技能库跨模型交换实验。
AI.result: SAT达到86.46%任务成功率，领先无画像教师（81.04%）与未受教学生（75.00%），且在每个运行中均胜出；移除分析性学习者模型会同时降低预测能力与成功率；在误导性学习者画像下，48个候选技能无一通过准入；DeepSeek-V4-Flash与Gemini-3.8-Flash交换技能库时，各自使用自有库表现更优；教师撤离后，已保存技能库平均增益最高达11.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将心智理论式学习者建模引入LLM教学可显著提升教学效果，且增益具备可迁移的持久性（技能库留存）。但收益依赖两个前提：学生具备指令遵循能力，以及存在能将其指令送达的部署路径。该结论强调教学有效性是教师、学生与部署条件三者共同作用的结果。

title: NIF-VIO: Visual--Inertial Odometry Across Inertial and Non-Inertial Reference Frames
summary: Conventional visual--inertial odometry (VIO) assumes that observations from cameras and an inertial measurement unit (IMU) are jointly consistent in an inertial reference frame. However, this assumption breaks down under non-inertial conditions. Inside accelerating or rotating carriers, visual observations of the interior reflect carrier-relative motion, while IMU measurements contain additional carrier-induced components, which can compromise conventional fusion. We therefore present NIF-VIO for localization relative to the local environment across inertial and non-inertial reference frames. It adapts visual--inertial fusion based on measurement consistency. As inertial conditions change, early constraint isolation is combined with local reoptimization to limit error propagation before inconsistency confirmation and repair the affected local geometry. Under non-inertial conditions, a compact model with temporally shared parameters is introduced to account for carrier motion while preserving inertial information that complements visual constraints. Experiments on public benchmarks and a self-collected dataset demonstrate that NIF-VIO achieves competitive performance under inertial conditions and improved localization accuracy and availability under non-inertial conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出NIF-VIO，一种可根据测量一致性自适应切换视觉-惯性融合策略的里程计框架，可在惯性与非惯性参考系下实现相对局部环境的定位。
AI.motivation: 传统VIO假设相机与IMU观测在同一惯性参考系下联合一致，但该假设在非惯性条件下失效：在加速或旋转载体内部，视觉观测反映的是载体相对运动，而IMU测量含有额外的载体诱导分量，导致常规融合性能退化甚至失效。
AI.method: 以测量一致性为判据自适应调整视觉-惯性融合。惯性条件变化时，先进行早期约束隔离并配合局部重优化，以在确认不一致之前抑制误差传播，并修复受影响的局部几何；在非惯性条件下，引入具有时间共享参数的紧凑模型来刻画载体运动，同时保留可与视觉约束互补的惯性信息。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集与自采数据集上的实验表明：惯性条件下NIF-VIO达到有竞争力的性能，非惯性条件下定位精度与可用性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过一致性驱动的约束隔离、局部重优化与紧凑载体运动建模，NIF-VIO规避了跨参考系融合的不一致问题，为惯性/非惯性混合场景提供了兼顾精度与可用性的VIO方案。

title: RetinexGS: Retinex-Inspired Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light RAW Reconstruction
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines struggle with severely underexposed images, producing unstable colors, floating artifacts, and incomplete reconstructions in dark regions. To better account for noise in these low-light observations, RAW images offer a natural basis for noise-aware reconstruction by preserving linear sensor measurements and providing access to noise metadata. We present RetinexGS, a RAW-domain 3DGS framework that combines Retinex-inspired appearance modeling with sensor-informed optimization for low-light novel-view synthesis. We factorize each Gaussian's color into a view-independent base color and a shared, position- and view-dependent modulation field, regularizing the two components separately to constrain appearance learning from noisy observations. We use DNG noise metadata to weight the reconstruction loss for signal-dependent noise, while distortion-aware rendering avoids spatially resampling RAW targets. To address sparse geometry in dark regions, we introduce depth-guided initialization. We evaluate RetinexGS on three public RawNeRF scenes and two custom-captured low-light RAW scenes. With all methods trained on the same RAW inputs for each scene, RetinexGS outperforms LE3D and RawNeRF in mean sRGB PSNR by 2.18 dB and 2.71 dB respectively, across the five scenes, while supporting real-time novel-view rendering.

AI.tldr: RetinexGS：面向低光RAW图像的3D高斯泼溅框架，结合Retinex外观建模与传感器噪声感知优化，在五个低光场景上sRGB PSNR超过LE3D和RawNeRF。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS在严重欠曝图像上颜色不稳定、出现浮空伪影、暗区重建不完整；RAW图像保留线性传感器测量与噪声元数据，更适合噪声感知重建。
AI.method: 1) 将每个高斯颜色分解为视角无关基础色与共享的、依赖位置与视角的调制场，并分别正则化；2) 利用DNG噪声元数据对重建损失加权以建模信号相关噪声；3) 采用畸变感知渲染，避免对RAW目标做空间重采样；4) 引入深度引导初始化以缓解暗区几何稀疏。
AI.result: 在3个公开RawNeRF场景与2个自采集低光RAW场景上，所有方法使用相同RAW输入训练，RetinexGS的平均sRGB PSNR分别比LE3D和RawNeRF高2.18 dB与2.71 dB，并支持实时新视角渲染。
AI.conclusion: 在RAW域建模外观与噪声可有效提升低光新视角合成质量，兼顾重建精度与实时渲染性能。

title: Wrong the Same Way: Cross-Prompt Sharing Both Suppresses and Amplifies Reward Hacking in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Two accounts of how reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) interacts with an imperfect verifier coexist: in one, reward hacking is inherited from the base model; in the other, RL amplifies it. We study both in a controlled environment small enough to compute the entire response distribution exactly. We vary the universality of a leak, or the fraction of prompts that accept the same wrong response, and the verifier's static false-positive rate. At its KL-regularized optimum, RLVR acts as a filter that reweights the accepted set without altering its composition, so the hack rate is inherited exactly. Taking that as a null model, a known decomposition writes the drift from it as a sum over prompts of covariances between reward and the empirical tangent kernel. The terms from other prompts vanish without parameter sharing. With sharing, every prompt that accepts a wrong answer pushes it up and every prompt that rejects it pushes it down through the baseline, in proportion to the model's probability of producing it there. A shared-parameter policy thus drives a leak that few prompts accept below the base rate and amplifies one that most prompts accept. At every convergent learning rate under Adam, SGD, and sampled GRPO, hacking ends higher at high universality than at low, but whether either end crosses the base rate depends on the step size. Independent per-prompt copies remove the dependence. The direction of this push depends on neither the verifier's error rate nor universality alone, but on how much of the model's kernel-weighted probability of a wrong answer falls on prompts that accept it, which frozen base model controls support. Verifier fixes should target the mistakes the model repeats across prompts: two patches that remove equally many errors differ by up to 38 points of true accuracy. We propose this alignment as a hypothesis for why earlier studies disagree.

AI.tldr: 该文用可精确计算完整响应分布的小规模受控环境，解析RLVR与不完美验证器交互的两种假说，指出在KL正则最优处RLVR只是对接受集重加权（黑箱率"继承"），而参数共享通过基线项使泄漏在低普遍性下被压低、高普遍性下被放大，且最终方向取决于模型对错误答案的核加权概率有多少落在接受它的提示上。
AI.motivation: 关于RLVR与不完美验证器交互存在两种相互竞争的解释：一种认为奖励黑客（reward hacking）完全继承自基座模型，另一种认为RL会放大它。此前研究结论不一致，且缺乏能精确刻画全分布、分离"继承"与"放大"机制的可控实验。作者希望建立一个可解析的零模型，厘清继承、放大条件及对验证器缺陷类型的依赖。
AI.method: 构建足够小、可精确计算全响应分布的受控环境；操纵两个变量：泄漏的普遍性（接受同一错误响应的提示比例）与验证器的静态假正率。以KL正则化最优作为零模型（仅对接受集重加权、不改变其构成）；采用已知分解，将漂移写成各提示上奖励与经验切核（empirical tangent kernel）协方差之和，比较无参数共享（各项消失）与参数共享（通过基线项产生跨提示耦合）两种情形；并在Adam、SGD、采样GRPO及不同学习率下检验收敛行为，辅以逐提示独立副本的对照。
AI.result: KL正则最优处黑箱率精确继承，漂移可分解为核协方差项。无参数共享时跨提示项为零；有共享时，接受错误答案的提示通过基线推高其概率，拒绝的提示推低之，幅度正比于模型在该处的概率，因而共享参数策略会把少数提示接受的泄漏压到基率以下、把多数提示接受的泄漏放大。在Adam、SGD、GRPO的所有收敛学习率下，高普遍性的最终黑箱率均高于低普遍性，但是否越过基率取决于步长；逐提示独立副本可消除该依赖。推动方向既不只取决于验证器误差率也不只取决于普遍性，而取决于"核加权错误概率中落在接受提示上的份额"，该份额由冻结基座模型支撑。验证器修补应针对模型跨提示重复的错误：两个移除等量错误的补丁，真准确率可相差达38个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RLVR下的奖励黑客既非纯粹继承也非无条件放大：无参数共享时为精确继承，参数共享时普遍性决定放大或抑制方向，步长决定是否偏离基率。作者将该"核加权接受份额"机制作为解释以往研究结论分歧的对齐假说，并主张验证器修复应优先消除模型跨提示系统性重复的错误。

title: Cognitive Multi-Agent Search and Rescue: Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collaborative Robotics
summary: Effective search and rescue (SAR) operations require autonomous systems capable of coordinating multiple heterogeneous agents, adapting to dynamic hazards, and aligning with human mission intent. Existing language-guided reinforcement learning (RL) methods primarily focus on single-agent instruction following and lack mechanisms for team-level coordination in complex, partially observable environments. This paper presents a Cognitive Multi-Agent Framework based on Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (LG-HRL) that integrates natural-language understanding, hierarchical policy decomposition, and a shared cognitive workspace to achieve cohesive multi-agent behavior in SAR scenarios. Human instructions are interpreted by a large language model (LLM) and transformed into structured semantic cues that guide high-level strategy selection and role assignment across UAV and UGV agents. A formal Language-Grounded Multi-Agent Hierarchical Decision Process (LG-MAHDP) is introduced to model the interplay between semantic grounding, hierarchical control, and distributed coordination. Comprehensive experiments in a simulated disaster environment show that LG-HRL improves learning speed by 2.3 times, increases coordination coherence by 37%, and enhances subgoal accuracy and hazard avoidance by 46% and 31%, respectively. The system achieves 20-30% higher victim rescue rates, demonstrates emergent role specialization, and adapts immediately to human verbal updates. Ablation studies confirm that both the shared cognitive workspace and language grounding are critical to overall system performance. Overall, this work establishes a new paradigm for language-guided multi-agent SAR robotics, demonstrating that semantic grounding combined with hierarchical reasoning enables safer, more efficient, and more interpretable autonomous rescue operations.

AI.tldr: 提出语言接地分层强化学习(LG-HRL)的认知多智能体框架，将LLM解析的自然语言指令转化为结构化语义线索，驱动UAV/UGV异构团队在搜索救援场景中的分层协调决策。
AI.motivation: 搜索救援(SAR)需要多异构智能体协同、适应动态危险并对齐人类任务意图。现有语言引导RL方法多局限于单智能体指令跟随，缺少在复杂部分可观测环境下的团队级协调机制。
AI.method: 由LLM解释人类指令并生成结构化语义线索，用于高层策略选择与UAV/UGV角色分配；引入共享认知工作区支撑分布式协调；形式化定义语言接地多智能体分层决策过程(LG-MAHDP)，刻画语义接地、分层控制与分布式协调的交互。
AI.result: 仿真灾害环境中学习速度提升2.3倍，协调一致性提升37%，子目标准确率与避障能力分别提升46%和31%，救援成功率提高20–30%；出现角色专门化涌现，并能即时响应人类口头指令更新；消融实验证实共享认知工作区与语言接地均为性能关键。
AI.conclusion: 语义接地与分层推理相结合可实现更安全、高效且可解释的自主救援；该工作为语言引导的多智能体SAR机器人学确立了新范式。

title: Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos
summary: In this paper, we investigate how human egocentric videos can benefit robot policy learning without action supervision. Building on a pretrained VLM, we propose Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR), an MoT architecture in which future visual state prediction can provide independent and complementary learning signals alongside action prediction. We find that representations learned from egocentric videos improve downstream performance on out-of-distribution robot tasks, with further gains as video data scales. We also study the effects of objective choices and data curation, providing insights into how to leverage action-free videos for scalable robot learning.

AI.tldr: 提出SPAR——一种基于预训练VLM的混合Transformer(MoT)架构，通过"动作预测"与"未来视觉状态预测"双任务共享学习，从无动作标注的第一人称人类视频中提取可迁移表征用于机器人策略学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略学习缺乏大规模带动作标注的数据，而人类第一人称（egocentric）视频数量庞大却无动作监督。核心问题是：如何在不具备动作标签的情况下，有效利用此类视频提升机器人策略学习，尤其是分布外(OOD)任务上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 以预训练VLM为骨干，构建MoT（Mixture-of-Transformers）架构，同时进行两路预测：动作预测与未来视觉状态预测。未来视觉状态预测被视为与动作预测相互独立且互补的学习信号，从而在无动作监督的视频上提供自监督训练目标。论文还系统消融了目标函数选择与数据筛选(curation)策略的影响。
AI.result: 从第一人称视频中习得的表征显著提升了下游分布外机器人任务的表现；随着视频数据规模扩大，增益进一步提升，呈现良好的可扩展性。同时，目标函数设计与数据筛选策略对最终效果有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 无动作标注的第一人称视频可作为机器人策略学习的可扩展数据来源；"动作+未来视觉状态"的联合预测是有效利用此类数据的关键机制，为规模化机器人学习提供了可操作的实践启示。

title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, accepted and presented at Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026)
summary: The rapid advancement of foundation models has transformed computer vision, yet their adaptation to medical imaging, particularly purpose built foundation models for spatio temporal echocardiography videos, remains limited. In this work, we explore the feasibility of fine tuning a pretrained foundation model for video (TimeSformer) for automated diagnosis of reduced ejection fraction heart failure (HFrEF) from apical four chamber videos. The model is finetuned on the publicly available RVENet A4C dataset with a phase aware clip generation strategy that captures complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics. We employ divided space time attention, layer wise learning rate decay, and multi clip inference to enhance robustness under limited data. Experimental results show that full fine tuning of the proposed model outperforms classifier only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline. These findings highlight the potential of leveraging foundation video models for echocardiography based heart failure diagnosis and motivates further domain adaptation studies in medical imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文探索将视频基础模型TimeSformer微调用于心尖四腔心超声视频的射血分数降低型心衰（HFrEF）自动诊断，并在RVENet A4C数据集上验证全量微调优于仅分类头微调与3D CNN基线。
AI.motivation: 基础模型已革新计算机视觉，但面向时空超声心动图视频的专用基础模型仍很有限，其在医学影像上的适配可行性尚待验证。
AI.method: 在公开RVENet A4C数据集上微调预训练视频基础模型TimeSformer；采用相位感知片段生成策略以捕获互补的收缩期与舒张期动态；结合分离时空注意力、逐层学习率衰减与多片段推理以提升小数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 全量微调优于仅分类头微调，并优于3D CNN基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果显示了利用视频基础模型进行超声心动图心衰诊断的潜力，并推动医学影像领域的进一步域适应研究。

title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement
summary: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. Independent stream contexts share model resources, and consecutive frames from one stream can be processed in a single inference call. We evaluate the released models on EARS-WHAM v2 and compare their quality and processing costs with RNNoise and DPDFNet2. All tested native and Web configurations process files faster than real time, although larger chunks require more time to collect input. We also measure how many streams a shared model can process on a CPU. Our contribution is a configurable deployment system and an experimental study of how model choice, chunk size, and execution environment affect its use. All reported SDK timing uses ONNX Runtime. Index Terms: speech enhancement, streaming inference, cross-platform deployment, temporal frame grouping, computational efficiency

AI.tldr: 论文提出开源SDK GigaEdge Spench，用于在CPU服务器、移动端与浏览器上进行流式语音增强，支持模块化组合神经去噪、归一化、动态处理、重采样与回声消除，并给出跨平台部署与性能实验研究。
AI.motivation: 现有语音增强模型多聚焦于指标提升，缺少可配置、跨平台（CPU服务器/移动端/浏览器）的流式部署系统，且缺少对模型选择、chunk大小与执行环境如何影响实际使用成本的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建共享C++核心，通过ONNX Runtime与TensorFlow Lite原生接口、Android/iOS SDK及WebAssembly实现跨平台部署；以模块化block构建增强通道（8 kHz INT8去噪器，以及判别式与混合式48 kHz FP32模型；归一化可脱离神经模型独立运行）；采用独立流上下文共享模型资源，并支持将同一流的连续帧合并为单次推理调用（时间帧分组）。在EARS-WHAM v2上与RNNoise、DPDFNet2对比质量与处理开销，并测量单模型在CPU上可并发处理的流数。
AI.result: 所有测试的原生与Web配置均实现快于实时的文件处理速度，但较大chunk需更长的输入累积时间；同时给出共享模型在CPU上的并发流处理能力测量结果。SDK计时均基于ONNX Runtime。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献在于一个可配置的部署系统，以及对模型选择、chunk大小与执行环境如何影响流式语音增强使用成本的实验研究。

title: AI Alignment Is Neither Solvable nor Sufficient
summary: Humans and AI systems increasingly act within the same social and economic environments. Alignment, the goal of ensuring that AI systems act in accordance with human values, is widely regarded as a central challenge for ensuring that AI benefits society while avoiding harm. We argue that this endeavor is misguided. First, alignment is not well defined, as it presumes a sufficiently stable and identifiable set of human intentions or values. Second, where a concrete notion of alignment can be specified, it is not solvable. Third, where alignment appears solvable, solving it would not necessarily mitigate the negative consequences of AI. A key reason is that alignment is typically framed as a property of individual AI systems, while the resulting hybrid societies of humans and machines are complex systems shaped by interactions and feedback loops. Emergent risks, and not only those posed by individual misaligned systems, are therefore likely to become a major source of harm. We conclude that AI safety is an ongoing challenge and not a problem that can be solved once and for all by verifying a particular model property.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"对齐"（alignment）作为AI安全核心目标的有效性：对齐概念定义不清、在可界定之处难以求解、在可解之处求解亦未必减灾；因AI风险源于人机混合社会的涌现性，AI安全是持续挑战而非一次性的模型属性验证问题。
AI.motivation: 当前主流观点将"确保AI系统符合人类价值"的对齐视为AI造福社会、避免危害的核心议题。作者认为这一努力方向存在根本性误区，需要重新审视对齐研究的前提假设与研究议程。
AI.method: 概念分析与论证性（position paper）论述，从三个层面依次反驳对齐纲领：（1）概念界定层面——对齐预设了稳定且可识别的人类意图/价值集合；（2）可解性层面——在能具体化对齐含义的情形下它并不可解；（3）有效性层面——在看似可解的情形下，解决对齐也未必能缓解AI的负面后果。核心论据是：对齐通常被框定为单个AI系统的属性，而人机混合社会是受交互与反馈回路塑造的复杂系统。
AI.result: 论证了对齐作为个体系统属性的框架忽视涌现风险：除单个"失准"系统带来的风险外，由人机交互与反馈回路产生的涌现性风险很可能成为危害的主要来源，因而"对齐即安全"的推论不成立。
AI.conclusion: AI安全是持续性的开放挑战，不能通过对某一特定模型属性的验证一次性"彻底解决"；研究议程应从个体系统属性转向人机混合复杂系统中的交互与涌现风险。

title: Joint-State Inference for Autonomous Excavators Using Cab-View Vision-Control Fusion
summary: Reliable state feedback of excavator front-end mechanisms is essential for autonomous excavation, yet retrofitting existing machines with dedicated joint sensors, external cameras, or visual markers can increase deployment and maintenance burdens. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous excavation framework for continuous inference of excavator joint states using onboard visual observations and control-related temporal information. The framework encodes structural cues from the current cab-view image, models short-term motion trends from historical joystick commands, and introduces a rolling state buffer for the bucket joint to preserve temporal continuity under severe occlusion. Mechanical joint-range constraints are incorporated into the learning objective to suppress infeasible estimates. The current cab-view image and inferred states are supplied to an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)-based control policy for online action generation. Experiments in an AGX Dynamics for Unity simulation environment under diverse operating conditions evaluate joint-state inference and end-to-end task execution. Across 20 autonomous excavation trials, the framework achieved a 95% task-completion rate, with an average joint-state-inference-and-control latency of 10.11 ms per step. The bucket-joint inference achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.965 degrees. These results demonstrate a sensor-light and computationally efficient joint-state-inference approach that can support closed-loop autonomous excavation with reduced dependence on additional sensing infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"传感器轻量"的闭环自主挖掘框架：仅用座舱视角图像与历史操纵杆指令，连续推断挖掘机关节状态，并驱动基于ACT的动作生成策略完成自主挖掘任务。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘依赖可靠的前端机构关节状态反馈，但在现有机器上加装专用关节传感器、外部相机或视觉标记会显著增加部署与维护负担，因此需要一种低附加传感依赖的状态估计方案。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 从当前座舱视图图像编码结构线索；(2) 由历史操纵杆控制指令建模短期运动趋势，融合控制相关时序信息；(3) 为铲斗关节引入滚动状态缓冲，以在严重遮挡下保持时序连续性；并将机械关节行程约束嵌入学习目标以抑制不可行估计。推断出的关节状态与当前图像共同输入基于Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)的控制策略，在线生成动作。
AI.result: 在AGX Dynamics for Unity仿真环境中，多种工况下评估关节状态推断与端到端任务执行。20次自主挖掘试验任务完成率95%，单步"关节推断+控制"平均延迟10.11 ms，铲斗关节推断MAE为0.965°。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该关节状态推断方法传感需求少、计算高效，可在减少额外传感基础设施依赖的前提下支撑闭环自主挖掘；但验证目前仅在仿真中进行，实机迁移尚待考察。

title: DUO: Dual Readouts of Diffusion Models for OOD Detection
summary: Diffusion models are powerful generative methods for learning and sampling from complex data distributions. Safely deploying these models requires detecting inputs that fall outside their training distribution. Because diffusion models recover clean samples from noisy inputs, reconstruction error is often used for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. This approach assumes that in-distribution (ID) inputs are reconstructed more accurately than OOD inputs. However, OOD inputs may be reconstructed equally well or even better, making this score unreliable. We therefore propose the leading sensitivity spectrum of intermediate denoising features as a complementary OOD signal and demonstrate that it remains informative when reconstruction error is misleading. We introduce DUal-readout of diffusion models for OOD detection (DUO), a fully unsupervised, training-free OOD detector that combines reconstruction error and feature sensitivity. DUO improves average AUROC by approximately 6% points over the strongest baselines while substantially reducing inference cost, and achieves SOTA on near-OOD and high-resolution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练、无监督的DUO方法，融合重构误差与去噪中间特征的"主导敏感度谱"作为OOD检测信号，在近分布与高分辨率基准上达到SOTA且推理成本更低。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型部署需检测训练分布之外的输入。现有基于重构误差的OOD检测依赖"ID样本重构得更准"这一假设，但OOD输入可能被同样好甚至更好地重构，导致该评分不可靠。
AI.method: 提出以去噪过程中间特征的"主导敏感度谱"（leading sensitivity spectrum）作为互补OOD信号，并与重构误差结合，构建双读出OOD检测器DUO；全过程无需训练、无需标签。
AI.result: 平均AUROC较最强基线提升约6个百分点，同时显著降低推理开销；在近分布OOD与高分辨率基准上取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 特征层面的敏感度信息可在重构误差失效时仍保持判别力，双信号互补使扩散模型OOD检测更可靠、更高效。

title: Domain-Routed Delta Optimization for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation assigns each sample a domain teacher but typically updates shared student parameters. We introduce Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD), which specifies which parameter components each domain's samples update. The student is the sum of a frozen base and trainable components initialized from expert-minus-base weights. All components participate in every forward pass; four update modes define the correspondence between sample domains and components, each with independent optimizer states. We analyze these update rules and measure retention of the original expert geometry through angles, projection coefficients, and energy. Prior work such as Open-MOPD distills directly from the base model; 97.02% of its released final checkpoint's increment energy lies outside the span of the original expert directions. In comparison, our Own checkpoint after 20 updates retains coefficients near one along each component's original direction and pairwise angles ranging from 88.04 to 92.41 degrees; its exported BF16 student's increment has 4.90% outside energy, versus 10.52% for the sum of saved FP32 components. The same checkpoint achieves a 32.72% macro score across six benchmarks, compared with 32.44% for its initial task-arithmetic merge. These measurements describe geometry and capability at the evaluated training stages and settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Domain-Routed Delta Optimization (DRD-MOPD)，在多教师 on-policy 蒸馏中显式规定各领域样本更新哪些参数分量，并系统度量其对原始专家几何结构的保持。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师 on-policy 蒸馏虽为每个样本指派领域教师，但通常更新共享的学生参数，缺乏"领域样本—参数分量"的显式对应；已有方法（如 Open-MOPD）直接从基座模型蒸馏，其最终检查点的增量能量绝大部分落在原始专家方向张成空间之外，专家几何被破坏。
AI.method: 学生模型为冻结基座与可训练分量之和，分量由"专家减基座"权重初始化；所有分量参与每次前向；定义四种更新模式，刻画样本领域与参数分量的对应关系，各分量拥有独立优化器状态；通过夹角、投影系数与能量分析更新规则及专家几何保持情况。
AI.result: Open-MOPD 发布检查点增量能量的 97.02% 位于原始专家方向张成空间之外；本文 Own 检查点经 20 次更新后，各分量沿原始方向系数接近 1，两两夹角为 88.04°–92.41°；导出的 BF16 学生增量外部能量占 4.90%，低于保存的 FP32 分量之和的 10.52%；六项基准宏平均 32.72%，高于初始 task-arithmetic 合并的 32.44%。
AI.conclusion: DRD-MOPD 通过领域—分量路由的增量优化在保持专家几何（方向系数与近正交夹角）的同时取得略优的下游能力；所报告指标仅反映特定训练阶段与设置下的几何与性能。

title: From Process Models to Composable Agentic Workflows: Combining BPMN, Agents and Enterprise Knowledge
summary:
LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce **Recursive Capability Composition**, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools.
  This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. Agentic Participants provide reusable interfaces for agent behavior or other executable processes.
  BPMN orchestration makes multi-agent systems more understandable and manageable. Explicit process models provide developers and operators with a shared view of workflow structures and execution progress, facilitating debugging, monitoring and optimization.
  Enterprise agents also need organization-specific context. Process Models and Knowledge Graphs describe activities, participants, information objects, decisions and relationships between processes. They provide structured knowledge of how an organization operates, supporting informed agent decisions and actions.
  Our contributions are threefold: 1. **Model-Driven Execution:** Transforming BPMN models into executable Agentic Workflows. 2. **Recursive Capability Composition:** Exposing agents and executable business processes as reusable tools for other agents. 3. **Enterprise Context:** Using Process Models and Ontologies to provide organization-specific knowledge for agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于BPMN的Agentic Workflow方法：将SemTalk BPMN模型经LangGraph/Pregel运行时转化为可执行工作流，在选定活动中以Agentic Task引入LLM推理，并用"递归能力组合"把智能体与业务流程封装为可复用工具，同时借助过程模型与知识图谱提供企业语境。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的决策分散在提示词、工具调用与应用逻辑中，使工作流隐式化，随着智能体应用复杂度上升，难以理解、监控与改进；同时企业智能体还需要组织特定语境支撑决策。
AI.method: 采用显式编排与自主推理相结合：以SemTalk BPMN建模，传统BPMN控制流负责确定性决策、系统交互与人工审批，Agentic Task在特定活动处注入LLM推理，Agentic Participant提供可复用的智能体/可执行流程接口；模型经LangGraph/Pregel运行时执行；并引入过程模型与本体/知识图谱描述活动、参与者、信息对象、决策及流程间关系。
AI.result: 实现从BPMN模型到可执行Agentic Workflow的转换，并支持智能体与业务流程互相作为工具递归复用；显式过程模型为开发者与运维者提供工作流结构与执行进度的共享视图，便于调试、监控与优化，过程模型与本体为智能体推理提供组织特定知识。
AI.conclusion: BPMN编排可提升多智能体系统的可理解性与可管理性；三项贡献为模型驱动执行、递归能力组合与企业语境。摘要未给出量化评估，其效果主张（可理解性、可监控性）仍需实证验证。

title: CIALLO: Learning Shared Intent Representations for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
summary: Robot demonstrations contain reusable manipulation knowledge, but transferring this knowledge across embodiments requires representations that bridge differences in control interfaces. Action reconstruction alone does not ensure that similar behaviors across robots share a representation. To address this gap, we introduce CIALLO, an action codec that aligns actions, visual changes, and observation-grounded language in a shared space of short-horizon behavioral intent. An embodiment-conditioned decoder maps this intent back to robot-specific actions, allowing a shared representation to support different control interfaces. After pretraining on eight embodiments, CIALLO adapts to a new robot from one recording of at most 10 seconds by updating only its embodiment embeddings. The calibrated codec then remains frozen while a policy learns to predict intent from observations and instructions. We instantiate this policy with Qwen3.5-4B to form Qwen-CIALLO, whose backbone requires no large-scale robot-action pretraining before policy finetuning. With 20 demonstrations per task, Qwen-CIALLO achieves 76.7\% average success across real SO-101 and single-arm Piper robots, compared with 70.0\% for fully finetuned $π_0$. In simulation, we additionally finetune the action decoder, achieving 97.3\% success on LIBERO and 52.7\% on RoboTwin 2.0. The LIBERO policy also achieves 80.8\% on LIBERO-Plus without further finetuning. Together, these results support a shared action codec as a transferable control interface that separates embodiment calibration from task learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 CIALLO 动作编解码器，将动作、视觉变化与语言对齐到共享的短时程行为意图空间，实现跨具身的知识迁移；配合 Qwen3.5-4B 组成 Qwen-CIALLO，在真实 SO-101/Piper 上以 20 条示教达到 76.7% 平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人示教蕴含可复用的操作知识，但跨具身迁移受控制接口差异阻碍。仅做动作重建无法保证不同机器人的相似行为在表征上共享，因此需要一个能桥接具身差异的共享行为表征。
AI.method: 构建 CIALLO：一个动作编解码器，将动作、视觉变化与基于观测的语言对齐到共享的短时程行为意图空间；用具身条件解码器把意图映射回机器人特定动作。在 8 种具身上预训练后，仅用不超过 10 秒的单条录制、只更新具身嵌入即可适配新机器人；校准后编解码器冻结，由策略从观测与指令预测意图。策略以 Qwen3.5-4B 实现（Qwen-CIALLO），主干无需大规模机器人动作预训练；仿真中额外微调动作解码器。
AI.result: 每任务 20 条示教下，真实 SO-101 与单臂 Piper 上平均成功率 76.7%（全量微调的 π0 为 70.0%）；仿真中微调解码器后 LIBERO 97.3%、RoboTwin 2.0 52.7%；LIBERO 策略在 LIBERO-Plus 上零样本达 80.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将共享动作编解码器作为可迁移的控制接口，把具身校准与任务学习解耦：极小数据即可完成具身适配，且不依赖大规模机器人动作预训练。

title: Domain-Adversarial Adaptation from MURA to In-House Radiographs for Improved Adult Elbow Fracture Classification
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, Accepted and presented on SPIE Medical Imaging 2026
summary: We studied domain shift in adult elbow fracture classification from radiographs when training on a large public dataset and deploying on a small, institution-specific dataset (UofL). We implemented a domain-adversarial neural network (DANN) to align feature distributions across source (MURA) and target (UofL) domains while optimizing fracture classification. A pretrained convolutional backbone was adapted to grayscale inputs; the task head predicts fracture presence, and a gradient-reversal-based domain head encourages domain-invariant features via adversarial learning. We compared four settings: (1) Source-only, (2) Target-only (limited labels), (3) Naive merge (pooled training), and (4) DANN (MURA to UofL). Evaluation on UofL test data uses AUC-ROC, and accuracy. DANN outperformed Source-only and Naive merge baselines by reducing domain bias without overfitting to the small target set. Ablations showed that progressive adversarial weight, dataset-size-aware domain loss, and domain-balanced sampling improved stability and target performance. Results demonstrated that domain alignment is a practical path to robust clinical generalization from public to local data.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对成人肘部骨折X线分类中的域偏移问题，采用域对抗神经网络（DANN）对齐MURA（源域）与UofL（目标域）的特征分布，并通过消融验证了渐进对抗权重、数据集规模感知的域损失与域均衡采样对稳定性和目标域性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 在大型公开数据集上训练的骨折分类模型部署到机构自有小规模数据集时存在显著域偏移（成像设备、协议、人群差异），单纯源域训练或朴素合并训练难以泛化，且目标域标签有限，需在少标签条件下实现跨域鲁棒迁移。
AI.method: 构建DANN：以预训练卷积骨干适配灰度X线输入，任务头预测骨折有无，域头经梯度反转层进行对抗学习以获取域不变特征；对比四种设置——(1) 仅源域、(2) 仅目标域（有限标签）、(3) 朴素合并（联合训练）、(4) DANN（MURA→UofL）；并进行消融：渐进式对抗权重、感知数据集规模的域损失、域均衡采样。
AI.result: 在UofL测试集上以AUC-ROC和准确率评估，DANN优于仅源域与朴素合并基线，在降低域偏差的同时未对小型目标集过拟合；消融表明上述三项改进提升了训练稳定性与目标域性能。
AI.conclusion: 域对齐是从公开数据到本地临床数据实现稳健泛化的可行路径，DANN在少标签目标域场景下有效缓解域偏移，具备临床落地潜力。

title: Off-policy Learning with Excursion Policies
summary: Off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) tries to learn the value of a target policy while data comes from a different behavior policy. This often requires trading off bias for variance or stability. One way to trade these off is to linearly interpolate between the behavior and target policies, but this represents only one point in a broader space of interpolation mechanisms. We introduce excursion policies--a structured alternative where the agent follows the target policy for a multi-step "excursion" before reverting to the behavior policy. We derive dynamic programming results for these policies, establishing the theoretical basis for their use in RL. We further develop provably sound off-policy temporal-difference (TD) algorithms for excursion value estimation. We find that excursion policies provide an efficiency-stability trade-off comparable to mixture policies in continuous control benchmarks, and our analysis illustrates conceptual differences in their behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"excursion policy"（偏移策略）：智能体先按目标策略执行多步"偏移"，再回到行为策略，从而在偏差-方差/稳定性之间提供不同于线性混合插值的折中机制，并给出动态规划与离策略TD估计理论。
AI.motivation: 离策略RL需在偏差、方差与稳定性之间权衡。常见的做法是在行为策略与目标策略间做线性插值（混合策略），但线性插值只覆盖了策略插值空间中的一个点，缺乏更丰富的结构化机制。
AI.method: 1) 定义excursion策略：连续多步遵循目标策略后再回落到行为策略；2) 推导该类策略的动态规划结果，建立理论基础；3) 设计可证明收敛/正确的离策略时序差分（TD）算法用于excursion价值估计；4) 在连续控制基准上与混合策略对比，并分析二者行为差异。
AI.result: excursion策略在连续控制基准上取得了与混合策略相当的效率-稳定性权衡；理论分析揭示了二者机制上的概念性差异。
AI.conclusion: excursion策略为离策略估计提供了线性混合之外的结构化插值方案，具备可靠的理论与算法支撑，可作为偏差-方差权衡的有效替代工具。

title: Counting Under Disagreement: Dollar-Weighted Measurement, Selective Machine Labelling and Budgeted Human Review from Disagreeing AI Readers of Administrative Text
comment: 61 pages, 8 figures, 46 tables. Replication record (calibration sample, population aggregates, prompts and analysis code): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23285230
summary: We study AI-assisted measurement when one text label applies to many administrative records, the target is a monetary total, and the human readings that anchor the machines disagree. The testbed is 121,070 grant-purpose texts from US tax filings (799,675 records, \$126.4B), labelled by a rule-based classifier and three language models, with a designed sample of 651 texts read independently by three people under one codebook. We state exact conditions for a fixed-predictor difference estimator and for a cross-fitted predictor whose folds are assigned to the whole frame before sampling, under Poisson sampling, and assess the implemented fixed-size procedures by simulation: 8 predictors whose own totals span \$11.2-15.0B agree to within \$0.4B once rectified. Two rules that accept machine labels at a stated dollar-weighted error, weighted conformal p-values under a dollar measure and Learn-then-Test on the design estimate of the error, are evaluated on nested held-out folds and on re-draws of the design with synthetic truths; their error control in deployment is not established, and the count-based rule accepts no text under a dollar-drawn sample. In a replay that charges every human label, a two-phase review policy whose calibrator is fitted on its own first phase reduces the RMSE of the total by 28% at a budget of 100 texts relative to dollar-proportional sampling, while pure Neyman allocation fails with an uncalibrated predictor. Independent readers shift the estimated total by \$3.93B, 2.2 times the within-reader sampling interval, and institution-level intervals under-cover at every size. Every headline result is re-run under each reader. The results identify both the benefits and the limits of using learned predictions to decide what a person should verify.

AI.tldr: 本研究以12.1万条美国税务申报中的拨款用途文本为测试台，系统考察"一个标签对应多条行政记录、目标是货币总额、人工读数相互不一致"情形下AI辅助测量的估计性质与误差控制，结论是机器学习预测能帮助决定"该让人核查什么"，但收益与局限并存。
AI.motivation: 行政记录的文本标签常被用于推算货币总量，实践中依赖机器自动标注并抽样人工核查；但同一标签对应大量记录、锚定机器的人工读数彼此不一致、且部署时误差控制难以保证，现有方法缺乏对估计量性质、误差控制规则与大额误差来源的严格刻画。
AI.method: 构建121,070条拨款用途文本（799,675条记录，1,264亿美元）的测试台，由规则分类器与三个语言模型标注，并设计651条文本由三人依同一编码本独立阅读的样本。在泊松抽样下给出固定预测差值估计量与"折叠在抽样前分配至全框架"的交叉拟合预测估计量的精确条件，并以模拟检验固定样本量程序；评估两类机器标签接受规则——按美元加权误差阈值的加权保形p值与基于设计估计误差的Learn-then-Test——在嵌套留出折与含合成真值的重抽样上的表现；还以两阶段（校准器在第一阶段自拟合）复核策略进行全人工计费回放，与按美元比例抽样及Neyman分配比较。
AI.result: 8个预测器自身总额跨度达112–150亿美元，经校正后彼此差异在4亿美元以内。两条接受规则在部署中的误差控制均未获确立；基于计数的规则在按美元抽取的样本下不接受任何文本。全人工计费回放中，两阶段复核策略在100条文本预算下相对美元比例抽样将总额RMSE降低28%，而纯Neyman分配在预测器未校准时失效。独立读者使估计总额变动39.3亿美元，达读者内抽样区间的2.2倍，机构级区间在所有样本量下均覆盖不足；所有主要结果均在每位读者下重跑。
AI.conclusion: 利用学习到的预测来决定"人应核查哪些文本"能显著提升货币总额估计效率（如复核策略降低RMSE 28%），但误差控制在部署层面尚不成立，且读者间不一致会主导机构级区间的不覆盖；方法学贡献在于给出差值/交叉拟合估计量的精确条件，并明确了该类人机协同测量的可用边界。

title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
summary: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control. FAME-QP combines constraint-dependent operator representations with fused single- and two-kernel iterations replayed through CUDA graphs, automatically selecting the execution configuration through device calibration and problem-specific timing. It probes a cached operator bank to select the initial penalty and updates operators lazily when problem matrices change. Numerical benchmarks and simulated humanoid and quadrotor control experiments demonstrate reduced latency relative to competing GPU solvers while maintaining solution accuracy and control performance.

AI.tldr: FAME-QP 是一个面向线性 MPC 中稠密二次规划的 GPU 加速求解器，通过约束相关的算子表示、经 CUDA Graph 回放的融合单/双核迭代、自动执行配置选择以及算子缓存与惰性更新，在保持精度与控制性能的同时降低求解延迟。
AI.motivation: 线性模型预测控制（MPC）需要在线求解稠密二次规划（QP），其计算延迟直接制约控制频率与实时性。现有 GPU QP 求解器在算子组织、核函数启动开销与执行配置选择上仍存在优化空间，需要进一步压缩求解延迟。
AI.method: 提出 FAME-QP，核心设计包括：（1）约束相关的算子表示（constraint-dependent operator representations）；（2）融合的单核与双核迭代，并通过 CUDA Graph 回放以降低启动开销；（3）基于设备标定与问题特定计时自动选择执行配置；（4）查询缓存算子库以选取初始惩罚参数；（5）当问题矩阵变化时惰性更新算子。
AI.result: 数值基准测试以及在仿真人形机器人与四旋翼控制实验中的评测表明，相比同类的 GPU 求解器，FAME-QP 降低了求解延迟，同时保持了求解精度与控制性能。
AI.conclusion: FAME-QP 通过算子表示、核融合与 CUDA Graph 回放、自动配置选择及算子缓存与惰性更新等系统级优化，有效提升了稠密 QP 的 GPU 求解效率，适用于实时线性 MPC 场景。

title: ABRR: Transforming Temporal Sentence Grounding with Wasserstein-Adaptive Refinement and Precision Ranking
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Temporal Sentence Grounding (TSG) aims to localize temporal segments in untrimmed videos that correspond to natural language queries, a critical task for video understanding with applications in video retrieval, summarization, and human-computer interaction. Despite significant progress driven by transformer-based models, existing TSG methods suffer from two key limitations: quantization errors due to temporal downsampling, which misalign segment boundaries, and suboptimal ranking of predictions based on semantic matching rather than localization precision. To address these challenges, we propose the Adaptive Boundary Refinement and Ranking (ABRR) framework, a novel, model-agnostic post-processing approach that enhances the performance of any TSG model without retraining. ABRR integrates three innovative components: (1) Temporal Distribution Smoothing, which mitigates noise in predicted score distributions using Gaussian kernel convolution; (2) Boundary Refinement via Optimal Transport, which leverages the 2-Wasserstein distance and Sinkhorn iterations to align coarse segment boundaries with true temporal moments, grounded in Monge-Kantorovich optimal transport theory; and (3) Quality-Driven Re-Ranking, which reorders predictions using a composite score balancing localization precision and semantic relevance. By correcting quantization errors and prioritizing accurately localized segments, ABRR achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art TSG models. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including Charades-STA, ActivityNet Captions, and QVHighlights, demonstrate consistent gains at stringent IoU thresholds (e.g., IoU=0.7), alongside enhanced ranking performance. The framework's computational efficiency and compatibility with existing models make it a versatile and impactful solution for real-world TSG applications.

AI.tldr: 提出ABRR：一种模型无关的TSG后处理框架，通过时序分布平滑、基于最优传输的边界细化与质量驱动重排序，无需重训练即可提升任意TSG模型在高IoU阈值下的定位与排序性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的TSG方法存在两大缺陷：(1) 时序降采样带来的量化误差导致片段边界错位；(2) 预测排序依据语义匹配而非定位精度，排序次优。作者希望以非重训练的通用后处理方式同时解决二者。
AI.method: ABRR含三个组件：(1) 时序分布平滑，用高斯核卷积抑制预测分数分布噪声；(2) 基于最优传输的边界细化，借助2-Wasserstein距离与Sinkhorn迭代，在Monge-Kantorovich最优传输理论框架下将粗粒度边界对齐到真实时刻；(3) 质量驱动重排序，以兼顾定位精度与语义相关性的复合分数重排预测结果。整体为即插即用、模型无关的后处理。
AI.result: 在Charades-STA、ActivityNet Captions、QVHighlights等基准上取得一致提升，尤其在IoU=0.7等严格阈值下增益明显，排序性能亦增强；同时保持计算高效、与现有模型兼容。
AI.conclusion: ABRR通过纠正量化误差并优先选择定位准确的片段，作为一种高效、通用的后处理方案，可显著增强现有TSG模型的实际应用价值。

title: An Analytical Model of Compute-limited Multistage Training Pipelines
summary: Modern foundation models are trained through multiple stages, yet how these stages interact and how compute should be allocated across them remain poorly understood. We introduce an analytically tractable high-dimensional model combining unsupervised pretraining with a linear autoencoder, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with noisy stepwise labels, and reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse episodic rewards. Using random matrix theory and an operator-projection closure, we derive approximate low-dimensional learning dynamics that closely match simulations. We show that finite pretraining data imposes a representation-dependent performance limit, with Bayes classification error scaling as the inverse square root of the pretraining sample ratio, and observe the same exponent in asymptotic SFT and RL errors. Better pretraining also reduces sensitivity to noisy supervision. SFT initialization shortens the initial RL plateau induced by sparse rewards, an effect we also observe in OLMo-2 1B on GSM8K. Longer SFT warm starts additionally improve asymptotic RL performance. Optimizing compute across all three stages reveals that the optimal allocation depends on supervision quality and total budget, with a non-monotonic dependence of the RL compute share on budget. Finally, a complementary compositional model shows how RL selectively strengthens task-relevant pretrained skills while largely preserving unused skills. Together, these results identify mechanisms linking representation quality, feedback structure, and compute allocation in multistage training.

AI.tldr: 论文构建可解析的高维理论模型（无监督预训练+线性自编码器、噪声逐步标签的SFT、稀疏回合奖励的RL），用随机矩阵理论与算子投影闭合导出低维学习动力学，揭示预训练数据量、SFT初始化与RL算力分配之间的相互作用机制。
AI.motivation: 现代基础模型经过多阶段训练（预训练→SFT→RL），但各阶段如何相互作用、算力应如何在阶段间分配仍缺乏理解，缺少可解析的理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出可分析的高维模型：线性自编码器无监督预训练、带噪声逐步标签的监督微调（SFT）、稀疏回合奖励的强化学习（RL）三阶段组合；利用随机矩阵理论与算子投影闭合（operator-projection closure）推导出与仿真高度吻合的近似低维学习动力学；另构建互补的组合式模型分析RL对预训练技能的选择性增强。
AI.result: 1）有限预训练数据造成依赖表征的性能上限，贝叶斯分类误差随预训练样本比例呈逆平方根标度，该指数在渐近SFT与RL误差中同样出现；2）更优预训练降低对噪声监督的敏感性；3）SFT初始化缩短稀疏奖励导致的RL初始平台期，并在OLMo-2 1B于GSM8K上观察到一致现象；4）更长SFT预热还提升渐近RL性能；5）三阶段算力最优分配依赖监督质量与总预算，RL算力占比对预算呈非单调依赖；6）组合模型显示RL有选择性地强化任务相关预训练技能，基本保留未使用技能。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出连接表征质量、反馈结构与多阶段训练算力分配的机制，为多阶段训练的设计与算力规划提供理论依据。

title: Reliability of Claude Code as an Agentic AI Grading System for Handwritten University Exams
summary: This study examines the reliability of Claude Code, an agentic deployment of the Claude Opus 4.6 large language model, as a grading system for handwritten university exams. Four research questions addressed agreement with expert human grading on total scores (RQ1), agreement across five question types from multiple choice to evaluative judgement (RQ2), consistency across two independent grading sessions one week apart (RQ3), and the accuracy of AI-generated feedback (RQ4). Claude Code graded the 20-mark mid-term papers of 60 consenting students in a Saudi computer graphics course in a single agentic session, guided by three rubric files. Reliability was estimated on disjoint samples: 20 papers for RQ1, RQ2 and RQ4, and 15 papers for RQ3. Analyses used Pearson correlation, mean absolute error, Bland-Altman analysis, weighted Cohen kappa, intraclass correlation, and a four-category coding scheme separating diagnostic from confirmation feedback. The author, as the sole subject-matter expert for the course, provided the human benchmark, so the design assesses agreement with a domain-expert reference rather than inter-rater reliability. AI grading agreed strongly with human grading on totals (r = 0.97; MAE = 0.85 marks) with a small but significant AI-positive bias of 0.68 marks, showed excellent test-retest consistency (ICC = 0.96), and produced accurate feedback (92.8% diagnostic; 97.8% confirmation). Drawing items were the outlier on three of four measures. Three failure modes recurred: keyword matching without conceptual depth, selection-state ambiguity on corrected multiple-choice answers, and region-of-attention drift on hand-drawn diagrams. The findings suggest that AI grading at this capability level can assist instructors on objective and short-form items under structural safeguards but is not yet ready to replace instructor judgement at boundary cases or on drawing items.

AI.tldr: 研究检验Claude Opus 4.6的智能体部署Claude Code对手写大学试卷的评分可靠性：总分一致性r=0.97、MAE=0.85分，重测一致性ICC=0.96，反馈准确率92.8%/97.8%，但绘图题表现最差，尚不能替代教师判断。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已具备多模态与智能体能力，有望减轻高校教师手写试卷评分负担，但缺乏对"AI评分与专家人工评分一致性、跨题型稳健性、跨场次稳定性、反馈质量"的系统证据，尤其在手写考试与图纸类题型上证据不足。
AI.method: 在沙特某计算机图形学课程中，Claude Code依据三份评分标准文件、以单一智能体会话评阅60名同意学生的20分期中手写试卷。样本不重叠分配：20份用于RQ1/RQ2/RQ4，15份用于RQ3。采用Pearson相关、平均绝对误差、Bland-Altman分析、加权Cohen kappa、组内相关系数，以及区分"诊断性/确认性"反馈的四类编码方案。人工基准由课程唯一学科专家（作者本人）提供，故设计衡量的是与领域专家参照的一致性而非评分者间信度。
AI.result: 总分与人工评分高度一致（r=0.97；MAE=0.85分），存在小幅但显著的AI偏高偏差（0.68分）；跨一周两轮评分重测一致性优异（ICC=0.96）；反馈准确（诊断性92.8%，确认性97.8%）。绘图题在四项指标中的三项上均为异常项。反复出现三类失效模式：缺乏概念深度的关键词匹配、改正后选择题的选项状态歧义、手绘图上的注意力区域漂移。
AI.conclusion: 该能力水平的AI评分在结构化的保障条件下可辅助教师评阅客观题与简答题，但在边界案例与绘图题上尚不足以替代教师判断。

title: From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Monocular depth foundation models make it tempting to replace depth sensors on mobile robots with a single RGB camera. We show that, used off the shelf, this is unsafe: in a simulated indoor navigation benchmark, a standard Nav2 stack driven by Depth Anything V2 (metric) collides in 63\% of 120 episodes, because the model systematically over-estimates the distance to nearby obstacles. We propose a lightweight plug-in module that turns predicted depth into \emph{safe depth}. A 0.58\,M-parameter head on top of the \emph{frozen} depth model predicts, per pixel, a log-depth correction $μ$ and an uncertainty $σ$, trained with a $β$-weighted Gaussian negative log-likelihood. The navigation stack consumes the one-sided bound $\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$, where $k$ is set by conformal calibration on a held-out world, and uncertainty also decides which pixels may be treated as floor. The correction halves the depth error (AbsRel $0.262\rightarrow0.134$) and reduces near-range over-estimation from 59.8\% to 12.0\%. In navigation, safe depth raises the success rate from 37\% to 70\% and lowers collisions from 63\% to 3\%, close to the 2\% of ground-truth depth. A constant safety margin calibrated to the same pixel coverage reaches only 30\% success because it freezes the robot; uncertainty-aware safety wins 52 of 56 discordant paired episodes against it. Gains hold on glass, texture-less walls and dark regions.

AI.tldr: 用冻结的单目深度基础模型加轻量不确定性头输出"安全深度"下界，使Nav2导航碰撞率从63%降至3%、成功率从37%升至70%，接近真值深度水平。
AI.motivation: 单目深度基础模型使机器人倾向用单目RGB替代深度传感器，但现成模型在室内导航中系统性高估近处障碍距离，导致不安全碰撞（63%的回合发生碰撞），需在不高成本重训的前提下提供安全保证。
AI.method: 在frozen深度模型（Depth Anything V2 metric）上加0.58M参数的轻量头，逐像素预测对数深度修正μ与不确定性σ，以β加权高斯负对数似然训练；导航使用单侧安全下界d_safe=d·e^{μ−kσ}，k由留出世界上的conformal校准确定，σ同时用于判断哪些像素可视为地面。
AI.result: AbsRel由0.262降至0.134，近距高估由59.8%降至12.0%；导航成功率37%→70%，碰撞63%→3%（真值深度为2%）。同像素覆盖率的常数安全裕度仅30%成功率（冻结机器人），在56个配对不一致回合中不确定性感知方案胜52个；在玻璃、无纹理墙面与暗区仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 现成单目深度模型不能直接替代深度传感器；加入轻量不确定性感知修正与conformal校准的安全下界，可在几乎不增算力的情况下获得接近真值深度的导航安全性，且优于静态安全裕度。

title: Uni-Loc: Weakly Supervised 3D CT Pathology Localization via Spatially Grounded Vision-Language Classification
summary: Accurate localization of abnormalities in three-dimensional (3D) CT scans is essential for linking automated predictions with clinically relevant pathological findings. We propose Uni-Loc, a vision-language framework that unifies pathology classification and 3D localization using scan-level supervision. Uni-Loc derives both predictions and localization maps from spatial similarities between pathology-conditioned queries and image features. A token-to-voxel upsampling module enables high-resolution localization, while gradient-guided thresholding identifies pathology regions without additional learned parameters. Evaluated on five localization tasks comprising 355 annotated CT scans, Uni-Loc achieves macro-averaged voxel-level AUROC/AUPR of 96.1\%/34.5\%, outperforming relevance propagation (80.7%/13.9%) and gradient saliency (88.7%/8.1%). Uni-Loc also achieves classification AUROC of 88.39% on CT-RATE and 78.03% on RAD-ChestCT, improving over a matched baseline. These results demonstrate effective 3D pathology localization without requiring pathology-specific voxel-level supervision.

AI.tldr: Uni-Loc：仅用扫描级监督的视觉-语言框架，统一病理分类与3D CT定位，通过病理条件查询与图像特征的空间相似度生成定位图，宏平均体素级AUROC/AUPR达96.1%/34.5%。
AI.motivation: 3D CT中异常的精确定位对于将自动预测与临床病理发现对应至关重要，但缺乏病理级体素标注使得定位困难。
AI.method: 提出Uni-Loc视觉-语言框架：由病理条件查询与图像特征的空间相似度同时导出预测与定位图；引入token-to-voxel上采样模块实现高分辨率定位；采用梯度引导阈值化在无额外可学习参数下确定病理区域。
AI.result: 在355例标注CT的5项定位任务上，宏平均体素级AUROC/AUPR为96.1%/34.5%，优于相关性传播(80.7%/13.9%)与梯度显著性(88.7%/8.1%)；分类AUROC在CT-RATE为88.39%，RAD-ChestCT为78.03%，均优于匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 无需病理特异的体素级监督即可实现有效的3D病理定位。

title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Efficient Multipath Parameter Estimation in MIMO Systems
summary: High-resolution multipath estimation in wideband multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels requires repeated searches over angle of arrival, angle of departure, and propagation distance. This paper presents neural network-assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), which replaces the multidimensional search at each extraction step with a multi-head classifier while retaining least-squares (LS) estimation of the complex path gain, parametric reconstruction, and residual cancellation. The same classifier is applied to successive residuals, allowing the extraction depth to vary without changing its output structure. With the number of iterations prescribed by the reference multipath-component (MPC) count, off-grid synthetic tests show that NN-CLEAN slightly exceeds grid-search CLEAN (GS-CLEAN) in path accuracy for one and two MPCs, although its accuracy declines more rapidly at larger path counts. For complete three-MPC extraction at a batch size of eight, NN-CLEAN achieves an approximately $27\times$ speedup and a $52$-fold reduction in peak GPU memory relative to GS-CLEAN. Applied without retraining to two-MPC line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) Sionna ray-tracing channels within a coded MIMO link, NN-CLEAN substantially reduces channel-reconstruction mean-squared error (MSE) and bit error rate (BER) relative to interpolated LS channel estimation. GS-CLEAN retains an accuracy advantage on these channels, indicating the estimation cost associated with the computational savings.

AI.tldr: 提出NN-CLEAN：用多头分类器替代CLEAN每步的多维搜索，保留LS增益估计、参数重构与残差消除，实现宽带MIMO信道高分辨多径估计的显著加速与显存节省。
AI.motivation: 宽带大规模MIMO信道的高分辨多径估计需在到达角、离开角和传播距离上反复做多维搜索，计算与显存开销极大，难以在实际链路中高效部署。
AI.method: 将CLEAN迭代中每步的网格多维搜索替换为多带头分类器（同时输出AoA/AoD/距离），保留最小二乘复增益估计、参数化重构与残差消除；同一分类器反复作用于更新后的残差，输出结构不随提取深度变化，因而提取阶数可灵活变动；迭代次数按参考MPC数设定。
AI.result: 离网格合成测试中，在1、2个MPC时路径精度略优于GS-CLEAN，路径数增多时精度下降更快；三MPC、批大小8的完整提取下，相对GS-CLEAN取得约27倍加速和52倍峰值GPU显存降低；未经重训练直接用于Sionna射线追踪的两MPC LOS/NLOS信道（编码MIMO链路），相比插值LS显著降低信道重构MSE与BER，但GS-CLEAN仍保持精度优势。
AI.conclusion: NN-CLEAN以少量精度代价换取显著的计算与显存收益，具备跨信道场景的免重训练泛化能力；精度—效率折衷主要随MPC数与信道复杂度而变。

title: W-ISA: Transactional Execution of Weight-Space Intervention Programs
summary: We present W-ISA, a software instruction set and transactional runtime for executing weight-space intervention programs on pretrained language models. Shape-checked instructions express parameter updates, projections, ablations, and rank-one transformations. The runtime applies these programs within request-scoped execution contexts and restores saved parameters after completion or interruption. Activation-based match-action rules connect measured model states to intervention selection. We evaluate restoration and replay on SmolLM-135M-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, and compare materialized rank-one updates with equivalent PyTorch hooks on the latter. In 45 timed requests, both intervention implementations produce identical greedy sequences at 32, 128, and 512 tokens; their maximum prompt-logit difference is 0.000184. On the complete WikiText-2 raw test split, the combined SmolLM attention-head ablation and MLP projection changes perplexity from 22.2353 to 22.3188, a relative increase of 0.3754%. W-ISA separates intervention specification, execution, and measurement, making parameter-level experiments reproducible and composable.

AI.tldr: 提出 W-ISA：面向预训练语言模型权重空间干预的软件指令集与事务型运行时，实现干预的可复现、可组合执行。
AI.motivation: 现有参数级干预（更新、投影、消融、秩一变换）多以临时脚本或框架钩子实现，存在规格、执行与测量耦合的问题，难以复现与组合。
AI.method: 设计带形状校验的指令表达参数更新、投影、消融与秩一变换；运行时在请求作用域执行上下文中施加程序，并在完成或中断后恢复已保存参数；用基于激活的 match-action 规则将实测模型状态映射到干预选择。
AI.result: 在 SmolLM-135M-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上验证恢复与重放；45 次计时请求中，物化秩一更新与等价 PyTorch 钩子在 32/128/512 token 下贪心序列完全一致，最大 prompt-logit 差异 0.000184；WikiText-2 raw 测试集上 SmolLM 注意力头消融加 MLP 投影使困惑度由 22.2353 升至 22.3188（相对 +0.3754%）。
AI.conclusion: W-ISA 将干预的规格说明、执行与测量解耦，使参数级实验具备可复现性与可组合性。

title: Softness is something you also need! Why compliance helps control: information metrics of a passive walker with compliant ankle
comment: main: 11 pages, 6 figures; supplemental: 7 pages, 1 figure
summary:
A great gap in adaptivity, flexibility, and dexterity still exists between intelligent robots, whether they are made of rigid or (partially) compliant components, and their naturally evolved animal and vegetal counterparts. One reason could be of `paradigm' nature. On the one hand, most robots (both rigid and soft) are still designed by following a `Cartesian' approach, with top-down control and a clear mind-body separation. Designing artificial agents on the basis of the principles that we observe in biology is not an easy task. The principles of organization of animals and plants rely on morphological computation and emergence of fit behaviors from loosely coupled networks of embodied agents.
  Modeling and control require radically new approaches. In this paper we briefly recall and explain some seminal mathematical results linking information metrics and dynamics of the agents, already published years ago; we integrate them with some recent methods developed by us and by the community, we highlight some brief remarks about their relevance and we hint to our current and near future work towards finding concrete and efficient ways for the modeling and control of completely or partially compliant artificial agents and for a better understanding of physical intelligence in nature. We present a technical note summarizing phase-space volume calculations for inverted-pendulum and passive-dynamic walking models, following our proposed framework. Starting from the McGeer compass gait, we introduce knee-ankle compliance, foot-rocker effects, and a Ruina-style compass gait with distributed leg inertia. Standard heel-strike maps are derived and used in the estimation of viable phase-space volumes $W(γ)$, based on a state-dependent Monte-Carlo and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces methods. We show how the methods based on RKHS allow deeper and more subtle analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇技术性研究笔记，主张以"形态计算/涌现"的生物式范式替代笛卡尔式机器人设计，并将信息论与动力学联系起来的经典数学结果与RKHS、蒙特卡洛等新方法整合，用于刚柔混合（被动动态）行走模型的相空间体积估计，从而为完全或部分柔性智能体的建模与控制提供工具。
AI.motivation: 智能机器人（无论刚性或部分柔性）在适应性、灵活性与灵巧性上仍远逊于自然演化的动植物。作者认为根源在于"范式"：现有机器人多以笛卡尔式自上而下控制、身心分离的方式设计，而生物系统的组织原则依赖形态计算（morphological computation）与由松散耦合的具身智能体涌现出适配行为。此类系统的建模与控制需要根本性的新方法，作者意在寻找面向柔性人工智能体建模控制的可行路径，并深化对自然中"物理智能"的理解。
AI.method: 1) 回顾并阐释若干将信息度量（information metrics）与智能体动力学相联系的奠基性数学结果，并与作者及社区近期发展的方法整合；2) 以所提框架对倒立摆与被动动态行走模型进行相空间体积计算，作为技术笔记：从McGeer罗盘步态出发，逐步引入膝-踝柔顺性、足部摇杆（foot-rocker）效应，以及Ruina型含分布式腿部惯性的罗盘步态；3) 推导标准足跟触地映射（heel-strike maps），并基于状态相关的蒙特卡洛方法与再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）方法估计可行相空间体积 W(γ)。
AI.result: 给出了倒立摆与被动动态行走模型的相空间体积计算结果；构建了从McGeer罗盘步态到含膝踝柔顺、足摇杆效应及Ruina型分布式惯性的递进模型族及其足跟触地映射；结果显示基于RKHS的方法相较蒙特卡洛可获得更深入、更细致的分析（对 W(γ) 的刻画更精细）。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，以信息度量-动力学联系为核心、结合RKHS等非参数估计的框架，可为完全或部分柔顺人工智能体的建模与控制提供具体而有效的途径，并有助于更好地理解自然界中的物理智能；RKHS类方法在可行相空间体积分析上具有更高解析深度，是后续研究的方向。

title: How Hyperbolic Are Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models?
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a rapidly growing area of research, reporting strong zero-shot performance alongside an interpretable embedding space in which radius orders representations by generality. But how hyperbolic are hyperbolic VLMs in practice? We investigate this at the exponential map, the single operation through which curvature enters an otherwise Euclidean network. We show that across MERU, HyCoCLIP, ARGENT, and PHyCLIP, the exponential map is well approximated by the identity function, i.e., pairwise distances and angles in the pre-map Euclidean space barely change under projection, and removing the map at inference leaves evaluation scores unchanged. Motivated by this observation, we train Euclidean VLMs on CC3M from scratch under the same hierarchy losses. Over roughly the final 90% of the training steps, the training statistics are nearly indistinguishable from those of their hyperbolic counterparts, and the resulting models match the evaluation scores and recover the same radial distributions. Our findings establish Euclidean space as a sufficient substrate for hierarchical vision-language learning as it is currently practiced, and motivate new paradigms in which hyperbolic geometry can deliver on its theoretical promise. Code is available at https://github.com/fbyrman/hyperbolic-vlms.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证性地检验了双曲视觉-语言模型（VLM）中曲率究竟起到了多大作用，发现指数映射可被恒等映射良好近似，欧氏 VLM 在相同层级损失下即可复现双曲模型的指标与径向分布。
AI.motivation: 双曲 VLM 被广泛宣称具备强零样本性能与可解释的嵌入空间（半径编码概念泛化性），但曲率是否真正被模型利用缺乏系统检验，因此需要量化"双曲程度"。
AI.method: 聚焦曲率进入网络的唯一算子——指数映射，在 MERU、HyCoCLIP、ARGENT、PHyCLIP 四个模型上比较映射前后的成对距离与夹角，并进行推理时移除该映射的消融；同时在 CC3M 上从头训练采用相同层级损失的欧氏 VLM，与双曲对照模型比较训练统计与评估结果。
AI.result: 指数映射在四个模型上均近似恒等：映射前后距离与角度几乎不变，推理端移除映射后评估分数不变；欧氏模型在约最后 90% 训练步中训练统计与双曲模型几乎无法区分，评估分数一致且恢复相同径向分布。
AI.conclusion: 在当前实践下，欧氏空间已足以作为层级视觉-语言学习的载体，双曲几何的理论优势尚未被真正兑现，需探索能让曲率发挥作用的新范式。

title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training
