summary: Transmitting LoRA adapters to rollout workers can bottleneck distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks. Lowering the training rank may limit the capacity a workload needs, while adaptive optimizer updates are difficult to compress. Rollout workers can instead reconstruct updates from gradients by maintaining replicated optimizer states. We introduce HiLo, a compressor-agnostic framework that replaces parameter transmission with compressed gradient dissemination and local optimizer replay. By applying the same decoded gradients, the learner and workers maintain consistent policy states at the same version under reproducible execution. We further develop Spar, a budget-aware gradient compressor that combines spectral truncation, adaptive rank allocation and error feedback to decouple training rank from communication cost. Experiments across on-policy distillation and reward-guided post-training show that HiLo with Spar maintains learning quality close to full synchronization while transmitting as little as 1.6% of the adapter bytes, and accelerates end-to-end updates by up to $2.2\times$ under bandwidth constraints.

AI.tldr: HiLo 将"传输 LoRA 参数"改为"传输压缩梯度 + 本地优化器重放"，并配套预算感知的梯度压缩器 Spar，在通信带宽受限下以约 1.6% 的适配器字节量保持接近全同步的训练质量，端到端更新加速最高 2.2×。
AI.motivation: 分布式 on-policy 后训练中，向 rollout worker 广播 LoRA 适配器会成为带宽受限网络下的通信瓶颈；降低训练 rank 会削弱模型容量，而自适应优化器状态/更新本身难以压缩。因此需要一种与压缩器无关、能把通信量与训练 rank 解耦的方案。
AI.method: 提出 HiLo 框架：rollout worker 复制优化器状态，learner 只下发压缩后的梯度，worker 本地执行优化器重放来重建参数更新；在可复现执行下，learner 与 worker 应用相同解码梯度，从而在同一版本上保持一致的策略状态。同时提出 Spar 梯度压缩器，融合谱截断（spectral truncation）、自适应 rank 分配与误差反馈（error feedback），实现预算感知的压缩并把训练 rank 与通信成本解耦。
AI.result: 在 on-policy 蒸馏与奖励引导后训练任务上，HiLo+Spar 的学习质量接近全同步基线，而传输字节量最低仅为适配器的 1.6%；在带宽受限条件下端到端更新速度最高提升 2.2×。
AI.conclusion: 以"压缩梯度传播 + 本地优化器重放"替代参数广播，是一种压缩器无关且有效的通信削减范式；配合预算感知的梯度压缩，可在大幅降低带宽需求的同时维持训练一致性，适用于分布式 on-policy 后训练场景。

title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.

AI.tldr: 提出"检索接地的鉴别性证据"框架，为医学选择题抽取选项特定的鉴别性证据并组织为精简证据提示，在多个数据集与目标LLM上取得一致准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 医学多选题（MCQ）的核心难点在于：多个看似合理的选项共享重叠证据，仅少数决定性因素可区分正误。现有检索式与推理式方法主要提供宽泛相关知识或诱发推理路径，未能识别出区分易混淆选项的紧凑鉴别性证据。
AI.method: 构造 retrieval-grounded differential evidence 框架：为每个选项抽取选项特定的鉴别性证据片段（differential evidence），并将其组织为简洁的证据提示（evidence prompts），用于最终答案选择。该设计使外部知识与鉴别性推理对齐，同时减少无关上下文。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多个目标LLM上取得一致的准确率提升。消融实验显示：优于直接使用检索证据块、优于闭源LLM生成的通用提示；提升并非仅由答案邻近性引导解释，而与鉴别性证据作为竞争性选项推理的紧凑辅助相一致。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的鉴别性证据是一种有效的知识注入形式，可支撑竞争性选项间的推理；结论对医学推理及其他多候选决策场景具有启示意义。

title: RiSE-Drive: Risk-Sensitive Long-Horizon Candidate Evaluation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, including supplementary material. Published in ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving systems increasingly rely on generating multiple trajectory candidates and selecting one for execution. In this setting, a central challenge is no longer only candidate generation, but how to evaluate candidates according to their long-horizon consequences under uncertainty. Existing methods still mainly use deterministic point scores, heuristic subscores, or single-outcome evaluations, which makes it difficult to capture delayed failures, tail risk, and ranking instability under plausible future perturbations. We present RiSE-Drive, a framework for risk-sensitive long-horizon candidate evaluation in end-to-end autonomous driving. RiSE-Drive first performs candidate-conditioned latent future rollout, then estimates long-horizon outcome distributions instead of single scalar scores, and finally ranks candidates using a tail-risk-aware and perturbation-robust decision criterion. This reformulates candidate scoring from deterministic oracle-style evaluation into distributional outcome assessment with explicit risk control. As a result, the evaluator is encouraged to prefer candidates that are not only strong under nominal conditions, but also reliable under long-horizon rollout and safety-critical deviations. Experiments on the NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks, as well as the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark, show that RiSE-Drive achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly improves the robustness of candidate selection.

AI.tldr: RiSE-Drive将端到端自动驾驶的候选轨迹评分从确定性打分重构为面向长时程后果的分布化风险评估，通过候选条件潜在未来推演+尾部风险感知与扰动鲁棒的排序准则提升候选选择鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶普遍采用"生成多候选轨迹—选一条执行"的范式，核心瓶颈已从候选生成转向候选评估。现有方法多用确定性点分数、启发式子分数或单结果评估，难以刻画延迟失效（delayed failures）、尾部风险（tail risk）以及合理未来扰动下的排序不稳定（ranking instability）。
AI.method: 提出RiSE-Drive框架，三阶段：(1) 以候选轨迹为条件进行潜在空间未来rollout（candidate-conditioned latent future rollout）；(2) 估计长时程结果分布而非单一标量分数；(3) 采用尾部风险感知（tail-risk-aware）且对扰动鲁棒（perturbation-robust）的决策准则对候选排序。即将deterministic oracle式评分替换为带显式风险控制的distributional outcome assessment。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2以及闭环HUGSIM基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，并显著提升候选选择的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 候选评估器被引导偏好那些不仅在名义条件下表现强、而且在长时程rollout与安全关键偏差下仍可靠的候选，说明分布化风险感知评分是提升端到端规划可靠性的有效方向。

title: Prompt2Echo (P2Echo): Text-Prompted Multi-View Echocardiography Segmentation with One Model
summary: Automated segmentation in multi-view echocardiography is essential for comprehensive cardiac assessment, yet remains challenging due to substantial anatomical and appearance variability across standard acoustic windows. In this paper, we present P2Echo, a unified framework capable of segmenting diverse cardiac structures across multiple standard echocardiographic views using a single model controlled by structured view-aware text prompts. Unlike recent foundation model adaptations that rely on implicit latent priors, P2Echo explicitly conditions the segmentation process via a novel Dynamic Image-Text Alignment (DyITA) module. DyITA integrates a differentiable routing mechanism and token differential operators to dynamically modulate decoder features according to the requested view and target structure. This allows the network to adaptively switch its processing pathways for different views without architectural changes. Extensive experiments on a large-scale internal dataset (seen during training) and held-out evaluation on three external datasets demonstrate that P2Echo matches or exceeds both view-specific specialists and state-of-the-art universal models at a fraction of their computational cost, offering an efficient, controllable solution for multi-plane cardiac analysis. Code is available at: https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/P2Echo.

AI.tldr: 提出 P2Echo 统一框架，用结构化视图感知文本提示控制单一模型完成多标准切面超声心动图多结构分割。
AI.motivation: 多视图超声心动图自动分割对完整心脏评估至关重要，但不同标准声窗之间存在显著的解剖结构与表观差异，导致分割困难；近期基础模型适配多依赖隐式潜在先验，缺乏对视图与目标结构的显式控制。
AI.method: 提出动态图文对齐模块 DyITA，集成可微路由机制与 token 差分算子，依据所请求的视图与目标结构动态调制解码器特征，使网络无需改动架构即可为不同视图自适应切换处理通路；整体为单一模型、以结构化视图感知文本提示显式条件化分割过程。
AI.result: 在大规模内部数据集（训练中可见）上以及三个外部数据集的留出评估中，P2Echo 的表现达到或超过视图专用专家模型与最先进通用模型，且计算成本仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: P2Echo 为多平面心脏分析提供了一种高效、可控的统一分割方案；代码已开源。

title: One Trajectory, Two Requirements: Accuracy and Local Stability in Euler Sampling for Flow Matching Policies
summary: Flow matching robot policies commonly use a fixed Euler step count selected from offline accuracy sweeps. At inference time, however, each policy input (visual observation, robot state, and language instruction) together with a source-noise draw defines a different ODE trajectory and sequence of local Jacobians. We ask whether a step count that accurately follows the nominal noise-to-action trajectory can still be too coarse for strongly contracting directions around it. An exact two-coordinate system and a controlled augmentation of six trained flow models show that trajectory accuracy and local Euler stability can impose different step requirements even when the original learned transport is unchanged. We then study a frozen $π_{0.5}$-LIBERO checkpoint without modifying its weights or action dynamics. Across 30 policy inputs from 10 LIBERO-10 tasks, the Jacobian exhibits strong contracting directions near the action endpoint, yet no sampled mode violates the Euler non-expansion condition. On five of those inputs, accuracy sweeps require 4--9 Euler steps at 5% terminal error and 87--112 at 1%. These five paired cases are therefore consistent with accuracy-limited rather than stability-limited sampling under this local criterion, while the controlled experiments show why endpoint accuracy alone cannot rule out a separate stability requirement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究flow matching机器人策略中Euler积分步数的选择问题：固定步数能否同时满足轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性要求。作者用精确两坐标系统和六个训练flow模型的受控增强实验表明，轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性对步数的要求可能不一致；并在冻结的π0.5-LIBERO检查点上发现，虽存在强收缩方向，但采样的模式均未违反Euler非扩张条件，五个配对案例在局部判据下表现为精度受限而非稳定性受限。
AI.motivation: flow matching机器人策略通常采用离线精度扫描选出的固定Euler步数。但每个策略输入（视觉观测、机器人状态、语言指令）与源噪声采样共同定义不同的ODE轨迹和局部Jacobian序列。作者质疑：能准确跟随名义噪声到动作轨迹的步数，是否仍可能对轨迹周围的强收缩方向而言过粗？即端点精度是否足以保证局部Euler稳定性。
AI.method: 1）构造精确的两坐标解析系统，分离轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性的步数需求；2）对六个已训练flow模型做受控增强，在保持原学习传输不变的前提下考察两种要求；3）在冻结的π0.5-LIBERO检查点上（不修改权重与动作动力学）分析30个策略输入（来自10个LIBERO-10任务）的Jacobian收缩方向，并检验Euler非扩张条件；4）对其中五个输入做精度扫描，比较达到5%与1%终端误差所需步数。
AI.result: 解析系统与受控实验显示，即使原始学习传输未变，轨迹精度与局部Euler稳定性也可对步数提出不同要求。在π0.5-LIBERO上，动作端点附近Jacobian存在强收缩方向，但所有采样模式均未违反Euler非扩张条件；五个输入在5%终端误差下需4–9步，在1%下需87–112步。这些配对案例在该局部判据下与"精度受限而非稳定性受限"一致；同时受控实验说明仅凭端点精度无法排除独立的稳定性需求。
AI.conclusion: 端点精度不能单独作为Euler步数充分性的判据：局部收缩方向可能施加额外的稳定性约束。在所考察的π0.5-LIBERO检查点上，经验证据支持精度主导的步数需求，但这是局部判据下的结论；受控实验提示在更极端收缩条件下稳定性可能成为独立瓶颈，值得进一步验证。

title: NCP: Verifier-Guided Optimization of Weight-Space Control Policies
summary: We present the Neural Control Plane (NCP), a closed-loop system that observes language-model execution, synthesizes candidate weight-space intervention rules, evaluates them, and maintains a versioned table of admitted policies. NCP separates a pretrained model's inference data plane from the control policy that selects temporary parameter interventions. W-ISA supplies transactional execution and parameter restoration; NCP supplies telemetry, candidate synthesis, admission criteria, priorities, and rule lifetime management. The optimization state consists of active rules and an archive of evaluated candidates, while base-model parameters are restored after each request. In a local SmolLM-135M-Instruct experiment, NCP generated three candidates from development telemetry and evaluated them on separate task examples and a 4,095-target WikiText-2 slice. One projection reduced validation token repetition from 0.4133 to 0.2191, with a perplexity change of -0.0574%. All candidates produced zero newly correct exact answers, so the configured admission gate archived all three and retained the original active policy. Fresh-process repetition and saved-table resumption reproduced the measured outcomes. NCP provides an executable framework for studying recursive self-improvement at the control-policy level through explicit synthesis, verification, and state transitions.

AI.tldr: 提出神经控制平面（NCP）：将模型推理数据平面与权重干预控制策略分离的闭环系统，可自动合成、评估并版本化管理权重空间干预规则。
AI.motivation: 为在"控制策略"层面研究递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement），需要一个显式包含候选合成、验证与状态转移的可执行框架。
AI.method: NCP 观测语言模型执行过程，合成候选权重空间干预规则并评估，维护版本化已准入策略表；W-ISA 提供事务化执行与参数恢复，NCP 提供遥测、候选合成、准入标准、优先级与规则生命周期管理；优化状态仅由活跃规则与候选档案构成，基座参数在每个请求后恢复。在 SmolLM-135M-Instruct 上，用开发遥测生成 3 个候选，在独立任务样例与 4095 目标 WikiText-2 切片上评估。
AI.result: 一个投影将验证集 token 重复度从 0.4133 降至 0.2191，困惑度变化仅 -0.0574%；但所有候选新增正确精确答案均为 0，准入门槛将三者全部归档，保留原活跃策略。新进程重复实验与保存表恢复均复现了测量结果。
AI.conclusion: NCP 提供了一个通过显式合成、验证与状态转移来研究控制策略级递归自我改进的可执行框架。

title: Camera equalisation of an 11.5x drop in environmental illuminance: four imitation-learning policies on an SO-101 arm
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Data and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/fysical/so101-lighting-autoexposure
summary: Real-robot benchmarks of learned visuomotor policies often record room illuminance as the lighting condition. We show that, on a typical low-cost rig, room light and image light can be almost unrelated. Four imitation-learning policies (ACT, SmolVLA, Diffusion Policy and pi0.5) were trained on the same 50 demonstrations of a pick-and-place task on an SO-101 arm. Each was run for ten rollouts at about 520 lux and again at about 45 lux, an 11.5x reduction. Success was 20/40 in normal light and 19/40 in low light: a change of -2.5 percentage points (95% CI -23 to +19), with no evidence that the policies differed in sensitivity (interaction p = 0.86). The recorded video shows why: mean image brightness was only 3% lower in low light on the front camera and 19% lower on the wrist camera. Both cameras were set to automatic exposure and white balance, which most likely absorbed the difference; exposure was not locked in this experiment. An accidental repeat of one 10-rollout block reproduced its success count (7/10) but matched the first block at only 6 of 10 placements, consistent with chance. We conclude that lux alone does not describe what a policy sees. Camera settings, and image statistics compared with the training recordings, are the quantities to report and control. Data and code are public.

AI.tldr: 在SO-101机械臂上，用50条示教训练4种模仿学习策略（ACT、SmolVLA、Diffusion Policy、pi0.5），在约520 lux与约45 lux（11.5倍差异）下各跑10次rollout：成功率40次中20次与19次，变化-2.5个百分点（95% CI -23至+19），策略间灵敏度无差异（交互p=0.86）。原因是相机自动曝光与白平衡抵消了照度差异，图像亮度仅在前相机降3%、腕部相机降19%。结论：仅用lux不能刻画策略所见，应报告并控制相机设置与图像统计量。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人视觉运动策略基准常以"房间照度(lux)"作为光照条件描述，但作者质疑该指标能否代表策略实际接收到的图像信息，即房间光与图像光之间是否相关。研究动机在于：若二者几乎无关，则仅以lux报告光照条件会误导对鲁棒性的判断，需要明确应报告和控制的真正变量。
AI.method: 在典型低成本实验装置上，使用SO-101机械臂的抓取-放置任务，以相同50条示教训练四种模仿学习策略：ACT、SmolVLA、Diffusion Policy与pi0.5。每种策略在约520 lux（正常光）与约45 lux（低光，约11.5倍衰减）两种条件下各执行10次rollout，共40次/条件。统计成功率并做95%置信区间估计与策略×光照交互检验；同时分析录制视频的均值图像亮度（前相机与腕部相机），检查相机曝光与白平衡设置；另有一个偶然重复的10次rollout区块用于可重复性核对。
AI.result: 正常光下成功19/40之外的对照为20/40，低光19/40，变化-2.5个百分点（95% CI -23至+19），无策略间灵敏度差异证据（交互p=0.86）。图像统计显示低光下均值亮度仅前相机低3%、腕部相机低19%，说明照度衰减大部分被自动曝光与白平衡吸收（本实验未锁定曝光）。偶然重复的10次rollout块成功数复现为7/10，但与首块仅在10个放置位置中6个一致，符合随机水平，提示结果需谨慎解读。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭lux不足以描述策略实际看到的内容；相机设置（尤其是自动曝光/白平衡与是否锁定曝光）以及相对于训练记录的图像统计量，才是应报告并控制的量。benchmark应披露相机配置与图像统计，而非仅记录房间照度。

title: Camera3R: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Camera Models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) from unconstrained multi-view images has recently emerged as a prominent research direction in 3D computer vision. Various foundational reconstruction models have been proposed with different architectures and reconstruction paradigms. Despite being trained on large-scale perspective datasets with substantial computational resources, these models generally struggle to generalize to non-perspective images. This limitation hinders their deployment in applications involving arbitrary, unknown, and potentially heterogeneous camera models. To build on the capabilities of existing reconstruction models with minimal retraining, we propose Camera3R, a low-rank adaptation framework that efficiently extends perspective-pretrained 3R networks to any other camera models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with only 0.5% additional parameters and less than a day of training, Camera3R adapts a foundational 3D reconstruction model to non-perspective cameras while fully preserving its original performance on perspective inputs. Code is available at https://github.com/android-xr/camera3r.

AI.tldr: 提出 Camera3R：一种低秩适配（LoRA）框架，用仅 0.5% 额外参数和不到一天训练，将透视相机预训练的前馈 3D 重建网络扩展到任意非透视相机模型，同时完整保留其在透视输入上的原始性能。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3D 重建（3R）模型虽在大规模透视数据集上耗费大量算力训练，但泛化到非透视图像能力弱，这限制了其在相机模型任意、未知乃至异构场景下的部署；而完全重训练代价过高，因此需要以最小重训练量复用现有重建模型能力的方法。
AI.method: Camera3R 采用低秩适配（low-rank adaptation）策略，在现有的透视预训练 3R 网络上引入小规模可训练的低秩参数模块，将网络高效迁移到其他任意相机模型；原始权重保持冻结，从而以极小的参数增量实现相机模型扩展而不破坏原有透视能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，仅需 0.5% 的额外参数与不足一天的训练，Camera3R 即可将基础 3D 重建模型适配到非透视相机，同时在透视输入上完整保持原模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 低秩适配为前馈 3D 重建模型的相机模型泛化提供了一种参数高效、训练高效的可行路径，可在不牺牲已有透视先验的前提下支持任意/异构相机模型部署。

title: MicroLens: Read, Trace, and Rewire the Residual Stream with Two Lenses
summary: Lenses that decode hidden states into words are a popular way to look inside language models, but a heatmap of decoded words only shows what a vector reads as and cannot distinguish whether, or how much, the model uses the information. We present an interactive viewer that puts reading, tracing and editing on the same layers-by-tokens grid of the residual stream. In the viewer, every cell can be decoded with two lenses, the logit lens and the Jacobian lens (J-lens), traced back to the tokens it drew from, and edited, with the rest of the model rerun on the spot. We demonstrate three usage scenarios on Gemma-3-4B-it, backed by sweeps over a few hundred prompts, to show what this tool can discover. First, the two lenses give different directions to write with, each suiting a different edit: the logit lens's word direction sets what a token outputs, while the J-lens's direction changes what later tokens read. Second, in two-hop trivia questions (the capital of the state or country containing a given city), the state or country is readable at the city token from as early as layer 7, and swapping it there can redirect the answer 92-98% of the time; however, at the answer position, the state or country information is not used. Third, when a chat model answers questions with a step-by-step reasoning prompt, the correct answer is often already the top word in the residual stream before any reasoning is written: for 89-92% of retrieval questions and 39-63% of multi-hop and serial ones, far above their respective distractors (at most 5%). However, ordering puzzles are an exception, as the model works them out only once it writes its final reasoning steps. Furthermore, for answers that are visible in the residual stream, the J-lens reads them a layer or two earlier than the logit lens across the different types of question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个交互式可视化工具，在残差流的"层×token"网格上同时支持解码（logit lens 与 Jacobian lens）、溯源与编辑；在 Gemma-3-4B-it 上的实验表明两种 lens 提供互补的编辑方向，并揭示了模型在两跳事实问题与推理任务中信息使用的时空格局。
AI.motivation: 现有把隐藏状态解码成词的 lens（如 logit lens）只能显示某个向量的"读出内容"，无法区分模型是否以及多大程度上真正使用了该信息。可视化热图缺乏因果验证手段，难以判断信息在模型内部的实际作用与流动路径。
AI.method: 构建交互式查看器：以残差流的层×token 网格为统一界面，每个单元可用两种 lens（logit lens 与 Jacobian lens, J-lens）解码、可回溯到来源 token、可直接编辑并即时重跑模型其余部分。在 Gemma-3-4B-it 上用数百条 prompt 的扫描实验，展示三类使用场景：关键词方向编辑、两跳 trivia 问题的信息定位与替换、推理提示下的答案可读性分析。
AI.result: (1) 两种 lens 给出不同的写入方向：logit lens 的词方向决定某 token 的输出，J-lens 的方向改变后续 token 的读取内容，各适用于不同编辑。(2) 在两跳 trivia（"包含某城市的州/国家的首府"）中，州/国家信息最早在第 7 层即可在城市 token 处读出，替换可令答案改向的比例达 92–98%；但在答案位置该信息并未被使用。(3) 使用分步推理提示时，正确答案常在写出任何推理前已是残差流中的首位词：检索类问题 89–92%、多跳与串行问题 39–63%，远高于干扰项（≤5%）；排序类谜题例外，模型需写出最终推理步骤才能解出。(4) 对残差流中可见的答案，J-lens 比 logit lens 提前一到两层读出。
AI.conclusion: 解码不等于使用：通过将解码、溯源与因果编辑整合在同一网格上，可区分"可读出"与"被使用"的信息。两种 lens 具有互补的因果语义，J-lens 在读出的早期性上占优；推理提示下的答案往往已预先存在于残差流中，而排序类任务依赖显式推理过程。

title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
summary: ExpertCrowd-SWE (EC-SWE) is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks for evaluating autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases. Each task is a change request written by a practising engineer against a pinned commit of a real repository, paired with a sealed reference solution and a task-specific grader whose weighted, mostly executable criteria award partial credit; must-pass blockers and pass/fail gates encode what a maintainer would refuse to merge. The tasks span 87 open-source projects and 11 languages. The median ticket is 148 words, while the median reference solution changes 471 lines. Every task image is calibrated before release so that the reference solution scores 1.0 and both the untouched repository and an inert change score 0; nearly half of the tasks also ship alternative, lazy and adversarial control patches that the grader must classify correctly. The final 100 tasks were selected for difficulty against current frontier models. We evaluate seven frontier models, five runs each (3,495 scored runs), in a single platform harness that gives each model its provider-native tool interface. Claude Opus 5.5 (67.3%) and GPT-6 Astra (63.7%) lead without a statistically significant gap, followed by Claude Fable 5.1 (46.5%), Gemini 3.8 Flash (40.0%), and a statistically indistinguishable group of Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.6 (32-34%). No task is fully solved by every model, and on 80 tasks no model earns full credit on all five runs. Scores span 35 points. Depending on the model, agents take a median of 33 to 166 steps per run, with little relation to score. We release 24 tasks with their environments, graders and results, and hold out 76 to limit contamination.

AI.tldr: ExpertCrowd-SWE (EC-SWE) 是一个由专家编写、面向真实大型代码库的 100 道多文件软件工程任务基准，用于评测自主编程智能体，并系统性地校准了参考解与对照补丁、报告了七个前沿模型的评测结果。
AI.motivation: 现有评测环境与真实工程场景存在差距：任务多由非专家构造、规模小或缺少"维护者视角"的通过门槛，且容易被污染。作者希望构建贴近真实变更请求（developer ticket）、规模较大且判分严格的基准，以可靠区分前沿编程智能体的能力。
AI.method: 1) 任务构造：每道任务由在职工程师针对真实仓库固定 commit 撰写变更请求，配密封参考解与任务专属评分器；评分采用加权、多为可执行的标准，支持部分得分，并设 must-pass 阻断项与 pass/fail 门槛以编码"维护者拒绝合并"的条件。任务覆盖 87 个开源项目、11 种语言，中位工单 148 词、中位参考解改动 471 行。2) 校准：发布前确保参考解得 1.0，未改动仓库与惰性改动得 0；近半数任务附带备选、惰性与对抗性控制补丁，要求评分器正确分类。3) 最终 100 题按对当前前沿模型的难度筛选。4) 评测：统一平台 harness，为各模型提供其原生的工具接口，七个前沿模型各跑五次（共 3,495 次计分运行）。
AI.result: Claude Opus 5.5（67.3%）与 GPT-6 Astra（63.7%）领先且差距不显著；其后为 Claude Fable 5.1（46.5%）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（40.0%）；Qwen 3.8 Max、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 Grok 4.6 处于 32–34% 且统计上不可区分。没有任何任务被所有模型全部解出；80 道任务上无模型能在五次运行中均获满分。得分跨度达 35 个百分点。各模型的单次运行中位步数为 33 至 166 步，且与得分关系不大。
AI.conclusion: EC-SWE 提供了高难度、判分严格、抗污染的真实软件工程智能体基准，显示前沿模型在专家级多文件任务上仍有显著未解空间，且步数等过程指标与成绩弱相关。为限制数据污染，作者公开 24 道任务及其环境、评分器与结果，保留 76 道不公开。

title: WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K: the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Technical report for Team IF1001's 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge at CoRL 2026. Challenge website: https://behavior.stanford.edu/challenge/index.html
summary: This work presents the 2nd-place solution (Team IF1001) to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, which evaluates mobile manipulation across 100 household tasks. Our method is built on a powerful world action model (WAM), Cosmos 3. We improve Cosmos 3 by using richer visual history, task-progress conditioning, and task-group and skill-specific LoRA adapters. During inference, we apply a separate progress estimator to supply task-progress context, and use task- and progress-conditioned routing to select a task-group or skill-specific policy, complemented by action-candidate aggregation, rolling inpainting, and task-specific temporal and gripper control. To meet the minimum inference requirement of 1 FPS, we use neither recursive self-improvement (RSI) nor agentic harness methods and rely on no closed-source models; during official private-test evaluation, our system handled concurrent requests across 100 evaluation ports with limited hardware resources, sustaining an average end-to-end inference rate above 2 FPS per port. Our method achieves a mean Q-score of 0.613 and a full-task success rate of 40.9%, averaged over 3 self-evaluation rounds across all 100 tasks. On the official private test set, with 20 instances per task, our system achieves a mean Q-score of 0.615 and a full-task success rate of 41.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出2026 BEHAVIOR挑战赛第二名方案：基于世界动作模型Cosmos 3，通过更丰富视觉历史、任务进度条件化、任务组/技能特异LoRA适配器及进度估计与路由机制，在100项家庭移动操作任务上取得Q-score 0.613、全任务成功率40.9%（自评测），官方私测Q-score 0.615、成功率41.2%，且在受限硬件下维持每端口>2 FPS。
AI.motivation: BEHAVIOR挑战需在100项长程家庭移动操作任务上实现通用策略，同时满足最低1 FPS的推理效率约束；现有方法常依赖递归自改进、agent harness或闭源模型，难以在有限算力与并发请求下落地，因此需要一种高效、可扩展且完全开源的统一方案。
AI.method: 以世界动作模型Cosmos 3为基座，引入三方面改进：(1) 使用更丰富的视觉历史输入；(2) 任务进度条件化；(3) 任务组与技能特异的LoRA适配器。推理时采用独立进度估计器提供任务进度上下文，并通过任务与进度条件化路由选择相应策略；辅以动作候选聚合、rolling inpainting以及任务特定的时间与夹爪控制。为满足1 FPS约束，不使用RSI与agentic harness方法，也不依赖闭源模型。
AI.result: 自评测（100任务、3轮平均）：平均Q-score 0.613，全任务成功率40.9%。官方私测（每任务20实例）：平均Q-score 0.615，全任务成功率41.2%。在有限硬件资源下支持100个评测端口的并发请求，每端口平均端到端推理速率超过2 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 将世界动作模型与模块化的LoRA适配器、进度估计与条件化路由相结合，可在严格效率约束下有效完成大规模长程移动操作任务，验证了该路线在BEHAVIOR类基准上的可扩展性与工程可行性，并获得挑战赛第二名。

title: Hand-Object Contact Transition Detection in Egocentric Video
summary: This paper tackles the task of hand-object contact transition detection in egocentric video, which aims to localize the two temporal boundaries of a contact episode: the moment a hand first establishes contact with an object (touch) and the moment contact is released (release). We propose a unified framework that jointly models the interacting hand and object to accurately localize both transition types. The proposed framework augments hand-centric spatiotemporal representations with object-aware features learned directly from the video and introduces a transition-aware event spotting formulation tailored to contact transitions, without relying on external object or hand-object interaction detectors during inference. To support this task, we present ContactTransition, a dataset comprising 4,021 egocentric videos with 8,498 touch and 8,077 release annotations, together with object-of-interest supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms strong two-stage and end-to-end event-spotting baselines on both transition types. Finally, we show that detected contact transitions provide effective temporal anchors for downstream egocentric hand-object reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架用于第一视角视频中手-物接触转换检测，同时定位接触开始（touch）与接触释放（release）两个时序边界，并构建了ContactTransition数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对接触转换（接触建立与解除）这两类时序边界的显式定位；单靠手部线索不足，需联合建模手与物体，且推理阶段不宜依赖外部检测器。
AI.method: 以手中心时空表征为基础，融合直接从视频学习到的物体感知特征，联合建模交互的手与物体；引入面向接触转换的transition-aware event spotting公式，推理时无需外部物体或手-物交互检测器；同时发布ContactTransition数据集（4,021段第一视角视频，8,498个touch与8,077个release标注，并含感兴趣物体监督）。
AI.result: 在两类转换上均稳定优于强二阶段与端到端event spotting基线；检测出的接触转换可作为下游第一视角手-物推理的有效时序锚点。
AI.conclusion: 联合手-物建模与转换感知事件定位可有效检测接触转换，所提数据集支撑该任务，且检测结果为下游推理提供有用时序锚点。

title: Robust Flow Matching under Target Corruption and Label Noise
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a strong framework for generative modeling due to its stable training and efficient sampling. However, FM assumes clean target data and labels, an assumption often violated in practice. We formulate FM training as a time-dependent regression problem over conditional vector fields and analyze how the two corruption types affect the objective: i) target corruption adds a time-dependent residual term that grows with time, ii) label noise causes updates to the wrong class-conditional vector field. Based on this analysis, we propose to improve FM robustness by mapping corruption-specific residual scores to sample weights. For target corruption, we propose the Temporal Residual Score (TRS), which emphasizes residual magnitudes at intermediate-to-late FM times, where clean and corrupted samples are more separable. For label noise, we propose the Comparative Conditional Score (CCS), which compares the residual of the observed class-conditional vector field against alternative class-conditional vector fields for the same trajectory and velocity target. Experiments across controlled corruption settings and real-world noisy labels show that the proposed methods improve robustness over standard FM and robust-training baselines, supporting corruption-specific residual structure as a practical basis for robust FM.

AI.tldr: 该文将Flow Matching（FM）训练建模为关于条件向量场的时间依赖回归问题，分析目标污染与标签噪声两类噪声对目标函数的影响，并提出TRS与CCS两种基于残差得分的样本加权方法提升FM鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: FM训练稳定、采样高效，但其隐含假设目标数据与标签干净，而实际数据常含噪声。作者希望从理论上刻画不同噪声类型如何在FM回归目标中产生不同的残差结构，从而指导鲁棒性改进方案。
AI.method: 将FM训练形式化为条件向量场上的时间依赖回归问题，分析两类污染的效应：目标污染引入随时间增长的时间依赖残差项，标签噪声导致向错误类条件向量场更新。据此把污染特异的残差得分映射为样本权重：TRS针对目标污染，强调FM中间至后期时刻的残差幅值（此时干净与污染样本更易区分）；CCS针对标签噪声，对同一轨迹与速度目标，比较观测类条件向量场的残差与替代类条件向量场的残差。
AI.result: 在受控污染设置和真实含噪标签实验中，所提方法相较标准FM和鲁棒训练基线均提升了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 污染特异的残差结构可作为鲁棒FM的实用基础，为不同噪声类型设计有针对性的样本加权策略有效且可行。

title: Dependable Long-Horizon LLM Agents: A Trajectory-Centered Empirical Study of Where Errors Enter and Which Controls Reach Them
summary: When an LLM agent fails part-way through a long task, the usual analysis records a symptom: a failure-mode label, or the agent and step judged responsible. It does not say where the error entered, which state carried it to the symptom, whether anything in the trajectory contradicted it, or which control could have caught it. We define an episode record that ties a candidate fault to its origin, propagation, detection, response and consequence, located by operational phase and state domain, and that names the control families whose observation and reach cover it. We turned the record into a written annotation protocol and applied it to 95 failed runs of six multi-agent systems from the public Who&When and MAD corpora, reading each trajectory in full. Faults enter early (median at 0.18 of the run), mostly as wrong decisions or fabrications over task state, and in 37 of 88 Who&When runs before the step the corpus' human labels mark as decisive. In 72% of failed runs the trajectory already contained evidence against the error before the failure; in 88% of those no agent acted on it. Something flagged a deviation in 31% of runs, but no response removed the deviated state. Independent judges reading the unused evidence, task contracts fixed at admission, and re-checking beliefs against the environment reach most episodes; restoring the agent's own state would have sufficed in 35 of 95 runs. A text scan of the raw corpus also shows that 45% of the hand-crafted Who&When failures ended with a provider content-filter crash after which the harness emitted a final answer no agent produced, a failure class that neither symptom taxonomies nor responsible-agent labels represent. Protocol, records and scripts are included.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"故障溯源记录"(episode record)，将多智能体系统失败中的候选故障与其起源、传播、检测、响应和后果关联，并按运行阶段与状态域定位，再据此建立书面标注协议；对Who&When与MAD语料中六个多智能体系统的95个失败轨迹全量阅读后发现故障多早期进入(中位0.18)、72%的轨迹在失败前已含反证证据但88%无智能体据此行动。
AI.motivation: 现有失败分析只记录症状(失败模式标签或归责的智能体/步骤)，无法说明错误从何处进入、由哪个状态传播至症状、轨迹中是否存在矛盾证据、以及哪种控制手段能拦截，因此缺乏可操作的诊断与干预依据。
AI.method: 定义包含起源、传播、检测、响应、后果五要素并按操作阶段与状态域定位的episode record，并标注可覆盖该故障的控制手段族；将其转化为书面标注协议，对Who&When与MAD两个公开语料中六个多智能体系统的95条失败运行逐条完整阅读轨迹进行人工标注。
AI.result: 故障进入较早(中位数0.18)，多为关于任务状态的错误决策或捏造，且88条Who&When运行中有37条早于语料人工标注的关键步骤；72%失败运行在失败前已含反证证据，其中88%无智能体据此行动；31%运行出现偏差信号但无响应消除该偏差状态；独立裁判读取未用证据、准入时固定任务契约、对照环境复核信念可覆盖多数episode；35/95运行仅需恢复智能体自身状态即可；45%手工构建的Who&When失败以provider内容过滤崩溃告终，随后harness输出无智能体产生的最终答案，属现有症状分类与归责标签均无法表达的失败类别。
AI.conclusion: 症状级标签不足，需以故障溯源episode record为核心的标注协议来刻画多智能体失败的因果链；该协议可揭示被现有分类遗漏的失败类别，并指向以证据裁判、任务契约与状态恢复为主的针对性控制手段。

title: Game-Enhanced Embodied Learning with Event and Foresight Pretraining
summary: Human gameplay supplies paired observations, actions, and visual consequences that can supplement robot-policy training. We study event-and-foresight pretraining for InternVLA-A1.5, combining recorded keyboard/mouse event prediction with history-conditioned visual supervision through a frozen video model. Coverage-preserving anchor selection constructs one-second targets, and an attention mask prevents teacher-forced future actions from entering foresight queries. The selected corpus contains 394 recordings across 20 games, with 223.36 hours of recorded timestamp span and 2,072,084 training anchors. After 12,400 game-pretraining updates, we compare the resulting initialization with the public base under the same suite-specific robot fine-tuning protocol. Across four LIBERO suites, aggregate success increases from 1,718/2,000 (85.90%) to 1,811/2,000 (90.55%), a gain of 4.65 percentage points. Suite gains are 9.2, 6.8, 0.2, and 2.4 points on Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long. The 40-task breakdown shows 24 improvements, 10 declines, and six ties. These results support the practical value of the complete game-pretraining stage in this evaluated setting, while revealing heterogeneous task outcomes. The comparison includes additional optimization and does not isolate the effects of game data, the two objectives, or training variability.

AI.tldr: 提出 InternVLA-A1.5 的游戏事件与预见预训练方法，用人类游戏数据预训练后再机器人微调，LIBERO 四套件总成功率由 85.90% 升至 90.55%（+4.65 个百分点），但任务级结果异质，且未做消融隔离。
AI.motivation: 人类游戏过程天然提供“观测—动作—视觉后果”的配对数据，可作为机器人策略训练的补充信号；作者希望验证完整的游戏预训练阶段在真实评测设定下是否具有实用价值。
AI.method: 对 InternVLA-A1.5 进行两类预训练目标：①记录下来的键盘/鼠标事件预测（事件预测）；②以冻结视频模型为监督、以历史为条件的视觉预见监督。数据构建上采用覆盖保持的锚点选择生成 1 秒长度的目标，并用注意力掩码阻止 teacher-forcing 的未来动作进入预见查询。语料为 20 款游戏、394 段录像，时间戳跨度 223.36 小时，共 2,072,084 个训练锚点，预训练 12,400 步；随后在相同套件专用机器人微调协议下与公开基座对比。
AI.result: LIBERO 四套件汇总成功率从 1,718/2,000（85.90%）提升至 1,811/2,000（90.55%），+4.65 个百分点；分套件增益为 Spatial 9.2、Object 6.8、Goal 0.2、Long 2.4 个百分点。40 个任务中 24 项提升、10 项下降、6 项持平。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持完整游戏预训练阶段在该评测设定下的实用价值，同时揭示任务级效果异质（Goal 与部分任务几乎无增益或退化）。对比包含额外优化量，未隔离游戏数据本身、两个预训练目标各自贡献及训练随机性的影响，因此增益归因仍待控制实验确认。

title: When Reconstruction Helps Event-Camera Person Triggers
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, ancillary score tables and recomputation script
summary: Event cameras record asynchronous changes in brightness. To use a general visual model as a recording trigger, a system must represent these measurements in a form the model can interpret. We compare direct grayscale accumulation, two temporal encodings, and two intensity reconstructors on paired real event data. On 192 windows from four held-out DSEC recordings, thresholds calibrated only on development data yielded 40 of 52 person detections and 12 of 140 background positives with E2VID. The strongest direct temporal encoding at an admissible fixed cutoff yielded 14 detections and seven background positives. A retrospective comparison at a common 10% background-positive cap yielded 40 detections for E2VID and at most 19 for any direct encoding. FireNet+ had lower preparation cost and produced 21 detections with zero observed background positives at its frozen cutoff. On the same 192 windows, Qwen3-VL-4B yielded 33/52, 2/140 with E2VID and 9/52, 9/140 with the highest-recall direct rendering, the three-bin image (person detections, background positives). A 96-second exploratory replay illustrates the sensitivity of episode capture and recording starts to cutoff selection. The experiments identify a detection benefit from reconstruction under controlled input history and distinguish it from the cost and false starts of continuous triggering.

AI.tldr: 该文比较多种事件相机数据表示方式（灰度累积、两种时间编码、两种强度重建器）作为通用视觉模型触发输入的效果，发现强度重建（E2VID）在受控输入历史下带来显著检测增益，但需权衡准备成本与连续触发造成的误启动。
AI.motivation: 事件相机仅记录亮度异步变化，而通用视觉模型需要可解释的图像形式输入；如何将事件测量转换为合适表示，并将其作为录制触发条件，尚缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 在真实配对事件数据上对比直接灰度累积、两种时间编码和两种强度重建器（E2VID、FireNet+）。使用四个未参与开发的 DSEC 录像中的 192 个窗口，阈值仅在开发数据上校准；同时在相同 192 个窗口上评估 Qwen3-VL-4B 的输出，并进行 96 秒探索性回放以考察触发截断选取对片段捕获与录制启动的影响。
AI.result: 开发集校准阈值下，E2VID 取得 52 例行人检测中的 40 例、140 个背景正例中的 12 个；最强的直接时间编码在可行固定截断下仅 14 例检测、7 个背景正例。在统一 10% 背景正例上限下，E2VID 为 40 例检测，直接编码最多 19 例。FireNet+ 准备成本更低，在其冻结截断下得到 21 例检测、零背景正例。Qwen3-VL-4B 在同一批窗口上，E2VID 为 33/52、2/140，最高召回的直接渲染（三通道图像）为 9/52、9/140。96 秒回放显示片段捕获与录制启动对截断选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，在受控输入历史下强度重建相较直接编码具有明显检测优势，但须与准备成本及连续触发带来的误启动代价区分评估；截断阈值选择对实际触发行为影响显著。

title: Stochastic Projections and Rank-Aware Learning Rates for Federated LoRA
summary: Fine-tuning large-scale foundation models across resource-constrained, distributed clients presents significant computational and communication challenges. While merging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with Federated Learning (FL) enables rank-based flexibility, the interdependence of the adaptation matrices ($\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$) often complicates optimization. In this work, we theoretically demonstrate that LoRA fine-tuning with Gaussian initialization and a frozen $\mathbf{A}$ matrix acts as a stochastic approximation of full fine-tuning, where batch gradients are subject to a random, rank-dependent perturbation. Motivated by this insight, we propose freezing and periodically resampling $\mathbf{A}$ matrices at the client level. This strategy decouples the $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ gradients, diminishes LoRA low-rank constraints and reduces both computational and uplink communication overheads by 50\%, allowing for the reallocation of resources toward higher adaptation ranks. Furthermore, we show that in this frozen-$\mathbf{A}$ regime, the adaptation rank $r$ directly governs the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the perturbed gradients. Specifically, we find that the SNR increases linearly with $r$, implying that clients' learning rates must be dynamically scaled with their adaptation ranks for higher utility. Building on these foundations, we introduce SPRA-LoRA (Stochastic Projection Rank-Aware LoRA), a federated rank-aware fine-tuning strategy that utilizes frozen, resampled $\mathbf{A}$ matrices and rank-dependent learning rates for clients. We also prove its convergence with heterogeneous client resources. Our experiments across benchmark datasets demonstrate that SPRA-LoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with half the overhead on clients.

AI.tldr: 本文证明冻结A矩阵的LoRA等价于全量微调的随机近似（梯度带秩相关扰动），据此提出联邦学习中的SPRA-LoRA：客户端级冻结并周期重采样A矩阵、按秩自适应调整学习率，通信与计算开销降低50%并提升高秩适配效果。
AI.motivation: 大规模基础模型在资源受限的分布式客户端上微调面临计算与通信瓶颈。LoRA与联邦学习结合可提供秩级灵活性，但A、B两个适配矩阵相互耦合，导致优化困难；如何在降低开销的同时支持更高适配秩、并应对客户端资源异构，是待解决的问题。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：在A矩阵冻结、A以高斯初始化时，LoRA微调是全量微调的随机近似，批梯度受与秩相关的随机扰动；2) 据此在客户端层面冻结A并周期性重采样，解耦A与B的梯度，削弱低秩约束，节省50%计算与上行通信，将资源转向更高秩；3) 证明冻结-A机制下秩r直接决定扰动梯度的信噪比（SNR随r线性增长），故客户端学习率需随其适配秩动态缩放；4) 提出SPRA-LoRA（Stochastic Projection Rank-Aware LoRA）联邦秩感知微调策略，并证明其在客户端资源异构条件下的收敛性。
AI.result: 理论结果表明：冻结-A下梯度SNR随适配秩r线性增长，故秩相关学习率可提升效用；SPRA-LoRA在异构资源客户端下具备收敛保证。基准数据集实验显示，SPRA-LoRA在客户端开销仅为基线一半的情况下，持续优于现有最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 冻结并周期性重采样A矩阵是一种兼顾解耦优化、降低通信计算开销与提升有效秩的简洁有效手段；秩与信噪比的线性关系为秩感知学习率设计提供了依据。SPRA-LoRA在资源异构的联邦场景中实现了更优的性能—开销权衡。

title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
summary: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"仅观测同伴推荐网络、规划干预以最小化隐藏接触网络中HIV传播"的新问题，并实现R2C-Agent决策智能体：其核心为Referral-to-Contact Diffusion（R2C-Diff）条件图扩散模型，将同伴推荐过程建模为对潜在接触网络的增量腐蚀并学习其逆过程；智能体在扩散模型采样的接触网络上规划干预以考虑隐藏网络不确定性。基于真实HIV网络数据的仿真实验表明其干预效果优于跨学科基线方法。
AI.motivation: 针对HIV预防与治疗资源有限，需用网络算法精准投放；但优化靶向生物医学干预通常需要观测个体间HIV传播风险行为的接触网络，而大规模采集该网络成本过高。同伴推荐网络可数字化、大规模获取，但存在偏差（推荐可能沿非风险社会关系、参与者仅接受一次推荐、已招募者之间的联系被隐藏），因此不能直接替代真实接触网络，形成了"观测的是推荐网络、优化的是隐藏接触网络"的规划难题。
AI.method: 1）形式化新问题：在仅观测同伴推荐网络的条件下，规划最小化隐藏接触网络中HIV传播的网络干预；2）构建R2C-Diff条件图扩散模型，把递归同伴推荐过程视为对潜在接触网络的逐步腐蚀（corruption），学习其反向去噪生成过程，从而在给定推荐网络条件下后验采样接触网络；3）实现R2C-Agent决策智能体，在R2C-Diff采样的接触网络上做干预规划，使决策对隐藏网络的不确定性具有鲁棒性；4）使用真实HIV网络数据进行仿真实验，并与跨学科文献基线方法对比。
AI.result: 仿真实验（基于真实世界HIV网络数据）显示，R2C-Agent所规划的干预在经验上比跨学科文献中的基线方法更有效；分析还揭示了影响性能的关键权衡与假设（如推荐偏差结构、观测信息量对规划质量的影响）。
AI.conclusion: 在只能获得同伴推荐网络的现实约束下，将推荐过程显式建模为对隐藏接触网络的条件腐蚀-反演生成，并在此基础上进行考虑不确定性的干预规划，是一种可行且更优的HIV靶向干预方案设计路径。

title: Learn-To-Propagate: Distributionally Robust Motion Planning for Nonlinear Uncertain Systems
summary: Motion planning for stochastic systems aims to find a sequence of control inputs that drives a system to a goal set while avoiding unsafe states with high probability. Existing approaches, however, are either restricted to linear dynamics with perfect knowledge of the underlying distributions or lack formal correctness guarantees. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Learn-To-Propagate Distributionally-Robust Forest (L2P-DR-Forest)}, a distributionally-robust sampling-based planning algorithm for \emph{nonlinear} stochastic systems with \emph{unknown} initial state and process noise distributions. Our approach leverages recent advances in optimal transport to learn ambiguity sets that contain the true system distributions with high confidence. We develop an efficient method for propagating these sets through the system dynamics and for verifying their safety. We then integrate these techniques into a novel sampling-based planning algorithm to grow a forest of search trees in the system's state space while accounting for and mitigating the growth of ambiguity-sets radii. We prove that the algorithm is correct, i.e., every returned plan satisfies the specifications with the prescribed confidence, and, under some feasibility and distributional assumptions, is probabilistically complete. Evaluations on several robotic benchmarks demonstrate that our algorithm significantly outperforms existing methods while providing formal guarantees with high confidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 L2P-DR-Forest：面向未知初始状态与过程噪声分布的非线性随机系统，用最优传输学习分布模糊集并高效传播，嵌入采样规划在状态空间生长树森林，兼具正确性与概率完备性。
AI.motivation: 现有随机系统运动规划方法要么限于线性动力学且需精确已知分布，要么缺乏形式化正确性保证；因此需要一种对分布未知的非线性随机系统也能给出高置信度保证的规划算法。
AI.method: 利用最优传输理论从数据中学习以高置信度包含真实系统分布的模糊集（ambiguity set）；设计高效方法将模糊集沿系统动力学传播并验证安全性；将这些技术集成进新的基于采样的规划算法，在状态空间中生长搜索树森林，并显式考虑与抑制模糊集半径的增长。
AI.result: 证明了算法正确性——每条返回的规划均以给定置信度满足规格；在一定的可行性与分布假设下证明概率完备性；在多个机器人基准测试中显著优于现有方法，且能提供高置信度的形式化保证。
AI.conclusion: L2P-DR-Forest 将分布鲁棒模糊集学习、传播与采样规划统一，解决了非线性随机系统在分布未知情形下缺少形式化保证的规划难题，兼具理论保证与实证性能优势。

title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026, codes are available at project page https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe
summary: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition and generalization to unseen predicates. To address these challenges, we propose RaRe, a reasoning-aware relational representation learning framework that transforms MLLM-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales into structured relation embeddings. Rather than using CoT only as an intermediate reasoning trace for final prediction, RaRe directly optimizes the rationale-derived representation space to improve inter-relation discriminability. Specifically, RaRe first aligns rationale embeddings with textualized relation descriptions through self-supervised contrastive learning, and then refines rationale generation with a specificity-oriented reinforcement learning objective that encourages semantically object-pair-specific relational evidence. Experiments on VG150 and PSG demonstrate improved category-balanced recognition over existing baselines, while the additional gains from learning vary across datasets and proposal settings. Code available at: https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/RaRe.

AI.tldr: 提出RaRe框架，将MLLM生成的思维链（CoT）理由转化为结构化关系嵌入，以缓解OV-SGG中依赖数据集特定共现模式导致的偏置与纠缠问题。
AI.motivation: 现有OV-SGG方法依赖数据集特定的物体--谓词共现模式；在长尾分布与噪声物体定位下，这种依赖导致关系表示偏置、纠缠，限制稀有关系识别与未见谓词泛化。
AI.method: RaRe不把CoT仅当作中间推理痕迹用于最终预测，而是直接优化由理由导出的表示空间以提升关系间可判别性：先通过自监督对比学习将理由嵌入与文本化关系描述对齐；再用面向特异性的强化学习目标精炼理由生成，鼓励生成语义上与物体对特定相关的证据。
AI.result: 在VG150与PSG上，相较现有基线在类别均衡识别上有提升；但学习带来的额外收益随数据集与候选框（proposal）设置而变化。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM理由直接用于优化关系表示空间是一种可行方向，可改善类别均衡识别；不过其增益具有数据集与proposal设置依赖性，通用性仍需进一步验证。

title: Advancing Mass-Conserving Deep Learning for Distributed Hydrologic Modeling: A Case Study in a Snow-Dominated Watershed
summary: Recent progress in physics-aware deep learning (DL) has embedded mass conservation within Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture for hydrologic modeling, improving physical consistency and enabling diagnostics of internal states. However, existing mass-conserving neural networks are primarily developed in lumped formulations. Consequently, previous studies provide only fragmented and often indirect evidence of when and why imposed physical constraints may lead to unrealistic hydrologic behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Physics-Enhanced Conservation-Augmented Net (PECAN), a mass-conserving convolutional LSTM-based framework for distributed hydrologic modeling and diagnosing structural limitations of physics-aware DL models. PECAN is implemented in two variants: (1) PECAN-MC with a strict precipitation-based conservation constraint and (2) PECAN-MCR with a relaxed conservation constraint allowing additional water inputs beyond precipitation. Both variants are trained solely on gauge streamflow and evaluated in a snow-dominated watershed in Colorado. We benchmark PECAN against lumped DL baselines and the distributed process-based Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC) model. Results show that PECAN achieves competitive outlet streamflow simulation accuracy while producing spatially explicit latent states for interpretation. Comparisons with reference soil moisture indicate that PECAN cell states resemble meaningful temporal soil moisture dynamics. However, analyses also reveal that PECAN misrepresents snow processes by prematurely removing winter snow water storage from the system rather than retaining it for spring release. PECAN demonstrates accurate streamflow simulation at gauges and shows diagnostic potential to expose structural limitations in hydrologic process representation, thereby informing future physics-aware neural network development for hydrology.

AI.tldr: 提出 PECAN——基于卷积 LSTM 的分布式质量守恒框架（含 PECAN-MC 严格降水约束与 PECAN-MCR 松弛约束两变体），在科罗拉多融雪流域仅用站点径流训练，出口流量精度可与集总 DL 基线及 VIC 媲美，但诊断出模型会提前释放冬季雪水储量、误表征积雪过程。
AI.motivation: 现有质量守恒神经网络多为集总式建模，只能提供零散、间接的证据来说明物理约束何时以及为何导致不合理的水文行为；缺乏分布式框架来系统诊断物理感知深度学习模型的结构性局限。
AI.method: 将质量守恒嵌入卷积 LSTM，构建分布式 PECAN 框架：PECAN-MC 施加严格的基于降水的守恒约束，PECAN-MCR 允许降水之外额外水分输入的松弛约束。仅以站点实测径流训练，在科罗拉多融雪主导流域测试，并与集总 DL 基线和分布式过程模型 VIC 对比；通过空间显式隐状态与参考土壤湿度对比进行诊断。
AI.result: PECAN 出口流量模拟精度具竞争力，且能输出可解释的空间显式隐状态；单元状态与参考土壤湿度对比显示其能刻画合理的时间土壤湿度动态；但模型过早将冬季雪水储量移出系统而非滞留至春季释放，积雪过程表征错误。
AI.conclusion: PECAN 在站点尺度径流模拟准确，并具备揭示水文过程表征结构性缺陷的诊断潜力，可为未来水文学物理感知神经网络的发展提供依据。

title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/henrique-polybee/f3-agi-v4
summary: Few-shot abstract reasoning on ARC-AGI requires inducing algorithmic transformations from 2 to 5 demonstration pairs without task-specific pretraining. Because few-shot demonstrations under-constrain the hypothesis space, program synthesis suffers from the Rashomon effect (predictive multiplicity): heuristic search finds spurious programs with low training error that fail on test inputs, while unconstrained library growth degrades latency. We introduce F3-AGI v4.0, a CPU-native neuro-symbolic and active inference architecture comprising three mechanisms: (1) F3-Metabolic-Optim, combining mistake-gated plasticity, Fisher-EMA preconditioning, and virtual ATP gating; (2) Adaptive Complexity-Guided Program Synthesis (AACR) with a Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer and smallest-pair early rejection; and (3) a 512D L2-normalized random projection driving Expected Free Energy (EFE) exploration with dead-signature pruning. Across three empirical studies: (i) on a synthetic 5-task class-incremental stream without replay, F3-Metabolic-Optim achieves 91.67% final accuracy with 9.17% forgetting, skipping 93.47% of updates, cutting L1 plasticity cost by 65.7%, and running 2.19x faster than EWC; (ii) on the 400-task ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation set (offline CPU, zero LLM calls), F3-AGI v4.0 solves 57/400 tasks (14.25% pass@2; 56/400 pass@1) with a mean latency of 1.62 s/task, decomposed into 19/50 (38.00%, 1.19 s/task, a 42.5x paired speedup over Horizon 2) on the 50-task calibration slice and 38/350 (10.86%) on the 350 strictly uninspected hold-out tasks (with 7 autonomous Cycle-3 patch solutions); and (iii) in a local 5-game (15-level) ARC-AGI-3-inspired interactive suite, our agent completes 15/15 levels with 89.44% level-weighted RHAE (90.72% unweighted).

AI.tldr: 提出F3-AGI v4.0：一种CPU原生神经符号+主动推断架构，用代谢式优化、复杂度引导的程序合成与EFE探索，在无LLM、无任务特化预训练条件下解决ARC-AGI少样本抽象推理，400题上pass@2为14.25%、平均1.62s/题。
AI.motivation: 少样本抽象推理仅凭2–5个示例严重欠约束假设空间，导致Rashomon效应（预测多重性）：启发式搜索易找到训练误差低但泛化失败的伪程序；而无约束的库增长又拖慢延迟。需要同时控制假设空间与搜索成本。
AI.method: 三机制架构：(1) F3-Metabolic-Optim，融合误差门控可塑性、Fisher-EMA预条件与虚拟ATP门控；(2) 自适应复杂度引导程序合成AACR，含Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer与最小对早拒（smallest-pair early rejection）；(3) 512维L2归一化随机投影驱动期望自由能（EFE）探索，并做死签名剪枝。全部在CPU上运行。
AI.result: 三项研究：(i) 无回放的合成5任务类增量流上，最终准确率91.67%、遗忘9.17%、跳过93.47%更新、L1可塑性成本降65.7%、比EWC快2.19倍；(ii) ARC-AGI-1公开评测400题（离线CPU、零LLM调用）解出57/400（pass@2 14.25%，pass@1 56/400），平均1.62 s/题，其中50题标定切片19/50（38.00%，1.19 s/题，相对Horizon 2配对加速42.5倍），350题严格未检查留出集38/350（10.86%，含7个自主Cycle-3补丁解）；(iii) 本地5游戏15关交互套件完成15/15关，RHAE加权89.44%、未加权90.72%。
AI.conclusion: 通过代谢式可塑性门控、复杂度引导的合成拒绝与EFE驱动探索，可在纯CPU、零LLM条件下有效缓解少样本程序合成的预测多重性并控制延迟，在ARC-AGI-1/AGI-3风格任务上取得可复现但仍有明显上限的表现（留出集约10.86%），提示后续重点在于提高留出泛化率而非速度。

title: ReACT: Reflection-Consistent Modulation and Cross-Load Consistency for Humanoid Velocity Tracking Under Asymmetric Loads
summary: In recent years, humanoid loco-manipulation has progressed to whole-body grasping, lifting, and transport. A basic requirement underlying these tasks is carrying the object to its destination, which depends on the locomotion controller accurately executing velocity commands from the navigation policy. However, carrying an object in one hand introduces a persistent asymmetric upper-body load that can degrade velocity tracking. Persistent tracking biases can accumulate into position and heading deviations, increasing the risk of collisions and navigation failure. To address this problem, we present ReACT, a framework for accurate velocity tracking under asymmetric upper-body loads. Reflection-consistent disturbance modulation uses the estimated wrench to modulate actor features for load compensation while preserving action correspondence under reflected observations. Cross-load tracking consistency training compares loaded and unloaded conditions under the same velocity commands to promote consistent velocity tracking across loading conditions. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot show improved velocity tracking and reduced directional bias under varying asymmetric loads. Real-world experiments demonstrate collision-free goal reaching in all 40 tested navigation trials under unilateral hand loads with a fixed mapless navigation policy.

AI.tldr: 提出ReACT框架，实现人形机器人在单侧上肢负载下（手部携带物体）的精确速度跟踪，进而保障无地图导航的成功率。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人的全身抓取、举升与搬运任务都依赖移动控制器准确执行导航策略下发的速度指令。但单手携带物体带来持续的上半身非对称负载，导致速度跟踪出现偏差；该偏差会累积为位置与航向漂移，增加碰撞与导航失败风险。
AI.method: 1）Reflection-consistent disturbance modulation：利用估计的外力（wrench）调制actor特征以进行负载补偿，同时在镜像观测下保持动作对应关系的一致性；2）Cross-load tracking consistency training：在相同速度指令下对比有负载与无负载情形，促使不同负载条件下的速度跟踪表现保持一致。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人的仿真实验中，变速非对称负载下速度跟踪精度提升、方向性偏差降低；真实实验中，在单手负载条件下配合固定的无地图导航策略，40次导航试验全部实现无碰撞到达目标。
AI.conclusion: 通过负载感知的特征调制与跨负载一致性训练，可有效抑制非对称负载引起的速度跟踪偏差，为人形机器人负重全身移动与导航提供可靠的底层控制基础。

title: Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction
summary: SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content. Latent diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for restoring missing detail, but their effectiveness is constrained by how HDR signals pass through the pretrained VAE. We find that common log-like encodings suppress low-luminance chromatic differences before generation, producing a dark-side collapse in the frozen-VAE latent. We introduce EquivFlow, a compact, invertible exposure-equivariant encoding that maps exposure changes to additive shifts while retaining a scale-independent chromatic component, without modifying the VAE. Encoding-level tests across pretrained image and video VAEs show that its exposure structure and deep-dark chroma transport persist across the tested hosts. Integrated into SDR-to-HDR video diffusion, EquivFlow delivers consistent chromatic-fidelity gains across the tested settings while retaining competitive reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 EquivFlow——一种紧凑、可逆、曝光等变的编码，将曝光变化映射为加性偏移并保留尺度无关色度分量，在不改动 VAE 的前提下解决 SDR-to-HDR 潜扩散重建中暗部色度塌陷问题。
AI.motivation: SDR-to-HDR 重建是不适定问题，需同时恢复高光截断、暗部压死与量化伪影并保持原内容。潜扩散模型虽提供强生成先验，但其效果受限于 HDR 信号如何通过预训练 VAE：常见的对数型编码会在生成前抑制低亮度色度差异，导致冻结 VAE 潜空间出现"暗侧塌陷"。
AI.method: 提出 EquivFlow：一种紧凑、可逆的曝光等变编码，把曝光变化映射为加性平移，同时保留尺度无关的色度分量，且无需修改 VAE。在多种预训练图像与视频 VAE 上进行编码层面的测试，并将其集成到 SDR-to-HDR 视频扩散框架中。
AI.result: 编码层面测试显示其曝光结构与深暗部色度传输特性在所测宿主 VAE 上均得以保持；集成到视频扩散后，在所测设置下取得一致的色度保真度提升，同时重建保真度保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: HDR 信号的编码方式是限制潜扩散先验发挥的关键瓶颈，通过设计曝光等变、可逆且兼容冻结 VAE 的编码即可在不重训 VAE 的情况下显著改善暗部色度恢复，提示编码设计应作为 SDR-to-HDR 生成流程中的一等公民。

title: When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition
summary: Practitioners often combine independently trained models while keeping their weights frozen. These experts are commonly combined through their final predictions, although their internal features may retain useful information that those predictions omit. We ask when combining features improves on combining predictions, and how to make that comparison fair. We introduce a reusable evaluation protocol, apply it to 21 frozen deepfake detectors from DF40 (Yan et al., 2024), and audit how evaluation choices change the conclusions. The protocol uses strong prediction baselines, compares simple and larger feature combiners, varies architecture and training data separately, and reports results by held-out generator with train/test overlap controls. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, logistic regression on the features of six architecture-diverse experts improves macro AUROC by 0.081 over the best tested prediction combiner in each fold, with gains on seven of eight generators. The larger network shows no clear improvement over the linear model (approximately 3.5M versus 10K parameters), suggesting that access to richer information matters more than additional combiner capacity on this pool. Features may help when they retain information that the predictions omit and that transfers to new generators. Predictions may be enough when the strongest prediction baseline already performs well, while neither approach reliably compensates for poor expert transfer. Weakening prediction baselines on the overlap-affected standard split inflates the apparent feature advantage by up to 0.172 AUROC. Overlap-aware evaluation also changes the estimated gain, though the contrast does not isolate overlap. Results by generator and expert pool show where the advantage holds, weakens, or reverses. Without these controls, the same benchmark can support different conclusions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出可复用的评估协议，用21个DF40冻结深度伪造检测器比较"特征组合"与"预测组合"，结果显示留一生成器评估下特征组合（6专家特征上的逻辑回归）宏AUROC比最佳预测组合高0.081；更大的组合网络无显著增益；削弱基线或使用重叠数据集可虚增优势至0.172。
AI.motivation: 实践中常将独立训练、权重冻结的模型通过最终预测进行组合，但专家的内部特征可能保留预测所遗漏的有用信息。作者追问：何时组合特征优于组合预测，以及如何公平地进行这一比较（现有评估往往缺乏对照，评估选择会左右结论）。
AI.method: 提出可复用评估协议：使用强预测基线；对比简单线性组合器与更大容量的特征组合器；分别改变架构与训练数据（解耦二者）；按留出生成器报告结果并控制训练/测试重叠。在DF40的21个冻结深度伪造检测器上应用该协议，并审计评估选择（如重叠污染的标准划分）对结论的影响。
AI.result: 留一生成器评估下，对六个架构多样专家特征做逻辑回归，宏AUROC较每折最佳预测组合器提升0.081，8个生成器中7个有效；约10K参数的线性模型与约3.5M参数的较大网络表现相近，说明信息丰富度比组合器容量更重要；在受重叠影响的标准划分上削弱预测基线，可将表观特征优势虚增至0.172 AUROC；感知重叠的评估也会改变估计增益，但该对比未能单独分离重叠因素。
AI.conclusion: 当特征保留预测所遗漏且可迁移到新生成器的信息时，组合特征有益；当最强预测基线已表现良好时，组合预测可能足够；两种方法都无法弥补专家迁移性差的问题。结论依生成器与专家池而异，可能增强、减弱甚至反转；缺乏上述控制时，同一基准可支持不同结论。

title: Agent-Guided Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Physics-based Validation
summary: Accurate, compact exchange--correlation functionals are central to predictive density functional theory. Symbolic search and language-model agents can propose new functional forms, but it remains unclear whether their gains survive self-consistency and external evaluation, whether the new terms carry physical content, whether agents outperform evolutionary search, and how language-model backbones compare. We connect frontier LLM agents to a GPU evaluator through the Model Context Protocol, with training-only fitting, persistent memory, and self-consistent and external evaluation. Opus-5.5 agents passed the screening gate with about 40-fold fewer tokens than Codex (GPT-6-Astra) agents and found a candidate with lower validation and held-out errors; only this candidate advanced to self-consistent evaluation. The resulting 13-parameter functional, O159, multiplies same-spin correlation by a smooth density window. Refitted controls favor a window that scales the entire same-spin factor, reducing it by 15--30\% at its peak, and that acts on reaction energies mainly in near-iso-orbital regions; against a refitted no-window control, it lowers heavy-atom total-energy errors on GSCDB137 by 29\%. With about 400 fits each, SyFES evolution did not improve on its GAS22 seed, whereas the agents found forms 0.10--0.13 \kcal\ lower in validation error by adding an explicit density scale. Self-consistent O159 lowers the held-out MGCDB84 test error of $ω$B97M-V by 11.7\%, and its mean normalized error ratio on 36 GSCDB137 datasets (1.139) is comparable to $ω$B97M-V (1.144) and below GAS22 (1.190). Frontier-LLM agents thus produced O159, a compact functional whose improvement over $ω$B97M-V survives self-consistent, physics-based validation.

AI.tldr: 将前沿 LLM 智能体通过 MCP 接入 GPU 评估器，在严格的自洽与外部评估下自动搜索交换-相关泛函，得到了 13 参数的 O159 泛函；其自洽评估误差优于 ωB97M-V，且智能体搜索效率与效果均超过进化搜索。
AI.motivation: 符号搜索与语言模型智能体已能提出新的泛函形式，但此前不清楚这些增益能否经受自洽计算与外部基准检验、新项是否具有物理含义、智能体是否优于进化搜索，以及不同 LLM 骨干之间的差异。
AI.method: 把前沿 LLM 智能体通过 Model Context Protocol 连接到 GPU 评估器，采用仅用训练集拟合、持久化记忆、自洽评估与外部评估的流程；将同自旋相关乘以平滑密度窗口得到 O159，并用重拟合对照（整体窗口缩放、无窗口对照）剖析其物理内容；同时以约 400 次拟合的 SyFES 进化搜索作对照。
AI.result: Opus-5.5 智能体以约少 40 倍的 token 通过筛选门，并找到验证与留出误差更低的候选（唯一进入自洽评估者）。O159 在自洽下将 ωB97M-V 的 MGCDB84 留出测试误差降低 11.7%，在 36 个 GSCDB137 数据集上的平均归一化误差比 1.139 与 ωB97M-V 的 1.144 相当、优于 GAS22 的 1.190；相对重拟合无窗口对照，重原子总能量误差降低 29%。进化搜索在约 400 次拟合后未超越其 GAS22 种子，而智能体通过引入显式密度尺度使验证误差降低 0.10–0.13 kcal。
AI.conclusion: 前沿 LLM 智能体成功构造出紧凑的 O159 泛函，其对 ωB97M-V 的改进在自洽、基于物理的验证下依然成立，表明 LLM 智能体搜索可优于进化搜索并具有实际物理内涵。

title: Optimization-Based Path Planning for Industrial Manipulators: Experimental Validation in Additive Manufacturing
comment: Submitted for the review in ECC 2027
summary: Robotic additive manufacturing requires joint paths that reconcile robot feasibility with process-specific geometry. We develop an offline optimization-based path planner that combines joint-path regularity and self-collision penalties with process costs and constraints, so that a new process enters through its own reference, residuals, and tolerances. Full-path and boundary-coupled chunked optimization handle references of different lengths. Iterative Weight Tuning (IWT) determines the cost weights from the gaps between Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and their targets. In carbon-fiber winding and robotic 3D printing, the planned paths meet the geometric tolerances and all KPI targets, and both paths are executed on a UR10e, without extrusion for printing, with joint-level tracking recorded during execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于离线优化的机器人增材制造联合路径规划器，将关节路径正则化与自碰撞惩罚同工艺代价/约束统一优化，通过IWT权重调节使碳纤维缠绕与机器人3D打印路径满足几何容差与全部KPI目标，并在UR10e上完成执行验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人增材制造需要关节路径同时满足机器人可行性与特定工艺几何要求，而不同工艺（缠绕、打印）差异大，现有方法难以以统一框架灵活接入新工艺。
AI.method: 构建离线优化式路径规划器，把关节路径正则项、自碰撞惩罚与工艺代价及约束联合建模；新工艺通过自身参考轨迹、残差与容差接入。设计全路径优化与边界耦合的分块优化以处理不同长度参考；采用迭代权重调节（IWT），依据KPI与目标值之间的差距确定各代价权重。
AI.result: 在碳纤维缠绕与机器人3D打印两类任务中，规划路径均满足几何容差且达到全部KPI目标；两条路径均在UR10e上执行（打印时不挤出），并记录了执行过程中的关节级跟踪数据。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架可统一处理多工艺的机器人增材制造路径规划，具备工艺可扩展性与KPI驱动的自动调参能力，并通过实际机器人执行验证了可行性。

title: Distribution Shift Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery using Machine Learning Models
comment: Accepted as a short paper at the 4th Workshop on Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO), held in conjunction with WACV 2027
summary: Remote sensing imagery acquired by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) supports wide range of applications; however, deploying machine learning (ML) models on resource-constrained aerial platforms introduces challenges beyond predictive accuracy, particularly when deployment data differ from the distributions observed during training. Such shifts are common in remote sensing due to geographic, sensor, seasonal, and other visual variations. A practical solution is to equip deployed models with mechanisms that detect emerging distribution shifts and support subsequent responsive actions. This paper presents an empirical case study of three open-source detection tools: (i) Alibi-Detect; (ii) NannyML; and (iii) PyTorch-OOD. Using cross-dataset remote-sensing shifts, we evaluate both detection effectiveness and computational latency of these tools. Our results reveal differences in detection behavior and processing cost across methods and implementations, highlighting trade-offs between detection capability and response-time. These findings motivate further work toward lightweight, and latency-aware monitoring mechanisms for resource-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文对三种开源分布漂移/异常检测工具（Alibi-Detect、NannyML、PyTorch-OOD）在无人机遥感跨数据集分布漂移场景下进行了实证对比，同时评估检测有效性与计算延迟。
AI.motivation: 无人机遥感平台资源受限，ML模型部署时面临的挑战不止于预测精度：部署数据分布常因地理、传感器、季节等视觉差异而与训练分布不同（分布漂移）。因此需要在部署模型中集成漂移检测机制以触发响应动作，但缺乏对现有工具在检测能力与计算开销之间权衡的系统性认识。
AI.method: 实证案例研究：选取三个开源检测工具——(i) Alibi-Detect；(ii) NannyML；(iii) PyTorch-OOD；构造跨数据集的遥感分布漂移设定，对每种方法同时测量漂移检测效果与推理计算延迟（处理成本）。
AI.result: 不同方法与实现之间在检测行为和计算开销上存在明显差异，揭示了检测能力与响应时间之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 现有开源漂移检测工具在资源受限航空平台上存在能力—延迟折衷，尚不能直接满足部署需求；未来需面向资源受限系统开展轻量化、延迟感知的监控机制研究。

title: Reconstructing Boundary Layer Wind Profiles with Machine Learning: A Comparative Study on IGRA Radiosonde Data
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI-Ready Data for Science Discovery (ADSD), IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Wind profiles in the atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) drive short-range forecasting and wind-energy siting, yet sparse radiosonde coverage forces practitioners to interpolate them from a handful of physical predictors. We benchmark modern tabular learners against analytical parameterizations on 158,097 IGRA soundings. CatBoost, TabM, and FT-Transformer reduce RMSE to 1.3-1.6 m/s, against approximately 3 m/s for power-law and Monin-Obukhov fits; once the predictor set is fixed the three architectures differ by less than 0.05 m/s, so accuracy is driven by predictors rather than architecture. A cohort analysis of within-bin profile dispersion places an empirical floor of approximately 1.77 m/s on any point-wise predictor that uses standard radiosonde features, consistent with prior eddy-viscosity inversions. A one-dimensional Fourier Neural Operator applied as a post-hoc corrector to frozen tabular predictions reduces near-surface RMSE on U.S. stations from 1.5 to 1.2 m/s, while leaving upper-layer error unchanged. Further gains should come from new predictors rather than larger models.

AI.tldr: 在158,097条IGRA探空数据上，现代表格学习器（CatBoost、TabM、FT-Transformer）将风速廓线RMSE降至1.3–1.6 m/s，远优于幂律与Monin-Obukhov解析参数化（约3 m/s）；固定预测变量后三种架构差异<0.05 m/s，说明精度由预测变量而非架构决定。分箱内廓线离散度的队列分析给出约1.77 m/s的经验下界，与既有涡黏度反演结果一致。以一维傅里叶神经算子作为冻结表格预测的事后校正器，可将美国站近地面RMSE从1.5降至1.2 m/s，高层误差不变。进一步提升应依赖新预测变量而非更大模型。
AI.motivation: 大气边界层风廓线支撑短时预报与风能选址，但探空站覆盖稀疏，实际应用只能依赖少量物理预测变量进行插值/参数化。作者希望系统检验现代表格学习器能否在该任务上超越传统解析参数化，并厘清性能瓶颈究竟来自模型架构还是预测变量（信息量）本身，从而指明后续改进方向。
AI.method: (1) 数据：158,097条IGRA探空样本。(2) 基准：幂律（power-law）与Monin-Obukhov相似理论拟合。(3) 表格学习器：CatBoost、TabM、FT-Transformer，在固定预测变量集下比较。(4) 对箱内廓线离散度做队列分析（cohort analysis），估计逐点预测器的经验误差下界。(5) 以一维傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为冻结表格模型预测的事后（post-hoc）校正器。
AI.result: CatBoost、TabM、FT-Transformer的RMSE为1.3–1.6 m/s，解析参数化约3 m/s；预测变量固定后三种架构差异小于0.05 m/s。队列分析给出约1.77 m/s的经验下界，适用于使用标准探空特征的任意逐点预测器，且与既有涡黏度反演结论一致。FNO事后校正将美国站近地面RMSE由1.5降至1.2 m/s，而高层误差基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的表格学习在ABL风廓线插值上显著优于经典解析参数化，且架构选择已非关键，性能受预测变量信息量（约1.77 m/s下界）约束。FNO校正仅在近地面带来有限增益。未来应从引入新预测变量（如更高分辨率观测、地形、湍流与局地信息）而非扩大模型入手，以突破误差下界。

title: Do AI Agents need Preventive Care? An Epidemiologic Cohort Design for Agentic AI
summary: As AI agents increasingly perform tasks autonomously across sectors, including healthcare and biomedical research, understanding how their behaviors develop and influence outcomes over time becomes increasingly important. Existing evaluations largely focus on model capabilities and performance on predefined tasks. Here, we propose an epidemiologic cohort design for studying agentic AI, drawing on principles established in human population studies. The framework treats individual agents as members of a cohort, their underlying model as genetic makeup, accumulated work as their time scale, and naturally occurring behaviors as exposures that may influence subsequent outcomes. By following agents longitudinally, this approach enables investigation of behavioral determinants of adverse events, estimation of their potential preventable burden under causal assumptions, and characterization of behavioral changes over an agent's work life. We illustrate the design through two prospective observational cohorts examining curiosity and probing as a safety question, and data checking and analytical accuracy as a reliability question. Together, the framework and illustrative studies provide a generalizable blueprint for designing epidemiologic cohorts of AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种借鉴人类人群研究原理的"流行病学队列设计"，用于纵向研究自主AI智能体的行为发展及其对结果的影响，并通过两个前瞻性观察队列进行示例验证。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在医疗、生物医学研究等领域日益自主执行任务，其行为如何随时间发展并影响结果至关重要；而现有评估主要聚焦于模型能力和预定义任务上的表现，缺乏对行为纵向演变的系统研究。
AI.method: 将个体智能体视为队列成员，其底层模型类比为"基因型"，累积工作量类比为"时间尺度"，自然发生的行为类比为"暴露"；对智能体进行纵向随访，以分析不良事件的行为决定因素、在因果假设下估计可预防负担，并刻画智能体工作生命周期内的行为变化。文中构建两个前瞻性观察队列作为示例：以好奇性与探索行为为暴露、以安全性为结局；以数据核查与分析准确性为暴露、以可靠性为结局。
AI.result: 两个示例队列展示了该设计在安全性（好奇/探索）与可靠性（数据核查/分析准确性）两类问题上的可行性与适用性，说明流行病学队列方法能够系统刻画智能体行为与结局的关联。
AI.conclusion: 该框架与示例研究共同构成一套可推广的蓝图，为设计AI智能体的流行病学队列研究提供通用范式。

title: LaST0.5: A Generalist World Action Model with Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, endowing policies with strong capabilities for modeling temporal and physical dynamics. Existing WAMs, encompassing both video-first action prediction and joint video-action modeling, directly transfer global physical representations from world models to action generation. However, global scene representations may underemphasize local robot-object interactions, creating a mismatch between representations optimized for world evolution and those required for manipulation. To bridge this gap, we propose LaST0.5, a novel WAM that introduces an interaction-centric physical representation between world modeling and action generation. Specifically, LaST0.5 learns a compact interaction-centric latent space under the supervision of visual interaction cues between the robot and the environment. This reasoning space is instantiated as a latent expert that bridges the world expert and the action expert within a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Furthermore, LaST0.5 performs adaptive world-to-action transfer by jointly predicting future representations and progress values, using progress consistency to adjust action execution and trigger future resampling. Finally, we pretrain LaST0.5 on a large-scale robotic data corpus comprising over 14k hours of data, establishing interaction-centric physical reasoning as a scalable and effective paradigm. LaST0.5 achieves 99.5% on LIBERO, surpasses the previous state of the art on ten evaluated RLBench tasks, and demonstrates robust long-horizon execution and precise dexterous manipulation in real-world experiments.

AI.tldr: LaST0.5 提出一种以交互为中心的物理表征，作为世界模型与动作生成之间的桥梁，构建紧凑的交互潜空间并以视觉交互线索监督，通过 Mixture-of-Transformers 中的潜专家连接世界专家与动作专家，并结合进度一致性实现自适应的世界到动作迁移，在 LIBERO 上达 99.5% 并在十个 RLBench 任务上超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）把世界模型的全局物理表征直接用于动作生成，而全局场景表征会弱化机器人与物体之间的局部交互，造成"面向世界演化的表征"与"面向操作的表征"之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 1）在世界建模与动作生成之间引入以交互为中心的物理表征，在机器人—环境视觉交互线索监督下学习紧凑的交互潜空间；2）将该推理空间实例化为潜专家（latent expert），在 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构中桥接世界专家与动作专家；3）通过联合预测未来表征与进度值（progress）实现自适应世界到动作迁移，利用进度一致性调整动作执行并触发未来重采样；4）在超过 14k 小时的大规模机器人数据语料上预训练。
AI.result: LIBERO 上达到 99.5%；在十个评测的 RLBench 任务上超越此前最先进方法；真实世界实验中展现出稳健的长时序执行与精细灵巧操作能力。
AI.conclusion: 以交互为中心的物理推理可作为可扩展且有效的范式，弥合世界模型与动作生成之间的表征错配，并在仿真基准与真实机器人任务上取得领先表现。

title: TMAL: Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
summary: Curvilinear structures such as retinal vessels and surface cracks need both pixel-level accuracy and structural continuity. Pixel-wise supervision does not model the connections between pixels, and topology-based losses still produce ordinary masks. Connectivity-based methods predict these connections directly, but they use binary connectivity targets over a fixed local range. Such labels give the same value to thin segments and to thick regions, and they cannot describe connections at larger offsets. To address these limitations, we propose Topology-preserving Multi-offset Affinity Learning (TMAL). TMAL uses soft affinities that emphasize thin regions near the boundary, and it predicts directional affinities at several offsets to reach further. It then combines these affinities with weights that come from the decoder features, so local continuity and wider context are used together. An auxiliary segmentation branch adds region-level supervision and keeps the overlap accuracy high. On the retinal vessel dataset DRIVE and the crack inspection dataset DeepCrack, TMAL reaches the highest Dice, IoU, and clDice scores, and it greatly reduces the connected-component error $Δβ_0$. Code is available at https://github.com/suho-han/TMAL.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑保持多偏移亲和度学习（TMAL），用软亲和度与多偏移方向亲和度建模曲线结构连通性，并结合辅助分割分支，在DRIVE与DeepCrack上取得最优Dice、IoU、clDice并显著降低连通分量误差Δβ₀。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管、表面裂缝等曲线结构既需像素级精度又需结构连续性。像素级监督不建模像素间连接；拓扑损失仍输出普通掩码；基于连通性的方法虽直接预测连接，但使用固定局部范围内的二值连通标签，导致细段与粗区域取值相同，且无法描述更大偏移处的连接。
AI.method: TMAL包含三部分：(1) 软亲和度监督，对边界附近的细薄区域赋予更高权重；(2) 在多个偏移处预测有向亲和度，以覆盖更大距离的连接；(3) 利用解码器特征生成权重对多偏移亲和度进行加权融合，兼顾局部连续性与更广上下文；另设辅助分割分支提供区域级监督以保持重叠精度。
AI.result: 在视网膜血管数据集DRIVE与裂缝检测数据集DeepCrack上，TMAL取得最高Dice、IoU与clDice分数，并大幅降低连通分量误差Δβ₀。
AI.conclusion: 以软亲和度、多偏移有向亲和度及特征自适应加权替代固定范围二值连通标签，可更有效保持曲线结构拓扑，同时通过辅助分割分支维持像素级重叠精度；代码已开源。

title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
comment: 23 pages (11 pages main text), 10 figures, 14 tables
summary: Looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters, yet caching full-context key-value (KV) states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. We design a looped causal encoder-decoder (CED) that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise KV growth, addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global KV. We find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections, which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. Furthermore, training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's KV cache. Compounding cross-layer and cross-round KV sharing, the resulting Looped CED matches an unlooped CED's minimal memory footprint and recovers 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV. To test serving at production scale, we loop the 552B-parameter DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for 8 rounds on one 4xGB200 node: with per-layer and per-round KV the loop cannot fit a single 128K-token request, whereas Looped CED holds 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 such requests (as many as the unlooped model), and serves 3.6x higher throughput on 8K-token prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出循环式因果编码器-解码器（Looped CED），通过在编码器侧进行循环细化全局KV，并复合跨层与跨轮KV共享，实现"零轮次KV增长"的循环深度；在552B模型上单节点8轮循环可容纳38个128K请求、吞吐提升3.6倍。
AI.motivation: 循环（recurrent-depth）语言模型能在不增加参数的情况下加深计算，但跨层、跨轮缓存完整上下文的KV状态会严重限制服务时的批大小，导致大模型长上下文场景下无法实际部署。
AI.method: 设计非对称编码器-解码器结构，仅由稀疏编码器层生成全局KV；将循环置于编码器而非解码器，以迭代式细化全局KV表示；在随机循环深度下训练编码器循环，使模型收敛到不动点均衡，从而每轮可无损共享最后一轮的KV缓存；再与跨层KV共享复合叠加。
AI.result: Looped CED内存占用与无循环CED的最小值持平，以1/6的全局KV恢复循环Transformer 86–93%的性能增益；将552B参数模型循环8轮部署在单台4×GB200节点上，每token KV减少36.8倍，可同时容纳38个128K请求（与无循环模型相当），8K提示下吞吐提升3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环应置于编码器以细化全局KV，而非重读静态解码器投影，方能同时获得语言建模收益并保持长上下文可扩展性；随机深度训练诱导的不动点均衡是消解循环KV爆炸的关键，使大模型在生产规模下的循环推理服务成为可能。

title: Disentangling Multimodal Rotary Positional Embedding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models widely adopt Multimodal Rotary Position Embedding (MRoPE), an extension of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) that incorporates temporal, height, and width axes to encode the spatial structure of visual tokens. However, MRoPE also assigns height and width coordinates to text tokens that lack inherent spatial structure, introducing spatial positional effects into text-vision attention. Existing MRoPE variants explore different frequency allocations and coordinate layouts, with their designs suggesting different intuitions about these cross-modal effects: they may provide useful spatial references for associating language with visual regions, or introduce unnecessary positional preferences that hinder text-vision interactions. In this work, we disentangle intra-visual spatial structure from cross-modal spatial effects to investigate this question. We identify a constraint of shared coordinate layouts that prevents eliminating cross-modal spatial effects while preserving intra-visual spatial encoding, and develop controlled experiments to isolate their respective contributions. Our results across multiple model scales, MRoPE variants, and benchmarks show that cross-modal spatial effects provide little additional benefit as spatial references and can even impair model performance, while intra-visual spatial encoding remains useful for fine-grained grounding.

AI.tldr: 该文将MRoPE中的"视觉内部空间结构"与"跨模态空间效应"解耦，通过受控实验证明：给无空间结构的文本token分配高/宽坐标基本无益甚至有害，而视觉内部空间编码对细粒度定位仍有用。
AI.motivation: MRoPE在RoPE基础上加入时间、高度、宽度三维坐标以编码视觉token的空间结构，但现有实现同时给本身无空间结构的文本token也分配了高、宽坐标，从而在文本-视觉注意力中引入"跨模态空间位置效应"。已有MRoPE变体在频率分配与坐标布局上设计各异，背后隐含两种相互矛盾的直觉：跨模态空间坐标或可为语言与视觉区域关联提供空间参照，或只是引入不必要的空间偏好、妨碍文本-视觉交互。作者希望厘清这一问题。
AI.method: 先做理论/结构分析：指出现有"共享坐标布局"约束使得无法在保留视觉内部空间编码的同时消除跨模态空间效应，从而说明必须解耦二者；再设计受控实验，分别隔离跨模态空间效应与视觉内部空间编码的独立贡献，并在多种模型规模、多种MRoPE变体与多个基准上验证。
AI.result: 跨模态空间效应作为空间参照带来的额外收益很小，甚至会损害模型性能；而视觉内部空间编码对细粒度grounding仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 文本token上的高/宽坐标属于冗余甚至干扰性设计，MRoPE的价值主要来自视觉内部的空间结构编码而非跨模态空间对齐；这为后续位置编码设计提供了"解耦"视角与实验依据。

title: RedirectMimic: Local Motion Content Redaction for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: Humanoid motion interfaces should accommodate application-specific movement constraints while retaining useful reference behavior. Local content redaction requires a controller to replace selected movements even when it continues to receive the original reference. Removing the tracking incentive for those movements leaves their replacement unspecified. We introduce RedirectMimic, which separates the reference observed by the actor from the target used to train its execution. A rule-generated edited reference guides tracking rewards during proximal policy optimization, while the deployed observation and action interfaces remain unchanged. We evaluate pose- and speed-defined arm editing in Unitree G1 simulation using a tracker pretrained on 7,509 motion clips. On the overhead-arm task, RedirectMimic reduces core-window content occurrence to 2.7%, compared with 58.9% for reward zeroing and 32.8% for anti-tracking. It achieves 94.2% core-window joint success, combining content suppression, fall-free execution, and local retention. On the speed-defined task, fast outward arm movements occurred at similarly low rates under all three local editing methods. Across both tasks, RedirectMimic achieved the lowest replacement error among these methods and tracked unedited motions with accuracy comparable to that of the pretrained controller. Project page: https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/.

AI.tldr: RedirectMimic 将 actor 观测到的参考与训练执行目标解耦：用规则生成编辑参考引导 PPO 跟踪奖励，而部署时观测与动作接口不变，从而实现局部动作替换（重定向）。
AI.motivation: 人形动作接口需在保留有用参考行为的同时满足应用特定的运动约束；局部内容擦除要求控制器在仍接收原始参考时替换指定动作。直接移除这些动作的跟踪激励会使其替换结果无约束（不定），因此需要一种既能抑制指定内容、又能产生明确替代动作的方法。
AI.method: 提出 RedirectMimic：分离 actor 观测的参考与用于训练执行的目标。基于规则生成编辑后的参考，在 PPO 训练中以其引导跟踪奖励；部署阶段的观测与动作接口保持不变。在 Unitree G1 仿真中，基于 7,509 条动作片段预训练的 tracker，评估基于姿态与基于速度定义的手臂编辑任务，并与奖励置零（reward zeroing）和反跟踪（anti-tracking）两种基线对比。
AI.result: 过顶手臂任务中，core-window 内容出现率降至 2.7%（奖励置零 58.9%，反跟踪 32.8%）；core-window 关节成功率达 94.2%（兼顾内容抑制、无摔倒执行与局部保留）。速度定义任务中，三种局部编辑方法的快速外展手臂动作发生率均较低。两任务上 RedirectMimic 的替换误差最低，且对未编辑动作的跟踪精度与预训练控制器相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦"观测参考"与"训练目标"，RedirectMimic 可在保持部署接口不变的前提下有效抑制指定局部内容并给出明确替代动作，替换精度优于奖励置零与反跟踪，同时保持对未编辑动作的跟踪能力。

title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. To appear in TAAI 2026
summary: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images.
