Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的条件熵函数作为证据深度学习（EDL）中量化预测不确定性的基础，用于视网膜眼底图像的青光眼检测，在不确定性校准和可解释性上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法（Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准、基于Dempster不确定性的传统EDL）在青光眼检测中的校准误差较大，且与模型可解释性的一致性缺乏系统评估，因此需要更优的EDL不确定性正则化机制。
AI.method: 以条件熵函数作为EDL的正则化项，构建新的EDL框架；在EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2和RIM-ONE-DL两个数据集上验证；比较对象包括Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准与传统Dempster-EDL；并通过Grad-CAM热图与"聚焦指数"（focus index，反映空间集中度）分析可解释性。
AI.result: 所提EDL模型的不确定性估计校准误差显著低于各对比方法；EDL模型在正确/错误分类图像之间具有更大的聚焦指数分布区分度；假阴性样本的Grad-CAM激活局部化且偏离视盘，与青光眼评估中视盘的临床重要性相符。
AI.conclusion: 所提基于条件熵的EDL框架不仅改善了青光眼检测的不确定性校准，还具备更符合生理学一致性的可解释性。

title: Settling the Burn-in Gap: Sharp Risk Bounds for Tail-Averaged SGD in Linear Regression
summary: We study the excess risk of constant-stepsize online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with tail-averaging for high-dimensional linear regression. Building on the instance-dependent spectral framework of Zou et al. (2021), we establish matching initialization-explicit upper and lower bounds on the total excess risk of tail-averaged SGD in terms of the population covariance spectrum $\mathbf{H}$ and initialization $\mathbf{w}_0-\mathbf{w}^*$ whenever a trajectory spectral feedback condition holds. Existing analyses exhibit a fundamental gap in the effective variance: the upper bound of Zou et al. (2021) retains an undamped contribution from the initial error in the head eigenspace $\mathbf{I}_{0:k^\dagger}$, whereas their lower bound omits the variance induced by the head initialization altogether. We show that both the existing upper and lower bounds are loose: the single-hop fast-mode variance contribution from the head initialization is exponentially damped during the burn-in phase, whereas fourth-moment energy scattered from the head initialization into slow spectral modes during the early burn-in steps survives undamped into the averaging window. We prove that our spectral feedback condition is satisfied in two concrete constant-stepsize regimes: (i) for arbitrary covariance spectra $\mathbf{H}$ and any finite horizon, under an explicit horizon-dependent stepsize chosen prior to execution; and (ii) for polynomially decaying spectra $λ_i\asymp i^{-a}$ ($a>1$), under a single horizon-independent positive stepsize. Finally, we complement these positive results with explicit one- and two-dimensional separation constructions proving an exponential-versus-polynomial gap in the lower bound of Zou et al. (2021) and showing why fourth-moment assumptions alone cannot determine the asymptotic exponential decay rate without additional structural conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究常数步长在线SGD配合尾部平均在高维线性回归中的超额风险，给出初始化显式的匹配上界与下界，并指出Zou et al. (2021)上下界均不紧的原因，即在燃烧期头部初始化经四阶矩能量散射到慢模态后未被衰减地进入平均窗口。
AI.motivation: Zou et al. (2021) 的实例依赖谱分析存在根本性缺口：上界保留了头部特征空间 I_{0:k†} 中初始误差未被衰减的贡献，而下界完全忽略了头部初始化诱导的方差，导致有效方差项上下不匹配。作者希望给出真正匹配的初始化显式界，并厘清该谱反馈条件的可满足性。
AI.method: 基于Zou et al. (2021)的实例依赖谱框架，以总体协方差谱H与初始化w0-w*刻画尾部平均SGD的总超额风险，建立初值显式的匹配上、下界，前提是轨迹谱反馈条件成立；证明该条件在两类常数步长情形下满足：(i) 任意协方差谱与任意有限时域，采用执行前给定的时域依赖步长；(ii) 多项式衰减谱λ_i≍i^{-a}(a>1)，采用单一与时域无关的正步长；并构造一维与二维分离实例。
AI.result: 证明既有上界与下界均松：头部初始化的单跳快模态方差在燃烧期指数衰减，而早期燃烧步中由头部初始化散射至慢谱模态的四阶矩能量未被衰减地保留到平均窗口。分离构造证明了Zou et al. (2021)下界存在指数级与多项式级之间的差距，并说明仅凭四阶矩假设无法确定渐近指数衰减速率，需额外结构条件。
AI.conclusion: 尾部平均常数步长SGD的超额风险可由协方差谱与初始化精确刻画；正确的有效方差应来自四阶矩散射而非单跳快模态项。谱反馈条件在时域依赖步长及多项式衰减谱的时域无关步长下均成立，而指数衰减速率的确定需要超越四阶矩的结构性假设。

title: Veritas: A Verifier Generation Harness for Agent Tasks
summary: The effectiveness of a self-improving system relies heavily on the quality of its verifier, which judges the outcome of each improvement round. However, the verifiers of most tasks are written by hand, which is expensive and does not scale to tasks that come without one. We propose Veritas, a harness that generates verifiers automatically. Unlike general-purpose agent harnesses, Veritas adds three mechanisms for verifier generation: an evidence header stating what the verifier will observe, a library of domain rules that tasks leave unstated, and authoring principles, partly refined by a self-improvement loop. We evaluate on six benchmarks: four scored by execution, whose official verifiers we first certify, and two that compare pairs of responses. With the model fixed, the verifiers Veritas generates agree better with the official verdicts than those of seven other harnesses on all four execution-scored benchmarks. On the two pairwise benchmarks they are at or near the best. They also agree better than those of the vendor's own harness for two of three other model families. Its mechanisms also improve 9 of 12 harness-benchmark pairs scored by execution across three harnesses.

AI.tldr: Veritas 是一个自动生成验证器（verifier）的 harness，通过证据头、领域规则库与编写原则三项机制提升生成验证器与官方判定的一致性，在六个基准上优于七个对比 harness。
AI.motivation: 自改进系统的效果高度依赖验证器质量，但多数任务的验证器需人工编写，成本高且无法扩展到没有现成验证器的任务。
AI.method: 提出 Veritas，在通用 agent harness 基础上增加三项机制：声明验证器将观察什么的证据头（evidence header）、补充任务未明说的领域规则库、以及部分经由自改进循环迭代的编写原则（authoring principles）。
AI.result: 在六个基准上评测：四个按执行结果打分（官方验证器先经过认证），两个为成对回答比较。固定模型时，Veritas 生成的验证器在四个执行打分基准上均比七个对比 harness 更贴合官方判定；在两个成对基准上达到或接近最佳；在另外三个模型家族中，有两个优于厂商自带 harness。其机制在三个 harness 的 12 个执行打分 harness-基准组合中改善了 9 个。
AI.conclusion: 验证器可被自动化生成，且结构化机制（证据头、领域规则、编写原则）能稳定提升生成验证器与官方判定的一致性。

title: A human-in-the-loop Control Paradigm for Construction Robotics: From VR-Guided Teleoperation to Semi-Autonomous Dual-Arm Operation
summary: Construction tasks in hazardous and unstructured environments require both human adaptability and robotic precision, yet existing approaches often treat teleoperation and autonomy as separate control modes. This paper presents a human-in-the-loop control paradigm that enables structured transitions among VR-guided teleoperation, semi-autonomous shared control, and rule-based autonomous execution for contact-rich dual-arm construction tasks. The proposed system combines immersive VR guidance, a manually defined library of reusable skill primitives, and a shared-autonomy framework with explicit human-robot role allocation and command-priority rules. This integration allows operators to retain supervisory and corrective authority while delegating repetitive and precision-critical actions to the robot. The paradigm is validated on a dual-arm platform through representative facade-installation tasks. Results show that autonomous execution provides the best performance under well-calibrated nominal conditions, whereas semi-autonomous control improves resilience when environmental disturbances exceed the predefined autonomous pipeline's correction capability. Semi-autonomous control also substantially reduces subjective operator workload compared with full teleoperation. These findings demonstrate that effective construction-robot control should adapt human involvement to task and environmental uncertainty, using autonomy for repeatable operations and shared control for disturbance recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种人在回路控制范式，使VR遥操作、半自主共享控制与规则化自主执行之间可结构化切换，并在双臂幕墙安装任务上验证：标称条件下自主执行最优，扰动条件下半自主控制更具鲁棒性且显著降低操作员负荷。
AI.motivation: 危险、非结构化环境中的施工任务既需要人的适应能力又需要机器人精度，但现有方法通常将遥操作与自主控制视为彼此分离的控制模式，缺乏面向接触密集任务的结构化人机角色分配与模式转换机制。
AI.method: 构建人在回路控制框架，融合沉浸式VR引导、人工定义的可复用技能原语库，以及带显式人机角色分配与指令优先级规则的共享自主框架；在双臂机器人平台上以典型幕墙安装任务进行验证，对比全遥操作、半自主共享控制与规则化自主执行三种模式。
AI.result: 在良好标定的标称条件下，自主执行性能最佳；当环境扰动超出预定义自主流程的纠偏能力时，半自主控制提升韧性；与全遥操作相比，半自主控制大幅降低主观操作员工作负荷。
AI.conclusion: 有效的施工机器人控制应依据任务与环境不确定性自适应调整人的参与程度：重复性操作交由自主执行，扰动恢复依赖共享控制，从而兼顾效率、鲁棒性与操作负荷。

title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) lesions vary widely in shape, and microaneurysms (MAs) span only a few pixels. We hypothesize that modeling the spatial organization of lesion regions, with global context and shape-adaptive scanning, improves the segmentation of such small and irregular lesions. To test this, we propose D$^2$Mamba, which couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning. We evaluate it with five-fold cross-validation on the DDR dataset, comparing against representative segmentation baselines under an identical training protocol, and conduct ablations on each component. D$^2$Mamba achieved the best overall performance, with 33.87% mIoU, 2.99 percentage points above the strongest baseline. The largest gain appeared on MAs, the smallest and most easily missed lesions, where Dice improved by 10.06 percentage points. These results confirm our hypothesis that spatially adaptive state space modeling benefits tiny-lesion segmentation. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/PUREPANEL1/D2Mamba.

AI.tldr: 提出D²Mamba，将非因果状态空间对偶与可变形Mamba扫描耦合，建模病灶区域的空间组织，以提升糖尿病视网膜病变中小而不规则病灶的分割效果。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）病灶形状差异大，微动脉瘤（MAs）仅占几个像素，现有分割方法难以捕捉其空间组织，导致微小病灶易漏检。
AI.method: 提出D²Mamba，将非因果状态空间对偶（non-causal state space duality）与可变形Mamba扫描（deformable Mamba scanning）相结合，实现形状自适应扫描与全局上下文建模；在DDR数据集上采用五折交叉验证，与代表性分割基线在相同训练协议下对比，并对各组件进行消融实验。
AI.result: D²Mamba取得最佳整体性能，mIoU为33.87%，比最强基线高2.99个百分点；在最小、最易漏检的MAs上增益最大，Dice提升10.06个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了假设：空间自适应的状态空间建模有利于微小病灶分割。代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
summary: Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models. Diffusion models can amortize this computation offline, but largely data-driven conditional models underutilize known physics and suffer from ill-conditioned transport maps when the target distribution is concentrated. Plug-and-play (PnP) methods explicitly leverage the physical model to guide a learned prior, improving data consistency but reintroducing costly iterative computations. We instead propose AdjointFlow, a framework built on stochastic interpolants that injects the known physics into the generative transport itself. We design a data-dependent, adjoint-based initialization to reduce transport distance to the target, modify the transport velocity to remain regular as the endpoint distributions concentrate, and parameterize the network to build the initialization directly into the learned velocity. Together, these enable accurate reconstruction at substantially lower cost than generative models starting from Gaussian noise. Experiments on inverse scattering, seismic imaging, and black hole imaging show that AdjointFlow consistently produces more accurate reconstructions than conditional diffusion models while being up to five orders of magnitude faster at inference than PnP methods. Optional inference-time refinement that queries the physical model can further improve data consistency, matching or exceeding the accuracy of PnP methods without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdjointFlow：基于随机插值（stochastic interpolants）将已知物理模型注入生成式传输过程，用伴随（adjoint）信息构造数据相关的初始化并修正传输速度，实现对逆问题的高精度、低开销求解。
AI.motivation: 逆问题（地震成像、天体物理、无损检测等）普遍存在非凸性与昂贵正演模型反复求解的问题。纯数据驱动的条件扩散模型虽可离线摊销计算，但未充分利用已知物理、且在目标分布集中时传输映射病态；PnP 方法利用物理模型提升数据一致性，却重新引入昂贵的迭代计算。因此需要兼顾物理约束与推理效率的生成式框架。
AI.method: （1）基于 stochastic interpolants 构建生成传输，将物理模型直接注入传输过程；（2）设计数据相关、基于伴随的初始化，缩短到目标分布的传输距离；（3）修改传输速度场，使其在端点分布趋于集中时仍保持正则性；（4）网络参数化将初始化直接内嵌于学习到的速度场；（5）可选推理期精化，通过查询物理模型进一步提升数据一致性且无需重训练。
AI.result: 在逆散射、地震成像与黑洞成像实验中，AdjointFlow 的重建精度稳定优于条件扩散模型，同时推理速度比 PnP 方法快最多五个数量级；可选的推理期精化可进一步提升数据一致性，在不重训练的情况下达到或超过 PnP 方法的精度。
AI.conclusion: 将物理模型（伴随信息）嵌入生成式传输的初始化与速度场设计，可在显著降低推理成本的同时提升逆问题重建精度，并可通过推理期物理模型查询灵活权衡一致性与速度，为物理驱动与生成式方法融合提供了有效范式。

title: Multi-Stage Phase-Aware Self-Supervised Reconstruction for Multi-Echo Gradient-Echo MRI
comment: Submit to a journal; under review
summary: Purpose: To develop a phase-aware self-supervised framework for accelerated high-resolution multi-echo gradient-echo (mGRE) MRI that preserves anatomical detail and complex echo information for quantitative mapping. Methods: We developed multi-stage phase-aware self-supervised reconstruction (MSPR-GRE), integrating progressive k-space expansion with phase estimation and refinement. Sequential unrolled networks reconstruct complex multi-echo images and update echo-dependent phase priors. A relaxation-informed temporal subspace is used for acquisitions with at least four echoes, while shorter echo trains are reconstructed in the image domain. Training uses held-out acquired k-space samples without fully sampled targets. Evaluation included 9.4 T ex vivo mouse-brain data 30um eight-echo and 18um dual-echo) and retrospectively undersampled 7 T AHEAD human-brain data, with supervised ablations. Results:MSPR-GRE reduced artifacts in regions of rapid phase variation and preserved fine mouse-brain anatomy. Across five AHEAD test datasets at R = 4, 8, and 12, it generally improved magnitude-image, T2* map, and QSM metrics, particularly at higher acceleration. At R = 12, fourth-echo magnitude NRMSE was 12.09$\pm$0.60% versus 21.55$\pm$1.12% for SSDU. Ablations indicated benefits of phase refinement, while supervised experiments supported multi-stage phase-aware reconstruction. Conclusion: MSPR-GRE improves accelerated mGRE reconstruction and quantitative-map agreement without fully sampled training targets. Further validation of generalizability and phase-estimation accuracy is needed.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段相位感知自监督重建框架MSPR-GRE，在无全采样训练标签下实现加速高分辨mGRE成像，R=12时第四回波幅度NRMSE降至12.09%±0.60%（SSDU为21.55%±1.12%）。
AI.motivation: 加速高分辨率多回波梯度回波（mGRE）MRI需在保留解剖细节与复回波信息的前提下获得可靠定量映射，而现有方法在相位快速变化区域易产生伪影，且通常依赖全采样参考数据作为监督。
AI.method: 提出MSPR-GRE：结合渐进式k空间扩展与相位估计/精修的相位感知自监督重建；采用顺序展开网络重建复数多回波图像并更新回波相关相位先验；≥4回波时引入弛豫信息引导的时间子空间，短回波链则在图像域重建；仅用留出的已采集k空间样本训练。评估含9.4T离体鼠脑30μm八回波与18μm双回波数据，以及回顾性欠采样7T AHEAD人脑数据，并做监督消融。
AI.result: MSPR-GRE减轻了相位快速变化区域的伪影并保留鼠脑细微解剖结构；在五组AHEAD测试集R=4/8/12下总体改善幅度图、T2*图与QSM指标，高加速时优势更明显；R=12时第四回波幅度NRMSE为12.09±0.60%，优于SSDU的21.55±1.12%；消融显示相位精修有益，监督实验支持多阶段相位感知设计。
AI.conclusion: MSPR-GRE在无全采样训练目标条件下改进了加速mGRE重建与定量图一致性；相位估计准确性与泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: DexSeed: Expanding Human Hand-Object Interactions into Robot Demonstrations for Dexterous Policy Learning
summary: We study how to generate diverse, physically executable robot demonstrations for dexterous vision-language-action (VLA) learning. Existing demonstration-generation methods typically rely on costly teleoperated examples. Meanwhile, human hand--object datasets provide a reusable source, but existing transfer methods mainly reproduce given interactions. Turning these interactions into VLA training data further requires coverage of different objects and manipulation locations, together with executable arm and finger actions, and visual observations. To achieve this, we present DexSeed, a framework for low-cost generation of dexterous robot data from human hand--object interactions. Our key idea is to expand human sequences while preserving their grasps and realizing the resulting motions under arm-tracking dynamics in physics simulation. Specifically, we organize source sequences by grasp mode with shared language descriptions. InteractionMesh-based retargeting and arm trajectory augmentation adapt these sequences to the robot hand, different object geometries, and pick-and-place locations while preserving local hand--object relationships. An RL finger-control policy produces executable rollouts, while the arm tracks precomputed trajectories. Rendered observations and recorded actions from successful rollouts are paired with grasp descriptions to fine-tune a VLA. Experiments show improved contact fidelity in retargeting and more reliable whole-arm execution than the evaluated baselines. Simulation evaluation and real-world deployment further demonstrate that a VLA fine-tuned solely on the generated demonstrations can execute language-specified grasps. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/.

AI.tldr: DexSeed 是一个从人手-物体交互数据低成本生成灵巧机器人演示的框架，通过保持抓取关系、扩展物体几何与操作位置、并用 RL 手指控制策略生成可执行轨迹，为 VLA 微调提供多样化训练数据。
AI.motivation: 现有灵巧操作演示生成方法依赖昂贵的遥操作数据；人手-物体数据集虽可复用，但现有迁移方法主要复现给定交互，难以覆盖不同物体与操作位置，且缺乏可执行的臂-指动作与视觉观测，无法直接作为 VLA 训练数据。
AI.method: 按抓取模式组织源序列并共享语言描述；采用基于 InteractionMesh 的重定向与手臂轨迹增强，使序列适配机器人手、不同物体几何及抓放位置，同时保持局部手-物关系；由 RL 手指控制策略生成可执行 rollout，手臂跟踪预计算轨迹；将成功 rollout 的渲染观测与记录动作同抓取描述配对，用于微调 VLA。
AI.result: 实验表明重定向的接触保真度提升，整臂执行比对比基线更可靠；仿真评估与真机部署显示，仅用生成演示微调的 VLA 能执行语言指定的抓取。
AI.conclusion: 以人手-物体交互为可复用来源、结合保持抓取关系的重定向与物理仿真中的强化学习控制，可低成本生成多样、可执行的灵巧机器人演示，并足以支撑 VLA 的语言条件抓取能力。

title: UniWeaver: Harnessing Unified Multimodal Models for Interleaved Text-Image Generation
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have opened up new possibilities for generating rich interleaved text-image content. However, they generally lack native support for coordinating the two modalities, and translating coarse user requests into coherent multimodal compositions also requires explicit planning. We propose UniWeaver, a structured, model-agnostic harness framework that integrates multimodal planning, generation, and visual feedback to produce coherent interleaved outputs. To train UMMs for this task, we construct UniWeaver-10K, a dataset of 10,000 tasks across 20 task families, paired with execution trajectories guided by UniWeaver. We also introduce UniWeaver-Bench, a task-oriented benchmark systematically assessing text coverage, writing quality, visual coverage, and image-text alignment. Experiments show that UniWeaver achieves state-of-the-art performance and improves interleaved text-image generation across multiple UMM backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出模型无关的结构化框架UniWeaver，通过多模态规划、生成与视觉反馈协同，实现连贯的图文交错输出，并配套构建UniWeaver-10K训练集与UniWeaver-Bench评测集，在多个UMM骨干上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽能生成丰富的图文交错内容，但缺乏对文本与图像两种模态的原生协同支持；将粗粒度用户请求转化为连贯的多模态组合仍需显式规划。因此需要一个显式的规划-生成-反馈机制来弥补这一能力缺口。
AI.method: 提出UniWeaver：一个结构化、与模型无关的harness框架，整合多模态规划、生成与视觉反馈三个环节以产出连贯交错输出。为训练UMM执行该任务，构建UniWeaver-10K数据集（20个任务族、共10,000个任务），并提供由UniWeaver引导的执行轨迹。同时构建UniWeaver-Bench任务导向基准，从文本覆盖度、写作质量、视觉覆盖度、图文对齐四个维度进行系统评估。
AI.result: 实验表明UniWeaver达到state-of-the-art性能，并在多个UMM骨干模型上一致提升图文交错生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式的多模态规划与视觉反馈闭环可有效增强现有UMM的交错图文生成能力，且框架与具体模型解耦、具备良好通用性与可迁移性；配套数据与基准为后续研究提供了标准化支撑。

title: Free Lunch Uncertainty: Sequence-Level Rényi Entropy from Particle Decoding for Adaptive LLM Reasoning
summary: Quantifying uncertainty over an entire LLM completion is critical for selective prediction and adaptive compute. Zero-cost signals such as mean token entropy and log-probability are local to tokens or to one completion, and self-consistency needs many extra completions. We show that Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding for power sampling already estimates the normalizing constant of the power distribution, which gives the sequence-level R'enyi entropy (SRE) of the model's completion distribution at zero marginal cost, with a guarantee at every particle budget. A R'enyi chain rule extends this readout to a family of stepwise entropies of any order. We prove that orders above one are tied to the most likely token of each step, which explains why they track log-probability, while the order-1/2 member accumulates the log of per-step search effort. This member is the best zero-cost selective-prediction signal in 10 of 13 settings. On MATH500 its AUROC is 0.022 to 0.044 above log-probability with all four models and within length quartiles, and the same order is selected when each setting is held out. An 8-particle probe identifies the problems that benefit from more particles, and a two-pass policy matches 64-particle accuracy on MATH500 with 34.2% fewer particles over three seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出利用SMC幂采样解码中已有的归一化常数估计，零边际成本地读出序列级R\'enyi熵（SRE），并证明1/2阶SRE累积逐步搜索努力的对数，是最优的零成本选择性预测信号。
AI.motivation: 对整个LLM补全序列做不确定性量化对选择性预测和自适应计算至关重要，但现有零成本信号（平均token熵、对数概率）只反映局部token或单一补全层面，而自一致性需要大量额外采样。
AI.method: 指出用于幂采样的SMC解码本身已估计幂分布的归一化常数，可在任意粒子预算下（有保证地）零成本得到补全分布的序列级R\'enyi熵；通过R\'enyi链式法则扩展出任意阶的逐步熵族；理论分析表明阶数大于1时熵与每步最可能token绑定（故追踪对数概率），而1/2阶累积每步搜索努力的对数。
AI.result: 1/2阶成员在13个设定中的10个里成为最佳零成本选择性预测信号；在MATH500上，四种模型及长度四分位内其AUROC比对数概率高0.022–0.044，且逐个留出设定时仍选中该阶数；8粒子探针可识别受益于更多粒子的题目，两遍策略在三个随机种子下以少34.2%的粒子数达到与64粒子相当的MATH500准确率。
AI.conclusion: SMC解码的归一化常数可免费提供序列级熵信号，其中1/2阶SRE兼具理论可解释性与实证优越性，并能指导自适应粒子预算分配。

title: A Technique to Model Product Information and User Reviews (MPIUR)
summary: Modern e-commerce platforms naturally provide three complementary modalities: textual item descriptions, item images, and user reviews. However, existing multimodal recommendation methods often omit reviews or do not integrate all three modalities within a unified framework. In this paper, we propose MPIUR, a multimodal graph-based recommendation model that encodes reviews in heterogeneous graphs, aligns image and text representations, and adapts collaborative--semantic alignment to item interaction density. Experiments on the Amazon Reviews 2023 Musical Instruments and Baby categories show that MPIUR achieves the best global nDCG@10 and Recall@10 among the evaluated methods on both datasets. It also obtains the best nDCG@10 and Recall@10 on sparse items, indicating that jointly exploiting reviews and multimodal item content is particularly useful when interaction histories are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出 MPIUR，一个统一融合文本描述、商品图像与用户评论三种模态的图推荐模型，在 Amazon Reviews 2023 两个类目上取得最佳 nDCG@10 与 Recall@10，且在稀疏交互物品上优势明显。
AI.motivation: 电商平台同时具备文本描述、商品图像和用户评论三种互补模态，但现有多模态推荐方法常忽略评论，或未在统一框架内整合三者。
AI.method: 基于多模态异构图编码评论信息，对图像与文本表示进行对齐，并根据物品交互密度自适应调整协同—语义对齐的强度。
AI.result: 在 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 Musical Instruments 与 Baby 两个类目上，所评估方法中全局 nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 最优；在稀疏交互物品上同样取得最佳 nDCG@10 与 Recall@10。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用用户评论与多模态商品内容在交互历史有限时尤为有效，验证了三模态统一建模的价值；但摘要未给出具体提升幅度与基线清单。

title: Model-Free Runtime Measurement of Task-Relevant Information
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 2 extended data tables, appendix included. Code available
summary: Autonomous systems increasingly monitor physical kinematics, environmental states and task completion outcomes. While existing work provides methods to plan information seeking actions and interpret acquired observations, current approaches do not monitor whether the live process of information gathering is functioning properly. Consequently, such systems can remain operationally active without resolving outstanding mission requirements. To address this limitation, we introduce Acquisition-State Telemetry (AST), a model free architecture that evaluates ongoing information acquisition from observable evidence relative to declared task requirements. Specifically, a domain interface maps raw observations into task resolution coordinates and normalized comparative representations, which are processed by a fixed causal monitor. This monitor emits two continuous real time signals that quantify (i) prospective progress across unresolved requirements and (ii) informational friction generated when recurrent evidence yields negligible informational gain. We evaluated a single, unadjusted monitor configuration across eight diverse domains including search and rescue dialogue, spatial grid exploration, hierarchical capability acquisition, continuous robotic manipulation, and probabilistic intent estimation. We show that across these domains the friction channel distinguished unproductive stagnation from purposeful exploration prior to task completion, while remaining muted during post completion activity. Furthermore, in closed loop reinforcement learning experiments under early termination constraints, we demonstrate that penalizing informational friction allowed agents to sustain high mission success, whereas unpenalized policies and baselines with matched operational costs failed to complete required tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Acquisition-State Telemetry（AST），一种无模型架构，通过域接口将原始观测映射为任务求解坐标与归一化比较表示，由固定因果监视器输出"预期进展"与"信息摩擦"两路连续实时信号，用于判断信息获取过程本身是否正常运作。
AI.motivation: 现有工作虽能规划信息寻求动作并解释观测结果，但缺乏对"信息获取过程本身是否正常运转"的监测，导致系统可能在未解决任务需求的情况下持续空转运行。
AI.method: AST 为 model-free 架构：域接口把原始观测映射为任务求解坐标和归一化比较表示，交由一个固定的因果监视器处理，输出两路连续实时信号——(i) 未解决需求上的前瞻性进展，(ii) 反复证据带来可忽略信息增益时产生的信息摩擦。整套单一、未调参的监视器配置跨八个领域评估。
AI.result: 在搜救对话、空间网格探索、分层能力获取、连续机器人操作、概率意图估计等八个领域中，摩擦通道能在任务完成前区分无产出停滞与有目的探索，且在任务完成后的活动中保持静默；在早停约束下的闭环强化学习实验中，对信息摩擦施加惩罚可使智能体维持高任务成功率，而未惩罚策略及操作成本匹配的基线均未能完成所需任务。
AI.conclusion: 以信息摩擦作为可监测、可惩罚的实时信号，可作为跨领域通用的任务停滞诊断与学习驱动信号，弥补现有方法只关注"如何获取信息"而不监测"信息获取是否有效"的空白。

title: AgenticConflictLens: From Long Traffic Videos to Verifiable Conflict Evidence
summary: Traffic cameras continuously record urban road-user behavior, providing proactive safety evidence beyond crash reports. Yet safety-critical events - conflicts, near misses, unsafe turns, sudden braking, and crosswalk interactions - are rare and brief, buried in hours of routine footage. Existing traffic-video pipelines extract detections, trajectories, and risk scores but process footage uniformly, without adapting to an analyst's query. Vision-language methods improve scene understanding but often lack traffic-specific verification of participant-level conflicts. We introduce AgenticConflictLens, an agentic, query-conditioned framework for efficient, auditable conflict extraction from long fixed-camera traffic videos. Given a natural-language safety query, a Traffic-Aware Controller combines structured traffic memory with specialized conflict-analysis tools to choose where to search, which road users to examine, and which evidence to verify or reject. A coarse-to-fine search retrieves candidate intervals and applies detailed verification selectively. The framework produces conflict records with refined time intervals, participant pairs, semantic regions, trajectories, motion evidence, uncertainty, rejection reasons, and supporting clips. On 96 annotated hours from Bellevue and NYC DOT, AgenticConflictLens achieves the highest conflict-existence F1 and temporal IoU on both datasets: 0.84 F1/0.77 tIoU on Bellevue and 0.80 F1/0.73 tIoU on NYC DOT, while inspecting only 8.7% and 11.9% of video, respectively. These results support scalable, evidence-grounded urban traffic-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticConflictLens——一种由自然语言安全查询驱动的智能体式框架，从长时固定摄像头交通视频中高效、可审计地抽取冲突事件，仅检视约9%–12%的视频即在两个数据集上取得最优冲突检测F1与时序IoU。
AI.motivation: 交通摄像头持续记录城市道路使用者行为，可提供事故报告之外的主动安全证据；但冲突、近失、不安全转弯、急刹、人行横道交互等安全关键事件稀少且短暂，淹没于数小时常规录像中。现有交通视频流水线虽可提取检测、轨迹与风险分数，却对视频均匀处理、无法随分析员查询自适应；视觉语言方法提升场景理解，但缺乏交通特定的参与者级冲突验证。
AI.method: 提出AgenticConflictLens：给定自然语言安全查询，Traffic-Aware Controller将结构化交通记忆与专用冲突分析工具相结合，决定搜索位置、检查哪些道路参与者、以及验证或拒绝哪些证据；采用由粗到细的搜索，先检索候选时间段，再选择性执行细粒度验证；输出含精确时间区间、参与者对、语义区域、轨迹、运动证据、不确定性、拒绝理由与支撑片段的冲突记录。
AI.result: 在Bellevue与NYC DOT共96小时标注视频上，冲突存在性F1与时序IoU均为最高：Bellevue达0.84 F1 / 0.77 tIoU，NYC DOT达0.80 F1 / 0.73 tIoU，同时仅检视8.7%与11.9%的视频。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该查询条件化、可审计的智能体式冲突抽取框架支持可扩展、证据可溯的城市交通安全分析。

title: You Don't Need Feature Learning to Do In-Context Learning
summary:
How should we understand memorization vs. generalization in in-context learning (ICL) tasks, and when does one happen vs. the other? To investigate, we study how rotation-invariant kernel machines learn the ICL linear regression task proposed by Raventos et al. (2023). By decomposing the task in the kernel eigenbasis, we obtain a spectral picture of learning in this ICL setting. This picture reveals that as sample size grows, kernel machines learn successively-higher-degree components of the memorizing solution, which depend upon successively-higher-degree statistics of the training task set. The generalizing solution is approximately a low-degree truncation of the memorizing solution, and so the model first generalizes, then degrades into memorization as training proceeds.
  The takeaways are threefold. First, if this case is indicative, learning a "generalizing" solution on an ICL task is really just underfitting the memorizing solution! Second, the fact that kernel machines can generalize on this task means that feature learning is inessential to ICL. Third, transformers empirically trained to do ICL are shown to memorize tasks through the higher-order statistics of the training tasks that the kernel-based theory predicts, suggesting it applies even to models capable of feature learning.

AI.tldr: 该文用旋转不变核机器在核特征基下对ICL线性回归任务做谱分解，揭示随着训练推进模型先泛化、后退化为记忆：泛化解只是记忆解的低阶截断。
AI.motivation: ICL中"记忆"与"泛化"的界定与发生条件尚不清晰，作者希望给出可解析的机制性刻画，并检验特征学习是否为ICL的必要条件。
AI.method: 研究旋转不变核机器学习Raventos等(2023)提出的ICL线性回归任务；在核特征基中将任务分解，得到该ICL设定下的谱学习图像，并与transformer实证结果对照。
AI.result: 随样本量增大，核机器依次学习记忆解中越来越高阶的分量，这些分量依赖训练任务集越来越高阶的统计量；泛化解近似为记忆解的低阶截断，故模型先泛化、随训练推进退化为记忆。transformer经验上通过核理论所预测的高阶统计量记忆任务。
AI.conclusion: 三点结论：ICL上的"泛化"解本质上是对记忆解的不充分拟合(欠拟合)；核机器能在该任务上泛化说明特征学习对ICL并非必需；核理论的预测在高阶统计量层面同样适用于具备特征学习能力的transformer。

title: No finite rulebook can certify every safe program: an impossibility theorem for gatekeeping AI agents
summary: An AI assistant writes small programs, and a gatekeeper must decide, from the code alone, whether each one may run. Suppose the rules are fixed: never perform a forbidden action, never let the output depend on a secret, always answer eventually. Can two rulebooks, one listing what is allowed and one listing what is not, both be complete, if every rule must be backed by evidence that a machine can check in finite time? We prove that they cannot. Checkable evidence can only establish what a finite record settles, and ``never'' and ``eventually'' are never settled by a finite record. For prohibitions the failure is one-sided: every violation can be caught by watching, but no safe program can be cleared for good. For confidentiality and responsiveness, neither side can be. We characterise exactly which rules about visible behaviour evidence can confirm, and we show that any sound rulebook of $n$ bits omits a compliant program of about $n$ bits. A time limit makes everything checkable, but only by running the program for essentially the whole limit, so a finite machine is not a feasible one. Finally, we show what a gatekeeper can still guarantee: not a verdict on every program, but a checkable list that contains everything it must allow and nothing it must refuse. Simulations on 2.2 million random programs and on self-referential adversaries show that the obstruction is adversarial rather than typical, and that the one error a longer test never removes is the liveness part of confidentiality.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：在仅凭有限时间可检验证据的前提下，同时完备的"白名单"（列出允许行为）与"黑名单"（列出禁止行为）规则书不可能存在。原因是"永不"和"最终"这类全称/活性性质无法由有限记录判定，因此对禁止类规则只能单侧捕获（能发现违规但无法永久放行安全程序），对保密性与响应性则两侧都无法判定。作者刻画了证据可确认的可见行为规则范围，证明n比特的可靠规则书必然遗漏约n比特的合规程序，并给出门卫仍可保证的松弛目标——一个包含所有必须放行程序、不含必须拒绝程序的可检验清单。
AI.motivation: AI助手生成小程序、门卫仅凭代码决定是否放行，是现实部署中的核心安全环节。理想规则（不执行禁止动作、输出不依赖秘密、总能给出答案）要求对"永不"和"最终"性质做判定，而门卫只能依赖机器在有限时间内可检验的证据。论文旨在探究这种"证据受限"的判定在原理上能走多远：完备的双向规则书是否存在，以及若不存在，其失效边界与可补救的替代保证是什么。
AI.method: 将规则书形式化为白名单（允许集合）与黑名单（禁止集合）两种完备性目标；把"规则须由有限时间可机器检验的证据支撑"作为唯一可用的判定资源，从可计算性与可判定性角度分析有限记录所能确定的行为性质。对禁止、保密性、响应性三类规则分别做单侧/双侧可判定性分析；对可见行为规则给出可确认性的精确刻画；构造基于对角化/自指的反例（自指对手）论证遗漏程序的信息量下界；并讨论引入时间上限后"可检验性"与"可行性"的分离。
AI.result: 1) 双向完备且证据可检验的规则书不存在；2) 禁止类规则单侧失败：任何违规都能被观测捕获，但安全程序无法被永久清白放行；3) 保密性与响应性两类规则双侧均不可判定；4) 给出证据可确认的可见行为规则的精确刻画；5) 任何n比特的可靠规则书都会遗漏约n比特的合规程序（遗漏量与规则书规模同阶）；6) 加入时间上限可使一切可检验，但需几乎跑满整个时限，故"有限机器"不等于"可行机器"；7) 门卫可退而保证一个可检验清单：包含所有必须放行的程序且不含必须拒绝的程序；8) 220万随机程序及自指对手的模拟显示，该障碍是对抗性而非普遍性的，且更长的测试无法消除的单一误差是保密性中的活性（liveness）部分。
AI.conclusion: 在有限证据约束下，"完全可检验的安全门卫"不可实现：全称否定（永不）与活性（最终）性质本质上是有限记录无法封闭的。实践含义是应放弃"对每个程序给出判决"的目标，转向可检验的松弛保证——一个只含必须放行项、排除必须拒绝项的白名单式清单，并明确其遗漏风险；同时应认识到延长测试时间只能把误差推向保密性中的活性部分，而不能根除。

title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
summary: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence. These advances make agentic robotics a promising path toward artificial general intelligence in robotics. However, we find that using foundation models to control robots poses serious safety risks, and comprehensive safety evaluation is still lacking. We introduce RoboRisk, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating safety in agentic robotics. Its 92 simulated tasks and 13 physical-robot tasks fall into five categories: Task-level Refusal (T), Plan Repair (P), Execution-time Hazard (E), Injection (I), and Sequential Memory (S). Prior benchmarks cover at most two of these categories, and several evaluate only text outputs. In contrast, RoboRisk covers all five and executes every task in closed loop. We evaluate six state-of-the-art foundation models on RoboRisk: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, and Grok 4.7. These models generally show high harm rates. We also evaluate two robot-specific APIs: the Dream API and PokeBot's RoboAPI. We further propose the Lease-Enforced Agentic Safety Harness (LEASH), which offers essential safety infrastructure for agentic robotics and can be integrated into nearly any agentic architecture. LEASH leverages a decision model (Jev or OpenAI's Decisions API) to implement task, action, and commit gates, which review the task, each action, and each irreversible operation in their visual context. The planner and all three gates share a common safety policy. Experiments on RoboRisk in simulation and on physical robots show that LEASH effectively reduces harm across all six foundation models. It largely preserves their task completion performance and adds little time and token overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboRisk 基准，覆盖五类安全场景并闭环执行，揭示六种主流基础模型在机器人智能体任务中伤害率高；并提出 LEASH 三层安全门（任务/动作/提交），共享安全策略，显著降低伤害且基本不损失完成率、开销小。
AI.motivation: 基础模型（GPT、Claude 等）在空间理解与具身智能上能力增强，使 agentic robotics 成为通向机器人通用智能的可行路径；但用基础模型直接控制机器人存在严重安全风险，而现有安全评测最多覆盖五类风险中的两类，且部分仅评估文本输出、缺乏闭环验证，因此缺少全面、可闭环的安全评测。
AI.method: 构建 RoboRisk 基准：92 个仿真任务 + 13 个物理机器人任务，分为 Task-level Refusal、Plan Repair、Execution-time Hazard、Injection、Sequential Memory 五类，所有任务均在闭环中执行。在此基准上评测六个前沿基础模型（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5.5、Gemini 4 Argon、Grok 4.7）及两个机器人专用 API（Dream API、PokeBot RoboAPI）。同时提出 Lease-Enforced Agentic Safety Harness（LEASH）：利用决策模型（Jev 或 OpenAI Decisions API）实现任务门、动作门、提交门，分别在其视觉上下文中审查任务、每个动作与每个不可逆操作，规划器与三道门共享同一安全策略，可嵌入几乎任何智能体架构。
AI.result: 所评测的基础模型普遍表现出高伤害率（harm rate）；在 RoboRisk 的仿真与真实机器人实验中，LEASH 对全部六个基础模型均有效降低伤害，同时基本保持任务完成性能，仅引入很小的时间与 token 开销。
AI.conclusion: agentic robotics 的安全问题真实且被现有评测严重低估；RoboRisk 提供了覆盖五类风险、闭环执行的统一评测平台；LEASH 作为一种通用、可插拔的运行时安全基础设施，能在不显著牺牲能力的情况下提升机器人智能体安全性。

title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
summary: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense. However, existing benchmarks rely on annotators who rate each video with a single score based on intuition, yielding ratings that are subjective and do not tell which physical principle is violated. We introduce PhyRubric, a rubric-grounded diagnostic framework for evaluating physical commonsense in T2V generation. For each caption, PhyRubric constructs a caption-specific rubric before any video is seen, decomposing the caption into semantic and physical items, and derives scores from item-level verdicts grounded in timestamped evidence. We instantiate this framework as PhyRubric-Bench, which spans 34 categories across five physical domains, and scale it up to PhyRubric-Train with 3,788 videos, on which we fine-tune the open-source PhyRubric-Judge. Empirical results across ten T2V models show that physical commonsense remains far from solved, and that PhyRubric-Judge correlates more closely with human judgments than existing open-source judges while matching the frontier proprietary Gemini 4 Argon. Further analysis provides actionable insights for T2V models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于评分量表（rubric）的诊断式框架 PhyRubric，用于评测文本到视频（T2V）模型生成内容的物理常识合规性，并构建基准 PhyRubric-Bench、训练集 PhyRubric-Train 与开源评判模型 PhyRubric-Judge。
AI.motivation: T2V 模型日益被定位为"世界模拟器"，因此需评估其视频是否遵循物理常识。现有基准依赖标注者对每个视频凭直觉打单一总分，评分主观，且无法指出具体违反了哪条物理原理，缺乏可解释性与诊断价值。
AI.method: 提出 PhyRubric 框架：在观看任何视频之前，针对每条 caption 构建专属 rubric，将 caption 分解为语义项与物理项；评分由基于时间戳证据的条目级判定（item-level verdict）推导得出。实例化为覆盖五大物理域、34 个类别的 PhyRubric-Bench，并扩展为含 3,788 个视频的 PhyRubric-Train，用于微调开源评判模型 PhyRubric-Judge。
AI.result: 在十个 T2V 模型上的实验表明物理常识仍远未解决；PhyRubric-Judge 与人类判断的相关性优于现有开源评判模型，并与前沿闭源模型 Gemini 4 Argon 持平。进一步分析为 T2V 模型改进提供了可操作的洞见。
AI.conclusion: 以 rubric 为锚、条目级证据驱动的评测方式，可替代主观单分数打分，提供可解释、可诊断的物理常识评测，并能训练出与人类判断高度一致的开源评判模型；当前 T2V 模型在物理常识方面仍有显著差距。

title: Fermat ProbCover: Coverage-Based Active Learning on Fermat Distance Graphs
summary: Active learning aims to reduce annotation cost by selecting the most informative examples for labeling. In the low-budget regime, where uncertainty-based methods often fail, coverage-based active learning methods such as ProbCover have been shown to be effective. However, these methods typically rely on Euclidean distance, which may not adequately capture the underlying geometry of data. In this article, we propose PC-Fermat, a coverage-based active learning method that replaces Euclidean coverage neighborhoods with neighborhoods defined by a Fermat distance, i.e., a data-adaptive distance that reflects the underlying distribution of the data points. To facilitate computation, we construct a weighted Euclidean neighborhood graph and use a truncated shortest-path algorithm to compute the Fermat coverage graph. We also establish sufficient conditions under which this construction exactly preserves the Fermat coverage computed on the complete graph. Finally, we evaluate PC-Fermat on eight classification datasets across varying labeling budgets, with particular emphasis on the very low-budget regime. Our experimental results demonstrate that PC-Fermat outperforms several existing active learning methods on the majority of the datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-Fermat：用数据自适应的Fermat距离替代欧氏距离定义覆盖邻域，构建加权欧氏近邻图并截断最短路计算Fermat覆盖图，在8个分类数据集上多数优于现有主动学习方法，尤其低预算情形。
AI.motivation: 低预算下基于不确定性的主动学习方法往往失效，基于覆盖的方法（如ProbCover）更有效；但这类方法依赖欧氏距离，难以刻画数据的潜在几何结构/分布。
AI.method: 将ProbCover的欧氏覆盖邻域替换为由Fermat距离（反映数据分布的数据自适应距离）定义的邻域；为便于计算，构建加权欧氏近邻图，用截断最短路算法计算Fermat覆盖图；并给出使该构造与完全图上Fermat覆盖计算结果一致的充分条件。
AI.result: 在8个分类数据集、多种标注预算（重点关注极低预算）下评测，PC-Fermat在多数数据集上优于若干现有主动学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 以Fermat距离定义覆盖邻域可在保持计算可行的前提下更好捕捉数据几何，是低预算主动学习的有效方案。

title: Online-Adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps for Neuro-symbolic Financial Forecasting
summary: We present a neuro-symbolic framework that pairs online-adaptive Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) with long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for financial forecasting. Financial markets exhibit regime shifts and nonlinear dynamics. Existing models often trade off one of these key properties: these models capture temporal patterns but hide causal drivers, or they recover causal graphs that cannot adapt post-training. We close this gap with two frameworks. Framework I constructs an FCM from live dual-source price series and macroeconomic indicators, and adapts its edges online through an error-driven Hebbian rule. We introduce the Asymmetric Additive Residual Fusion method to seamlessly combine the FCM and LSTM predictions under Framework I. Framework II constructs a literature-grounded, LLM-augmented FCM where every edge carries a verifiable citation that gives an auditable map of factor interactions. On NASDAQ Composite data, Framework I matched the performance of the LSTM baseline on state-directional accuracy and outperformed LSTM by 7.6 percentage points on the return-sign accuracy. Framework I outperformed standalone FCM models across both evaluation metrics. The adaptive maps converged to new regimes within 10-15 trading days, and Framework II center-node FCMs scored 68.9% to 85.7% on the state-directional accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出将在线自适应模糊认知图(FCM)与LSTM配对的神经符号框架用于金融预测，含双框架与一种新的残差融合方法。
AI.motivation: 金融市场存在状态转换与非线性动态。现有模型难以兼顾二者：一类能捕捉时序模式但缺乏可解释的因果驱动，另一类可恢复因果图但训练后无法自适应。
AI.method: 两个框架。框架I：由双源实时价格序列与宏观指标构建FCM，并用误差驱动的Hebbian规则在线更新边权重；提出非对称加性残差融合(Asymmetric Additive Residual Fusion)将FCM与LSTM预测结合。框架II：构建文献支撑、LLM增强的FCM，每条边带有可核验的引用，形成可审计的因子交互图。
AI.result: 在NASDAQ综合指数上，框架I状态方向准确率与LSTM基线持平，收益符号准确率高出7.6个百分点；两项指标均优于独立FCM模型。自适应图在10–15个交易日内收敛至新状态。框架II的中心节点FCM状态方向准确率达68.9%–85.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该神经符号框架兼顾时序建模能力与可解释、可在线适应的因果结构，并可通过文献引证实现可审计性。

title: Koopman Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose a Koopman model-based reinforcement learning (K-MBRL) algorithm for controlling nonlinear robotic systems with unknown dynamics. The K-MBRL learns a control policy by minimizing an approximate policy objective that combines the analytical immediate cost with an estimate of the future cost evaluated at the one-step predicted state. To this end, we develop a stochastic Koopman operator-based learning method to approximate the unknown nonlinear dynamics in a linear representation, while a critic function estimates the remaining future cost. This formulation offers two key advantages. First, the linear Koopman dynamics simplify the model-dependent policy gradient computation to a constant matrix product, enabling computationally efficient policy improvement. Second, one-step model propagation mitigates the accumulation of prediction errors associated with long-horizon rollouts while retaining long-term cost information through the critic. The learned policy enables real-time control through feedforward evaluation without online optimization. We establish policy learning convergence guarantees under standard stochastic approximation assumptions. Simulations on HalfCheetah and quadruped four-legged locomotion tasks demonstrate strong sample efficiency and improved performance compared with classical model-free and model-based reinforcement learning baselines. A pendulum swing-up task is used to assess policy gradient approximation accuracy and conduct ablation studies on the learning mechanism and key hyperparameters. The proposed K-MBRL is further validated on a physical quadruped robot performing a challenging sequence of maneuvers: rising to an upright posture supported by two rounded rear feet, maintaining balance during bipedal walking, and safely returning to the ground, as shown in Fig.1.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Koopman算子的模型强化学习算法K-MBRL，将未知非线性动力学近似为线性表示，结合critic估计剩余未来代价，实现高效策略改进与实时控制，并在仿真与实体四足机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 针对未知动力学的非线性机器人系统控制问题：无模型RL样本效率低，传统基于模型RL的长时域滚动预测会累积误差且计算代价高，需要一种兼顾样本效率、计算效率与预测精度的学习框架。
AI.method: K-MBRL最小化近似策略目标：解析即时代价 + 在一步预测状态处评估的未来代价估计。具体地，用随机Koopman算子学习方法将未知非线性动力学拟合为线性表示；由critic函数估计剩余未来代价。线性Koopman动力学使模型相关的策略梯度计算简化为常数矩阵乘积；一步模型传播避免长时域滚动的误差累积，同时通过critic保留长期代价信息。策略以feedforward前向评估方式实现实时控制，无需在线优化。并在标准随机逼近假设下给出策略学习收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在HalfCheetah与四足运动任务上，相比经典无模型与基于模型RL基线具有更强样本效率和更优性能；单摆起摆任务用于评估策略梯度近似精度，并对学习机制与关键超参数进行消融实验；在实体四足机器人上完成由两只圆弧后足支撑起立、双足行走保持平衡、安全落地的连续动作序列验证。
AI.conclusion: Koopman线性表示与单步预测加critic的结构可在保证长期代价信息的同时显著降低计算与预测误差累积，兼具收敛性保证与实机可行性，适用于未知动力学非线性机器人系统的实时控制。

title: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
comment: Accepted for publication in npj Imaging. 19 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, including Supplementary Material. Code is available at https://github.com/QuIN-Lab/AstroSeg-vEM
summary: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量化、以星形胶质细胞为中心的分割与三维重建框架 AstroSeg-vEM，在保持原始平面分辨率的前提下实现高保真星形胶质细胞形态重建与定量分析。
AI.motivation: 星形胶质细胞形态与其支持、调控神经环路的功能密切相关，但从体电子显微镜（vEM）数据重建其形态仍依赖大量人工与算力，尽管 vEM 具备高空间分辨率，仍难以推广与规模化。
AI.method: 将基于 Transformer 的二维分割与专门设计的后处理方法结合，直接在高分辨率 EM 切片上运行，适配各向异性 vEM 数据及下游校对（proofreading）流程，完整保留原始 EM 数据的面内分辨率；整体架构轻量。
AI.result: 在四个小鼠海马数据集（涵盖正常及形态学定义的压力相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态）上评估，于留出测试集取得平均 Dice 0.92、加权 Dice 0.95，表现出良好的鲁棒性与泛化性；轻量架构可在消费级硬件上高效完成高保真重建。
AI.conclusion: AstroSeg-vEM 为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析及未来星形胶质细胞—神经元相互作用研究提供了可扩展、易获取的技术平台。

title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://hangroup.mit.edu/slic/
summary: Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. We further release an open, goal-conditioned benchmark of 41 amplifier topologies with standardized protocols for in-distribution validation, held-out topology evaluation, and cross-technology-node transfer. Trained solely with open source 65 nm CMOS predictive technology models (PTM), SLIC-Random achieves 87.1% in-distribution four-specification Pass@1 within eight turns, surpassing the 763B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Think by 48.5 percentage points. Beyond the training distribution, SLIC-Softmax reaches 72.6% Pass@1 on held-out topologies, and the trained policies consistently transfer across five unseen technology nodes without additional fine-tuning. This transfer extends to a commercial TSMC 65 nm CMOS PDK, where SLIC-Random achieves 49.9% held-out-topology Pass@1, demonstrating practical deployment through local inference without transmitting proprietary data to external LLM services. Performance further scales with test-time simulator interactions, reaching up to 83.2% held-out-topology Pass@1 at a 32-turn budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLIC，一个强化微调框架，训练 4B 规模可本地部署的小语言模型完成闭环模拟电路优化，在开放 65nm PTM 上训练即超越 763B 大模型 48.5 个百分点，并可零微调迁移到未见拓扑与五个未见工艺节点（含商用 TSMC 65nm PDK）。
AI.motivation: 模拟 IC 设计是多轮、依赖仿真器的迭代工程任务，需在耦合的性能折衷间反复推理；而专有 PDK 使托管式大语言模型（LLM）工作流难以落地——既无法把敏感工艺数据外传，也难以在实用环境中部署。因此需要可本地推理、成本可控的小模型方案。
AI.method: SLIC（Small LM Iterating on Circuits）由四部分构成：(1) 结构化电路表示 + 离散化“相对更新”动作空间；(2) 领域门控与成功门控的多目标奖励；(3) Reward-Guided Rollout Steering（RGRS），将每步仿真器反馈同时用于策略学习与在线 rollout 构造，以应对该领域的稀疏、强约束特性；(4) 发布一个目标条件化的开放基准：41 个放大器拓扑，含分布内验证、留出拓扑评估与跨工艺节点迁移的标准协议。基座为 4B 级模型，仅用开源 65nm CMOS PTM 训练。
AI.result: SLIC-Random 在 8 轮内取得 87.1% 分布内四指标 Pass@1，比 763B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Think 高 48.5 个百分点；SLIC-Softmax 在留出拓扑上 Pass@1 达 72.6%；策略在五个未见工艺节点上零微调一致迁移；迁移至商用 TSMC 65nm CMOS PDK 时，SLIC-Random 在留出拓扑上 Pass@1 为 49.9%；测试时仿真交互可扩展，32 轮预算下留出拓扑 Pass@1 升至 83.2%。
AI.conclusion: 小型本地化语言模型经强化微调后，可在强约束、稀疏奖励的模拟电路优化任务上显著优于超大托管模型，并具备跨拓扑、跨工艺节点的泛化与商用 PDK 上的实用可部署性，同时避免向外部 LLM 服务传输专有数据；性能还可通过增加测试时仿真预算进一步提升。该工作同时提供了可复现的目标条件化基准与评估协议。

title: Living constitutions: Participatory alignment for sovereign foundation models
summary: In Constitutional AI, a plain-text "constitution" encodes values and gets incorporated into a model via post-training. However, the procedure for creating such a constitution poses significant challenges: who contributes, who decides which norms are included, and to what extent must the process be participatory or democratic? These challenges can be paralyzing. Yet, we argue that taking action is essential: without a deliberate constitution, sovereign models would risk misalignment or default to norms set by frontier model providers. We propose treating the development of a constitution as an evolving, participatory process akin to citizen science, iteratively drafted, tested, and refined. We therefore formulate five desirable principles: iterative, modular, justifiable, positional, and legitimate. We further argue that such a document must remain responsive not only over time but across the people it governs, and propose that provisions be marked as settled, contested, or underdetermined, so that durable disagreement is recorded in the constitution rather than resolved away. Empirically, we show via agent-based modelling that proposed process for maintaining living constitutions is robust against 50% bad actors among citizens - assuming a share of 75% participants with good intent in the deliberative body. This indicates that the proposed process tolerates a substantial share of adversarial participants.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将AI"宪法"的制定视为一个演化式的、参与式的过程（类似公民科学），并提出五项设计原则与"已定/争议/未定"条款标记机制，最后通过基于智能体的建模证明该维护流程在公民中有50%恶意行为者、协商机构中75%善意参与者时仍具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Constitutional AI 中的"宪法"以纯文本编码价值并通过后训练注入模型，但宪法的制定过程本身存在难题：谁来贡献、谁来决定纳入哪些规范、过程需多大程度的参与性或民主性。这些难题可能导致行动瘫痪。作者认为必须采取行动，否则自主的主权模型将面临失准风险，或默认采纳前沿模型提供方设定的规范。
AI.method: 将宪法制定视为类似公民科学的演化式、参与式过程，迭代起草、测试与精炼；提出五项期望原则：迭代性（iterative）、模块化（modular）、可证成性（justifiable）、立场性（positional）、合法性（legitimate）；并主张条款应标注为"已定（settled）、争议（contested）、未定（underdetermined）"，使持久分歧被记录而非被消解。实证上采用基于智能体的建模（agent-based modelling）评估该"活的宪法"维护流程的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 基于智能体的建模显示：在公民中存在50%恶意行为者、且协商机构中善意参与者比例为75%的假设下，所提出的宪法维护流程仍保持鲁棒，表明该流程可容忍相当比例的对抗性参与者。
AI.conclusion: 宪法应随时间演化，并对其所治理的人群保持响应性；通过在文本中显式记录持久分歧（settled/contested/underdetermined），可在不强行消解分歧的前提下维持宪法的可运作性与合法性；且该参与式维护流程对恶意参与者具有实际容忍度，因而"行动"是可行且必要的。

title: Elastic-WAM: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Imagination for Efficient Robot Control
summary: World-Action Models improve robot control by predicting future visual dynamics, but iterative video denoising incurs substantial inference overhead. Recent approaches reduce this cost through partial future denoising, yet typically rely on fixed refinement budgets. Our empirical observations reveal that preferred refinement depths vary across tasks and states, while different future regions exhibit varying relevance to action generation. Motivated by these findings, we propose Elastic-WAM, which adaptively allocates world refinement computation across temporal denoising time and spatial future space. A unified spatiotemporal refinement demand field governs when to stop world refinement, how far to advance each denoising step, and which regions to refresh. We parameterize this field with a shared temporal basis and spatial amplitudes, and learn it through a three-stage action-grounded supervised procedure. At inference, the learned field guides recurrent sparse world refinement to improve task success while reducing inference overhead. Evaluations across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world long-horizon manipulation demonstrate state-of-the-art control performance with reduced inference latency.

AI.tldr: Elastic-WAM 通过对世界精炼计算在时间与空间维度上的自适应分配，在降低推理开销的同时提升机器人控制成功率。
AI.motivation: World-Action Models 依赖迭代视频去噪预测未来视觉动态，推理开销大；现有部分未来去噪方法采用固定精炼预算，但作者观察到最优精炼深度随任务与状态变化，且未来不同区域对动作生成的相关性不同，固定预算次优。
AI.method: 提出统一的时空精炼需求场（demand field），由共享时间基与空间幅度参数化，控制三件事：何时停止世界精炼、每步去噪推进多远、刷新哪些区域；通过三阶段、以动作为监督的（action-grounded）有监督流程学习该场；推理时用学到的场引导循环稀疏世界精炼。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准与真实世界长程操作任务上取得 SOTA 控制性能，并降低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、任务与状态相关的时空计算分配可替代固定精炼预算，在 World-Action Models 中实现成功率与效率的良好权衡。

title: When to Start Denoising? Adaptive Denoising Entry for Generative Video Compression
summary: Generative video compression offers a promising solution for compressing and reconstructing videos under extremely low bitrate constraints, among which the diffusion-based solutions still achieve the best performance by providing the powerful generative latent prior. However, their effectiveness critically depends on when the compressed latent is introduced into the diffusion process, which directly governs the trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism. To address this limitation, we identify denoising start-timestep selection as a key factor governing this trade-off and formulate it as a geometric optimization problem. Based on this formulation, we propose a novel adaptive diffusion entry method for generative video compression (ADE-GVC), the first timestep-aware generative video compression framework, featuring a lightweight predictor that estimates an adaptive denoising start point from the compressed latent. A temporal adapter further extracts compression-aware conditions and injects them into a pretrained video diffusion model, enabling the reconstruction of videos with both high fidelity and realism. More importantly, we observe a strong quantitative relationship between the predicted timesteps and the distortion between the original and compressed latents, providing empirical support for our optimization formulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADE-GVC achieves the state-of-the-art performance on perceptual metrics and substantially improves reconstruction realism over existing generative video compression methods. Notably, our ADE-GVC achieves an average bitrate savings of 40.99\% (on DISTS) and 95.24\% (on PSNR) compared to the latest open-source baseline GLC-Video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ADE-GVC，首个时间步感知的生成式视频压缩框架，通过预测器自适应选择扩散去噪起始时间步，并用时间适配器注入压缩感知条件，在超低码率下兼顾重建保真度与感知真实感。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散先验的生成式视频压缩性能最佳，但其效果严重依赖"压缩潜变量在何时注入扩散过程"（即去噪起始时间步），该因素直接决定重建保真度与感知真实感之间的权衡，而现有方法未对该选择进行显式建模与优化。
AI.method: 将去噪起始时间步选择形式化为几何优化问题；提出轻量级预测器，从压缩潜变量中估计自适应去噪起点；引入时间适配器（temporal adapter）提取压缩感知条件并注入预训练视频扩散模型。
AI.result: 实验发现预测时间步与原/压缩潜变量间失真存在强定量关系，为优化公式提供经验支持；在感知指标上达到 SOTA，显著提升重建真实感；相比最新开源基线 GLC-Video，平均节省 40.99%（DISTS）与 95.24%（PSNR）码率。
AI.conclusion: 自适应选择扩散入口时间步是提升生成式视频压缩性能的关键，ADE-GVC 以明确的优化建模与轻量预测机制，在极低码率下实现了保真度与真实感的更好平衡，并取得显著码率节省。

title: Deep Personalization: Continuous Context Observation for Local Proactive Agents
summary: As AI agents become increasingly capable, users must still recognize when and how to ask for help, leaving many opportunities for useful support unrealized. Proactive agents hold the promise to close this gap, but effective proactivity requires understanding users' real-time activities and personalizing intervention timing so that assistance is offered when it is likely to be helpful rather than disruptive. We introduce deep personalization, a closed-loop process that connects continuous context observation with continual agent adaptation: an agent observes user activity, selectively retains long-term context, and adapts intervention decisions from implicit feedback. We initiate deep personalization in Coco, a proactive desktop agent, by having a separate Observer Agent that monitors desktop activity, maintains compact long-term user modeling context, and learns when assistance is desirable from implicit signals such as engagement, dismissal, explicit requests, and repeated work patterns. We further develop efficient on-device strategies to enable the Observer Agent to run on local AI compute platforms without streaming raw activity data off-device. For evaluation at scale without collecting sensitive real-user activity, we introduce a data-synthesis pipeline that transforms existing computer-use trajectories into OSWorld-Persona, a benchmark with persona-conditioned intervention labels. On OSWorld-Persona, deep personalization improves macro F1 across three model backbones from 0.12-0.19 under direct prompting to 0.35-0.48 after adaptation, a 2.4-3.0x relative gain. In a week-long user study, we observe that Coco improves its macro-averaged F1 score from 0.199 to 0.515. These results suggest that on-device deep personalization can make proactive agents more timely and increasingly aligned with each user's everyday work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"深度个性化"（deep personalization）闭环框架，并实现为主动式桌面智能体 Coco：由独立的 Observer Agent 持续观察桌面活动、压缩式维护长期用户建模上下文，并从隐式反馈中学习干预时机；配合端侧高效推理与 OSWorld-Persona 合成基准，在三个模型骨干上把 macro F1 从 0.12–0.19 提升到 0.35–0.48，一周用户研究中从 0.199 提升到 0.515。
AI.motivation: 用户往往难以自行判断何时该求助，主动式智能体可填补这一空白；但有效主动性依赖对用户实时活动的理解与干预时机的个性化，否则帮助可能变成干扰。现有工作缺乏把持续上下文观察与智能体持续适应相连接的闭环机制，也难以在不上传原始活动数据的前提下实现大规模、可评估的个性化。
AI.method: 1) 提出深度个性化闭环：观察 → 选择性保留长期上下文 → 依据隐式反馈持续调整干预决策；2) 实现为 Coco 桌面主动智能体，采用独立的 Observer Agent 监测桌面活动、维护紧凑的长期用户建模上下文，并从参与、忽略/关闭、显式请求、重复工作模式等隐式信号中学习"何时帮助更有价值"；3) 设计端侧高效策略，使 Observer Agent 可在本地 AI 计算平台运行，原始活动数据不出设备；4) 构建数据合成流水线，将已有 computer-use 轨迹转化为带人格条件干预标签的 OSWorld-Persona 基准，用于规模化评估并规避采集真实敏感数据。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-Persona 上，深度个性化使三个模型骨干的 macro F1 由直接提示下的 0.12–0.19 提升至适应后的 0.35–0.48，相对增益 2.4–3.0 倍；在一周时长的用户研究中，Coco 的宏平均 F1 由 0.199 提升至 0.515。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，端侧深度个性化可使主动式智能体的干预更及时，并逐步贴近每位用户的日常工作习惯；该闭环范式在隐私受限的真实部署条件下具备可行性。

title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On $τ^2$-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 SteerDistill：一种量化感知蒸馏方法，通过全精度教师在学生执行反馈驱动下闭环纠正失败行为，并将纠正内化，使低比特 LLM 智能体在无辅助推理下接近 BF16 表现。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化降低 LLM 智能体推理成本，但会损害任务成功率。分析失败轨迹发现，量化智能体常忽略任务要求或环境条件，产生与全精度参考成功轨迹不一致的环境状态转移。修正这些行为偏差存在困难：离线数据可能缺少学生的失败上下文，而学生自身 rollout 在这些上下文中又少有正确响应。
AI.method: SteerDistill：全精度教师在学生实际执行的反馈下迭代修正学生的失败响应，形成闭环教师引导，产生经本地验证的行为纠正；随后在无引导条件下训练学生，在纠正轮次对齐"被引导学生"的预测、在其他轮次对齐全精度教师的预测，从而将纠正内化，实现无辅助推理。
AI.result: 在 5 个智能体基准与 3 个模型上，W4A16 设置下平均分超过最强量化基线 1.67–2.18 分，与 BF16 差距在 1 分以内；在 τ²-Bench 上成功率较 QeRL 高 1.84 个百分点，训练 GPU 时数减少 67%，且成功轨迹比量化基线更短。
AI.conclusion: 以执行反馈驱动的闭环教师引导＋纠正内化蒸馏，可有效缓解量化智能体的行为偏差，在显著降低推理成本的同时保持接近全精度的任务成功率与更高训练效率。

title: From Prediction to Action: Learning Physical Context for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation
summary: A representation that accurately predicts a deformable object's response is not necessarily the one most useful for choosing manipulation actions. We study this distinction between predictive utility and decision utility in planar single-grasp shape control of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs). As a common decision backbone, we introduce Geometry-Pointer-Flow (GPF), a geometry-grounded policy that separates grasp-location selection from grasp-conditioned motion generation. Its geometry-only variant reduces one-step executed shape error by 32.8% relative to a DLO-specific diffusion policy, while using 18.7 times fewer parameters and achieving approximately 193 times faster inference. On this backbone, we compare physical context represented by ground-truth parameters, estimated parameters, and learned interaction-history representations, for both forward prediction and executed control. For prediction, ground-truth physical parameters reduce next-shape error by 15.8% over geometry alone, and estimated parameters are slightly more predictive than interaction history. This ordering does not carry over to control: estimated parameters provide no detectable one-step control gain, whereas history-conditioned GPF reduces executed error by 9.9% relative to geometry-only GPF across 470 paired simulation trials. In closed loop, interaction history improves strict-threshold attainment in simulation and yields the strongest zero-shot performance on hardware. All policies are trained exclusively in simulation and transferred to the physical robot without real-world training or fine-tuning. These results show that physical context should be evaluated by the decisions it supports rather than by predictive accuracy alone. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文区分“预测效用”与“决策效用”，提出几何锚定的策略骨干GPF，并在平面单抓取DLO形状控制中比较了真值参数、估计参数与交互历史三种物理上下文的预测与控制表现，发现预测精度的排序不能迁移到控制效果上。
AI.motivation: 准确预测形变响应的表征未必是选择操作动作最有用的表征。作者希望澄清“预测效用”与“决策效用”的区别，检验常用做法（以预测精度选择/评价物理上下文表征）是否合理。
AI.method: 在平面单抓取可变形线性物体（DLO）形状控制任务上，提出Geometry-Pointer-Flow（GPF）决策骨干，将抓取位置选择与抓取条件动作生成解耦；以几何-only变体为基线，在同一骨干上分别注入真值物理参数、估计参数和学习的交互历史表征，并分别在正向预测与执行控制两方面评估。全部策略仅在仿真中训练，直接零样本迁移到实体机器人，无真机训练或微调。
AI.result: 几何-only GPF较DLO专用扩散策略单步执行形状误差降低32.8%，参数量少18.7倍，推理快约193倍。预测方面：真值物理参数较纯几何降低下一步形状误差15.8%，估计参数略优于交互历史。控制方面该排序不成立：估计参数无可检测的单步控制增益，而历史条件GPF在470对配对仿真试验中较几何-only降低执行误差9.9%；闭环仿真中交互历史提升严格阈值达成率，并在硬件上取得最强零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: 物理上下文应按其支持的决策质量而非仅按预测精度来评价；对DLO形状控制，交互历史表征在控制上优于显式参数估计，且仿真训练的策略可零样本迁移到真机。

title: PUMA: Probability-Constrained Sequential Interaction for Forensic Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization must jointly exploit semantic structure and noise-sensitive forensic evidence. However, the effects of spatial correspondence, matching quality, and interaction order are often conflated. Existing semantic-forensic fusion methods provide complementary representations, but do not explicitly preserve quality-mismatch information during spatial correspondence or adaptively select the order in which information is propagated across branches. We propose PUMA (Probability-constrained Unbalanced Matching and Aggregation), which combines spatially constrained unbalanced optimal transport with position-wise convex selection between two sequential operators through a shared positional interface. Before normalization, PUMA retains signed transport-mass residuals, constructs row-stochastic cross-branch and within-noise-branch operators, and updates noise features through a gated residual path. PUMA achieves strong localization results on four test sets, with scores on COVERAGE and NIST16 exceeding the published results of the representative methods listed in our comparison. The experiments support the utility of local matching states and adaptive sequential interaction for cross-source localization and several post-processing conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 PUMA，用空间约束的非平衡最优传输 + 逐位置凸选择实现语义-取证证据的匹配与交互，在 COVERAGE 与 NIST16 上超过所列代表性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有语义-取证融合方法虽提供互补表示，但在空间对应过程中未显式保留质量失配信息，也未自适应选择跨分支信息传播的顺序；空间对应、匹配质量与交互顺序三者的效应被混杂。
AI.method: PUMA（概率约束非平衡匹配与聚合）：结合空间约束的非平衡最优传输与共享位置接口上的逐位置凸选择；在归一化前保留带符号传输质量残差，构造行随机的跨分支与噪声分支内算子，并通过门控残差路径更新噪声特征。
AI.result: 在四个测试集上取得较强的定位性能，COVERAGE 与 NIST16 上的分数超过对比中代表性方法的已发表结果。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持局部匹配状态与自适应序列交互对跨源定位的有效性，并在若干后处理条件下保持稳健。

title: Leveraging Psychophysical Attentional Distribution for Gaze-Augmented Reward Modeling
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026 Main Track)
summary: Integrating human feedback into language models has gained increasing attention as a means to align model outputs with human preferences, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) serving as a prominent framework for preference-based alignment. Recent studies have incorporated eye-tracking (ET) data as an additional supervisory signal for reward model training, grounding reward learning in human reading behavior. Building on this approach, we extend prior fixation-centric models by leveraging established findings from cognitive psychology on human letter recognition. Specifically, we model visual attention as a spatially graded distribution centered on the current gaze location and incorporate this representation into reward model training. Our results show that the reward model trained with the proposed gaze distribution achieves higher preference prediction accuracy than a baseline model. Moreover, some results from our experiments are qualitatively consistent with established findings on human attention during reading, suggesting that they potentially capture cognitively meaningful aspects of human attention allocation.

AI.tldr: 该文在基于眼动数据的奖励模型训练基础上，引入认知心理学中人类字母识别的发现，将视觉注意建模为以当前注视点为中心的空间梯度分布表示，并用于偏好奖励模型训练；结果显示所提模型偏好预测准确率优于基线，且部分实验现象与阅读中人类注意分配已有结论定性一致。
AI.motivation: RLHF 是偏好对齐的主流框架，奖励模型质量关键。已有工作将眼动（ET）数据作为额外监督信号，使奖励学习扎根于人类阅读行为；但现有做法多为"注视点中心化"（fixation-centric）建模，忽略了认知心理学关于人类字母识别与注意分配的空间梯度特性，因此需要更符合人类视觉注意机制的表示。
AI.method: 在原有眼动监督奖励模型框架上扩展：依据人类字母识别的认知心理学结论，将视觉注意建模为以当前注视位置为中心、随空间衰减的梯度分布（gaze distribution），并把该分布表示引入奖励模型训练，替代/补充单纯注视点信号。
AI.result: 采用所提注视分布训练的奖励模型在偏好预测准确率上高于基线模型；部分实验结果在定性层面与阅读中人类注意分配的既有研究发现一致，提示模型可能捕捉到了具有认知意义的注意分配特征。
AI.conclusion: 将认知心理学启发的空间梯度注意表示融入眼动监督的奖励学习是有效的，可提升偏好预测性能，并使模型行为在定性上与人类阅读注意机制对齐，为人机偏好对齐提供了更具认知合理性的监督信号设计思路。

title: SafeRoute-MAS: Coverage-Aware and Risk-Calibrated Message Routing for Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning
summary: We introduce SafeRoute-MAS, a coverage-aware, risk-calibrated procedure that keeps all specialist messages or removes one using only pre-integration information. On a sealed cache of 5,328 committees, its source-compatible operating point gains +1.80 percentage points (95% CI [+1.13, +2.52]) while removing 12.76% of message tokens. We also run 4,580 controlled integrations over a stratified 458-committee sample on a public gpt-oss-120b endpoint. The sample estimate is -0.09 points; design weighting to the original workload gives +0.94 points (95% CI [-1.31, +3.50]) and 18.72% acted-input reduction. A weighted token-matched comparison likewise does not establish a selector advantage (+1.68 points, CI [-1.27, +5.10]). Only 13 of 88 cached non-neutral labels (14.8%) retain direction by repeated-call majority. Expected-corruption UCL is 4.60% after weighting, but only 2 of 11 prespecified marginals pass the support/risk rule. We therefore propose a numerical qualification with Keep-All fallback, applied here retrospectively rather than validated prospectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeRoute-MAS——一种覆盖率感知、风险校准的多智能体消息筛选流程（全保留或删除一条，仅用集成前信息），并在密封缓存与公共端点上做实证评估；结果显示原始工作负载下收益显著（+1.80pp，去12.76% token），但加权外推与token匹配对照均无法确立选择器优势，因此作者转而提出"数值资格认证+Keep-All兜底"的回顾性框架，尚待前瞻验证。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中专家消息集成带来大量token开销，需要在集成前判断消息是否冗余可删；但消息选择器在分布外（OOD）与低支持区域易失效，现有工作缺乏对覆盖度、风险上界与统计稳健性的联合约束，导致"选得准"的主张难以被证据支持。
AI.method: 1) SafeRoute-MAS：仅在集成前信息基础上执行"全部保留/删除一条"的二值决策，带覆盖率感知与风险校准；2) 密封评测：5,328个committee缓存上的source-compatible工作点；3) 受控实验：分层458-committee样本、4,580次集成，运行于公开gpt-oss-120b端点，采用设计加权与token匹配对照；4) 稳定性检验：对88个非中性缓存标签重复调用做多数方向一致性；5) 风险评估：加权期望损坏率的单侧置信上界（UCL）与11个预设边际的support/risk规则检验。
AI.result: 密封缓存：+1.80pp（95% CI [+1.13, +2.52]），token减少12.76%。受控集成：样本估计-0.09pp；设计加权至原始工作负载为+0.94pp（CI [-1.31, +3.50]），动作输入减少18.72%；token匹配加权对照+1.68pp（CI [-1.27, +5.10]），均不显著。标签稳定性仅13/88（14.8%）经重复调用多数保留原方向。加权后期望损坏UCL=4.60%，但11个预设边际中仅2个通过support/risk规则。
AI.conclusion: 原始工作负载上的收益不能稳健外推：选择器优势在加权与token匹配下均未确立，且标签方向稳定性低、边际支持不足。作者因此不宣称方法已验证，而提出"数值资格认证+Keep-All兜底"的部署范式，本工作中的该流程仅为回顾性应用，需前瞻性验证。

title: ForeseeDrive: Future-Token Conditioning for Anticipatory Generative Driving
comment: 15 pages (8 pages main text + appendix), 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Generative driving planners can represent diverse ego futures, but a downstream scorer can choose only among sampled candidates; it cannot recover an absent maneuver. We present ForeseeDrive, which turns future scene evolution into a deployable interface for shaping candidate generation. Rather than reconstructing dense future states or scoring a fixed menu, ForeseeDrive derives query-indexed tokens from logged actor motion, occupancy evolution, route interactions, and TTC margins, and predicts the same token space from present context at deployment. The tokens condition trajectory geometry before candidates materialize. A zero-token-gated residual path and candidate-preservation loss limit unnecessary drift, while a TTC-margin guard targets brittle safe-to-unsafe boundary crossings. Under their respective benchmark protocols, ForeseeDrive reaches 89.2 PDMS on NAVSIM navtest, 0.41\,m average L2 and 0.05\% collision rate on nuScenes validation, and a 76.50 driving score on Bench2Drive. Controlled DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostics show an exact zero-token no-op, a small aligned-over-shuffled selected-PDM advantage under preservation, mixed oracle-best quality, and localized TTC-boundary failures. Together, the benchmark results and bounded mechanism tests support future-conditioned generation as a practical interface for anticipation. Code is included in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 提出ForeseeDrive，将"未来场景演化"转化为可部署的候选轨迹生成接口：用未来token在候选生成前调制轨迹几何，而非在固定采样菜单上打分，在NAVSIM、nuScenes、Bench2Drive上取得竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 生成式驾驶规划器虽能表征多样自车未来，但下游打分器只能在已采样候选中挑选，无法"找回"未被采样的机动（缺失机动不可恢复）。因此需要一种在候选生成之前就注入未来信息的机制。
AI.method: ForeseeDrive不重建稠密未来状态、也不对固定候选集打分，而是从日志中actor运动、占据演化、路线交互与TTC裕度导出query-indexed tokens，并在部署时由当前上下文预测同一token空间；这些token在候选轨迹生成之前条件化轨迹几何。为避免漂移，引入零token门控残差通路与候选保持损失；并设置TTC裕度守卫以抑制"安全→不安全"的脆弱边界穿越。
AI.result: 在各自基准协议下：NAVSIM navtest 达89.2 PDMS；nuScenes val 平均L2 0.41 m、碰撞率0.05%；Bench2Drive驾驶得分76.50。基于DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM的受控诊断显示：零token时精确等价于no-op、保持约束下"对齐优于打乱"的selected-PDM小幅优势、oracle-best质量表现混合、TTC边界失效呈局部化。
AI.conclusion: 基准结果与有界机制测试共同支持"未来条件化生成"作为可落地的预判接口；但其收益受限于候选保持与TTC边界等局部机制，尚非全面占优。

title: FlashMotion: Ultra-Fast Long-Term 3D Motion Generation
summary: 3D human motion generation plays a crucial role in game development, extended reality (XR), digital humans, and embodied simulation. Beyond motion generation, practical pipelines include rigging, retargeting, and rendering, making ultra-fast long-term 3D motion generation without compromising quality valuable for real-time interactive applications. Despite promising progress, high-quality long-horizon motion generation under tight inference budgets remains challenging, owing to 2 coupled bottlenecks: (1) generative strategies that require many sampling steps for high-quality 3D motion generation and (2) model architectures with substantial per-step computational and memory costs for long sequences. We present FlashMotion, a co-designed framework for high-quality long-horizon 3D motion generation under a strict inference budget, covering text-to-motion, music-to-dance, and speech-to-gesture tasks. To enhance trajectory-level efficiency, we introduce a 3D motion-space MeanFlow formulation with kinematic and dynamic consistency constraints for few-step generation, together with an Adaptive Soft masking mechanism for temporally coherent motion editing. To improve per-step efficiency, we design a lightweight non-autoregressive BiMamba architecture with condition-guided state selection and AdaIN-based condition fusion mechanism, enhancing cross-modal alignment and generalization to longer motion sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlashMotion achieves overall state-of-the-art performance in both quality and efficiency across text-to-motion, speech-to-gesture, and music-to-dance generation. Code is available at FlashMotion (https://github.com/Sun-Happy-YKX/FlashMotion).

AI.tldr: 提出 FlashMotion 协同设计框架，在严格推理预算下实现高质量长时序 3D 人体动作生成，覆盖 text-to-motion、music-to-dance、speech-to-gesture。
AI.motivation: 实时交互应用（游戏、XR、数字人、具身仿真）需要超快长时序 3D 动作生成。现有方法受两个耦合瓶颈制约：(1) 高质量生成策略需大量采样步数；(2) 长序列下模型每步计算与显存开销大，难以在紧张推理预算下兼顾质量。
AI.method: 轨迹级效率：在 3D 动作空间提出 MeanFlow 表述，辅以运动学与动力学一致性约束实现少步生成，并引入自适应软掩码（Adaptive Soft masking）机制实现时间连贯的动作编辑。单步效率：设计轻量非自回归 BiMamba 架构，含条件引导状态选择与 AdaIN 条件融合机制，提升跨模态对齐与长序列泛化。
AI.result: 在 text-to-motion、speech-to-gesture、music-to-dance 三类任务上，质量与效率整体达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成范式（少步 MeanFlow）与架构（轻量 BiMamba）的协同设计，可在严格推理预算下同时获得高质量与高速度的长时序 3D 动作生成，适用于实时交互管线。

title: Sharp Sample Complexity of KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning
summary: KL-regularized reinforcement learning, the objective behind maximum-entropy RL and RL from human feedback, is variational inference in the graphical model of "control as inference": the regularized optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories, and the suboptimality of a policy is $β$ times a KL divergence between path measures. However, it is not known how many samples it takes to learn this posterior, even with a generative model. Earlier $1/ε$ guarantees scale with $H^5$ in the effective horizon $H$, and no lower bound for MDPs depends on the temperature $β$. In this work, we show that for a discounted MDP with $K$ state-action pairs, the plug-in estimator finds a policy that is $ε$-optimal from every initial state with $\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(ε\max\{ε,β\}) + KH)$ samples, and that no algorithm, even one that chooses where to sample, can do with fewer when $ε\lesssim \min\{H, H^2/β\}$. For $ε< β$ this is a $1/ε$ rate with the same horizon dependence as unregularized RL. We also find the exact asymptotic constant of the plug-in estimator, a Fisher-weighted variance of the estimated soft Q-function. The estimator is locally asymptotically minimax among methods that sample every pair equally often, and we give the allocation of samples that is optimal among adaptive designs. Simulations on small MDPs match the rates and the constants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带KL正则（soft-max/最大熵、RLHF目标）的强化学习中，"控制即推断"图模型后验（正则化最优策略）的学习样本复杂度，给出匹配的上界与下界：使用生成模型时，plug-in估计器达到\(\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(\varepsilon\max\{\varepsilon,\beta\}) + KH)\)的样本复杂度，并证明在该范围内任何算法（包括自适应采样）都无法更少；当\(\varepsilon<\beta\)时与无正则RL具有相同的时间跨度依赖的\(1/\varepsilon\)速率。
AI.motivation: KL正则RL的目标等价于"控制即推断"图模型中的变分推断，其中正则化最优策略是轨迹上的后验，策略次优性等于路径测度间KL散度的\(\beta\)倍。然而该后验的学习样本复杂度尚不清楚，即使拥有生成模型也是如此：已有\(1/\varepsilon\)保证在有效时间跨度\(H\)上依赖\(H^5\)，且MDP下界均不依赖温度\(\beta\)。作者旨在厘清该问题的紧样本复杂度及其对\(H\)、\(\beta\)、\(\varepsilon\)的精确依赖。
AI.method: 在具有\(K\)个状态-动作对的折扣MDP上分析plug-in估计器（先估计soft Q函数再取后验/贪心策略），给出从每个初始状态出发均\(\varepsilon\)-最优的样本复杂度上界；构造信息论下界，允许算法自适应选择采样位置，证明在该\(\varepsilon\)范围内无法减少样本；进一步推导plug-in估计器的精确渐近常数，即估计soft Q函数的Fisher加权方差，证明其在"每对等量采样"方法类中局部渐近极小极大，并给出自适应设计下的最优样本分配。最后在小规模MDP上进行仿真验证速率与常数。
AI.result: 上界：\(\widetilde{O}\big(KH^3/(\varepsilon\max\{\varepsilon,\beta\}) + KH\big)\)样本即可对所有初始状态达到\(\varepsilon\)-最优；下界：当\(\varepsilon\lesssim\min\{H, H^2/\beta\}\)时，任何算法（含自适应采样）均无法更少。当\(\varepsilon<\beta\)时得到与无正则RL具有相同\(H\)依赖的\(1/\varepsilon\)速率（\(H^3\)而非\(H^5\)）。plug-in估计器的渐近常数恰为估计soft Q函数的Fisher加权方差，且在等量采样类中局部渐近极小极大；给出最优自适应采样分配。小规模MDP仿真与理论速率及常数吻合。
AI.conclusion: KL正则RL的后验学习具有紧致的样本复杂度\(\widetilde{O}(KH^3/(\varepsilon\max\{\varepsilon,\beta\}) + KH)\)，与下界匹配，且改进了此前\(H^5\)的时间跨度依赖；当\(\varepsilon<\beta\)时正则化不带来额外代价，速率与无正则RL一致。plug-in估计器在渐近意义下最优（Fisher加权方差的极小极大性），并可通过自适应采样进一步优化采样分配。该结果将最大熵RL/RLHF的学习复杂度纳入"控制即推断"的统计理论框架。

title: When Reasoning looks like Hidden Understanding: How Chain-of-Thought Fosters Anthropomorphism, Perceptions of Epistemic Superiority, and Cognitive Deference
comment: Conference submission to FAccT, 4th November 2026. No Figures
summary: As AI-based products permeate society, specifically systems using generative models, a belief system is emerging about what these products are and what they can and cannot do. One common belief concerns the perception of the form of language as evidence of 'understanding' language. As these generative models reproduce linguistic patterns rather than understand meaning, interpreting these patterns as evidence of understanding is a misattribution. This misconception is extended by the notion that generative models can 'explain their reasoning.' Anecdotally, these misconceptions which mistake the form of language for its meaning are driving cognitive deference to AI systems in a way that displaces human agency. Such mistakes involve attributions of cognitive properties to the system, allowing them to be treated like intentional 'minds'. Importantly, perceived epistemic authority and superiority make that 'mind' worth deferring to. Anthropomorphism in tandem with epistemic authority and superiority, we argue, increases the risk that users generalise from narrow task performance to broader competencies, committing the "fallacy of composition". This paper explores misconceptions of Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning as sufficient transparent 'explanation'. We explore how anthropomorphism acts as a vehicle for cognitive deference of decision-making and perceptions of epistemic superiority in AI systems. Finally, we explore CoT's ramifications using medicine as an example. Taken together, we conclude that explainability operationalised through CoT is highly problematic and undercuts the very ethical principles it is intended to serve. While CoT may be valuable for improving output accuracy and moderation, we suggest that the practice of asking models to provide user facing reasons for their outputs should be actively discouraged, and AI literacy training should explicitly caution against its use.

AI.tldr: 该文指出，将语言形式误当作"理解"、将思维链（CoT）输出误当作透明"解释"，会经由拟人化放大用户对AI的认知权威感，导致"认知让渡"与"组合谬误"，因此以CoT实现可解释性在伦理上是站不住脚的。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI产品渗透社会，公众逐渐形成关于其能力边界的信念体系，其中一种常见误解是把语言形式的流畅与自洽视为"理解"语言的证据，并进一步认为模型能"解释自身推理"。作者担忧这类误解会促成对AI系统的认知让渡（cognitive deference），侵蚀人的能动性；而现有可解释性讨论（尤其围绕CoT）尚未充分批判这种"形式即意义"的错配及其伦理后果。
AI.method: 概念/论证性分析（非实证研究）：(1) 论证生成模型是复现语言模式而非理解意义，将其模式输出解读为理解属于"误归因"；(2) 分析拟人化（anthropomorphism）与感知到的认知权威、认知优越性如何共同作为认知让渡的载体；(3) 引入"组合谬误"（fallacy of composition）说明用户如何从狭窄任务表现外推至广义胜任力；(4) 以医学场景为例，剖析将CoT推理视为充分"透明解释"的误区及其后果。
AI.result: 作者论证：拟人化叠加感知的认知权威与优越性，会提高用户从窄任务表现泛化到广能力域的风险；CoT所提供的"理由"只是形式化的语言产物，并非对内部因果机制的透明说明，故不能构成真正的可解释性。以医学为例，此类误读可能诱导不当的临床决策让渡，与可解释性所服务的伦理原则（如自主性、问责）相冲突。
AI.conclusion: 以CoT操作化的可解释性是高度可疑的，反而削弱了它本应服务的伦理原则。CoT可用于提升输出准确性与内容审核，但应主动劝阻让模型向用户提供其输出的"理由"这一做法，并在AI素养教育中明确警示其局限。

title: Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control for 6-DoF Trajectory Tracking with a Holonomic AUV
summary: Small, holonomic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) enable close-range inspection of underwater structures from arbitrary viewpoints, requiring accurate position and attitude tracking under state and input constraints. Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) naturally handles these requirements, but relies on an accurate dynamics model, which is difficult to obtain underwater. In this paper, we present a nonlinear MPCC in all six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) for a holonomic AUV and alleviate the inaccuracies in the dynamics by augmenting the nominal model employed with residual dynamics learned via Gaussian Process (GP) regression.
