The learned residual is embedded in the optimal control problem through a zero-order robust optimization scheme, which keeps the controller real-time capable at 25 Hz. A simulation ablation shows that residual selection is essential when designing the controller, and simulation and in-water experiments with the Multimodality, Observing, Low-cost, Agile (MOLA) AUV validate the resulting controllers against a nominal MPCC and a field proven Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller.

AI.tldr: 针对全驱动AUV在水下难以获得精确动力学模型的问题，提出六自由度非线性MPCC，并用高斯过程学习残差动力学嵌入零阶鲁棒优化，控制器保持25 Hz实时性，仿真消融表明残差建模方式关键，仿真与水试均优于标称MPCC和PID。
AI.motivation: 小型全驱动AUV可对水下结构进行任意视角近距离检测，需在状态与输入约束下精确跟踪位置与姿态。MPCC天然适合此类约束跟踪，但依赖精确动力学模型，而水下动力学建模困难，因此需在保持MPCC约束处理能力的同时补偿模型误差。
AI.method: 构建全驱动AUV六自由度非线性MPCC；在名义模型上叠加由高斯过程回归学习的残差动力学，并通过零阶鲁棒优化（zero-order robust optimization）将该残差纳入最优控制问题，以保证实时性（25 Hz）；在MOLA AUV上开展仿真消融实验，并与标称MPCC和现场验证的PID控制器对比，进行仿真与水试验证。
AI.result: 控制器在25 Hz下实时运行；仿真消融实验表明残差选择在设计控制器时至关重要；仿真与MOLA AUV水试结果显示，所提方法相对标称MPCC与现场验证的PID控制器具有更好性能。
AI.conclusion: 将GP学习的残差动力学以零阶鲁棒优化方式嵌入六自由度MPCC，可在水下模型不精确条件下实现实时、满足约束的精确位姿跟踪，是一种工程可行的补偿方案；残差项的选取对控制器设计具有决定性影响。

title: DepthGS: Depth-Guided Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Regularization for High-Quality Surface Reconstruction
comment: To appear in IEEE Trans. on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient representation for novel view synthesis, offering fast differentiable rendering and high visual fidelity, and has increasingly been extended to surface reconstruction. However, the relationship between depth information and reconstruction error remains insufficiently explored, limiting the principled design of geometric optimization strategies. To fill the above gap, we propose DepthGS, a depth-guided Gaussian splatting framework. We derive theoretical relations between depth discrepancies and reconstruction error under single-view and multi-view settings, and rigorously establish corresponding upper bounds on reconstruction error. The above analysis informs the design of adaptive regularization strategies in both single-view and multi-view optimization. More specifically, for single-view optimization, we propose a depth-difference-guided adaptive normal regularization strategy that modulates the normal constraint strength using a geometric reliability weight computed from local depth differences. For multi-view optimization, we introduce a cross-view depth consistency regularization strategy that promotes consistency between neighboring-view depth maps and the corresponding depth predictions obtained by transforming the current view's depth predictions into those neighboring views. Extensive experiments on DTU, Mip-NeRF360, and Tanks and Temples demonstrate that DepthGS achieves competitive performance in both surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis.

AI.tldr: DepthGS 是一个深度引导的高斯泼溅框架，从理论上建立深度差异与重建误差之间的上界关系，并据此设计单视图与多视图的自适应正则化策略。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 已扩展到表面重建，但深度信息与重建误差之间的关系缺乏系统研究，导致几何优化策略的设计缺乏理论依据。论文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 推导单视图与多视图下深度差异与重建误差之间的理论关系，并严格给出重建误差上界；基于该分析设计两类正则化：(1) 单视图下，用局部深度差异计算几何可靠性权重，调制法向约束强度的深度差异引导自适应法向正则；(2) 多视图下，将当前视图深度预测变换到邻近视图，与邻近视图深度图进行跨视图深度一致性正则。
AI.result: 在 DTU、Mip-NeRF360、Tanks and Temples 上的大量实验表明，DepthGS 在表面重建与新视图合成两项任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 深度差异可作为重建误差的可解释指标，为自适应正则化提供理论支撑；DepthGS 验证了理论驱动的几何优化设计在 3DGS 表面重建中的有效性。

title: Evaluating Compositional Generalization in Transformers: The Role of Composition Equivalence and Module Coverage
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Compositional generalization is an important form of out-of-distribution generalization, defined as the ability to train on some combinations of modules (e.g., functions such as sort, filter) and then generalize to unseen combinations. Despite substantial empirical work evaluating compositional generalization in transformers, findings have been inconsistent because evaluations were often conducted on a limited set of train-test splits, defined in an ad hoc manner. Through a systematic evaluation, we identify two key aspects of the train-test distribution that strongly affect performance: composition equivalence and module coverage. We show that the apparent performance of direct models (trained only on final outputs) results primarily from exploiting composition equivalences, meaning different sequences of modules that reduce to identical end-to-end functions. When benchmarks eliminate these equivalences, performance drops significantly, showing their inability to generalize to compositions of known modules that produce novel end-to-end functions. We further demonstrate that performance degrades monotonically as module coverage shifts increase (when modules appear in different contexts between train and test), affecting both direct and step-by-step models (trained on intermediate and final outputs). These findings have concrete implications for benchmark design: benchmarks that include compositional equivalences can lead to significant overestimation of the generalization abilities of direct models, and benchmarks that include both module coverage violations and compositional equivalences can exacerbate shortcut learning. As a case study, we demonstrate the role of compositional equivalence on the generalization performance of the pre-trained model Llama3-8B on the code-output prediction task in the coding benchmark LiveCodeBench.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估Transformer的组合泛化能力，指出"组合等价性"与"模块覆盖"是两个决定性能的关键数据划分因素；消除等价性后直接模型性能大幅下降，模块覆盖偏移增大则性能单调下降，并据此提出基准设计建议。
AI.motivation: 既有关于Transformer组合泛化（在部分模块组合上训练、泛化到未见组合）的实证结论不一致，根源在于评测所用的训练-测试划分往往是临时设定、覆盖面有限，缺乏系统性的划分维度分析。
AI.method: 对训练-测试分布进行系统化评估，识别出两个关键维度：组合等价性（不同模块序列归约为相同的端到端函数）与模块覆盖（模块在训练与测试中出现于不同上下文）。在此框架下对比仅学最终输出的直接模型与学习中间及最终输出的逐步模型；并消除等价性、控制模块覆盖偏移幅度进行受控实验；最后以Llama3-8B在LiveCodeBench代码输出预测任务上作案例研究。
AI.result: 直接模型的表面性能主要来自利用组合等价性；当基准消除等价性后，其性能显著下降，表明其无法泛化到已知模块构成的、产生全新端到端函数的新组合。随着模块覆盖偏移增大，直接模型与逐步模型的性能均呈单调下降。基准若同时包含模块覆盖违例与组合等价性，会加剧捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: 组合等价性会使直接模型的泛化能力被显著高估，模块覆盖偏移会系统性削弱性能。基准设计应避免包含组合等价性与模块覆盖违例，以真实反映模型的组合泛化能力；Llama3-8B在LiveCodeBench上的案例进一步印证了组合等价性对预训练模型性能评估的影响。

title: The WoW: A Large-Scale World Knowledge Corpus for Full-Lifecycle LLM Training
summary: Existing Chinese educational corpora often suffer from fragmented coverage and a lack of systematic organization. In this paper, we propose WoW (\textbf{Wo}rld Kno\textbf{w}ledge), a large-scale dataset designed for the full-cycle training of foundation models. The construction of this dataset is driven by an Educational Knowledge Graph, which serves as a taxonomic backbone for the systematic collection and completion of missing educational modules across all levels. Compared to previous versions, this iteration provides enhanced systematicity, superior quality, and a larger scale, while incorporating multimodal signals and supporting every stage of model development. Experiments demonstrate that WoW significantly improves model performance across diverse benchmarks. To facilitate community research, we further provide an interactive platform for graph-based data selection and retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出WoW（World Knowledge）大规模中英文教育数据集，以教育知识图谱为分类骨架系统采集并补全各学段缺失模块，具备更强系统性、更高质量、更大规模，并引入多模态信号，支持基础模型全周期训练；实验显示其在多类基准上显著提升模型性能，并提供基于图谱的交互式数据选择与检索平台。
AI.motivation: 现有中文教育语料存在覆盖碎片化、缺乏系统组织的问题，难以支撑基础模型从预训练到后续各阶段的完整训练需求。
AI.method: 以教育知识图谱作为分类学主干，系统性地按学段与知识模块采集数据并补全缺失内容；相较前版本在系统性、质量与规模上做迭代提升，并纳入多模态信号，构建覆盖模型开发全阶段的数据集；同时搭建基于图谱的交互式数据选择与检索平台。
AI.result: 在多样化基准测试中，使用WoW训练的模型性能获得显著提升；数据集在系统性、质量与规模上均优于先前版本。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱驱动的构建方式可有效缓解教育语料碎片化问题，WoW可作为基础模型全周期训练的系统化教育资源，并通过交互平台促进社区研究。

title: SIGMO: Sigmoid Gated Interaction-Aware Motion Planning
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicle technologies, reliable navigation within cluttered environments remains arduous due to the necessity of interaction-aware strategies; example scenarios include: narrow passages with multiple agents, lane changing in dense traffic, and crossing unsignalized intersections. These scenarios often require highly proactive strategies, simultaneously demanding interpretability and quick adaptability, which challenge end-to-end and data-driven methods. An effective strategy requires: scalability to multiple agents, adaptability to changes in other agents' behavior, and harmony with surrounding traffic without freezing or becoming overly conservative. To meet these requirements, we present SIGMO, a sigmoid-gated interaction-aware motion planner, with two main contributions. First, we formulate polynomial sigmoid functions that analytically estimate yield scores of surrounding agents using physics-grounded interaction features that capture driving intuitions. Second, we integrate the polynomial sigmoid functions into a receding-horizon planner, which facilitates interaction-aware planning with arbitrary trajectory predictions. We validate SIGMO in interaction-intensive simulations and hardware experiments. The results show that SIGMO balances proactive and defensive behavior while remaining computationally lightweight, serving as a strong baseline in a mobility stack. The simulation and hardware experiment videos are available here: https://sites.google.com/view/sigmoid-polygate.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMO——一种基于多项式Sigmoid门控的交互感知运动规划器，利用物理启发的交互特征解析估计周围智能体的让行倾向，并嵌入滚动时域规划框架，实现轻量、主动且防御兼备的导航。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在复杂拥挤环境中的可靠导航仍困难，需交互感知策略（窄通道多智能体、密集车流换道、无信号交叉口）。此类场景要求高主动性与可解释性、快速适应性，而端到端与纯数据驱动方法难以胜任。理想策略需具备：对多智能体的可扩展性、对其他智能体行为变化的适应性、以及与周边交通的协调性（不僵停、不过度保守）。
AI.method: 1）构造多项式Sigmoid函数，基于物理推导的交互特征（编码驾驶直觉）解析估计周围智能体的yield scores（让行评分）；2）将该多项式Sigmoid函数集成到滚动时域（receding-horizon）规划器中，从而在任意轨迹预测下实现交互感知规划。
AI.result: 在交互密集的仿真与硬件实验中验证：SIGMO在主动与防御行为间取得平衡，计算开销低，可作为移动出行技术栈中的强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于解析Sigmoid让行评分建模的交互感知规划框架，能在保持可解释性与计算轻量的同时实现主动—防御平衡的复杂场景导航，适合作为通用规划栈的基线方案。

title: picoEmergencyNet : Attention-Enhanced Ultra-Small Deep Learning Model for Aerial Image Classification in Emergency Monitoring
comment: 6 pages, Appeared in IJCNN2026 C. Kyrkou, "picoEmergencyNet: Attention-Enhanced Ultra-Small Deep Learning Model for Aerial Image Classification in Emergency Monitoring," 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN), Maastricht, Netherlands, 2026, pp. 1-6
summary: Real-time disaster recognition from aerial imagery requires deep learning models that operate under strict memory, compute, and latency constraints. While recent approaches achieve high accuracy, their computational cost limits deployment on resource-constrained UAV platforms. This work introduces picoEmergencyNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for aerial image disaster classification. The proposed architecture combines depthwise dilated convolutions with efficient channel attention and channel shuffling to enable multi-scale feature extraction at minimal computational cost. picoEmergencyNet has 23k parameters and 7M FLOPs, requiring only 0.1 MB of model storage. Evaluated on the AIDER and AIDERv2 disaster datasets, it achieves up to 96.1% accuracy, matching or exceeding state-of-the-art lightweight models that are orders of magnitude larger. Deployment experiments on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin show that, without hardware-specific optimizations, picoEmergencyNet achieves 258 FPS on GPU and 46 FPS on CPU with a 7x lower activation memory footprint compared to competing models. These results demonstrate that careful architectural specialization, rather than model scaling, enables highly efficient and accurate TinyML-ready disaster recognition for real-time UAV-based emergency monitoring.

AI.tldr: picoEmergencyNet：面向UAV航拍灾害分类的超轻量CNN，仅23k参数、7M FLOPs、0.1MB存储，在AIDER/AIDERv2上最高96.1%准确率，Jetson AGX Orin上GPU 258 FPS、CPU 46 FPS，激活内存降低7倍。
AI.motivation: 实时航拍灾害识别需在严格内存、算力与延迟约束下运行，现有高精度方法计算开销大，难以部署于资源受限的UAV平台，因此需要从架构专门化而非模型缩放的角度提升效率。
AI.method: 提出picoEmergencyNet，将深度可分离空洞卷积与高效通道注意力、通道混洗（channel shuffling）相结合，以极低计算成本实现多尺度特征提取。
AI.result: 模型规模仅23k参数、7M FLOPs、0.1MB存储；在AIDER与AIDERv2上达到最高96.1%准确率，与规模大数个数量级的SOTA轻量模型持平或更优；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上无需硬件特定优化即达GPU 258 FPS、CPU 46 FPS，激活内存占用比对比模型低约7倍。
AI.conclusion: 精心的架构专门化设计（而非模型缩放）即可实现高效准确的TinyML级实时航拍灾害识别，适用于UAV应急监测部署。

title: Parallel Broyden Methods for Efficiently Evaluating Nonlinear State Space Models
summary: Nonlinear state space models are typically evaluated sequentially, limiting their ability to exploit modern parallel hardware. Recent work has shown that state space models can be evaluated in parallel by reformulating evaluation as a root-finding problem, which can be solved with a parallel form of Newton's method. However, exact Newton methods require expensive multiplication of dense Jacobian matrices, and quasi-Newton methods based on diagonal approximations, while more scalable, are often slow to converge because they neglect interactions across state dimensions. We introduce a novel quasi-Newton approach based on Broyden's method, which captures coupling terms with diagonal-plus-low-rank approximations to blocks of the Jacobian. We construct the approximations from trajectory secants, avoiding automatic differentiation while retaining the favorable scaling of diagonal approximations and remaining compatible with parallel scan through rank compression. We prove finite-step recovery of the exact trajectory under the compressed scan, and show that convergence is tracked by the compression error and by the block approximation error along the current trajectory error, rather than in spectral norm. Empirically, we show that our method is advantageous when interactions are approximately low rank or when Jacobian evaluation is expensive: on low-rank RNNs, parallel MCMC algorithms, and denoising diffusion models, it converges in fewer iterations than other quasi-Newton methods and is the fastest parallel method when Jacobian evaluation is expensive or state dimensions are large.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 Broyden 方法的块状“对角加低秩”拟牛顿法，用于非线性状态空间模型的并行求根式求解，在不依赖自动微分的前提下捕获状态维度间耦合，并保持与并行扫描（parallel scan）兼容。
AI.motivation: 非线性状态空间模型通常只能串行求值，难以利用现代并行硬件。已有工作把求值重构为求根问题并用并行 Newton 法求解，但精确 Newton 需对稠密 Jacobian 做昂贵乘法；基于对角近似的拟牛顿法虽可扩展，却忽略状态维度间耦合，收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 对 Jacobian 的各个块采用“对角加低秩”逼近，构造 Broyden 型拟牛顿更新；近似量由轨迹割线（trajectory secants）构造，避免自动微分；通过秩压缩使更新保持与 parallel scan 兼容，并维持对角近似的良好扩展性。
AI.result: 理论上证明压缩扫描下可有限步精确恢复真实轨迹；并证明收敛性由压缩误差以及块逼近误差在“沿当前轨迹误差方向”上的作用刻画，而非谱范数。实验上，在低秩 RNN、并行 MCMC 算法与去噪扩散模型上，迭代次数少于其他拟牛顿方法；当 Jacobian 求值昂贵或状态维度较大时，是速度最快的并行方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在交互近似低秩或 Jacobian 求值昂贵的场景下更具优势，在保持并行可扩展性的同时显著改善收敛速度，为非线性状态空间模型的并行求解提供了有效方案。

title: Nepali-English Code-Mixed Speech Recognition: Data Preparation and Adaptation of a Speech Foundation Model
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Code and model checkpoints: https://github.com/AI-Lab-Pvt-Ltd/nepali-codemixed-asr
summary: Nepali speakers regularly mix English words into conversation, but multilingual speech recognisers often struggle with language switches and the writing script used for English words. We study how to adapt SraVaani, a 449M-parameter hybrid TDT-CTC model, using a 172.8-hour corpus covering six Nepali speech domains. Its pretrained tokenizer does not support digits and several common symbols. Rather than replace it or discard these recordings, we generate Nepali and English readings for numbers and use zero-shot ASR output to select a plausible form. Full fine-tuning reduces test word error rate (WER) from 48.6% to 17.1%; a 12-epoch run reaches 16.3%, compared with 16.4% for fine-tuned Whisper large-v3-turbo. Freezing the encoder increases WER to 25.5%, while excluding numeric clips raises WER on numeric test speech from 14.3% to 21.3%. We also evaluate on FLEURS using both its original references and mixed-script alternatives. The comparison shows that transcription conventions explain part, but not all, of the out-of-domain performance loss.

AI.tldr: 该文研究如何用172.8小时、覆盖六个尼泊尔语领域的语料适配449M参数的混合TDT-CTC模型SraVaani，重点解决数字/符号词表缺失与英尼混说（code-switching）问题。全量微调将测试WER从48.6%降至17.1%（12轮达16.3%），与微调后的Whisper large-v3-turbo（16.4%）相当。
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔语使用者日常口语中频繁混入英语词，但多语种语音识别器在语码转换处及英语词的书写脚本选择（拉丁字母 vs 天城文）上表现不佳；同时SraVaani预训练分词器不支持数字及若干常用符号，若直接更换分词器或丢弃相关录音代价过大。
AI.method: 基于SraVaani（449M参数，TDT-CTC混合架构）进行域内微调。针对词表缺失问题，不替换分词器，而是为数字生成尼泊尔语与英语两种读法，并用零样本ASR输出挑选更合理的形式，从而保留含数字的录音。随后开展消融：全量微调、12轮训练、冻结编码器、剔除含数字样本；并在FLEURS上用原始参考与混合脚本替代参考两种标注进行域外评测。
AI.result: 全量微调将测试WER由48.6%降至17.1%，12轮训练进一步达到16.3%，略优于微调Whisper large-v3-turbo的16.4%。冻结编码器使WER升至25.5%，说明编码器适配是必要的；剔除含数字片段会使数字类测试语音的WER由14.3%恶化至21.3%，验证数字数据增强/保留策略有效。FLEURS域外评测显示，转写规范（脚本选择）差异只能解释部分而非全部域外性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 在受限词表条件下，通过"数字多读法生成+零样本选择"的数据侧方案可在不更换分词器的前提下有效适配多语混说ASR；编码器需参与微调，含数字样本不可省略。域外泛化差距不能仅归因于转写/脚本约定，模型层面仍有待改进的空间。

title: One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
summary: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10. The core of the solution is a single vision-language-action (VLA) model, one checkpoint for all 100 tasks, built on our 1st-place 2025 solution, which is based on $π_{0.5}$. On the 50 tasks shared with 2025, its Q rises from 0.260 to 0.371; across all 100 tasks it scores 0.392. Our main conclusion from 2025 was that the model was undertrained, so most of the 2026 work went into training the model for longer, optimizing some training parameters, making each training step slightly faster and reducing the gradient noise: a migration from 50 to 100 tasks (semantic stages built from the demonstrations' skill annotations, task and stage embeddings of new tasks warm-started from similar old ones, and a 21-dimensional action space matching the teleoperation controls); variance-reduced multi-sample flow matching with a simple noise-vs-compute model that picks the number of action-expert samples per observation without ablations; and a 200k-step training run, about one pass over the 211M frames of the demonstrations. A cloud evaluation infrastructure keeps a shared record with provenance, episode diagnostics and restorable simulator states, and runs six simulators on one GPU together faster than real time. On top of the learned policy, 14 tasks are routed to a GPT-6 Astra coding agent that controls the robot through observation and motion tools, starting every episode from a frozen copy of its own practice session on training instances. Across these 14 tasks, Astra's mean Q is 0.639, against 0.108 for the learned policy. The public submission included only part of the Astra results and scored 0.446 Q with 27.3% full-task success.

AI.tldr: 该文为2026 BEHAVIOR挑战赛（OmniGibson仿真器中100项长时程家务任务）的技术报告。最终排行榜第9名，是前10中唯一独立团队。核心是单一VLA模型（一个checkpoint覆盖全部100个任务），基于2025年第1名的π0.5方案改进；与2025共享的50个任务上Q从0.260提升至0.371，全部100任务得分0.392。此外将14个任务路由给GPT-6 Astra编码智能体，其平均Q为0.639（学习策略为0.108）。公开提交仅含部分Astra结果，得分为0.446 Q、27.3%全任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 2025年的主要结论是模型训练不足（undertrained），因此2026年的工作重点是延长训练、优化训练参数以加快单步速度并降低梯度噪声；同时需要把系统从50个任务扩展到100个任务。
AI.method: 1) 在π0.5基础上构建单一VLA，一个checkpoint覆盖100个任务；2) 任务迁移策略：基于示范的技能标注构建语义阶段，新任务的任务/阶段embedding由相似旧任务热启动，采用与遥操作控件匹配的21维动作空间；3) 采用方差缩减的多样本flow matching，配合简单的"噪声-算力"模型，在无消融的情况下自动选择每个观测的动作专家采样数；4) 进行200k步训练，约相当于对2.11亿帧示范数据过一遍；5) 云端评测基础设施：共享带来源记录的日志、episode诊断与可恢复的仿真状态，可在单GPU上并行运行6个仿真器且快于实时；6) 14个任务路由至由观察与运动工具操控机器人的GPT-6 Astra编码智能体，每个episode从其在训练实例上练习会话的冻结副本开始。
AI.result: 与2025共享的50个任务上Q由0.260升至0.371；全部100个任务得分0.392。被路由的14个任务上，Astra平均Q为0.639，学习策略仅为0.108。公开提交（仅含部分Astra结果）得分0.446 Q，全任务成功率27.3%，最终排行榜第9名。
AI.conclusion: 延长训练与降低梯度噪声是提升VLA长时程任务性能的有效路径；将困难的、可工具化操作的任务交由编码智能体（Astra）处理可显著超过端到端学习策略的Q值，表明混合（学习策略+智能体路由）方案在长时程家务任务上具有明显优势。

title: Predicting Single-Cell Spatial Gene Expression from H&E using Pathology Foundation Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact. Project page: https://he2sc-st.github.io/
summary: Predicting gene expression directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images offers a scalable and cost-effective approach to deriving spatial molecular insights from routine histology. Pathology foundation models, typically pretrained using tile-level objectives, may not adequately capture the fine-grained cellular features required for single-cell molecular prediction. In this work, we systematically evaluate and establish domain-informed and task-specific strategies for adapting pathology foundation models to single-cell spatial gene expression prediction. Using paired H&E and Xenium 5K data, our approach improves mean gene-wise Pearson correlation by 2.67x over the standard zero-shot baseline and achieves state-of-the-art performance on this task. We demonstrate strong gene-detection performance across the full gene panel (AUROC = 0.800) and importantly identify that predictive performance varies substantially across biological contexts, with our model achieving its highest Pearson correlation for spatially variable genes (r = 0.643). Our findings demonstrate that, despite the challenges of sparse single-cell measurements, H&E-derived representations can recover biologically meaningful spatial expression patterns, highlighting both the opportunities and limitations of morphology-based molecular inference at cellular resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估并建立了面向单细胞空间基因表达预测的病理基础模型适配策略，在配对H&E与Xenium 5K数据上将平均基因级Pearson相关提升至零样本基线的2.67倍，达到该任务SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从常规H&E图像直接预测基因表达可从常规组织学中低成本、可扩展地获取空间分子信息。但病理基础模型多采用tile级目标预训练，可能难以捕捉单细胞分子预测所需的细粒度细胞特征，如何有效适配尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 基于配对的H&E与Xenium 5K数据，系统评估并构建领域先验驱动（domain-informed）与任务特定（task-specific）的病理基础模型适配策略，用于单细胞空间基因表达预测。
AI.result: 相较标准零样本基线，平均基因级Pearson相关提升2.67倍，达到该任务SOTA；全基因panel基因检测AUROC=0.800；预测性能随生物学情境显著变化，空间可变基因上相关性最高（r=0.643）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管单细胞测量稀疏带来挑战，H&E衍生表征仍能恢复具有生物学意义的空间表达模式，同时揭示了细胞分辨率下基于形态学推断分子的潜力与局限。

title: The RSI Tax: When Recursive Self-Improvement Is Not Worth the Cost
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to improve an agent using its own task experience. Its practical value depends on whether performance gains justify the full cost of self-improvement and task execution. We evaluate this trade-off on continual task streams, scoring each task before its feedback is used for subsequent updates. We define the \emph{RSI Tax} as the token cost of the self-improvement process and include it alongside task-execution costs in end-to-end evaluation. Across six methods and two language models, a bounded-note baseline matches or exceeds the observed accuracy of Meta-Harness, EvoSkill, and RRSI, with mean total-token savings of 65.6-71.0\%. We decompose the RSI Tax into verification, exploration, and writing costs, and track subsequent use of the associated state or artifact. For these three RSI methods, verification accounts for 74.8--93.6% of the aggregate RSI Tax. A substantial share of the RSI Tax is also associated with states or artifacts that are not used later in the evaluated streams. These results expose a practical limitation of costly RSI procedures: improvements in the deployed agent need not justify the expense of the improvement process. They motivate RSI objectives that jointly optimize the RSI Tax and expected task-execution cost while ensuring continued growth in agent capabilities across the task stream.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"RSI Tax"（自改进纳税成本）指标，将自改进过程的token成本与任务执行成本合并进入端到端评估。在持续任务流上比较6种方法、2个语言模型发现：有界笔记（bounded-note）基线达到或超过Meta-Harness、EvoSkill、RRSI的准确率，同时节省65.6–71.0%的总token。RSI成本中验证环节占74.8–93.6%，且大量成本产生于后续未被使用的状态/产物，说明昂贵自改进的收益未必能抵消其开销。
AI.motivation: 递归自改进（RSI）用智能体自身任务经验提升自身能力，其实际价值取决于性能增益能否抵偿自改进与任务执行的完整成本。现有工作多只报告能力提升，缺少将自改进开销纳入端到端成本的评估，因而无法判断RSI是否"划算"。
AI.method: 在持续任务流（continual task streams）上评估，每项任务在反馈被用于后续更新之前先评分，避免信息泄漏。定义RSI Tax为自改进过程的token成本，并与任务执行成本一并计入端到端评估。对比6种方法与2个语言模型；以有界笔记（bounded-note）基线对照Meta-Harness、EvoSkill、RRSI三种RSI方法；进一步将RSI Tax分解为验证（verification）、探索（exploration）、撰写（writing）三类成本，并追踪相关状态或产物在后续任务中的实际使用情况。
AI.result: 有界笔记基线的准确率与Meta-Harness、EvoSkill、RRSI持平或更高，平均总token节省65.6–71.0%。对三种RSI方法，验证成本占RSI Tax总量的74.8–93.6%；相当比例的RSI Tax对应后续任务流中未被使用的状态或产物，即存在明显的无效开销。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示昂贵RSI流程的实际局限：部署智能体的性能提升不一定能合理化改进过程的支出。应设计同时优化RSI Tax与期望任务执行成本、并保证智能体能力在任务流上持续增长的自改进目标。

title: Agent Benchmarks Stop Ranking Before They Run Out of Tasks
summary: Data-science and ML-engineering agents are evaluated on benchmarks such as MLE-bench, ALE-Bench, SWE-fficiency and AlgoTune, whose tasks yield a quantity (a Kaggle metric, contest score or speedup). When one stops separating the best models, the usual remedy is a harder version. Re-scoring released runs of eight benchmarks, including SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench for breadth, we find much of this saturation lies in the measurement, not the tasks. Most agent benchmarks reduce a run to one pass/fail bit, which fails in two ways. It is too coarse: neighbouring top-ten agents on SWE-bench Verified differ by less than its tests' errors, and correcting them reorders neighbours no more than deleting a random sixth of each agent's passes. It is capped at the reference: ALE-Bench's top ten, separated by contest score, tie when graded against the median human, although nearly half the runs beat that human. On fixed tasks, a higher bar only moves the problem; graded credit fixes it. We derive a clipped log-ratio score with dated anchors and cost as a separate axis. In a Terminal-Bench re-run, pass/fail-tied models differ over tenfold on the quantity the tests discard.

AI.tldr: 本文指出数据科学与ML工程类智能体基准的"饱和"主要源于测量方式而非任务本身（单一位 pass/fail 结果过于粗糙、以参考值为上限）。作者的标定分析表明，相邻顶尖智能体的差距小于测试误差，且修正测试错误后排名变化有限；ALE-Bench 中按竞赛分数排名前十的模型若以人类中位数为基准则互相并列。作者据此提出以带日期锚点的截断对数比值分数作为主要度量，并将成本作为独立维度。
AI.motivation: MLE-bench、ALE-Bench、SWE-fficiency、AlgoTune 等基准的任务输出的是连续量（Kaggle 指标、竞赛分数、加速比），但现有评估多将一次运行压缩为单个 pass/fail 位。当这种粒度无法区分最强模型时，常见做法是构造更难版本；本文怀疑饱和其实是度量造成的假象而非任务本身缺乏区分度，因此需要系统检验测量误差与评分设计。
AI.method: 1) 对八个基准（含 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 以覆盖广度）已发布运行结果进行重新打分；2) 估计测试误差，并将相邻顶尖智能体的分数差与之比较；3) 通过删除每个智能体约六分之一随机通过样本的扰动实验，检验"修正测试错误"对排名稳定性的影响；4) 在固定任务上比较相对人类中位数与相对参考上限的评分差异；5) 提出带日期锚点的截断对数比值（clipped log-ratio）评分，并把成本设为独立评分轴；6) 在 Terminal-Bench 重跑中验证被 pass/fail 判定为并列的模型在连续量上的差异。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，相邻的前十名智能体之间的差距小于其测试所对应的误差，且修正这些误差所导致的邻位重排，不多于随机删除每个智能体六分之一通过样本所带来的重排。ALE-Bench 中按竞赛分数区分的前十名，在相对人类中位数评分时出现并列，但近一半运行实际超过了该人类水平。Terminal-Bench 重跑显示，pass/fail 判为并列的模型在测试所丢弃的连续量上相差十倍以上。八个基准的重打分结果一致表明饱和主要来自度量。
AI.conclusion: 在固定任务集上，单纯提高通过门槛只会把问题转移到别处，而分级（graded）评分才能真正解决问题。评估设计应采用带有日期锚点的截断对数比值分数，以保留连续成绩信息并支持跨时间可比性；同时不应把成本折入单一总分，而应将其作为独立评分轴。该框架使已发布运行结果能够被重新利用，并为数据科学与ML工程智能体提供更具区分度与稳健性的评估。

title: TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Preventing human error in physical assembly tasks requires assistance systems that can intervene before mistakes are made. This is especially challenging in settings where users are free to choose the construction order and correctness depends on the evolving assembly rather than a fixed next step. We present TanCRAFT, a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system that tracks the scene state, reasons about the current partial assembly, forecasts the near-future motion of manipulated pieces, and intervenes when the predicted placement is incompatible with the target. We instantiate our framework and confirm its effectiveness in a controlled tangram assembly task through offline benchmarks and a within-subject user study. Our findings show that the predictive feedback significantly reduces mistakes relative to unguided and reactive sessions, while yielding the lowest mean perceived workload and shortest mean completion time. Overall, these results demonstrate the value of predictive feedback for error prevention and provide a step toward cost-aware assistance for automation and human-robot workcells.

AI.tldr: 提出TanCRAFT四阶段实时预测式辅助系统，通过跟踪场景状态、推理当前部分装配、预测部件近未来运动并在预测放置与目标不兼容时介入，在七巧板装配任务中验证其可显著减少错误并降低工作负荷、缩短完成时间。
AI.motivation: 物理装配中人为错误成本高，需要在错误发生前干预；但用户可自由选择装配顺序、正确性取决于不断演化的装配状态而非固定下一步，使传统逐步指导式辅助难以适用。
AI.method: 提出TanCRAFT四阶段框架：(1)跟踪场景状态；(2)对当前部分装配进行推理；(3)预测被操作部件的近未来运动；(4)当预测放置与目标不兼容时进行干预。以受控七巧板装配任务为实例，采用离线基准测试与被试内用户研究评估。
AI.result: 预测式反馈相较无引导与反应式（reactive）条件显著减少错误，同时具有最低的平均主观工作负荷与最短的平均完成时间。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明预测式反馈对错误预防具有价值，并为面向自动化与人-机器人工作单元的成本感知辅助（cost-aware assistance）奠定基础。

title: EgoHMP: Achieving Precise Human Motion Prediction in 3D Scenes via Egocentric Cues
summary: The complex interactive dependencies between human behavior and 3D scenes make accurately predicting human intent a major challenge for human motion prediction (HMP). While recent studies use human gaze to infer intent, gaze signals suffer from ambiguity, drift, and a reliance on eye-tracking hardware. Research in cognitive science indicates that egocentric views inherently encode potential interactions, while head motion serves as a crucial precursor in motion planning. Motivated by this, we propose EgoHMP, a novel framework that uses egocentric views and head motions as robust carriers of interaction intent. By translating this intent into an envisioning of future interactions, EgoHMP achieves precise HMP in 3D scenes. EgoHMP first employs a vision-motion alignment encoder to align the visual and motion feature spaces. Based on these aligned features, an egocentric intent predictor with a modality-aware modulation mechanism adaptively suppresses invalid interaction cues to predict an accurate interaction probability map. Furthermore, to enhance the stability and realism of the generated motions, we propose a contact-aware motion decoder. Specifically, inspired by the human cognitive process of planning trajectories prior to action execution, we first predict a global trajectory to serve as a self-prompt, effectively mitigating the optimization conflict in diffusion models. Subsequently, we introduce a multi-stage denoiser, which relieves motion artifacts by incorporating human contact modeling through a multi-stage optimization strategy. Finally, a GCN-based motion decoder is employed to synthesize physically plausible and semantically consistent motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoHMP achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoHMP框架，以第一视角图像与头部运动作为交互意图的稳健载体，通过"预测交互意图—规划全局轨迹—接触感知多阶段去噪—GCN解码"的流程，实现3D场景中精确且物理合理的人体运动预测，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 人体行为与3D场景之间存在复杂的交互依赖，使人体运动预测（HMP）中的意图推断十分困难。已有方法借助人眼注视（gaze）推断意图，但注视信号存在歧义大、漂移、依赖眼动追踪硬件等问题。认知科学表明，第一视角（egocentric）视图天然编码潜在交互，且头部运动是运动规划的重要先导信号，因此可替代gaze作为更稳健的意图载体。
AI.method: 1）视觉-运动对齐编码器，将第一视角视觉特征与头部运动特征映射到统一特征空间；2）第一视角意图预测器，配以模态感知调制机制，自适应抑制无效交互线索，输出交互概率图；3）接触感知运动解码器：先预测全局轨迹作为self-prompt以缓解扩散模型的优化冲突，再引入多阶段去噪器并结合人体接触建模以抑制运动伪影；4）基于GCN的运动解码器，合成物理合理、语义一致的运动序列。
AI.result: 大量实验结果表明EgoHMP达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 第一视角视觉与头部运动可作为交互意图的有效且稳健的表示，将意图"外化"为对未来交互的构想，并结合轨迹自提示、接触感知去噪与图卷积解码，可显著提升3D场景下人体运动预测的准确性与真实感。

title: Beyond the Log-Linear Frontier: Pre-Asymptotic Analysis of Finite-Budget Neural Scaling Laws
summary: Classical neural scaling laws model excess risk as a separable power law in model capacity $N$ and dataset size $D$. At finite budgets, however, empirical learning curves and compute-optimal allocations depart from this log-linear frontier. This paper analyzes how spectral and domain heterogeneity govern these finite-scale departures. Along the capacity axis, Mellin--Barnes analysis of covariance resolvents yields a three-term expansion where competing spectral and regularization modes produce finite-scale curvature and logarithmic transitions. Because fitting multiple power laws on narrow pilot grids is ill-conditioned, we eliminate the loss floor via first-order Aitken differencing to obtain a well-conditioned closed-form initializer. Along the data axis, KKT duality reduces $K$-domain mixing to scalar water-filling, yielding finite-budget bottleneck bounds, an online sampling curriculum, and a simplex Hessian metric for cross-domain transfer. Along the iso-compute frontier $C=6ND$, we prove that the optimal allocation exponent drifts in proportion to capacity and data exponent variances, while Schur-complement reduction separates intrinsic drift from frozen-hyperparameter bias. Across 45 operator spectra, Pythia (70M--12B), Chinchilla (245 runs), and RegMix (17 domains), our estimators achieve $5.89\%$ holdout MAPE, cut high-compute allocation regret by up to $76.4\%$, and reduce cross-scale mixture RMSE by $59.4\%$ with zero selection regret.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限规模下神经缩放定律的偏离机制，从谱异质性与领域异质性两个维度给出三阶展开、水填充与等算力漂移理论，并在45种算子谱、Pythia、Chinchilla、RegMix上验证估计精度与分配收益。
AI.motivation: 经典缩放定律将超额风险建模为模型容量N与数据量D的可分离幂律，但在有限预算下经验学习曲线与算力最优分配明显偏离该对数线性前沿，需要刻画这种有限尺度偏离的成因与结构。
AI.method: 容量轴：对协方差预解式做Mellin–Barnes分析，得到含竞争谱模式与正则模式的三项展开，产生有限尺度曲率与对数转变；用一阶Aitken差分消除损失下限，得到良态闭式初始化。数据轴：KKT对偶将K领域混合化为标量水填充，给出有限预算瓶颈界、在线采样课程与单纯形Hessian度量。在等算力前沿C=6ND上证明最优分配指数按容量与数据指数方差成比例漂移，并用Schur补分离内在漂移与冻结超参偏置。
AI.result: 在45种算子谱、Pythia(70M–12B)、Chinchilla(245次运行)与RegMix(17领域)上，估计器取得5.89%留出集MAPE，高算力分配遗憾最多降低76.4%，跨尺度混合RMSE降低59.4%且选择遗憾为零。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺度偏离可由谱模式竞争与领域异质性定量解释；所提估计与分配框架在拟合精度、算力分配效率与跨尺度混合迁移上均显著优于基线，为实际有限预算下的缩放律外推与数据配比提供可计算的理论与工具。

title: Darmok: Championship Cryptic Crossword Solving via Constraint Tightening and Resilient Orchestration
summary:
We present Darmok, the first automated system to reach superhuman performance on British cryptic crosswords. Unlike American-style crosswords, cryptic clues disguise an unmarked definition and compositional wordplay beneath a misleading surface reading, sparse grids leave nearly half of each word's letters unchecked, and tournament rules rank a grid with even a single wrong or blank square behind all error-free solutions regardless of speed. Competing alongside an elite human field at the 55th Times Crossword Championship in London, Darmok solved all seven championship puzzles error-free and finished faster than every human competitor in every round. It solved the Final puzzle in 6m 52s, a full 3m 13s ahead of the human champion.
  Today's frontier AI models can on average solve a whole puzzle in a single try with comparable accuracy and speed. However, cloud API calls still stall, time out, trigger safety refusals, or get stuck in reasoning loops. To simultaneously achieve tournament-grade accuracy, speed, and reliability, Darmok cross-checks clues across three independent models in rounds; uses verified crossing letters to unlock harder clues; and uses a whole-puzzle model and dictionary lookups to fill any remaining gaps without overwriting confirmed words. This design maintained near-zero-error performance across a five-month daily evaluation period. Under normal benchmark conditions, removing backup models, fallback steps, or elaborate prompt instructions barely changes accuracy, making the architecture appear over-engineered. Yet during both the worst days of daily operation and a severe slowdown of our primary model in the live Championship Final, the backup paths carried the solve, showing that as foundation models master the average case, the central challenge in building complex AI systems shifts to resilience in the worst case.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍Darmok——首个在英国式隐晦填字游戏（cryptic crossword）上达到超人类水平的自动化系统：在伦敦第55届《泰晤士报》填字锦标赛中零错误完成全部7道赛题，且每轮均快于所有人类选手，决赛用时6分52秒，领先人类冠军3分13秒。核心论点是：当基础模型已掌握"平均情况"时，构建复杂AI系统的关键挑战已转向"最坏情况"下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿AI模型虽能在单次尝试中以相近的准确率和速度解出整道谜题，但云API调用仍会出现卡顿、超时、安全拒答或陷入推理循环等故障。而锦标赛规则要求：只要有一个格子填错或留空，整张网格的排名便落后于所有无误解，且隐晦填字本身具有定义隐藏、文字游戏与误导性表层语义叠加、稀疏网格导致近半数交叉字母无法校验等难点。因此，仅靠单一模型的"平均表现"不足以满足"锦标赛级"的准确率、速度与可靠性要求。
AI.method: Darmok采用多模型分层校验架构：(1) 三轮交叉校验——在多个轮次中由三个独立模型对线索互相核对，取共识；(2) 已验证交叉字母解锁难线索——利用已确认的交叉字母作为约束，辅助求解更难线索；(3) 全谜题模型与词典查询兜底——仅用于填补剩余空缺，且绝不覆盖已确认词条，从而保证不引入新错误。系统同时具备备用模型、回退步骤与精细提示指令等冗余设计。
AI.result: 在锦标赛实战中，Darmok零错误解出全部7题，每轮均快于所有人类选手，决赛6分52秒、领先冠军3分13秒。在为期五个月的每日评测中保持近零错误。消融实验显示：在常规基准条件下，移除备用模型、回退步骤或复杂提示指令几乎不影响准确率，使该架构看似"过度设计"；但在每日运行的最差日子，以及锦标赛决赛中主模型严重降速时，备用路径成功接管并完成求解。
AI.conclusion: 隐晦填字可作为检验AI系统级鲁棒性的严苛测试平台。论文的主要启示是：随着基础模型对平均情况的掌握日益充分，冗余与回退等"看似过度工程"的设计在基准测试中难以体现价值，却恰恰在最坏情况下决定系统成败；因此构建复杂AI系统的核心挑战正从平均性能转向最坏情况的韧性。

title: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
summary: Memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies are meant to remember what happened. Many of them, however, fill memory by time: they sample frames uniformly across the episode and stamp each frame with its time step. Because time passes even when nothing happens, such a memory may not tell waiting from working. We show that it does not. On the counting tasks of RoboMME, we make the robot briefly pause or fidget its wrist. Such a null event changes nothing the task depends on, yet a released memory VLA counts the interval as work done and stops early. We call this failure phantom progress. It cuts success from 47 to 16 of 50 on one task and from 44 to 10 on the other. When the same frames are withheld from memory, success returns, so the cause lies in memory rather than in the interruption itself. We trace the failure to a temporal shortcut: because demonstrations proceed at a steady pace, elapsed time predicts progress. Indeed, rescaling the time stamps alone makes the policy stop early when the clock runs fast and repeat when it runs slow. Surprisingly, removing the time encoding does not cure the failure, because the frames of a null event still occupy slots of the time-sampled memory. Across RoboMME's released designs, vulnerability follows how memory is indexed. Of the fixes the diagnosis suggests, training with injected pauses does not remove the failure and impairs counting, whereas indexing memory by events recovers half or more of the loss without retraining. A memory meant to remember what happened should count events rather than clock ticks.

AI.tldr: 记忆增强VLA策略按时间均匀采样帧并打时间戳的"时间索引"记忆，会让机器人把空事件（停顿/空转）误判为任务进展，产生"幻影进展"而提前终止；改为按事件索引记忆可在不重训的情况下挽回至少一半的性能损失。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强VLA以时间为轴建记忆（均匀采样帧+时间步标记），但"时间流逝"并不等于"任务在推进"。作者试图验证这种以时钟刻度索引的记忆是否会混淆"等待"与"工作"，并定位其失效机制。
AI.method: 在RoboMME的计数任务上引入null event扰动（短暂停顿或腕部小幅抖动），这些扰动不改变任务依赖的任何要素；对比"保留该段帧入记忆"与"将同样帧从记忆中剔除"两种条件；再做时间戳重缩放实验与去除时间编码实验；并跨RoboMME已发布的多套记忆设计，考察脆弱性与记忆索引方式的关系；最后比较两类修复：注入停顿的训练 vs. 事件索引记忆。
AI.result: null event使某计数任务成功率从47/50降至16/50，另一任务从44/50降至10/50；剔除同样帧后性能恢复，说明成因在记忆而非中断本身。仅重缩放时间戳即可复现失败（时钟走快则提前停止，走慢则重复动作）；去除时间编码并不能修复，因为null event的帧仍占用时间采样的记忆槽位。脆弱性与记忆索引方式相关；注入停顿的训练无法消除失败且损害计数能力，事件索引记忆无需重训即挽回至少一半损失。
AI.conclusion: 失败根因是"时间可预测进度"的时间捷径与按时间索引的记忆槽位分配，而非时间编码本身。意在"记住发生过什么"的记忆应按事件计数而非时钟刻度索引。

title: CJRR-Net: A Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking for Future-View Selection in Human Pose Estimation
comment: 10pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026)
summary: Multi-camera systems support performance recording, sports and human-movement analysis, where selecting an informative viewpoint is important for reliable human pose estimation. We propose the Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking Network (CJRR-Net) for future-view selection among eight calibrated cameras in MPI-INF-3DHP. The model combines current-view pose observations, camera configuration, and candidate-specific geometric features obtained by reprojecting the estimated 3D pose and its uncertainty into each candidate view. CJRR-Net achieves a selected-view 2D mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) of 105.18 pixels, compared with 114.64 pixels for the shared-input MLP and 117.56 pixels for adapted PoseErrNet. It also achieves the lowest mean error among the listed policies in each evaluated occlusion group. A blender rollout illustrates repeated camera selection. These findings support candidate-specific geometry for single-view selection in the evaluated fixed eight-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 提出CJRR-Net，在8相机标定场景下为人体姿态估计选择信息量最大的候选视角，重投影几何特征带来更低的2D MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 多相机系统用于表演记录、运动与人体动作分析，选取信息量丰富的视角对可靠的人体姿态估计至关重要；现有视角选择方法多依赖共享输入，未充分利用候选视角特有的几何信息。
AI.method: 在MPI-INF-3DHP的8个已标定相机间做未来视角选择。模型融合三类输入：当前视角的姿态观测、相机配置，以及将估计的3D姿态及其不确定性重投影到各候选视角所得到的候选专属几何特征，构成Candidate-Joint Reprojection Ranking Network进行候选排序。
AI.result: 所选视角的2D MPJPE为105.18像素，优于共享输入MLP（114.64像素）与改进版PoseErrNet（117.56像素）；在各评估遮挡分组中均取得所列策略的最低平均误差；并用blender rollout演示了多次连续相机选择。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明候选专属几何特征对单视角选择有效，但结论限于所评估的固定8相机设定。

title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
summary: Catalysis underpins chemical manufacturing, yet knowledge for catalyst design remains dispersed across experimental observations, computational data and catalysis subdisciplines. To overcome this challenge, we present Composable Catalytic Intelligence (CatAI), a physics-grounded modular AI framework that learns 1.8 million structure-property relations and organizes them into 30 physicochemical encoders. This reusable intermediate layer enables task-specific models to guide catalyst discovery for targeted reactions and objectives. Across benchmark tasks, CatAI achieves a 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than the next-best models. In experimental validation, CatAI identified a new confined-passable pocket catalyst applicable in industrial homogeneous polymer synthesis with 9 times the activity of the commercial benchmark. In parallel, it guided autonomous closed-loop optimization of a highly active Cu-based geminal-atom photocatalyst for C-O coupling reactions surpassing the traditional Ni-based systems. This approach connects property-level data to catalytic objectives, supporting physicochemical knowledge reuse across mechanistically distinct systems through computational screening and iterative model-experiment feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可组合催化智能框架CatAI，将180万条结构-性质关系组织为30个物理化学编码器，实现跨任务知识复用，在基准任务上预测误差降低7.8%，并实验验证了活性达商业基准9倍的限域均相聚合催化剂及高效的Cu基偕原子光催化剂。
AI.motivation: 催化剂设计知识分散于实验观测、计算数据与各催化分支学科中，缺乏统一、可复用的知识表征方式，制约了数据驱动催化剂发现的效率与迁移能力。
AI.method: 构建物理启发的模块化AI框架CatAI：学习180万条结构-性质关系，并组织为30个物理化学编码器，形成可复用的中间层；在此基础上由任务特定模型指导目标反应的催化剂发现，并结合计算筛选与模型-实验迭代反馈闭环。
AI.result: 基准任务上任务平均预测误差比次优模型低7.8%；实验验证发现一种可用于工业均相聚合、活性为商业基准9倍的新型可穿越限域口袋催化剂；并指导Cu基偕原子光催化剂用于C-O偶联的自主闭环优化，性能超越传统Ni基体系。
AI.conclusion: CatAI将性质级数据与催化目标相连接，实现跨机理迥异体系的物理化学知识复用，并通过计算筛选与迭代实验反馈支撑催化剂发现。

title: Benchmarking Vendor-Guided Optimizations on Edge NPUs: From NPU Only to End-to-End Performance. Extended technical report
summary: Edge NPU performance depends not only on hardware capabilities, but also on model transformation and the overall deployment pipeline. We propose a benchmarking methodology that separates these effects by comparing three configurations: Baseline, Vendor Guided NPU Only (VG-NPU), and Vendor Guided End-to-End (VG-E2E), where VG-NPU preserves common model I/O and host-side processing while VG-E2E follows the vendor-native deployment pipeline. We apply this methodology to four edge NPUs and three vision workloads. VG-NPU improves both accuracy and Runtime-call latency in 10 of 12 NPU--workload combinations, whereas VG-E2E reduces System-level latency in all combinations but improves accuracy in only four. Moreover, NPU-level performance rankings do not always match End-to-End rankings, and VG-E2E provides an additional 10.4--70.7\% reduction in System-level latency over VG-NPU. These results demonstrate the importance of evaluating vendor-guided optimization separately at the controlled model-transformation and full deployment levels when comparing heterogeneous commercial Edge NPU platforms in practice.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种将硬件能力、模型变换与部署流水线效应分离的边缘NPU基准测试方法，通过Baseline、VG-NPU、VG-E2E三种配置在4款边缘NPU与3个视觉任务上评测，发现NPU级排名与端到端排名不一致，且厂商引导优化在精度与延迟上的收益需分层评估。
AI.motivation: 边缘NPU实际性能不仅取决于硬件本身，还受模型变换与整体部署流水线影响；现有基准往往混淆这些因素，导致在异构商用边缘NPU平台间比较时难以判断性能差异来源，因此需要一种能区分各影响层级的评测方法。
AI.method: 提出三配置对照的基准测试方法：Baseline（基线）；VG-NPU（仅采用厂商引导的NPU侧优化，同时保留通用模型I/O与主机端处理，以控制模型变换这一变量）；VG-E2E（遵循厂商原生端到端部署流水线）。在4款边缘NPU与3个视觉负载（共12种组合）上实施，分别测量精度、Runtime-call延迟与System-level延迟。
AI.result: VG-NPU在12个NPU–负载组合中的10个上同时提升了精度与Runtime-call延迟；VG-E2E在全部组合上降低System-level延迟，但仅在4个组合上提升精度；相对VG-NPU，VG-E2E额外带来10.4–70.7%的System-level延迟下降；NPU级别的性能排名并不总与端到端排名一致。
AI.conclusion: 评估厂商引导优化应分为受控的模型变换层与完整部署层两个层级进行；仅看端到端或仅看NPU级指标会导致对异构商用边缘NPU平台的误判，分层评测更能反映实际部署中的真实性能与精度权衡。

title: Hint, Not Hole: Localization-Robust Video Overlay Removal
summary: Video overlay removal recovers the scene beneath burned-in subtitles, karaoke lyrics, titles, credits, logos and watermarks. Generative video models now fill a known region convincingly, but in practice the region comes from a detector or a segmenter, and it is wrong in both directions: it misses strokes, halos, whole frames and whole objects, and it covers background between characters, around boxes and on genuine scene text. Erasers that treat the mask as a hole, regenerating inside and copying outside, inherit every one of these errors. We present HintErase, which treats localization as a hint, not a hole. The model sees the full, unmasked video together with a hint channel; during training the hint is corrupted the way real localizers fail, while supervision follows the true overlay. The result is a single model that removes overlay the hint missed, keeps background the hint wrongly covered, and is trained to keep genuine scene text even when the hint lands on it. For full-length releases, a streaming pipeline handles interlaced sources, shot cuts, missed and jittering hints, paste-back and audio, with memory independent of the length of the video. This report describes the approach, the pipeline that turns it into full-length deliveries, and qualitative results; video results, with input, hint and output side by side, are on the project page.

AI.tldr: 提出 HintErase，将视频内嵌文字/水印的定位掩码视为"提示"而非"待填补的洞"，在训练中按真实定位器的失败方式腐蚀提示，实现单一模型即可去除漏检的叠加内容、保留误覆盖的背景与真实场景文字，并配套可处理隔行扫描、镜头切换、提示抖动、贴回与音频的流式全片管线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频模型虽能对已知区域进行可信填补，但该区域实际来自检测器或分割器，误差双向存在：漏检笔画、光晕、整帧与整目标；同时误覆盖字符间背景、框周区域及真实场景文字。将掩码当作硬洞（洞内重建、洞外复制）的擦除器会继承上述全部错误。
AI.method: HintErase 以非掩码的完整视频加一路 hint 通道为输入；训练时按真实定位器的失效模式对 hint 施加腐蚀，而监督信号以真实叠加层为准。由此获得单一模型：补除 hint 漏检的叠加、还原 hint 误覆盖的背景、并在 hint 落在真实场景文字上时仍保留该文字。面向全片交付，设计流式管线处理隔行源、镜头切换、漏检与抖动提示、回贴与音频，显存占用与视频长度无关。
AI.result: 单一模型同时具备漏检去除、误覆盖背景恢复与真实场景文字保持三种能力；流式管线可实现全片交付且内存与时长解耦。论文以方法、管线与定性结果为主，视频结果（输入/提示/输出三栏对照）见项目主页，摘要中未给出定量指标。
AI.conclusion: 视频叠加层去除应从"掩码即洞"转向"掩码即提示"：通过模拟定位器误差的训练使模型对不完美定位具有鲁棒性，并以工程化流式管线支撑全片实际应用，为不依赖高精度掩码的视频擦除提供了可行范式。

title: Sanity Checks for Attention Surgery: Null Models and Matched Interventions for Representation-Motivated Design
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/Basavarajearlybird/SANITY-CHECKS-FOR-ATTENTION-SURGERY_Original (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24096410)
summary: Transformer architectural modifications frequently measure a statistic on internal representations, observe that it is large, remove it architecturally, and report an improvement. Interpreting that sequence requires evaluating whether the statistic exceeds its noise floor, whether it survives a geometric null, and whether the training gain requires the specific direction removed. We formulate these requirements as three reusable checks and apply them to self-attention removal, which deletes the component of an attention head's output aligned with its own value vector. Across nine multi-head pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M to 6.9B parameters), an earlier-position causal null accounts for 48% to 63% of the head-value cosine alignment, with no monotone scale trend. Under grouped-query attention, this alignment is specific to each head's own key-value group and reverses across groups (+0.24 to +0.27 within-group, -0.11 to -0.19 across-group). Split-half reliability demonstrates that the per-head intervention effect is resolvable in GPT-2 ($r_Δ= 0.80$) but attenuated in Pythia-160M (0.42) and Pythia-410M (0.53), whereas structural self-cosine reliability is near-perfect in all three ($r_{\text{stat}} > 0.99$); which statistic predicts its own intervention is model-dependent. In a pre-registered 3-arm by 8-seed paired factorial at $4.0 \times 10^8$ tokens per run (399,900,672 tokens), a fixed arbitrary rank-one direction does not differ from baseline (+0.0011 nats, $p = 0.197$), while self-directed removal lowers validation loss (-0.0029 nats, Holm-corrected $p = 0.0023$) and outperforms the fixed arbitrary control directly (-0.0040 nats, $p = 0.0018$). At 50.9M scale the training benefit requires the own-value direction rather than a fixed arbitrary one, but a large cosine alignment alone does not establish redundancy in frozen models.

AI.tldr: 将“测量统计量→发现其偏大→从架构中移除→报告性能提升”这一常见范式拆解为三项可复用检验（噪声下限、几何零假设、方向特异性），并以自注意力移除为案例进行系统验证。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构修改研究往往只凭内部表示上某统计量较大就推断其冗余并加以移除，却未排除该统计量可能源于平凡的结构性因素（如因果性导致的近邻相似），也未验证训练收益是否真的依赖被移除的那个特定方向。因此需要一个可复用的评判框架来区分“真实冗余”与“几何必然”。
AI.method: 提出三项检查：(1) 统计量是否超过噪声下限；(2) 能否在几何/因果零假设下复现；(3) 训练增益是否依赖被移除的特定方向。应用于“自注意力移除”——删除注意力头输出中与其自身value向量对齐的分量。在9个多头预训练模型（5,408个头，124M–6.9B参数）上测量head-value余弦对齐，构造前位因果零假设与分组查询注意力（GQA）组内/组外对比；用分半信度评估逐头干预效应的可分辨性；并进行预注册的3臂×8种子配对因子实验（每run 4.0×10^8 tokens，共399,900,672 tokens）。
AI.result: 前位因果零假设可解释48%–63%的head-value余弦对齐，且无单调规模趋势；GQA下对齐具有组特异性（组内+0.24~+0.27，组外−0.11~−0.19，符号反转）。分半信度显示逐头干预效应在GPT-2可分辨（r_Δ=0.80），在Pythia-160M（0.42）与Pythia-410M（0.53）被削弱，而结构自余弦几乎完美（r_stat>0.99），说明哪个统计量能预测其自身干预效应依赖于模型。预注册实验中，固定任意秩一方向与基线无差异（+0.0011 nats，p=0.197），自定向移除降低验证损失（−0.0029 nats，Holm校正p=0.0023），并显著优于固定任意对照（−0.0040 nats，p=0.0018）。
AI.conclusion: 在50.9M规模上，训练收益确实需要“自身value方向”而非任意固定方向，即方向特异性成立；但仅凭较大的余弦对齐并不能在冻结模型中确立冗余。架构修改研究应同时报告噪声下限、几何零假设与方向特异性检验，避免把平凡的几何必然误判为可移除的冗余。

title: Transformers Provably Learn Graph Search: Training Dynamics and the Exponential Power of Depth
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks, yet the mechanisms by which they acquire reasoning capabilities and the efficiency of their reasoning remain poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate the path-finding problem over directed graphs, a symbolic abstraction of multi-step reasoning. We first characterize the architectural requirements for this task, proving that one-layer transformers require $Ω(N^2)$ size on dense graphs to implement the key DFS child-selection primitive. While a two-layer transformer implements full DFS with $O(N\log(N))$ size. Thus, a second layer is necessary and sufficient for near-linear DFS reasoning. We then extend this expressivity analysis to deeper models: for every $k\geq3$, a $k$-layer transformer implements a bounded-reachability DFS policy with look-ahead horizon $1+2^{k-3}$, establishing an exponential increase in reachability horizon with depth. Finally, going beyond expressivity, given appropriately curated training data, we show that two-layer transformers can provably learn to execute DFS via gradient flow and generalize to unseen graphs. Together, our results provide a mechanistic account of how transformers implement graph search, how depth expands bounded look-ahead, and how such reasoning algorithms can emerge through training.

AI.tldr: 该论文以有向图路径查找作为多步推理的符号抽象，从表达力与可学习性两方面刻画Transformer实现深度优先搜索（DFS）的机制：一层无法高效实现，两层即可近线性规模实现，且层数增加带来指数级前瞻视界，并证明两层模型可在合适数据下经梯度流学到DFS并泛化。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但其获得推理能力的内部机制与推理效率仍不清楚。作者希望借助可精确分析的符号化子问题（有向图路径查找），建立Transformer实现图搜索算法的机制性解释。
AI.method: 1) 表达力下界：证明单层Transformer在稠密图上实现关键的DFS子节点选择原语需Ω(N²)规模；2) 表达力上界：构造两层Transformer以O(N log N)规模实现完整DFS，论证第二层的必要性与充分性；3) 深度扩展分析：对每个k≥3，证明k层Transformer可实现前瞻视界为1+2^{k-3}的有界可达性DFS策略；4) 可学习性：在恰当筛选的训练数据下，用梯度流证明两层Transformer可学习执行DFS并泛化到未见图。
AI.result: 单层需Ω(N²)规模、两层仅需O(N log N)即可完成DFS；层数k每增加一层，可达前瞻视界呈指数增长（1+2^{k-3}）；两层Transformer在梯度流训练下可证明地习得DFS算法并对未见图泛化。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了Transformer实现图搜索的机制性解释：深度是突破局部前瞻瓶颈的关键资源，且此类推理算法可在训练中自然涌现，为理解LLM多步推理的表达力边界与深度–效率权衡提供了理论依据。

title: Effects of Laser Beam Width and Measurement Noise on Tree Diameter Estimation in Laser Scanning
summary: Laser scanning has been utilized for decades to measure tree structure and geometry. Despite continuous advances in sensor technology, uncertainties arising from scanner characteristics and measurement conditions has remained relevant sources of error. In particular, factors such as laser beam diameter can introduce both systematic and random errors in the reconstructed tree geometry. This study investigates the main sources of these errors in mobile laser scanning (MLS) and quantifies their effects on stem curve (stem diameter) estimation. We discovered through simulations and experiments that the heteroscedasticity (difference in variance in ranging and scan angle) in the measurement noise is a key factor along with the beam width of the lidar, which cause the bias of the diameter estimates to depend not only on distance, but also on the tree diameter. We demonstrated that this bias can be reliably predicted and negated for trees with a diameter at the breast height greater than 10 cm using technical specifications of the sensor without any additional calibration. In experiments, the proposed bias compensation method reduced the root-mean-square error of stem diameter estimates to sub-centimeter level on boreal forest test sites. However, for small trees with diameter below 10 cm, the diameter bias becomes sensitive to the diameter of the tree$\unicode{x2013}$an unknown factor$\unicode{x2013}$and other factors, such as different bark and out-of-roundness of the stem, limiting the precision of lidar for measuring geometry of trees and applicability of the presented method.

AI.tldr: 该文研究移动激光扫描（MLS）中激光束宽与测量噪声异方差性引起的树干直径估计偏差，提出一种无需额外标定、仅依据传感器技术参数的偏差预测与补偿方法，可将胸径>10 cm树木的直径估计均方根误差降至亚厘米级。
AI.motivation: 激光扫描虽广泛用于树木结构与几何测量，但扫描仪特性与测量条件（尤其激光束直径）带来的系统误差与随机误差仍是显著误差来源，且其对树干曲线（直径）估计的影响缺乏定量刻画。
AI.method: 结合仿真与实测实验，识别MLS中主要误差源；分析测距与扫描角测量噪声的异方差性（方差随距离/角度变化）与激光束宽对直径估计的影响机制，建立可预测的直径偏差模型，并基于传感器技术规格直接进行偏差补偿（无需额外标定）。
AI.result: 直径估计偏差不仅随距离变化，还依赖于树径本身；所提补偿方法在北方森林试验区将胸径>10 cm树木的直径RMSE降至亚厘米水平；对<10 cm小树，直径偏差对树径这一未知因素及树皮差异、树干非圆度等较为敏感，限制了激光雷达测量精度与该方法适用性。
AI.conclusion: 测量噪声异方差性与光束宽是MLS树干直径偏差的关键成因，其偏差可被可靠预测并被有效补偿；方法对大径阶树木效果显著且无需标定，但对小径阶树木受制于未知树径及树皮、非圆度等因素，适用性受限。

title: Closing the BF16-FP16 Convergence Speed Gap in RL Post-Training with Stochastic Rounding
summary: BF16 is widely used to pretrain large language models because it has the same dynamic range as FP32 and converges similarly to FP32 training. However, in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where learning rates are typically low, we find that standard mixed-precision BF16 training converges more slowly than FP16 training at the same learning rate. We attribute this gap to weight sticking: when FP32 shadow weights are quantized to BF16 using round-to-nearest, small updates often leave the BF16 weights used for rollout generation and training unchanged. Consequently, several optimizer steps may be needed before updates to the shadow weights are reflected in the BF16 weights. Raising the BF16 learning rate reduces weight sticking and matches FP16's convergence speed, but it also increases the KL divergence from the reference model. We instead apply stochastic rounding when quantizing the FP32 shadow weights to BF16. This approach matches FP16's convergence speed across different models and datasets while reducing the KL divergence relative to BF16 training with a larger learning rate. Unlike FP16, it keeps BF16's wider dynamic range and needs no loss scaling.

AI.tldr: 在低学习率的可验证奖励强化学习中，标准BF16混合精度训练因“权重粘滞”（FP32影子权重经就近舍入量化为BF16时，小更新被吞掉）导致收敛慢于FP16；作者改用随机舍入量化FP32影子权重至BF16，可匹配FP16的收敛速度，且比“提高BF16学习率”的方案KL散度更小，同时保留BF16宽动态范围、无需loss scaling。
AI.motivation: BF16因动态范围与FP32相同、收敛行为近似而被广泛用于大模型预训练。但在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中学习率通常很低，此时标准BF16混合精度训练收敛速度明显慢于同学习率的FP16，作者需要解释这一差距并给出不牺牲BF16优势的解决方案。
AI.method: 将差距归因于“权重粘滞”：FP32影子权重以就近舍入（round-to-nearest）量化为BF16时，微小更新常使用于rollout生成与训练的BF16权重保持不变，需多步优化器更新才能体现。解决方案是在FP32影子权重→BF16的量化环节采用随机舍入（stochastic rounding），而非提高学习率。
AI.result: 随机舍入在不同模型与数据集上均达到与FP16相当的收敛速度；相比“提高BF16学习率的”基线，其相对参考模型的KL散度更低。同时保留BF16更宽的动态范围，且无需loss scaling（FP16则需）。
AI.conclusion: BF16在低学习率RLVR中的性能短板源于量化舍入方式而非格式本身；随机舍入是一种低开销、可即插即用的修正，兼得FP16的收敛速度与BF16的数值优势。

title: Towards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). 47 pages, 16 figures. Project page: https://xinyuw922-pixel.github.io/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judge/ ; Code: https://github.com/xinyuw922-pixel/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judge ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nahco318/Towards-Reliable-VLM-Judges
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal and embodied tasks, yet aggregate accuracy or consistency alone does not reveal whether a judge changes its verdict for the right reason. We propose State-Conditional Invariance (SCI), a reliability principle requiring a judge to remain stable under semantics-preserving changes in presentation while responding to causal interventions that change the task outcome. We instantiate SCI in GridWM-Judge, a simulator-grounded diagnostic benchmark built from deterministic MiniGrid trajectories with aligned Full, evidence-removal, and counterfactual variants, plus presentation and representation probes. Across five diagnostic tasks, GridWM-Judge tests local perception, action-conditioned transitions, presentation stability, representation exchangeability, and Full-CF causal discrimination. Our diagnostic evaluations reveal heterogeneous failure modes, including sensitivity to evidence presentation and encoding, low activation on successful trajectories, and weak paired counterfactual discrimination. Perception-controlled analyses further indicate that visual grounding and objective recovery are substantial, model-dependent bottlenecks. These results motivate jointly reporting correctness, presentation stability, and causal sensitivity instead of relying on a single score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“状态条件不变性”(SCI)可靠性原则，并构建模拟器接地的诊断基准GridWM-Judge，揭示视觉语言模型作为自动评判者时存在异质失效模式，主张同时报告正确性、呈现稳定性与因果敏感性。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多被用作多模态与具身任务的自动评判者，但聚合准确率或一致性指标无法揭示评判者是否“因正确理由”改变判定，即缺乏对判定依据合理性的诊断手段。
AI.method: 提出State-Conditional Invariance (SCI)原则：评判者应对语义保持的呈现变化保持稳定，同时对改变任务结果的因果干预作出响应。据此构建GridWM-Judge基准，基于确定性MiniGrid轨迹生成对齐的Full、证据移除与反事实变体，并附加呈现与表征探针；设置五项诊断任务：局部感知、动作条件转移、呈现稳定性、表征可交换性、Full-CF成对因果判别，并进行感知控制分析。
AI.result: 诊断评估显示评判者存在异质失效模式：对证据呈现形式与编码方式敏感、在成功轨迹上激活度低、成对反事实判别能力弱。感知控制分析表明视觉 grounding 与目标恢复是显著且依赖具体模型的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 单一聚合分数不足以刻画VLM评判者可靠性，应联合报告正确性、呈现稳定性与因果敏感性；SCI与GridWM-Judge为可控、可诊断的评判者评估提供了范式。

title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
summary: Smart industrial solutions that can address multiple tasks require models that understand the underlying processes. We examine representation learning for modeling the injection moulding process as an example of such solutions. We consider its data efficiency and multi-modal benefit compared to classical machine learning alternatives. To this end, we synthesize a process-informed dataset based on a real reference cycle of an Erlanger Träger part. We then introduce MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention based variational autoencoder that reconstructs in-mould signals, while classifying parts as acceptable or as one of our synthetic failure modes. We evaluate MouldIt on two tasks, known-class classification and unknown-class detection, across nine dataset sizes in single-modal and multi-modal settings. We compare it with an accept-all baseline and the classical methods k-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, random forests, and principal component analysis, which we adapt to support both tasks. MouldIt outperforms classical methods across both tasks from 4000 cycles in the single-modal setting and from 2000 cycles in the multi-modal setting. It achieves part sorting losses of 6.0 $\pm$ 0.7% and 1.0 $\pm$ 0.3% in the single-modal and multi-modal settings respectively, ranking first across all baselines and a combination of principal component analysis and random forests.

AI.tldr: 本文将注塑成型过程建模视为表征学习问题，提出 MouldIt——一种时间卷积与注意力机制结合的变分自编码器，同步完成模内信号重构、合格件分类与未知故障模式检测，并在合成数据集上验证其数据效率与多模态增益优于 kNN、逻辑回归、随机森林和 PCA。
AI.motivation: 智能工业方案需同时处理多任务，要求模型理解底层工艺过程。作者以注塑成型为切入点，希望回答两个问题：相比经典机器学习，表征学习是否更具数据效率？融合多模态信号能否带来额外收益？
AI.method: 基于 Erlanger Träger 零件的真实参考循环合成过程信息驱动的数据集（含合成失效模式）。提出 MouldIt：时间卷积 + 注意力机制的变分自编码器，重构模内信号的同时将零件判为合格或某一失效模式。在两个任务（已知类分类、未知类检测）、九种数据规模、单模态与多模态设置下评估，并与 accept-all 基线及 kNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、PCA（均改造以支持两任务）对比。
AI.result: 单模态设置下从 4000 次循环起、多模态设置下从 2000 次循环起，MouldIt 在两任务上均优于经典方法。分拣损失为单模态 6.0±0.7%、多模态 1.0±0.3%，在所有基线及 PCA+随机森林组合中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 表征学习式建模在注塑过程的多任务监控中优于经典方法，且所需数据量更少；多模态融合显著提升性能并进一步降低数据需求，说明工艺感知的表征对智能工业多任务方案具有实际价值。

title: Exploring Synchrony for Communication in Modular Neural Networks
summary: One motivation for modular neural networks is to divide computation across components that learn distinct, reusable functions, which could then be recombined to support compositional generalisation. In practice, modular structure alone does not guarantee that such roles develop, and unrestricted communication between modules can undermine any specialisation that does emerge. This raises the question of how modular communication should be organised. The problem can be viewed as an analogue of the perceptual binding problem, where synchrony has been proposed as a mechanism for coordinating distributed representations. We introduce SyncNet, a modular architecture that separates module content from a dynamical phase state: learnt Kuramoto dynamics evolve the phases, while phase alignment determines communication through a shared channel. We evaluate SyncNet on Sort-of-CLEVR for relational reasoning and on SQOOP for systematic generalisation, where lower pair variety demands more recombination at test time. SyncNet gives the best held-out accuracy of the models compared at the three lowest pair varieties, by 5.1 percentage points at the hardest, and is competitive on Sort-of-CLEVR though below the strongest attention baselines. Test-time overrides show that performance depends on phases that evolve: fixed phases cost as much as no addressing at all, and permuting which module holds which region is nearly as damaging. A content-addressed variant trained from scratch nonetheless matches it, so the benefit appears to come from the modular decomposition rather than synchrony itself.

AI.tldr: 提出SyncNet：将模块内容与动态相位分离、以Kuramoto动力学演化相位、相位对齐控制共享信道通信的模块化架构，用于检验"同步"能否诱导模块专化与组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 模块化网络期望通过分工学习可复用子功能并重组以支持组合泛化，但实践上模块结构本身不保证专化产生，且模块间无限制通信会破坏已涌现的专化。因此需要回答"模块间通信应如何组织"。作者将其类比为知觉绑定问题，考察同步（synchrony）作为协调分布式表征的机制。
AI.method: SyncNet将模块内容与动态相位状态解耦：相位由可学习的Kuramoto动力学演化，模块间是否通信由相位对齐程度决定，通信经共享信道进行。在Sort-of-CLEVR（关系推理）与SQOOP（系统泛化）上评测；SQOOP中pair variety越低，测试期越需要重组。另设测试期干预（固定相位、置换模块-区域对应）与从头训练的content-addressed变体作为对照。
AI.result: 在SQOOP三个最低pair variety上取得对比模型中最优的留出准确率，最难设定下领先5.1个百分点；在Sort-of-CLEVR上有竞争力但低于最强注意力基线。测试期操纵显示性能依赖"演化中的相位"：固定相位退化到与完全无寻址相当，置换模块-区域对应同样造成近乎同等损害。但从头训练的content-addressed变体可达到同等表现。
AI.conclusion: 同步相位通信在低pair variety的系统泛化上有效，但消融表明增益主要来自模块化分解（及内容寻址的通信组织方式），而非同步机制本身；固定相位实验印证了动态路由的必要性。整体结论对"同步是绑定机制"的强假设持保留态度。

title: Massive Activations Confound Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are commonly evaluated by variance explained and ablation damage. We show how massive activations undermine both evaluations, and propose a correction. Massive activations cause up to 99.9% of activation variance to lie along the first principal component (PC1). Because the PC1 component has no unique sparse decomposition, each SAE run rebuilds it from a different set of features. These features dominate importance rankings: an average of 47 of the 50 most important features are unmatched in a separate run, compared with about 27 of a random 50. A dictionary can also report 99.96% of variance explained while leaving 33% of the variance outside PC1 unexplained. We bypass PC1 by training the SAE on activations with PC1 removed, then adding PC1 to the reconstruction. In affected models, the top-50 feature sharing rate rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%. At the same TopK sparsity, the resulting SAE degrades the model up to 44% less and reduces content reconstruction error by up to 33.9%.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示稀疏自编码器（SAE）评估中被忽视的"巨型激活"（massive activations）问题：PC1主导方差导致特征分解不稳定、方差解释率与消融损伤指标失真，并提出去除PC1训练再加回的修正方案，显著提升特征稳定性与重建质量。
AI.motivation: SAE通常用方差解释率（variance explained）和消融损伤（ablation damage）来评估，但作者发现这两项指标会被巨型激活系统性误导。巨型激活可使高达99.9%的激活方差集中于第一主成分（PC1），而PC1分量不存在唯一的稀疏分解，于是每次训练都会从不同特征集合重建PC1，导致重要特征排名在不同运行间高度不可复现，评估结论失真。因此需要一个能绕开PC1污染、使评估与分解更可靠的方案。
AI.method: 核心观察与诊断：量化PC1方差占比、跨运行的特征匹配率，以及"总体方差解释率"与"PC1之外方差解释率"之间的落差。修正方法：在训练SAE前从激活中移除PC1分量，仅对残余激活训练字典，推理/重建时再将PC1加回重建结果。实验中在相同TopK稀疏度下对比原始SAE与修正版SAE，考察top-50特征共享率、模型损伤（消融导致的下游性能下降）以及内容重建误差。
AI.result: 1）跨运行不稳定：前50个最重要特征中平均有47个在另一次运行中无法匹配，而随机抽取50个特征的基线匹配数约为27。2）指标虚高：字典可报告99.96%的方差解释率，但PC1之外的方差仍有33%未被解释。3）修正后稳定性大幅提升：受影响模型中top-50特征共享率由4%–39.5%升至73%–99.5%。4）相同TopK稀疏度下，修正版SAE对模型的损伤最多降低44%，内容重建误差最多降低33.9%。
AI.conclusion: 巨型激活通过支配PC1破坏了SAE的可识别性与评估可信度，使方差解释率与消融损伤指标产生误导性结论。去除PC1训练、重建时再加回的简单修正是有效的：它显著提高跨运行特征一致性，并在同等稀疏度下减少模型损伤与重建误差。作者据此建议SAE评估应纳入跨运行稳定性与PC1之外的方差解释等更稳健的度量。

title: Earth Embeddings in Environmental Remote Sensing
summary: Earth observations from satellite platforms have profoundly transformed research and applications across numerous domains. However, uneven observation coverage and frequent data gaps continue to limit their ability to capture Earth's surface dynamics. Moreover, processing multi-modal Earth observations requires substantial computational resources and sophisticated data harmonization frameworks, which may not be readily accessible to many remote sensing practitioners. Earth embeddings have emerged as promising solutions to these challenges. As general-purpose representations converted from multi-source Earth observations, Earth embeddings can support a wide range of downstream tasks with no requirement of task-specific feature design and preprocessing. In this study, we first introduce the theoretical foundations of Earth embeddings. Then, we review several representative Earth embedding products. We next examine the applications of Earth embeddings across six major domains of environmental remote sensing. Finally, we systematically assess the performance of Earth embeddings in four downstream tasks, including hyperspectral image classification, individual tree crown segmentation, crop yield prediction, and aboveground biomass mapping. Our review and case studies suggest that, despite several advantages over conventional Earth observation data, current Earth embeddings do not always outperform remote sensing imagery or hand-crafted features. Earth embeddings should not be viewed as a direct replacement for conventional EO data, but rather as representations that provide stable information across space and time. Remote sensing practitioners may consider evaluating Earth embeddings' suitability for specific tasks and using them strategically, rather than assuming superior performance by default.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了Earth embeddings（地球嵌入）的理论基础、代表性产品以及在六大环境遥感领域的应用，并通过四类下游任务实证评估其性能，指出其优势与局限。
AI.motivation: 卫星对地观测存在覆盖不均、数据缺口频繁的问题；多模态观测处理需大量算力与复杂的数据协调框架，普通遥感从业者难以获取。Earth embeddings作为由多源观测转换而来的通用表征，无需任务特定特征设计与预处理即可支持多种下游任务，因而受到关注。
AI.method: 综述与实证相结合：先阐述Earth embeddings的理论基础，回顾若干代表性产品，考察其在六大环境遥感领域的应用；进而系统评估其在四项下游任务中的表现——高光谱影像分类、单木树冠分割、作物产量预测、地上生物量制图。
AI.result: 尽管Earth embeddings相较传统对地观测数据具有若干优势，当前Earth embeddings并非总优于遥感影像或手工特征。案例研究显示其在四类任务中的表现存在明显差异，不具备默认的优越性。
AI.conclusion: Earth embeddings不应被视为传统对地观测数据的直接替代，而应作为在时空上提供稳定信息的表征。遥感从业者应针对具体任务评估其适用性并策略性使用，而非默认其性能更优。

title: A computational framework for understanding embodied plans
summary: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. Across several experiments spanning the qualitatively distinct domains of object manipulation and navigation, featuring diverse tasks and multiple behavioral measures, we show that GenEA, through simple transformations of this joint distribution, recapitulates how humans reason about embodied plans. Crucially, GenEA consistently outperforms strong alternative models, including plausible heuristics, standard task-and-motion planning, and a state-of-the-art vision-language model. GenEA thereby offers a new perspective on the architecture of human reasoning and social cognition, suggesting that embodied artificial intelligence systems seeking to seamlessly interact with humans should adopt GenEA-like generative models of action planning.

AI.tldr: GenEA：一种基于多层级状态空间的生成式智能体表征，可对人类多步、长时程具身计划进行推理，并在物体操作与导航任务中优于启发式、标准任务与运动规划及先进视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 从他人行为推断其计划与目标是人类社会互动的基础，也是协作式具身人工智能的关键能力；然而在自然的具身场景中形式化这一能力长期是难题，现有方法（启发式、标准任务与运动规划、视觉语言模型）难以胜任长时程、多步具身计划的推理。
AI.method: 提出GenEA智能体表征。其核心是多层级状态空间：将机器人学的任务与运动规划框架（刻画铰接身体的粗粒度生物力学）与基于仿真的直觉物理（刻画与邻近物体的交互）相耦合；再把该状态空间嵌入生成模型，得到目标与具身计划的联合概率分布。通过对该联合分布的简单变换，可复现人类对具身计划的推理。
AI.result: 在涵盖物体操作与导航这两个性质不同领域的多项实验中，使用多样任务与多种行为测量，GenEA能够复现人类对具身计划的推理方式，并稳定优于强基线模型，包括合理的启发式方法、标准任务与运动规划，以及最先进的视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: GenEA为人类推理与社会认知的架构提供了新视角，提示追求与人类无缝交互的具身人工智能系统应采用GenEA式的生成式行动计划模型。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Joint first authors: Qiang Wen, Guotao Meng, and Junhong Ruan
summary: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出RF3DGS，利用多视图像素强度最小值先验实现3D高斯溅射场景的反射去除，并构建首个基于Unity的3D反射去除基准。
AI.motivation: 高保真可视化（如博物馆展览）需要去除3D重建中的反射伪影，但现有方法难以将2D反射去除的光度先验推广到多视图3DGS场景中。
AI.method: 1) 借助几何先验优化原始3DGS，估计每视角的粗略无反射深度图；2) 基于深度图与光度先验（同一3D点对应多视图像素最小强度含无反射信息），通过3D warping从辅助视图聚合无反射信息，生成参考视图的清晰透射伪标签，作为自监督信号；3) 提出自适应孪生渲染（ATR）损失，在利用伪标签的同时保留原始退化图像的高频细节，实现内部3D自先验与ATR损失的融合。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景中均取得SOTA的反射去除性能；并建立了首个基于Unity渲染引擎的3D反射去除基准，用于严格定量评估。
AI.conclusion: RF3DGS表明多视图光度先验结合3D warping伪标签与ATR损失，可有效实现3DGS层面的反射去除，并为该任务提供可量化评测的基准。

title: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
summary: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context, without post-release training or tuning, making them natural and easy to use for forecasting. The TFMs we study are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, so they avoid look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. We compare Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model developed in recent accounting research and with several tree-based models. TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models. It is also faster and less computationally intensive than the large language model. Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We conclude that TFMs have promise as a new tool for forecasting in accounting and finance. However, our evaluation is based on a single benchmark task, and no class of models is likely to dominate in all settings.

AI.tldr: 该技术札记将表格基础模型（TFMs）引入会计研究，在"预测企业下一年盈余变化"这一基准任务上评估其表现；Google Research的TabFM准确率超过微调开源大语言模型与多种树模型，且比LLM更快、算力需求更低。
AI.motivation: 会计与金融预测需要易用、无需大量调参且可避免前视偏差的预测工具。现有微调大语言模型虽有效但计算成本高、使用门槛高；树模型速度快但精度有限。作者希望检验"预训练于合成表格数据、可在上下文学习（in-context learning）"的表格基础模型能否成为一种自然、易用且无记忆偏差的预测新工具。
AI.method: 以"预测企业下一年盈余变化"为单一基准任务，比较三类模型：(1) Google Research的TabFM（在合成表格数据上预训练，发布后无需再训练或调参，通过上下文学习直接产生数值预测，因而避免因记忆企业历史结果而产生的前视偏差）；(2) 近期会计研究中开发的、经微调的开源权重大语言模型；(3) 多种树模型设定。评价维度包括预测准确性与计算效率（速度、算力开销）。
AI.result: TabFM的预测准确率高于所有对比模型；相比微调大语言模型，TabFM速度更快、算力强度更低。部分树模型设定在预测速度上快于TabFM，因此在两者之间选择存在"准确性—速度"权衡。
AI.conclusion: TFMs有望成为会计与金融预测的新工具。但作者强调，结论仅基于单一基准任务，且很可能不存在在所有情境下都占优的模型类别，后续需在更多任务与设定中检验其泛化性。

title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
summary: General-purpose coding agents equipped with proof-assistant tools have shown strong performance on standalone competition problems, yet cumulative textbook formalization inside a low-resource mathematical library still faces three obstacles: aligning textbook concepts with library declarations, keeping long-horizon search synchronized with live proof states, and integrating locally verified proofs reliably into a growing codebase. We present Megrez, a knowledge-guided formalization agent for Rocq libraries built on Morse--Kelley (MK) set theory. Megrez coordinates a general coding agent through three mechanisms: (1) a source-rebuildable knowledge graph merging formal declarations, compiler references, and curated metadata to support retrieval via Chinese aliases, concept clusters, proof dependencies, and multi-lane full-text ranking; (2) a feedback-driven 1--5 tactic short-burst proving loop paired with a goal-local branch ledger and exponential-interval structured reflection; and (3) a three-check acceptance pipeline (statement fidelity, axiom auditing, and full builds) coupled with a multi-corpus Provider stack and a candidate-bound recoverable batch state machine. Deployment and evaluation on a point-set topology corpus demonstrate effective cross-chapter formalization and scalable premise retrieval.

AI.tldr: Megrez 是一个面向 Rocq（基于 Morse–Kelley 集合论）数学库的知识引导形式化智能体，通过知识图谱检索、短程策略反馈证明循环与三重验收流水线，解决教科书累积形式化中的概念对齐、长程搜索同步与证明可靠入库三大问题。
AI.motivation: 通用编码智能体在独立竞赛题上表现良好，但在低资源数学库内进行教科书式累积形式化时仍面临三重障碍：教科书概念与库中声明难以对齐；长程搜索难以与实时证明状态保持同步；本地验证的证明难以可靠地整合进不断增长的代码库。
AI.method: Megrez 以一个通用编码智能体为核心，协调三种机制：(1) 可源码重建的知识图谱，融合形式化声明、编译器引用与人工整理元数据，支持中文别名、概念簇、证明依赖及多通道全文排序检索；(2) 反馈驱动的 1–5 步短突发策略证明循环，配合目标局部支路账本与指数间隔结构化反思；(3) 三重检查验收流水线（陈述保真、公理审计、完整构建），结合多语料 Provider 栈与候选绑定、可恢复的批处理状态机。
AI.result: 在点集拓扑语料上完成部署与评估，展示了有效的跨章节形式化能力与可扩展的前提检索效果。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的智能体设计可在低资源形式化库中支撑教科书级的累积形式化与规模化前提检索，为长程、跨章节的数学形式化工程提供了可复用的范式。

title: Taxonomy-Agnostic Neurosymbolic Grounding of Robot Kinematics
summary: While symbolic reasoning for task allocation requires grounding a robot's physical capabilities, standard Unified Robot Description Format (URDF) files provide only low-level kinematics without the formal semantic context needed for reasoning. We present URDF2Ontology, an automated, taxonomy-agnostic neurosymbolic framework that transforms raw URDF files into populated, grounded OWL ontologies. It leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) for targeted semantic reasoning, coupled with an iterative sequential graph-purging mechanism to prevent context window saturation. To process complex kinematic structures, it employs a morphology-aware dual-track architecture featuring a bottom-up Tree Track for branching assemblies and a top-down Chain Track for serial limbs. Guided by neurosymbolic guardrails, the framework extracts functional sub-graphs and asserts populated ontologies aligned with arbitrary user-provided taxonomies. Empirical evaluation across a diverse fleet of heterogeneous robots demonstrates strong schema alignment, valid structural extraction, and a significant reduction in manual domain authoring overhead.

AI.tldr: URDF2Ontology 是一个自动化、与分类体系无关的神经符号框架，可将原始 URDF 文件转换为已填充、已落地的 OWL 本体，用于机器人任务分配中的符号推理。
AI.motivation: 符号化任务分配需要将机器人物理能力"落地"到形式化语义中，但标准 URDF 仅提供底层运动学信息，缺乏推理所需的形式语义上下文，人工编写领域本体开销大。
AI.method: 框架利用 LLM 进行定向语义推理，并配以迭代式顺序图剪枝机制避免上下文窗口饱和；针对复杂运动学结构提出形态感知双轨架构——自底向上的 Tree Track 处理分支装配、自顶向下的 Chain Track 处理串联肢体；在神经符号护栏引导下抽取功能子图，并依据用户任意的分类体系断言填充本体。
AI.result: 在异构机器人机队上的实证评估显示：良好的模式对齐性、有效的结构抽取结果，以及人工领域建模开销的显著降低。
AI.conclusion: URDF2Ontology 可自动化地从 URDF 生成落地的语义本体，兼容任意用户分类体系，有效降低人工本体编写成本，为机器人符号化任务分配提供可用的语义基础。

title: DisasterAgent: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Verifiable Disaster Report Generation From Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Remote sensing disaster assessment is moving from simple damage classification toward comprehensive report-level analysis. In this setting, responders need not only damage descriptions but also verifiable evidence to guide response and recovery. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) and tool-augmented agents offer strong multimodal reasoning and perception, but they struggle to provide the evidence required for high-stakes verification. To address these limitations, we propose DisasterAgent, an evidence-driven agent that uses a Perception-Augmentation-Generation workflow to generate verifiable disaster reports from bitemporal optical imagery. DisasterAgent first invokes a specialized vision expert toolkit in the perception phase to build a Spatiotemporal Perception Graph (STPG), serving as a structured memory to store and organize disaster-induced changes across space and time. Evidence-based Augmentation (EA) then extracts evidence from the STPG, attaching inline citations that form a closed evidence loop from each statement to the supporting visual evidence. Extensive experiments on the DisasterM3 and RSCC benchmarks demonstrate that DisasterAgent consistently outperforms general-domain VLMs, remote sensing-specialized models, and existing remote sensing agents. Notably, compared with the original model, it improves the average score for disaster report generation on DisasterM3 by 13.5\% and ST5-SCS on RSCC by 15.34\%, providing a more accurate and verifiable solution for disaster emergency response. The code will be available at https://github.com/ZhijianLi2003/DisasterAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出DisasterAgent，一个以证据为驱动的智能体，通过"感知-增强-生成"工作流从双时相光学影像生成可验证的灾情报告；在DisasterM3与RSCC上分别提升13.5%（平均分）与15.34%（ST5-SCS）。
AI.motivation: 遥感灾害评估正从单纯损伤分类转向报告级综合分析，应急响应者不仅需要损伤描述，更需要可核验的证据来指导响应与恢复；现有VLM及工具增强型智能体虽具备多模态推理与感知能力，但难以提供高风险场景下验证所需的证据支撑。
AI.method: DisasterAgent采用Perception-Augmentation-Generation三阶段工作流：感知阶段调用专用视觉专家工具构建时空感知图（STPG），作为结构化记忆组织跨时空的灾害变化；证据增强（EA）阶段从STPG抽取证据并附加行内引用，使每条陈述与视觉证据之间形成闭合的证据环路，最终生成可验证的灾情报告。
AI.result: 在DisasterM3与RSCC基准上的大量实验表明，DisasterAgent持续优于通用VLM、遥感专用模型及现有遥感智能体；相比原始模型，DisasterM3灾情报告生成平均分提升13.5%，RSCC的ST5-SCS提升15.34%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，证据驱动、可追溯的智能体范式能同时提升灾情报告生成的准确性与可验证性，为灾害应急响应提供更可靠的解决方案；代码将开源。

title: Discovering Structurally Plausible and Interpretable Cognitive Models with Large Language Models
summary: Computational cognitive modeling has traditionally relied on manual model construction, which is a time-intensive process that requires substantial domain expertise. Although recent LLM-based approaches have begun to automate model generation, they often prioritize predictive accuracy at the expense of structural plausibility and parameter identifiability.
