Our training audit shows that false positives (incorrect responses receiving positive rewards) dominate reward errors. We focus on a practical regime where ground-truth rewards are difficult to obtain at scale, while a limited labeled source set is available. We introduce TRUER, a framework that uses limited supervision to train a reward rectifier that distinguishes correctness from consensus. To achieve this goal, we train the rectifier with an emphasis on incorrect majorities and correct minorities, targeting cases where consensus and correctness disagree. After that, we freeze the rectifier and use it to correct rewards during subsequent test-time adaptation. By improving reward accuracy and thereby model performance, TRUER consistently outperforms naive TTRL in both metrics across all evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出TRUER框架：利用有限标注数据训练"奖励矫正器"，区分正确性与共识，纠正测试时强化学习中的奖励信号偏差。
AI.motivation: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）依赖模型自身答案导出的奖励进行自适应，但多数投票机制会在存在正确答案时仍强化错误解。作者通过训练审计发现，奖励错误中以假阳性（错误回答获得正奖励）为主。由于大规模获取真实标签奖励代价高昂，但存在有限的带标注源集，因此需要一种在有限监督下提升奖励准确性的方案。
AI.method: TRUER框架：先用有限标注源集训练一个奖励矫正器（reward rectifier），使其能够区分"正确性"与"共识"；训练时重点聚焦于"错误多数"与"正确少数"这类共识与正确性相冲突的样本；随后冻结该矫正器，在后续测试时自适应阶段用它来矫正奖励信号。
AI.result: 在所有评估配置下，TRUER在奖励准确率与模型性能两项指标上均稳定优于朴素TTRL（naive TTRL）。
AI.conclusion: 奖励信号的质量是测试时强化学习的关键瓶颈，尤其是假阳性主导的奖励错误。借助有限监督学习一个针对共识—正确性分歧的矫正器，可有效提升奖励准确性并进一步改善模型表现，且该矫正器冻结后可直接迁移至测试时自适应流程中复用。

title: A 10K drone image dataset with component-level annotations for rooftop photovoltaic inspection
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary information is included as an ancillary file
summary: Component-level information supports rooftop photovoltaic (PV) inspection, but recognizing individual components across complex scenes remains challenging. We present PVIS-10K, a dataset of 10,065 drone images with component-level annotations covering 63,632 physical PV modules across 22 rooftop installations. The high-resolution red-green-blue (RGB) images were acquired by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs, also known as drones) in Ningbo, Shaoxing and Shenzhen, China. Multi-angle oblique observations capture installation-height and scale variation, dense arrangements, occlusion, shadows and reflections. Three-dimensional delineation, reprojection and image-by-image review produced 3,516,675 image-level polygon annotations, stored in Common Objects in Context (COCO) format. Station-disjoint partitions support evaluation on unseen stations within and across cities. Four supervised models and text-prompted zero-shot Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) provide full-resolution benchmarks of instance matching and foreground coverage. PVIS-10K supports component localization, delineation and image-based counting for drone-based rooftop PV inspection research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PVIS-10K数据集，包含宁波、绍兴、深圳三地22个屋顶电站的10,065张无人机RGB图像，提供组件级实例多边形标注（3,516,675个图像级标注），并给出四个监督模型与零样本SAM 3的全分辨率基准，用于屋顶光伏组件的定位、轮廓分割与计数。
AI.motivation: 组件级信息对屋顶光伏巡检具有重要价值，但复杂场景下的单体组件识别仍具挑战。现有数据集在分辨率、标注粒度（组件级实例而非电站级或阵列级）、多角度遮挡与跨站点泛化评估方面存在不足，缺乏支撑组件级定位、精细轮廓刻画与图像计数研究的公开基准。
AI.method: 构建PVIS-10K数据集：无人机采集高分辨率RGB图像，覆盖22个屋顶装置、63,632块物理光伏组件；采用多角度斜视观测以涵盖安装高度与尺度变化、密集排布、遮挡、阴影与反光；通过三维勾勒、重投影及逐图人工复核生成3,516,675个图像级多边形标注，以COCO格式存储；按电站划分（station-disjoint）构建同城与跨城市的未见电站评测划分；在四个监督模型与文本提示的零样本SAM 3上进行全分辨率实例匹配与前景覆盖率基准测试。
AI.result: 建立了覆盖三城市、多角度、组件级实例分割的10,065张图像数据集，标注规模达百万级图像级多边形；提供电站不相交的站内与跨城市泛化评测协议；给出四个监督模型与零样本SAM 3在全分辨率下的实例匹配与前景覆盖性能基准。
AI.conclusion: PVIS-10K可作为无人机屋顶光伏巡检研究的组件级基准，支持组件定位、精细轮廓分割与基于图像的计数任务，并为跨站点、跨城市场景下的模型泛化评估提供统一平台。

title: Weighted-AoI-Driven UAV Trajectory and Reporting for Dynamic CKM Tracking
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, submitted to the WCNC conference
summary: Existing channel knowledge map (CKM) construction assumes quasi-static environments, failing when channels rapidly decorrelate. This paper investigates continuous online dynamic CKM tracking over an airborne 2D plane via a UAV fleet. We formulate a long-term error minimization problem under UAV mobility and reporting constraints. This problem, however, is intractable with unobservable errors for unmeasured cells. To tackle this, we propose a metric-driven scheduling approach featuring the Weighted-Age of Information (W-AoI). W-AoI evaluates cells by combining exact temporal staleness with spatial uncertainty predicted by a 2D U-Net. We prove that top-$K$ W-AoI selection maximizes the one-slot error reduction bound. Guided by this guarantee, we develop a lightweight greedy trajectory policy incorporating continuous along-path sensing. Simulations demonstrate our method reduces steady-state error by 3.8 dB$^2$ and 4.8 dB$^2$ over AoI-only and FIFO baselines, closely approaching an idealized oracle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无人机集群在二维空域上对动态信道知识地图（CKM）的连续在线跟踪，提出基于加权信息年龄（W-AoI）的调度方法，并证明其Top-K选择可最大化单时隙误差下降上界，仿真中稳态误差较AoI-only与FIFO基线分别降低3.8 dB²和4.8 dB²。
AI.motivation: 现有CKM构建方法假设环境准静态，当信道快速去相关时性能失效，缺乏对动态CKM持续在线跟踪的研究。
AI.method: 将问题建模为无人机机动与上报约束下的长期误差最小化问题；针对未测单元格误差不可观测导致的问题不可解性，提出由W-AoI驱动的调度方法：W-AoI结合精确时间陈旧度与由2D U-Net预测的空间不确定性对单元格进行评分，并证明Top-K W-AoI选择最大化单时隙误差下降上界；据此设计含沿路径连续感知的轻量贪心轨迹策略。
AI.result: 仿真表明，相比AoI-only和FIFO基线，所提方法将稳态误差分别降低3.8 dB²与4.8 dB²，并接近理想oracle性能。
AI.conclusion: 以W-AoI为度量、由理论界指导的贪心轨迹与连续感知策略，可有效实现无人机集群对动态CKM的低开销在线跟踪。

title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
summary: Recommender systems increasingly influence what users discover and consume online, yet the decision logic behind their outputs often remains opaque. Counterfactual explanation (CFX) methods provide an effective way to show which changes to a user's interaction history would alter a recommendation. In recommendation settings, however, CFXs often require many edits, producing long, low-level lists that are hard for users to interpret. Moreover, most evaluations emphasize edit counts while largely overlooking whether the resulting CFXs are coherent and actionable for users. We argue that this gap between generating valid CFXs and communicating model behavior stems from the lack of user-centered abstraction and limited qualitative evaluation. To bridge this gap, we investigate large language models as mediators that summarize raw CFX interaction edit lists into concise natural language explanations describing higher-level preference patterns. We optimize these mediators for correctness, informativeness, and linguistic quality through preference optimization, and evaluate the resulting explanations with human-calibrated metrics derived from separate human-labeled datasets. On the MovieLens-1M dataset, across multiple counterfactual generators and language models, the resulting summaries achieve high overall linguistic quality, while the strongest semantic results are obtained with high-success CFX methods such as ACCENT and SPINRec. Direct Preference Optimization improves the semantic metrics in almost all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大语言模型（LLM）作为"中介者"，把反事实解释（CFX）生成的原始交互编辑列表总结为简洁的自然语言解释，以揭示更高层的偏好模式，并通过偏好优化提升正确性、信息量与语言质量。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统的决策逻辑不透明，CFX 虽能说明哪些交互历史改动会改变推荐结果，但往往需要大量编辑，生成冗长、低层级的列表，用户难以理解；同时现有评测偏重编辑数量，忽视解释的连贯性与可操作性。作者认为这一"生成有效CFX"与"传达模型行为"之间的鸿沟源于缺乏以用户为中心的抽象以及定性评估不足。
AI.method: 提出以LLM作为中介者，对原始CFX交互编辑列表进行自然语言总结，生成描述高层偏好模式的简洁解释；采用偏好优化（含直接偏好优化DPO）针对正确性、信息性和语言质量进行优化；并使用由独立人工标注数据集校准的人评指标进行评估，覆盖多种反事实生成器与多种语言模型。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-1M数据集上，生成的摘要总体语言质量较高；在ACCENT、SPINRec等高成功率CFX方法下取得最强的语义效果；DPO在几乎所有评估设置中都提升了语义指标。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM作为中介者并辅以偏好优化，可有效把低层级CFX编辑转化为连贯、可操作的高层偏好解释，弥补生成有效解释与向用户传达模型行为之间的差距；未来应更重视以用户为中心的抽象与定性评估。

title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
summary: Optimized floating-point inference is not reproducible across environments: the same model on different hardware, compilers or thread counts can produce different bits. We present tritify, an open-source runtime that executes the forward pass of real models -- decoder-only language models, Mixture-of-Experts decoders, and the Segment Anything 2.1 image/video stack -- with the entire run-time path in exact integer arithmetic; floating point is confined to offline quantization and the float reference used for verification. We make three separate claims and verify each. (1) Cross-hardware reproducibility: the integer path produces bit-identical output run to run, across CPU instruction-set architectures, and across CPU/GPU, carried by a reproducing SHA-256 of the output. (2) Decision fidelity: the integer path reproduces the float reference's decision on the models and inputs tested, with the numeric exceptions measured; per-layer fidelity through sixteen layers of OLMoE-1B-7B and of a 106-billion-parameter MoE shows no fidelity cliff. (3) Location independence: a model's computation can be split across instruction sets, CPU and GPU, and networked machines with zero effect on the output bits. GLM-4.5-Air (106,852,251,264 parameters, 427 GB of integer codes) generated its answer across three machines, none of which can hold its integer codes in RAM, bit-identically to a single-host reference. The consequence is verifiable distributed inference: an untrusted server or a fleet of devices runs the model while an open scalar oracle re-derives the exact bytes; a guarantee against a dishonest server is future work. We do not claim a per-device speed-up, bit-equality of floating-valued intermediates, or confidentiality. Code: https://github.com/pelloran-inc/tritify

AI.tldr: tritify 是一个开源运行时，将模型前向传播的整个运行路径改为精确整数运算，浮点仅用于离线量化和验证参考，从而在跨硬件、跨设备、跨网络分片三种场景下实现比特级可复现推理。
AI.motivation: 优化后的浮点推理不可复现：同一模型在不同硬件、编译器或线程数下会产生不同比特结果，阻碍可验证、可审计的推理部署。
AI.method: 运行时全程使用精确整数算术执行前向传播，浮点被限制在离线量化与用于校验的浮点参考中；在解码器语言模型、MoE 解码器（OLMoE-1B-7B、GLM-4.5-Air）及 Segment Anything 2.1 图像/视频栈上实测，并用输出 SHA-256 复现校验。
AI.result: (1) 跨硬件可复现：同一整数路径在不同 ISA、CPU/GPU 之间逐次、逐比特一致；(2) 决策保真：整数路径在测试模型与输入上复现浮点参考的决策，并量化数值例外，OLMoE-1B-7B 与 106B 参数 MoE 的十六层逐层保真无"保真断崖"；(3) 位置无关：计算可拆分到不同指令集、CPU/GPU 与联网机器而不改变输出比特，GLM-4.5-Air（106,852,251,264 参数、427 GB 整数编码）在三台均无法单机容纳其整数编码的机器上跨机生成，与单机参考比特一致。
AI.conclusion: 实现了可验证的分布式推理：不可信服务器或设备群可运行模型，而开放标量 oracle 可重新推导出精确字节；对不诚实服务器的保证为未来工作。作者明确不主张单设备加速、浮点中间值的比特相等性或机密性。

title: Beyond Proxy Metrics: MLLMs as Human Surrogates for Explainable AI Evaluation
comment: Neural Information Processing Systems. NeurIPS 2026. Sydney
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) has expanded into a broad and impactful research area, but the fundamental question of how best to evaluate explanation techniques has proven frustratingly elusive. Methodologies typically revolve around either proxy metrics which tell us little about the utility of an explanation, or human evaluation which---while generally considered the gold standard---is expensive, difficult to scale, and challenging to reproduce. In this paper, we investigate if Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can act as surrogate human participants to automate the evaluation of XAI. To do this, we first propose a ``purpose-grounded'' evaluation framework with metrics applicable to both MLLMs and human users alike. Then, we offer some conceptual insights as to why and when we can trust these models to automate this process. Lastly, we conduct extensive empirical testing across five purpose-grounded areas such as model improvement and fourteen popular MLLMs. Results indicate that all models trend positively, but OpenAI and Qwen models generally show higher alignment compared to other variants, which would be the recommended choices in practice. We expect our insights not to replace user testing, but rather to help XAI researchers complement their current evaluation methodologies and move the field away from heavy reliance on proxy metrics for measuring explanation utility.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨用多模态大模型（MLLM）充当"替身人类被试"来自动化XAI解释评估，提出"目的锚定"评估框架并在5类场景、14个MLLM上实证，发现各模型趋势一致正向，OpenAI与Qwen系对齐度更佳。
AI.motivation: XAI评估长期缺乏共识：代理指标（proxy metrics）难以反映解释的真实效用；人工评估虽被视为金标准，但成本高、难扩展、难复现。作者希望探索MLLM能否替代人类参与者，实现可扩展且可复现的XAI自动评估。
AI.method: 1) 提出"purpose-grounded（目的锚定）"评估框架，其指标同时适用于MLLM与人类用户，从而可直接比对二者判断；2) 给出概念性论证，说明在何种条件下及为何可以信任MLLM来自动化该评估过程；3) 在模型改进等五类目的锚定场景与14个主流MLLM上进行大规模实证测试。
AI.result: 所有被测MLLM均呈现正向趋势；OpenAI与Qwen系列模型在与人类判断的对齐度上普遍优于其他变体，是实践中推荐的选择。
AI.conclusion: MLLM作为XAI评估的替代被试具有可行性，但定位是补充而非取代用户测试；该工作旨在帮助研究者完善现有评估方法，推动领域摆脱对代理指标的过度依赖，转向以解释效用为核心的评估。

title: EVAThink: Evidence Sufficiency-Guided Training for Adaptive Thinking in Video Understanding
comment: The code, model, and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/EVAThink}{EVAThink}
summary: Under a fixed frame budget, video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) depends on whether the sampled frames provide sufficient evidence for the question. Sufficient frame evidence supports direct answering, whereas less informative observations may benefit from reasoning that connects the available cues. We introduce EVAThink, which enhances video understanding through evidence sufficiency-guided training for adaptive thinking. First, Recoverable Evidence Gap Mining constructs evidence-dense and evidence-sparse video views that share the same question and answer under an identical frame budget. It retains pairs where sparse views yield lower direct-answer accuracy than dense views but benefit from explicit reasoning, providing supervision for response-mode selection. Second, Evidence-Guided Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning uses stage-specific rewards to guide training with evidence-based mode preferences and then refine response efficiency, while first-token advantage regularization mitigates mode collapse. Trained on only 6.7K curated samples, EVAThink consistently improves upon the base model across video understanding benchmarks under both 32- and 64-frame budgets, while outperforming strong baselines on average. The code, model, and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/ChangtiWu/EVAThink}{EVAThink}.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVAThink，通过"证据充分性引导"的训练让视频理解模型自适应地在直接回答与显式推理之间切换，仅用 6.7K 样本即在 32/64 帧预算下稳定提升多个视频理解基准。
AI.motivation: 固定帧预算下，VLM 视频理解性能取决于采样帧是否提供足够证据：证据充分时可直接作答，证据稀疏时需显式推理补充线索；然而现有模型缺乏对"何时该想、何时该直接答"的自适应选择能力。
AI.method: 两步：1）Recoverable Evidence Gap Mining——在同一问题、同一答案、同一帧预算下构造证据密集/稀疏两种视频视图，保留"稀疏视图直接作答准确率更低、但显式推理可获益"的样本对，作为响应模式选择的监督信号；2）Evidence-Guided Two-Stage RL——用阶段化奖励先引导模型学习基于证据的模式偏好，再优化响应效率，并用首 token 优势正则化缓解模式坍缩。
AI.result: 仅用 6.7K 精选样本训练，EVAThink 在 32 帧与 64 帧预算下的多个视频理解基准上均优于基座模型，平均表现超过强基线。
AI.conclusion: 证据充分性可作为可挖掘的监督信号，实现推理/直答的自适应切换，在有限帧预算下以极少数据获得稳定的性能与效率收益。

title: Plug-and-Play ADMM for Inverse Problems with Flow Matching Denoiser
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods with generative priors have achieved strong performance in inverse problems, with recent flow matching models enabling fast and scalable reconstruction. However, a key challenge in PnP methods is maintaining consistency between data fidelity updates and the learned generative prior, as data-consistency steps can move iterates away from the flow trajectory. We propose an ADMM-based PnP framework for flow matching priors that enforces stronger consistency between the measurement model and the prior through auxiliary variables and dual updates. In addition, we introduce a trajectory correction mechanism that restores consistency with the flow via a combination of deterministic and stochastic projections. Our method provides a more principled integration of flow priors within PnP frameworks, achieving high-quality reconstructions with reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出基于ADMM的PnP框架，结合flow matching先验与轨迹校正机制，在逆问题重建中实现更强一致性、更高质量且计算成本更低。
AI.motivation: PnP方法配合生成先验在逆问题中表现优异，flow matching模型带来快速可扩展的重建能力。但PnP的关键难题在于数据保真更新与学习到的生成先验之间难以保持一致：数据一致性步骤会使迭代点偏离flow轨迹。
AI.method: 1) 构建ADMM-based PnP框架，通过辅助变量与对偶更新，在测量模型与先验之间施加更强的一致性约束；2) 引入轨迹校正机制（trajectory correction），利用确定性投影与随机投影的组合，将迭代点重新拉回与flow一致的状态。
AI.result: 所提方法为flow先验在PnP框架中提供了更具原则性的整合方式，实现高质量重建，同时降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过ADMM结构化的一致性与轨迹校正，有效缓解了数据一致性与flow先验之间的偏离问题，兼顾重建质量与效率。

title: TreeAgent: Structure-Aware Memory Agent for Processing Long Hierarchical Data
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-LLM-Safety/TreeAgent
summary: Practical Web applications increasingly require agents to interpret long conversations or documents. For inputs exceeding the context windows of large language models (LLMs), memory agents process segments sequentially and retain past information in bounded memory. However, they typically divide inputs into flat token segments without preserving structure or hierarchy, causing three limitations for structured data such as API responses or HTML documents. First, fixed-length segmentation can split fields of the same record, breaking their relationships. Second, segments lack hierarchical information, obscuring their structural context and positions. Third, successive memory updates may discard details of earlier sibling records needed for reasoning on later segments. To address these limitations, we propose TreeAgent, a structure-aware agent that uses the input hierarchy to guide both segment-wise context processing and access to past information. Specifically, TreeAgent constructs segments from complete subtrees and groups of adjacent sibling subtrees to preserve local structural relationships. We provide theoretical guarantees on segment counts to guide token budget selection toward matching the segment count of fixed-length segmentation. We further attach structural paths to the segments for the agent to identify their ancestors and hierarchical positions. We also introduce residual memory links from the segments of low-level children to the segments of high-level parents, enabling direct information flows beyond successive memory updates. We evaluate TreeAgent with four representative memory agents on eight retrieval and aggregation tasks. The inputs are derived from real-world application data in JSON, HTML, YAML, and JavaScript and range from 8K to 1M tokens. TreeAgent improves the average score across the four datasets for all four agents, with 3.61% performance gain on average.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知的记忆代理 TreeAgent，利用输入层级结构指导分段与历史信息访问，在四种记忆代理和八个检索/聚合任务上平均提升 3.61%。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆代理把超长输入切分为扁平 token 分段，忽略结构层次，导致三类问题：定长切分割裂同一记录的字段关系；分段缺少层级信息，结构上下文与位置不明；连续记忆更新会丢弃早期兄弟记录的细节，影响后续推理。
AI.method: 1) 以完整子树及相邻兄弟子树组合构建分段，保留局部结构关系；2) 给出分段数量的理论保证，用于将 token 预算选择对齐到定长分段的数量；3) 为分段附上结构路径，使代理可识别祖先与层级位置；4) 引入从低层子节点分段指向高层父节点分段的残差记忆链接，实现跨连续更新的直接信息流。
AI.result: 在 JSON、HTML、YAML、JavaScript 真实应用数据（8K–1M token）上，用四种代表性记忆代理评估八个检索与聚合任务；对四个数据集上全部四种代理的平均得分均有提升，平均性能增益 3.61%。
AI.conclusion: 利用输入固有层级结构进行分段与记忆组织，可在不改变底层代理的前提下缓解扁平分段带来的结构丢失与信息遗忘问题，是一种通用且有效的增强方案。

title: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Fracture Characterization in Acoustic Image Logs
summary: Natural fractures (NFs) and drilling-induced tensile fractures (DITFs) in acoustic image logs provide insights into rock mass structure and in situ stress, but manual characterization is time-consuming. Deep learning can automate this task, although expert-labeled data are scarce. We investigate whether adapting a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM) outperforms task-specific models trained from scratch with limited annotations. Using 80 annotated acoustic image samples, we fine-tuned DINOv3, pretrained on satellite imagery, and evaluated it on four boreholes excluded from fine-tuning. The adapted model estimated NF and DITF parameters comparably to human interpretation. Relative to U-Net, YOLOv8, and Swin Transformer models trained from scratch, it yielded fewer false positives and negatives and more accurate fracture counts and orientations. However, its performance advantage generally narrowed as training sample size decreased. We also assessed decoder architecture, fine-tuning strategy, and image enhancement. A progressive upsampling decoder with full fine-tuning performed best among the DINOv3 configurations tested, while fracture-focused image enhancement did not consistently improve accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of VFM adaptation for fracture characterization in acoustic image logs with limited labeled data and suggest a transferable workflow for other annotation-scarce geoscientific imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于80个标注声波成像测井样本微调卫星影像预训练的DINOv3视觉基础模型，在4口留出井中实现与人工解释相当的天然裂缝与钻井诱导张性裂缝参数提取，性能优于从头训练的U-Net、YOLOv8与Swin Transformer。
AI.motivation: 声波成像测井中的天然裂缝（NF）与钻井诱导张性裂缝（DITF）可反映岩体结构与地应力，但人工刻画耗时；深度学习可自动化，然而专家标注数据稀缺。作者因此检验"预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）微调"在少标注条件下是否优于任务专用模型从头训练。
AI.method: 使用80个标注声波成像样本，微调在卫星影像上预训练的DINOv3，并在未参与微调的4口井上测试；与从头训练的U-Net、YOLOv8、Swin Transformer对比；另评估解码器结构（渐进上采样解码器）、微调策略（全参数微调）与图像增强（面向裂缝的增强）的影响。
AI.result: 微调后的模型估计的NF与DITF参数与人工解释相当；相比从零训练的基线模型，假阳性与假阴性更少，裂缝计数与产状更准确；但其性能优势随训练样本量减少而总体缩小；渐进上采样解码器+全参数微调在DINOv3各配置中表现最佳，裂缝导向图像增强未带来一致精度提升。
AI.conclusion: VFM适配在标注有限的声波成像测井裂缝刻画中具有潜力，并可推广为其他标注稀缺地球科学成像任务的可迁移工作流程。

title: When Covariance Is Not Enough: Kernel-Based Regularization for Single-Cell Counterfactuals
summary: Counterfactual editing of single cells, predicting how an observed cell would look had one factor been different, enables in-silico screening where experiments are infeasible, but is useful only if the edit is faithful to the individual and not merely to the condition. Concept bottleneck generative models make the effects of interventions interpretable by decomposing a cell's representation into known and unknown factors. Previous work uses a linear cross-covariance penalty to disentangle known and unknown dimensions. We demonstrate that this first-order criterion does not fully separate information when non-linear interactions are present. We first demonstrate the inadequacy of linear cross-factor penalization with simulation experiments with controlled edits and known non-linear covariate effects. We then demonstrate that adding a nonlinear kernel criterion, the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, is able to recover the true intervention effects on simulation data. Finally, we apply the non-linear concept bottleneck model to a complex single-cell RNA-seq dataset and find that it improves the ability to generate counterfactual expression profiles of cells under different tissue environments.

AI.tldr: 提出用非线性核独立性准则（归一化HSIC）替代线性交叉协方差惩罚来训练概念瓶颈生成模型，以实现更忠实的单细胞反事实编辑。
AI.motivation: 单细胞反事实编辑只有在编辑“忠实于个体而非仅忠实于条件”时才有价值；概念瓶颈模型通过将细胞表示分解为已知与未知因子使干预效应可解释，但现有的线性交叉协方差惩罚在一阶意义上无法在存在非线性交互时充分分离信息。
AI.method: 先通过带受控编辑且已知非线性协变量效应的仿真实验，证明线性跨因子惩罚的不足；再引入归一化Hilbert-Schmidt独立性准则（normalized HSIC）作为非线性核判据加入概念瓶颈生成模型；最后将该非线性概念瓶颈模型应用于复杂单细胞RNA-seq数据。
AI.result: 仿真数据上，加入归一化HSIC能恢复真实的干预效应，而线性准则不能；在复杂scRNA-seq数据集上，该模型提升了在不同组织环境下生成细胞反事实表达谱的能力。
AI.conclusion: 线性解耦准则不足以处理非线性交互，采用非线性核独立性准则可显著提升概念瓶颈模型反事实编辑的个体忠实性，并在真实单细胞数据上验证了其有效性。

title: Understanding Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Beyond Expert Boundaries
summary: In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, the nature of expert specialization remains controversial. Reports of domain-associated expert preferences contrast with analyses attributing routing primarily to token identity or syntactic patterns. To clarify these differing accounts, we look beyond expert-level routing to investigate the neuron-level organization of domain-specialized computation using Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP), a measure developed for this analysis. Using mixed-domain calibration data, we identify domain-specialized neuron sets with 58-74% overlap across multi-source samples of the same domain, compared with 15-24% across domains. To understand how this organization evolves during training, we trace neuron importance throughout pre-training and post-training across three fully open MoE families. Neuron importance continues to reorganize between pre-training checkpoints despite comparatively stable expert-level importance rankings, while post-training largely preserves neuron rankings. Building on these neuron-level perspectives, we further introduce RAMP-based Pruning (RAMPr) to select neurons across experts for balanced multi-domain capability preservation. At 75% neuron retention, RAMPr preserves average 91-98% of original full performance across six models. At 50% retention, our pruning method can reduce resident GPU memory by 36-43% and improves batched prefill throughput by 17-39% effectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/ydyjya/Neuron-Level-Specialization-in-MoE

AI.tldr: 论文提出Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP)指标，从神经元层面刻画MoE模型的领域专门化组织，发现神经元级专业化的稳定性规律，并据此设计RAMPr剪枝方法在多领域能力保持下实现显存与吞吐收益。
AI.motivation: MoE中专家专业化机制存在争议：一方报告领域相关的专家偏好，另一方将路由归因于token身份或句法模式。作者认为仅看专家级路由不足以澄清分歧，需下沉到神经元级组织来审视领域专门化计算。
AI.method: 提出Routing-Aware Magnitude Profiling (RAMP)，结合路由权重与激活幅度量化神经元重要性；用混合领域校准数据识别领域专门化神经元集合，并跨多源同域样本与跨域样本比较重叠率；在三个完全开源的MoE系列上追踪预训练各checkpoint与后训练阶段的神经元重要性演化；基于RAMP提出RAMPr，跨专家选择神经元进行平衡剪枝。
AI.result: 同域多源样本间专门化神经元集合重叠达58–74%，跨域仅15–24%；预训练checkpoint间神经元重要性持续重组，而专家级重要性排序相对稳定，后训练基本保持神经元排序；75%神经元保留率下，RAMPr在六个模型上保持原性能的91–98%均值；50%保留率下减少36–43%常驻GPU显存，批处理prefill吞吐提升17–39%。
AI.conclusion: 领域专门化在神经元层面具有可测量、可复现的组织结构，且其训练动态与专家级路由不同；RAMP可作为分析与剪枝的统一工具，RAMPr在显著压缩下较好保持多领域能力，表明神经元级视角对MoE可解释性与效率优化均具价值。领域内存在“专家级 vs 神经元级”分析层级的差异，未来可进一步区分token/句法因素与领域因素的贡献。

title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC), 2026
summary: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. Leveraging this, we first devise a centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm that utilizes predicted centroids as shared anchors to simultaneously condition dense segmentation and instance-level localization. To counteract the tumor size imbalance, we further devise a Volume-Calibrated Loss (VC-Loss) that adaptively amplifies the gradient contribution of micro-lesions, alongside a Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization (SACO) that stabilizes multi-task training by establishing global representations before progressively unlocking fine-grained localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroBT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on metastases, where micro-lesion ($\leq 3$ mm) localization precision improves by approximately 7% and counting estimation errors decrease by approximately 26%. The code is available at https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT.

AI.tldr: 提出MicroBT统一框架，借助尺度不变的病灶质心作为共享锚点，联合实现多模态脑肿瘤的微病灶分割与计数，并设计VC-Loss与SACO缓解尺寸不平衡与多任务训练不稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有方法整体分割性能虽好，但依赖基于重叠度（overlap-based）的目标函数，天然偏向大区域，导致亚3 mm微病灶在训练中被系统性抑制；同时像素级分割框架缺乏显式实例级建模，病灶计数不可靠，直接影响临床分期与治疗决策。因此需要同时解决微病灶分割与可靠计数问题。
AI.method: 核心洞察是几何上的尺度不变性：无论病灶大小，每个病灶都有明确定义的质心。据此提出质心锚定的协同范式（centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm），以预测质心作为共享锚点，同时条件化稠密分割与实例级定位；针对肿瘤尺寸不平衡，设计体积累积校准损失（Volume-Calibrated Loss, VC-Loss）自适应放大微病灶的梯度贡献；并提出尺寸感知课程优化（Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization, SACO），先建立全局表征再逐步解锁细粒度定位，以稳定多任务训练。整体为统一的多模态框架。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MicroBT优于现有最先进方法，在转移瘤上尤为显著：≤3 mm微病灶定位精度约提升7%，计数估计误差约降低26%。
AI.conclusion: 以质心这一尺度不变几何属性为统一锚点，可有效兼顾稠密分割与实例计数；配合VC-Loss与SACO，显著提升微病灶分割与计数可靠性，为临床诊断、放疗规划与纵向监测提供更可用的多模态解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Project website: https://daravaram.github.io/BioWSP
summary: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using $6\times$ fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将"权重空间编程"（让语言模型直接读取并编辑神经网络权重）应用于脑电（EEG）与心电（ECG）等生物信号模型，发现前沿模型可在不知情的情况下定位并修复模型中植入的特定缺陷，甚至仅凭架构、任务和极少量受试者可从头写出全部网络权重。
AI.motivation: 权重空间编程为"通过推理而非梯度下降来训练模型"提供了可能，已有工作在游戏网络、语言模型特定故障修复甚至扩散模型上验证了其可行性，但尚未在生物信号（EEG/ECG）这类典型的小型边缘可穿戴模型上得到检验。
AI.method: 以生物信号训练的神经网络为对象，让前沿语言模型直接在权重空间进行操作：一是无提示地定位并修复人为植入的特定故障；二是仅给定网络架构、任务与少量训练受试者，从头生成网络的全部权重，全过程不做任何梯度下降。并与人手工设计的EEG流程（alpha频带功率、CSP+LDA）及标准梯度下降训练进行对照。
AI.result: 语言模型仅靠推理即可用少6倍的训练受试者达到标准梯度下降训练的效果；由Claude Opus 5.5写出的网络在同样5名受试者条件下得分高于经典手工EEG流程。局限包括：无法改进已训练良好的分类模型，也难以仅凭权重可靠识别网络所训练的任务。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间编程对小型网络（如部署于边缘设备与可穿戴设备的模型）具有实用价值，但在投入实际应用前仍需进一步研究。

title: Personalized Memory Rubrics: Learning What to Remember per User via Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment
summary: Long-horizon personalized agents maintain an evolving memory by continuously deciding what to add, modify, or discard. However, learning an optimal update policy remains challenging. Conventional training relies solely on terminal question-answering accuracy, yielding a coarse feedback signal that treats all intermediate updates identically. Furthermore, update utility is inherently user-specific, as identical memory actions may yield opposite effects across different user personas. Existing methods fail to address this heterogeneity, relying on globally shared evaluation standards with at most a single scalar intermediate reward. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Personalized Memory Rubrics} (\textbf{PMR}), a framework that translates terminal feedback into fine-grained, per-step, and per-user credit assignment. PMR decomposes evaluation into a universal layer capturing cross-persona failure patterns and a per-user adaptive layer modeling individual traits as a specialized delta over the universal baseline. Through \textbf{Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment}, PMR redistributes credit at the token level, selectively amplifying validated decisions on successful trajectories while falling back to standard policy optimization on failed ones to avoid unreliable attribution. The rubric and memory policy \textbf{co-evolve} in a closed loop with anti-circularity guarantees. Crucially, PMR incurs zero inference overhead, operating without any rubric or external judge during deployment. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over strong memory-augmented baselines.

AI.tldr: PMR将终端问答反馈转化为细粒度、逐步、个性化的信用分配，实现记忆更新策略与评估量规的闭环共演化，且推理零开销。
AI.motivation: 长时程个性化智能体的记忆更新极度依赖奖励信号质量，但现有训练仅用终端QA准确率提供粗粒度反馈，对所有中间更新一视同仁；同时记忆更新效用高度依赖用户画像，同一动作对不同用户可能效果相反，而现有方法只采用全局统一标准、最多给出单一标量中间奖励，无法刻画这种异质性。
AI.method: 提出个性化记忆量规框架PMR：评估分解为通用层（捕捉跨画像的失败模式）与逐用户自适应层（以相对通用基线的delta建模个体特质）；通过Rubric-Guided Credit Assignment在token级重分配信用，对成功轨迹放大已验证决策，对失败轨迹回退到标准策略优化以避免不可靠归因；量规与记忆策略闭环共演化并具抗循环性保证；部署时不需量规或外部评判器。
AI.result: 在四个基准上相对强记忆增强基线取得一致提升；推理阶段零额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、个性化的中间信用分配可有效改善长期记忆更新策略的学习，且通用+用户delta的分层量规设计兼顾共享规律与个体异质性，具备实际部署优势。

title: CAppleNet: A Coordinate Attention-Based YOLO11 for Real-Time Apple Stem Cavity and Calyx Detection
summary: Automated fruit grading, sorting, and orientation systems require real-time, accurate detection of fruit-level morphological landmarks rather than the fruit boundary alone. This paper presents a custom, fully self-collected and self-annotated dataset of 1506 apple images (1054 training, 301 validation, 151 test) captured under controlled, fixed-camera conditions and annotated for three target classes: fruit body, stem cavity, and calyx. A YOLO11s detector trained with default hyperparameters is adopted as the baseline, and a systematic, one-factor-at-a-time ablation study is conducted across input resolution, data augmentation policy, optimizer configuration, and lightweight architectural enhancement to identify the factors that most improve detection of these fine-grained landmarks under high inter-cultivar color and texture variability. Neither increased input resolution, nor any of six tested augmentation variants, nor manual optimizer tuning improved on the untuned baseline (F1 = 0.9047); only a same-slot architectural substitution of the backbone's C2PSA block with Coordinate Attention (CA) matched the baseline's overall F1 (0.9038) while reducing parameter count by 10.2% and achieving the study's best mAP@0.5 (0.935) and best stem-cavity F1 (0.8217). A confidence-threshold sweep identified 0.15 as the deployment operating point for this model, and a confirmatory experiment combining the CA-swap architecture with the best-performing augmentation variant showed the two effects do not combine additively, reversing the architectural gain rather than compounding it. The resulting design recommendations --- the CA-swap architecture alone, at a 0.15 confidence threshold --- target real-time apple landmark detection for orientation-aware industrial sorting and alignment systems.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了1506张苹果图像的自采集标注数据集（三类：果体、果梗洼、萼洼），以默认超参的YOLO11s为基线，通过单因素消融（输入分辨率、数据增强、优化器、轻量架构改进）寻找细粒度形态关键点检测的最优配置；最终仅C2PSA→Coordinate Attention的同槽替换在参数量降低10.2%的前提下保持F1并取得最佳mAP@0.5，推荐以0.15置信度阈值部署。
AI.motivation: 自动化水果分级、分选与定向系统需要实时准确地检测果实级形态关键点（果梗洼、萼洼），仅靠果实轮廓无法确定朝向；同时苹果不同品种间颜色纹理差异大，细粒度关键点检测困难，而实践中哪些训练因素真正有效尚缺乏系统性证据，且工业部署对参数量与实时性有约束。
AI.method: 在固定相机、受控条件下采集并自标注1506张苹果图像（1054训练/301验证/151测试），标注果体、果梗洼、萼洼三类；以默认超参数的YOLO11s检测器为基线，开展系统性的单因素（OFAT）消融实验，分别考察输入分辨率、六种数据增强策略、优化器配置以及骨干网络中C2PSA模块替换为Coordinate Attention（CA）的轻量架构改动；随后进行置信度阈值扫描，并做CA架构与最优增强组合的验证性实验。
AI.result: 未调优基线F1=0.9047；提高输入分辨率、六种增强变体及手动优化器调参均未超过基线；仅C2PSA→CA的同槽替换在参数量减少10.2%的情况下取得F1=0.9038（与基线相当）、全研究最佳mAP@0.5=0.935及最佳果梗洼F1=0.8217；置信度阈值扫描确定0.15为部署工作点；CA架构与最佳增强的组合实验显示两者效应不可加性叠加，反而抵消了架构带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 针对苹果细粒度形态关键点检测，在固定相机、自建小规模数据集条件下，默认超参的YOLO11s已相当强，分辨率、增强与优化器调优均无增益；唯一有效改进是C2PSA→Coordinate Attention的轻量替换，可在降参10.2%的同时保持精度并提升mAP@0.5与果梗洼检测；最终推荐"CA替换架构+0.15置信度阈值"的单一方案，用于朝向感知的工业分选与对齐系统的实时检测，并提示多因素组合需经验证而非默认叠加。

title: Beyond Interaction Scores: Selecting Feature Interactions via Independent Replication
summary: Learning feature interactions is essential for accurate prediction and interpretable modeling, yet a high interaction score may reflect fitting noise rather than a reproducible pattern. Ranking methods score feature pairs but leave the cutoff to the user; testing methods set the cutoff but rely on repeated model refits or a model of the joint feature distribution. We present LENS, a model-agnostic framework for selecting feature interactions through independent replication. LENS trains two models with the same learning algorithm on disjoint data and accesses them only through predictions. For each feature pair, it removes main effects from the joint-effect surface to isolate an interaction pattern, ranks pairs by its strength, and tests whether the second model reproduces it at a meaningful strength. A single multiple-testing correction determines which pairs to retain, using only two model fits regardless of the number of features. We prove that a replication ratio alone can retain arbitrarily weak patterns shared by both fits, whereas a strength floor restores selection consistency, and we characterize when normalization in Friedman's $H^2$ reverses interaction rankings. On 16 synthetic designs, LENS matches leading model-specific ranking methods (e.g., TreeSHAP) and recovers 91% of material interactions, against 45% for the knockoff-based DIAMOND, without selecting false pairs; with 1,225 candidate pairs and no interactions, it makes substantially fewer false discoveries. On large-scale French motor insurance data, it identifies interactions documented in the actuarial literature and recovers 90% of the deviance gain obtained using all pairs. On two credit datasets, LENS selects few pairs while maintaining or slightly improving predictive performance over the additive baseline.

AI.tldr: LENS：基于独立复现的模型无关特征交互选择框架，仅需两次模型拟合，通过"去主效应交互面强度+复现检验+单次多重检验校正"筛选特征对，并证明强度下限对选择一致性必要。
AI.motivation: 特征交互建模对预测精度与可解释性至关重要，但高交互分数可能只是拟合噪声而非可复现模式。现有方法存在两类缺陷：排序类方法（ranking）只给分数、阈值留给用户；检验类方法（testing）虽给阈值，却依赖反复重拟合模型或对特征联合分布建模，成本高且强假设。
AI.method: 提出 LENS（模型无关、仅通过预测访问模型）：在同一学习算法下于不相交数据上训练两个模型、仅用其预测；对每个特征对，从联合效应面中剥离主效应以隔离交互模式，按其强度排序，并检验第二个模型是否在"有意义强度"上复现该模式；用一次多重检验校正决定保留哪些对，拟合次数恒为 2，与特征数无关。理论上证明：仅用复现比例会保留两次拟合共享的任意弱模式，加入强度下限可恢复选择一致性；并刻画Friedman H² 归一化在何种条件下会反转交互排序。
AI.result: 16组合成设计上，LENS 与 TreeSHAP 等领先的模型专用排序方法相当，找回91%的实质交互（knockoff类 DIAMOND 为45%），且不选入错误对；在1,225个候选对且无真实交互时，误发现显著更少。大规模法国车险数据上，识别出精算文献记载的交互，并以更少对恢复使用全部对所得偏差增益的90%。两个信用数据集上仅选少量特征对，预测性能与加性基线持平或略优。
AI.conclusion: LENS 以极低计算成本（两次拟合）实现了模型无关、可控制误发现率且带一致性保证的交互选择，兼顾统计有效性与实用性，适用于高维候选对场景与真实业务数据。

title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve expert-level diagnostic accuracy in static evaluations, where the model receives a curated vignette or case report that already condenses the diagnostically relevant findings. Such evaluations measure inference over already selected evidence; the evaluations do not account for the inquiry used to obtain it. In clinical practice, however, diagnosis is an iterative process of inquiry. Clinicians take the patient's history, or anamnesis (Hx), through targeted questioning, examine the patient, and request and interpret tests, progressively narrowing the differential until they reach a final diagnosis (Dx). We introduce Hx2Dx ARENA, an interactive benchmark of 1'000 clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM). Each case is a simulated encounter that proceeds from initial presentation through history taking and physical examination to diagnostic workup. We evaluate open- and closed-source LLMs under multiple configurations. Performance varies considerably across models in the interactive setting, and every model loses diagnostic accuracy relative to the static setting, where the full case is presented upfront. The ability to ask the right questions accounts for much of both the gap between models and the loss of accuracy: diagnosis improves as questions become more targeted and build a more complete clinical picture. LLMs thus reason well once the relevant data are available but remain limited in hypothesis-driven information gathering, in knowing what to ask in order to know. Closing this gap is a prerequisite for their safe integration into real-world diagnostic workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式基准 Hx2Dx ARENA（1000 例 NEJM 病例），模拟从病史采集、体查到检查的完整问诊流程，发现所有 LLM 在交互场景下诊断准确率均低于静态场景，且性能差异主要由“是否会问对问题”解释。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 诊断评测多基于已压缩好的病例摘要（vignette/case report），只衡量"对已给定证据的推理"，忽略了获取证据所需的主动问诊过程；而真实临床诊断是迭代式询问（病史—体查—检验）逐步缩小鉴别诊断的过程，因此需要能评估"信息获取能力"的基准。
AI.method: 构建 Hx2Dx ARENA：基于《新英格兰医学杂志》1000 个临床病例的交互式基准，每个病例为一次模拟问诊，从初始就诊依次经过病史采集（Hx）、体格检查到诊断性检查（workup），直至给出最终诊断（Dx）。在多种配置下评测开源与闭源 LLM，并与"病例全文一次性给出"的静态设置对比。
AI.result: 交互设置下各模型表现差异显著；所有模型相对静态设置均出现诊断准确率下降。提问质量（问题是否更具针对性、能否构建更完整临床图景）既解释了模型间差距的很大一部分，也解释了准确率损失的来源；随问题更聚焦，诊断表现提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在相关信息齐备时推理良好，但在假设驱动的信息收集上仍受限，即"不知道该问什么才能知道"。缩小这一差距是 LLM 安全融入真实诊断工作流的前提。

title: The Case for AI-Enabled Gate Monitoring as Farm Security in the UK: A PRISMA-Guided Review of the Evidence on Rural Crime, Livestock Predation and Farm Access
comment: Keywords: farm security; rural crime; livestock predation; camera traps; computer vision; PRISMA; evidence review
summary: Farm security in the UK rests on thinner evidence than its cost suggests. We ran a PRISMA guided review: twelve searches of Web of Science and Scopus on 2nd -4th November 2026 returned 1,183 records (761 unique), and grey-literature and hand-searches added 35 assessed sources. We synthesised 96 database records and 24 grey sources narratively. UK peer-reviewed evidence is small (16 records), and the main UK survey of crime and farmer mental health has 80 responses. Cost estimates rest on insurer claims: NFU Mutual put UK rural crime at £41.5 million in 2025, with livestock theft up almost 30% to about £4.5 million and dog attacks on livestock costing £1.95 million. The Home Office states that agricultural crime cannot be separately identified in its central data. We found no independent evaluation of cameras, sensors, trackers or marking; light and sound deterrents lost effect within one to five months in a systematic review of anti-predator interventions; and no study examined how often farm gates are left open or what follows. Camera-trap AI papers report accuracy on ecological datasets, none at a farm gate in the records we found, and in one comparison machine learning detected 41% of wildlife against 81% for analysts. We argue, as an inference from these gaps and not as a demonstrated effect, that continuous gate-level AI-mediated monitoring, as implemented in Fieldmark AI, would be highly beneficial for UK farm security. It would create the farm-level, time-stamped record that no official source holds, verify events that periodic human checks miss, resolve whether foxes, dogs or people were responsible, and give every other security measure something to be tested against. No study has yet shown that it reduces loss, and we set out the evaluation needed to show it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PRISMA系统综述揭示英国农场安全证据薄弱：同行评审文献仅16条，官方无法单独统计农业犯罪，各类安防措施缺乏独立评估；作者据此推测性主张（非实证结论）田门级AI持续监控（Fieldmark AI）将大有裨益，并提出验证所需的研究设计。
AI.motivation: 英国农场安全投入与其证据基础不匹配。犯罪成本估算依赖保险公司理赔数据（NFU Mutual称2025年乡村犯罪4,150万英镑），而内政部中央数据无法单独识别农业犯罪；摄像头、传感器、追踪器、标记等手段缺乏独立效果评估，威慑措施效果衰减快。因此需要系统梳理现有证据的规模与缺口，并提出能填补"无官方来源、无时间戳事件记录"空白的干预思路。
AI.method: PRISMA导向综述：2026年11月2—4日在Web of Science与Scopus执行12次检索，获1,183条记录（去重后761条），另经灰色文献与手工检索补充35条评估来源；最终对96条数据库记录与24条灰色文献进行叙事性综合。按国别与主题分层统计，并对相机陷阱AI准确率、抗捕食者干预效果等具体研究进行对照分析。
AI.result: 英国同行评审证据仅16条；英国主要犯罪与农户心理健康调查样本仅80份。家畜盗窃上升近30%至约450万英镑，犬类袭击家畜损失195万英镑。未发现对摄像头、传感器、追踪器或标记的独立评估；抗捕食者干预系统综述显示光声威慑在1—5个月内失效；无研究考察农场门开闭频率及后果。相机陷阱AI论文均在生态数据集上报告精度，所获记录中无一在农场门口场景验证；一项对比中机器学习检出率为41%，人工分析为81%。
AI.conclusion: 现有英国农场安全证据在规模与严谨性上严重不足，官方统计缺位、干预效果未经独立检验。作者明确将该主张定位为"基于缺口的推断而非已证实的效应"：田门级AI持续监控可生成官方缺位的农场级时间戳记录、核验周期性人工巡检遗漏的事件、判定肇事者（狐狸、犬或人），并为其他安防措施提供可检验基准。但目前尚无研究证明其降低损失，作者据此提出验证该效果所需的研究方案。

title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions
summary: A user utterance does not uniquely determine the next action in full-duplex dialogue: its consequences depend on the assistant's response state and interaction history. Speech activity, utterance completion, and interruption intent provide related evidence, whose implications for a response require an explicit action policy. We formulate this task at collected-segment endpoints and introduce Omni-JEV, which maps text or role-indexed user and assistant-reference speech to probabilities over five interaction actions. An aligned speech-to-speech understanding backbone encodes the acoustic roles separately and shares its candidate readout with text inputs. Bilingual weak supervision supports cross-entropy fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning for probability-sensitive decisions (RLCD). We compare Gaussian-logit and categorical Choice RLCD from the same supervised initialization under matched training exposure, observing different trade-offs between classification and probability quality. Gaussian Omni-JEV achieves test accuracies of 84.08% for audio and 96.55% for text. This common action interface supports decisions about when a full-duplex voice assistant should respond, preserve ongoing speech, interrupt, or resume an interrupted response.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Omni-JEV框架，将全双工对话中的"如何响应"建模为在五个交互动作上的概率判定任务，基于对齐的语音-语音理解骨干分别编码用户与助手参考语音的角色，并结合双语弱监督、交叉熵微调与RLCD强化学习，音频测试准确率84.08%、文本96.55%。
AI.motivation: 用户的一句话并不能唯一决定助手的下一动作，其后果依赖于助手当前的响应状态与交互历史；语音活动、话语完成度、打断意图等线索只是相关证据，需显式的动作策略才能映射为响应决策。现有全双工语音助手缺乏统一、可概率化的"何时响应/保持/打断/恢复"动作接口。
AI.method: 在采集片段端点处形式化该任务；提出Omni-JEV，将文本或按角色索引的用户语音与助手参考语音映射为五类交互动作的概率分布。以对齐的语音-语音理解骨干分别编码声学角色，并与文本输入共享候选读出层；采用双语弱监督进行交叉熵微调，随后用RLCD针对概率敏感决策做强化学习；在相同监督初始化与匹配训练曝光下比较高斯-logit与分类式Choice RLCD两种变体。
AI.result: Gaussian Omni-JEV在测试集上取得音频84.08%、文本96.55%的准确率；两种RLCD变体在分类质量与概率质量之间存在不同的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该统一动作接口支持判断全双工语音助手应何时响应、保持当前语音、打断或恢复被打断的响应，验证了联合建模声学角色与显式动作策略的可行性。

title: BARS: Budget-Aware Sequential Sampling with Refusal for Majority Identification under Unknown Distributions
comment: 23 pages (17 pages without appendix), 7 tables, 8 figures
summary: Repeated sampling with majority selection is an effective means of enforcing self-consistency in large language models. Recently, a variant has also been introduced that terminates early to save costs when the output distribution is favorable. But it still cannot yield a correct confidence estimate from the answer distribution. For this issue, we formalize this as majority identification under an unknown distribution with a budget and a target error rate, and propose BARS, a sequential rule certifying the top-two gap and returning an early stop, a budgeted majority vote, or a refusal when feasibility cannot be established. A refusal is a statement about the rule and its budget, not a claim that a question is unanswerable, and it tells practitioners when to widen the budget or switch models. A certified mode carries proven bounds on the joint answering error and on refusing an instance the budget could handle, while a practical mode, used in our experiments, replaces them with empirical calibration. On synthetic instances drawn from known distributions over thousands of seeds, the difficulty-driven behavior is recovered and the price of the certified mode is measured.On GSM8K the practical mode draws 22.3\% fewer samples than fixed-8 sampling over the same pool, refused questions included, at the cost of declining 18.8\% of the questions. On MATH, it greatly improves the accuracy of its output answers into 82.5\% at the cost of honestly refusing to answer half of the difficult questions that the model itself is unable to solve.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BARS：将"重复采样+多数投票"的自一致性方法形式化为未知分布下带预算与目标错误率的多数识别问题，设计序列规则认证top-2差距，实现早停、预算内多数投票或拒绝。
AI.motivation: 多数投票采样可提升LLM自一致性，已有的早停变体虽能省成本，但无法从答案分布中给出正确的置信度估计，缺乏对错误率的可靠保证。
AI.method: 形式化为未知分布、给定预算和目标错误率下的多数识别问题；提出BARS序列规则，认证前两名答案的差距，输出三种决策：早停返回答案、预算内多数投票、或在无法建立可行性时拒绝。提供认证模式（对联合答题错误率和误拒率给出可证明界）与实际模式（用经验校准替代理论界）。
AI.result: 合成数据数千随机种子上复现了难度驱动的行为并量化认证模式的代价；GSM8K上比固定8次采样少22.3%样本（含拒绝题目），代价是拒答18.8%题目；MATH上输出答案准确率提升至82.5%，代价是诚实拒答一半模型本身无法解决的难题。
AI.conclusion: BARS为多数投票采样提供了带统计认证的序贯决策框架，拒绝是对"规则+预算"的陈述而非题目不可答，可提示实践者何时扩大预算或更换模型，在成本与准确率间实现可控权衡。

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
summary: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: MEOW是首个将非交互式分割骨干网络改造为交互式开放世界学习器的框架，且无需更新任何可学习参数。
AI.motivation: 开放世界识别要求模型不只对未知结构做预测，还要能随时间从这些预测中持续学习改进；交互式分割虽能获得用户反馈，却始终局限于开放集设定，局限于一次性预测。
AI.method: MEOW结合无参数化的直推式推理（parameter-free transductive reasoning）与记忆巩固（memory consolidation），在不更新模型参数的前提下累积知识。实验聚焦医学数据。
AI.result: MEOW能够持续提升自身对训练中从未见过类别的预测表现，并可零样本迁移到不熟悉领域，包括micro-CT数据及其他成像模态。
AI.conclusion: 通过无参数直推推理加记忆巩固，可在冻结骨干网络条件下实现交互式开放世界持续学习，并具备跨域零样本迁移能力。

title: AnchorMTS: Multi-View Signal Representation and Forecast-Anchored Fusion for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time-series forecasters typically optimize a single numerical representation, even though the same history exposes complementary geometry, recurrence, and semantic structure. We propose AnchorMTS, which derives self-aligned visual and textual views from each observed window and uses them only to refine a complete numerical forecast. A trainable evidence path produces a candidate forecast, while a parameter-free output projection enforces an exact per-variable bound on its displacement from the numerical anchor. Across six benchmarks and four horizons, AnchorMTS achieves the best macro MSE/MAE (0.336/0.367) among seven supervised baselines and wins 18 of 24 MSE settings against the cellwise baseline envelope; removing the auxiliary path raises macro MSE to 0.340. The projection leaves 95.8% of candidate refinements unchanged while yielding zero bound violations, showing that complementary multi-view evidence can improve forecasting while its final influence remains explicitly controlled.

AI.tldr: AnchorMTS 从观测窗口自对齐构建视觉与文本视图，仅用其校正一个完整的数值预测，并通过无参数输出投影施加逐变量位移硬约束，在六个基准、四个预测步长上取得最优宏平均 MSE/MAE。
AI.motivation: 长期时间序列预测器通常只优化单一数值表示，忽视同一历史中蕴含的互补的几何、周期（递归）与语义结构信息；同时引入辅助多视图证据时，其影响难以显式控制。
AI.method: 提出 AnchorMTS：由每个观测窗口自对齐地生成视觉与文本视图，仅用于精化数值预测。可训练证据路径输出候选预测，无参数输出投影将其相对数值锚点的位移限制在逐变量的精确界内。
AI.result: 在六个基准与四个步长上，七个监督基线中取得最佳宏平均 MSE/MAE（0.336/0.367）；相对逐单元（cellwise）基线包络在 24 个 MSE 设置中胜出 18 个；去除辅助路径后宏 MSE 升至 0.340。投影保持 95.8% 的候选精化不变，且边界违规为零。
AI.conclusion: 互补的多视图证据可提升预测精度，且其最终影响可通过无参数投影被显式、精确地控制，验证了"证据精化+硬约束锚定"设计的有效性与可控性。

title: Cross-Border Fulfillment Center Selection via Doubly Robust Estimation and Linear Programming
summary: We introduce the cross-border (XB) fulfillment center (FC) Selection Model: a multi-stage optimization framework combining forecasting, doubly robust estimation, and linear programming to select optimal source FCs. For each source-destination shipping arc, the objective is to choose a subset of source-country FCs that minimize delivery time and cost while maximizing profit and shipped units under a fixed domestic network. We evaluate the model on three production-scale international shipping corridors for a large e-commerce company using 12 months of shipment data, employing both aggregate offline replay and shipment-level counterfactual nearest-neighbor matching. Across all shipping corridors, the XB FC Selection Model achieves 8.5-51.1% reductions in delivery time and 4.4-48.3% reductions in logistics cost relative to human expert-defined FC selection policies, with up to 6.5 percentage-point improvements in 5/5 target compliance (5 days, $5 USD). Pareto analysis shows the model consistently dominates single-objective ranking strategies and unconstrained LP on the efficiency-reallocation frontier, with all results statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 提出跨境履约中心(XB FC)选择模型：融合预测、双稳健估计与线性规划的多阶段优化框架，为每条源-目的运输弧选择最优源国履约中心子集；在三个生产级国际货运通道上实现配送时间降低8.5–51.1%、物流成本降低4.4–48.3%。
AI.motivation: 跨境履约中心的源仓选择直接影响配送时效、物流成本与利润，但实践中多依赖人工专家经验制定政策，缺乏系统性优化，且需在固定国内网络约束下兼顾时效、成本、利润与出货量等多目标。
AI.method: 构建多阶段优化框架：先进行需求/时效预测，再用双稳健估计(Doubly Robust)评估各源-目的弧的反事实效果，最后以线性规划在固定国内网络下选择源国履约中心子集，目标为最小化配送时间与成本、最大化利润与出货量。评估采用12个月货运数据，结合聚合离线回放与货运级别的反事实最近邻匹配两种方式。
AI.result: 在大型电商企业的三条生产级国际货运走廊上，相比人工专家定义的FC选择策略，配送时间降低8.5–51.1%，物流成本降低4.4–48.3%，5/5达标率(5天、5美元)提升最高6.5个百分点；Pareto分析显示模型在效率-再分配前沿上持续优于单目标排序策略与无约束线性规划，且结果均具统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该多阶段优化模型可有效替代人工经验政策，在多目标权衡下实现时效、成本与利润的协同改进，并在真实生产数据与多种评估口径下验证稳健有效。

title: Pulse or Provenance? What rPPG-Based Deepfake Detectors Learn
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) has been proposed as a physiological cue for deepfake detection, based on the premise that synthesized faces lack a genuine cardiac signal. We examine what rPPG-style detectors learn on Celeb-DF++ (22 forgery methods) and FaceForensics++ (FF++), using one identically sampled window per real and fake video. On talking-face forgeries, simple chrominance traces reach an AUC of 0.998, exceeding a dedicated rPPG extractor (0.87). Controlled experiments indicate that this signal is not physiological in origin. On fully synthesized forgeries, it is equally discriminative when extracted from background regions or from full frames without face detection, and it is concentrated above the 0.7 to 4 Hz heart-rate band. It is largely removed by shuffling frame order but persists after normalizing resolution, frame rate and encoding, and an independent reimplementation reproduces these findings. Removing high-frequency content makes most synthesized videos appear real, adding it makes real videos appear fake, and injecting a synthetic pulse has little effect. In controlled self-reenactment experiments with two generators, animating a face from a single frame introduces the same high-frequency signal, whereas reconstructing each frame from its own source does not. Face-based chrominance detectors trained on Celeb-DF++ classify over 99% of real FF++ videos as fake, indicating that they largely encode video source rather than manipulation, and a CLIP-based detector exhibits the same behavior. A frozen CLIP backbone matches or exceeds fusions of CLIP with rPPG and frequency features. Finally, we show that the official Celeb-DF and Celeb-DF++ splits share identities and source-video content between training and test, and that custom protocols reusing test videos and identities in training inflate weaker detectors by up to 0.30 AUC.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了rPPG类深度伪造检测器在Celeb-DF++与FF++上真正学到的信号，发现其判别力主要来自合成过程引入的高频伪影与视频来源线索，而非生理性心脏信号，并揭示了官方数据集划分存在身份与源视频泄漏。
AI.motivation: rPPG检测方法的前提假设是"合成人脸缺乏真实心脏信号"。但若该信号实际并非生理来源，则相关检测器的有效性与可解释性均不成立，且数据集划分泄漏可能进一步夸大性能，因此需要严格审计。
AI.method: 在每个真/假视频中取等量采样窗口，比较简单色度轨迹与专用rPPG提取器；开展背景区域、无面部检测全帧、心率频带（0.7–4 Hz）、帧序打乱、分辨率/帧率/编码归一化、独立复现、高频增减与合成脉冲注入等控制实验；用两种生成器做受控自重现实验；进行跨数据集（Celeb-DF++训练→FF++测试）与CLIP基线/融合对比，并核查官方划分的身份与源视频重合情况。
AI.result: 说话人脸伪造上简单色度轨迹AUC达0.998，超过专用rPPG提取器（0.87）；全合成伪造上背景区域或无面检全帧同样具判别力，信号集中于0.7–4 Hz以上频段；打乱帧序可大部分消除该信号，归一化分辨率/帧率/编码后仍存在，独立复现一致；去除高频使多数合成视频判为真、添加高频使真实视频判为假，注入合成脉搏影响甚微；单帧驱动动画引入相同高频信号而逐帧重建不引入；Celeb-DF++训练的色度检测器将超99%真实FF++视频判为假，CLIP检测器同样；冻结CLIP主干匹配或超过CLIP+rPPG+频域特征融合；官方划分训练/测试共享身份与源视频，自定义协议复用测试视频与身份可使弱检测器AUC虚高最多0.30。
AI.conclusion: rPPG风格检测器的判别力主要源于生成伪影引发的高频信号及视频来源偏差，而非生理线索；现有Celeb-DF/FF++评测协议存在严重泄漏，需重新设计划分与基线，未来工作应以控制高频伪影与来源混杂为核心。

title: JAX-WAVE: A Differentiable Physics-Supervised Framework for Inverse Wave Design in Heterogeneous Media
summary: Designing a prescribed wave field in a heterogeneous medium requires an initial pressure distribution that compensates for the medium's propagation response. Repeated numerical inversion solves this task afresh for each target and environment. We introduce JAX-WAVE for amortized inverse wave design: a shared neural network maps desired terminal fields and known wave-speed maps directly to bounded initial pressures. Training through a differentiable finite-difference time-domain solver uses the physical design objective without requiring optimized control labels. Linear propagation and symmetric pressure bounds imply an exact sign-reversal relation for the regularized optimum. A shared-weight projection enforces this relation, preserves feasibility, and satisfies an exact identity for the paired-sign objective. We characterize the discrete propagator and its weighted adjoint to connect learning, numerical inversion, and optimality assessment. On an independent confirmation set, three trained models achieve unseen-material errors of 25.24% for geometric targets and 4.77% for reachable targets. Matched-capacity comparisons show improved reconstruction with the sign parameterization. Within a 5 ms median online budget, the learned map reduces mean error by 45% relative to accelerated numerical inversion on the heterogeneous benchmark; longer numerical solves recover greater accuracy. The results establish a reusable inverse-design procedure and show how its accuracy and computational value depend on target structure and query workload.

AI.tldr: 提出JAX-WAVE框架，用共享神经网络将目标终端波场与波速图直接映射为有界初始压力，通过可微FDTD求解器端到端训练，实现摊销式逆波设计。
AI.motivation: 在非均匀介质中设计指定波场需要初始压力分布来补偿介质传播响应，而传统做法是对每个目标和环境反复求解数值反演，计算重复且昂贵。
AI.method: 构建共享神经网络，输入期望终端场与已知波速图，输出有界初始压力；训练通过可微有限差分时域（FDTD）求解器直接优化物理设计目标，无需最优控制标签。利用线性传播与对称压力上下界推出正则最优解的精确符号反转关系，并用共享权重投影强制满足该关系、保持可行性及成对符号目标的精确恒等式；同时刻画离散传播算子及其加权伴随，以连接学习、数值反演与最优性评估。
AI.result: 在独立确认集上，三个训练模型对未见材料的误差为几何目标25.24%、可达目标4.77%；等容量对比显示符号参数化改善重建。在5 ms中位在线预算内，学习映射相对加速数值反演将异质基准平均误差降低45%；更长数值求解可获得更高精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了可复用的逆设计流程，并表明其精度与计算价值取决于目标结构与查询负载。

title: An Augmented Lagrangian Approach to Lifted Bellman Linear Programming
summary: Temporal-difference critics regress onto a bootstrapped target and usually need a target network. Lifted Bellman Linear Programming (LBLP) instead expresses the in-sample optimal values of offline RL as the solution to a linear program over the dataset. Its neural solver ALBUM relaxes the constraints into hinge penalties with fixed coefficients, and its guarantees are conditions on coefficients chosen in advance. We solve the same program with the method of multipliers: the coefficients become multipliers learned by dual ascent, with one penalty parameter $ρ$. In the convex case the fixed points are the KKT pairs of LBLP, and at every stationary point the applied constraint weights balance the objective exactly. The critic can serve a Gaussian actor, a flow actor, and best-of-N sampling, and for the Gaussian actor we propose an advantage-normalized DDPG+BC objective. With a single $Q$ and $V$ and no target network, our AL-LBLP with best-of-N reaches 60.1\% average success on the 50 state-based OGBench tasks. On long-horizon tasks, it reaches 81.5% on humanoidmaze-giant and 79.8% on antmaze-giant. It does not collapse up to batch size 8192.

AI.tldr: 提出AL-LBLP：用乘子法求解LBLP，把固定惩罚系数改为对偶上升学习的乘子，无需目标网络，在OGBench 50个状态任务上best-of-N平均成功率60.1%。
AI.motivation: TD critic依赖自举目标且通常需要目标网络；LBLP将离线RL的样本内最优值表述为数据集上的线性规划，但其神经求解器ALBUM将约束松弛为固定系数的hinge惩罚，理论保证仅是对预先选定系数的条件性结论，缺乏自适应性与严格的KKT对应。
AI.method: 采用乘子法（method of multipliers）求解同一LBLP：约束权重变为由对偶上升学习的乘子，仅保留一个惩罚参数ρ；凸情形下不动点为LBLP的KKT对，任一稳定点处约束权重精确平衡目标。critic支持Gaussian actor、flow actor与best-of-N采样，并针对Gaussian actor提出优势归一化的DDPG+BC目标。整体仅用单个Q与V，无目标网络。
AI.result: AL-LBLP结合best-of-N在50个基于状态的OGBench任务上平均成功率60.1%；长时程任务中humanoidmaze-giant达81.5%、antmaze-giant达79.8%；batch size 扩大至8192仍未出现崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 以乘子法替代固定惩罚使约束权重自适应，获得KKT层面的理论刻画，同时在无需目标网络的简洁架构下取得强性能与大批量稳定性。

title: Lipschitz-Controlled Flow Matching for Robust Image Restoration
summary: Flow-matching models can produce high-quality image restorations, but their learned dynamics may amplify small input perturbations and make reconstructions unstable. We introduce LipsFlower to reduce this amplification. We derive stability bounds for Flow-from-$Y$, which initializes the ordinary differential equation from a noise-perturbed observation, as well as for observation-conditioned posterior sampling, which conditions the velocity field on the observation throughout integration. Based on this analysis, we develop LipHDiT, a Lipschitz-aware hourglass diffusion transformer that serves as the vector-field architecture of LipsFlower. LipHDiT incorporates stabilized approximate spectral normalization, bounded modulation, and convex residual mixing. We also use adversarial finite-radius gain regularization at sampled interpolation states to penalize excessive sensitivity to the state and, for conditional sampling, the observation. We test both formulations on blind face restoration, measuring adversarial robustness and the perceptual quality of the reconstructions. LipsFlower reduces perturbation amplification while keeping restoration quality competitive with the evaluated baselines. These results suggest that Lipschitz-aware flow matching can improve the stability of generative image restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出 LipsFlower：通过稳定性界限分析与 Lipschitz 感知的向量场架构 LipHDiT，抑制流匹配图像复原中的扰动放大，在盲人脸复原中兼顾鲁棒性与复原质量。
AI.motivation: 流匹配（flow matching）模型能产出高质量图像复原结果，但其学到的动力学可能放大输入的微小扰动，导致重建不稳定（对对抗扰动敏感）。作者旨在从理论与架构两方面约束这种敏感度。
AI.method: 1）理论：分别针对 Flow-from-Y（以噪声扰动的观测初始化 ODE）与观测条件后验采样（整个积分过程中以观测为条件的速度场）推导稳定性界限；2）架构：据此设计 LipHDiT——Lipschitz 感知的沙漏型 DiT，作为 LipsFlower 的向量场骨干，包含稳定化近似谱归一化、有界调制（bounded modulation）、凸残差混合（convex residual mixing）；3）训练：在采样插值状态上施加对抗性有限半径增益正则，惩罚对状态（以及条件采样下对观测）的过度敏感性。
AI.result: 在盲人脸复原任务上，对两种形式化方案均测试了对抗鲁棒性与重建感知质量。LipsFlower 降低了扰动放大，同时复原质量与所评估基线保持可比。
AI.conclusion: Lipschitz 感知的流匹配能够提升生成式图像复原的稳定性，说明将稳定性界限与架构约束结合是控制流模型敏感性的可行路径。

title: Where to Approximate in Neurosymbolic Inference?
summary: Probabilistic neurosymbolic methods rely on weighted model counting (WMC) to combine neural predictors with symbolic constraints. Exact WMC is #P-hard and typically scales poorly, so many methods resort to approximations. By unifying existing approaches under a three-step bottom-up approximate compilation pipeline, we study where approximation budget is best allocated. Inspired by tensor networks, we instantiate two steps with tensor train decompositions and derive new pipelines that exactly multiply approximated factors and recompress their products via SVD- or interpolation-based schemes. Across six tasks in Sudoku, arithmetic reasoning, and scene understanding, and across increasing problem sizes, our pipelines produce WMC estimates orders-of-magnitude more accurate than prior methods. This translates into stronger downstream learning on tasks where reasoning relies on tight interactions between symbolic factors, where cruder approximations ignore these dependencies. Our pipelines open novel design space for effective approximate compilation of challenging probabilistic reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文将现有概率神经符号方法统一为三步自底向上的近似编译流水线，借鉴张量网络思想，用张量列（tensor train）分解实现其中两步，并提出通过SVD或插值方案精确相乘近似因子并重压缩乘积的新流水线，从而在WMC估计精度与下游学习效果上显著超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 概率神经符号方法依赖加权模型计数（WMC）将神经预测器与符号约束结合，但精确WMC是#P-hard问题、扩展性差，现有方法多采用近似策略。然而，近似预算应如何分配缺乏系统性认识，因此需要一个统一框架来研究这一问题。
AI.method: 将现有近似WMC方法统一到三步自底向上的近似编译流水线中；受张量网络启发，用张量列（tensor train）分解实例化其中两步；推导出精确相乘近似因子、并通过基于SVD或基于插值的方案对乘积进行重压缩的新流水线。
AI.result: 在数独（Sudoku）、算术推理和场景理解共六个任务上，随问题规模增大，所提流水线给出的WMC估计比先前方法精度高出若干数量级；在符号因子间存在紧密交互、粗糙近似会忽略这些依赖的任务上，带来更强的下游学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为困难概率推理任务的高效近似编译开辟了新的设计空间，表明在统一流水线下合理分配近似预算、结合张量分解与精确因子相乘/重压缩，是提升WMC精度与下游性能的有效途径。

title: Joint Quantization and Dynamic Partitioning for Context-Aware Edge Vision Transformers
summary: Deploying vision transformer models across connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) requires joint management of computation and Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication. Static split-inference methods use fixed partition points and cannot adapt to time-varying link bandwidth, processing load, and concurrent multi-stream traffic. This paper proposes an edge orchestration framework that jointly selects model partition points, per-layer quantization bitwidths, and execution placement across heterogeneous vehicular compute nodes. The joint partitioning and mixed-precision allocation problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) that minimizes compute and communication energy subject to end-to-end latency and task-quality constraints. The framework is evaluated on Jetson Orin Nano (8~GB), Jetson Orin NX (16~GB), and Jetson AGX Orin (32~GB) nodes using OPV2V-driven multi-stream workloads with $K \in \{2,4,6,8\}$. Across the evaluated configurations, the proposed formulation reduces V2V communication energy by $33.3$--$36.0\%$ relative to a Uniform INT8 split. At $K=8$, end-to-end task completion latency is reduced by $34.0\%$ on the Orin Nano and $33.1\%$ on the Orin NX relative to the same baseline, while limiting the reduction in 3D detection accuracy to $3.1$--$4.1$ percentage points in $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ relative to FP16 execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向车联网（CAV）的边缘编排框架，联合优化视觉Transformer模型的分割点、逐层量化位宽与执行节点放置，构建MILP以最小化计算与通信能耗，并在多款Jetson平台与OPV2V多流负载下验证其优于统一INT8分割基线。
AI.motivation: 在CAV上部署ViT需同时管理计算与V2V通信。现有静态分割推理采用固定划分点，无法适应时变链路带宽、处理负载及并发多流流量，因此需要动态联合优化分割、量化与放置。
AI.method: 将联合分割与混合精度分配问题建模为混合整数线性规划（MILP），联合决策模型分割点、逐层量化位宽以及异构车载计算节点上的执行放置，目标为最小化计算与通信能耗，约束为端到端时延与任务质量。在Jetson Orin Nano（8GB）、Orin NX（16GB）、AGX Orin（32GB）上以OPV2V驱动的多流负载（K=2,4,6,8）评估。
AI.result: 相对Uniform INT8分割基线，V2V通信能耗降低33.3%–36.0%；K=8时端到端任务完成时延在Orin Nano上降低34.0%、Orin NX上降低33.1%；相对FP16执行，3D检测精度（mAP50）仅下降3.1–4.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化分割点、混合精度位宽与执行放置可显著降低V2V通信能耗与时延，并以较小精度代价实现ViT在异构车载边缘节点上的高效多流推理部署。

title: Specify Privacy Yourself: Assessing Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Preservation Ability of Large Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2025 (Brave New Ideas track)
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but raise significant privacy concerns due to their abilities to infer sensitive personal information from images with high precision. While current LVLMs are relatively well aligned to protect universal privacy, e.g., credit card data, we argue that privacy is inherently personalized and context-dependent. This work pivots towards a novel task: can LVLMs achieve Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection (ITP$^3$), allowing users to dynamically specify privacy boundaries through language specifications? To this end, we present SPY-Bench, the first systematic assessment of ITP$^3$ ability, which comprises (1) 32,700 unique samples with image-question pairs and personalized privacy instructions across 67 categories and 24 real-world scenarios, and (2) novel metrics grounded in user specifications and context awareness. Benchmarking the ITP$^3$ ability of 21 SOTA LVLMs, we reveal that: (i) most models, even the top-performing o4-mini, perform poorly, with only $\sim$24% compliance accuracy; (ii) they show quite limited contextual privacy understanding capability. Therefore, we implemented initial ITP$^3$ alignment methods, including a novel Noise Contrastive Alignment variant which achieves 96.88% accuracy while maintaining reasonable general performance. These results mark an initial step towards the ethical deployment of more controllable LVLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/achernarwang/specify-privacy-yourself

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理时个性化隐私保护（ITP³）任务与首个系统评测基准 SPY-Bench，揭示当前 LVLM 个性化隐私能力普遍不足，并给出初步对齐方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 虽在通用隐私（如信用卡信息）上对齐较好，但隐私本质上是个人化且依赖上下文的；现有工作未考虑用户能否在推理时通过语言指令动态划定隐私边界。
AI.method: 定义 ITP³ 任务；构建 SPY-Bench，含 32,700 个唯一样本（图文问答对＋个性化隐私指令），覆盖 67 个类别、24 个真实场景；提出基于用户指定与上下文感知的新指标；评测 21 个 SOTA LVLM；实现初步 ITP³ 对齐方法，包括一种新颖的 Noise Contrastive Alignment 变体。
AI.result: 多数模型（含最佳的 o4-mini）表现较差，合规准确率仅约 24%；上下文隐私理解能力有限。所提 Noise Contrastive Alignment 变体达到 96.88% 准确率，同时保持合理的通用性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LVLM 尚不具备可靠的推理时个性化隐私保护能力；本文基准与对齐方法为更可控、更符合伦理部署的 LVLM 迈出第一步，代码与数据已开源。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Deep Neural Networks: Methods, Frameworks, and Perspectives
summary: Deep neural networks underpin fundamental tasks in a wide range of signal domains, such as image, audio, and language processing. However, their internal mechanisms are notably difficult to interpret. Internal activations are structured signals transformed across layers that may encode a multitude of interdependent relationships, as individual neurons frequently represent multiple underlying concepts. Mechanistic interpretability aims to uncover the internal mechanisms of neural networks by identifying components whose activations are causally responsible for specific behaviors. In such a context, this article provides an overview of advances in mechanistic interpretability for the analysis of causal inference in deep neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，梳理面向深度神经网络因果推断的机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）研究进展，聚焦于识别其激活对特定行为具有因果作用的网络组件。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络广泛应用于图像、音频、语言等信号领域的基础任务，但其内部机制难以解释。层间传递的激活是结构化信号，神经元常多义表征，编码多重相互依赖关系，因此需要从因果角度揭示其内部机制。
AI.method: 综述性方法：以机制可解释性为框架，围绕"识别激活对特定行为负因果责任的组件"这一核心问题，对相关研究进行归纳与分类。
AI.result: 系统整理了深度学习因果推断分析中机制可解释性的研究脉络与代表性方法（摘要未给出具体实验或量化结果）。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性为理解深度网络的内部因果结构提供了有前景的路径；本文为该方向提供概览性参考，并可能指出神经元多义性等开放挑战。

title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
summary: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.

AI.tldr: 在GSM8K上通过配对实验证明：与预算匹配的弥散随机丢弃相比，时空集中的注意力头掩蔽会显著损害自回归大模型的链式推理能力，且这种损害在Qwen3-8B上远大于LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct。
AI.motivation: 受哺乳动物清醒状态下新皮层网络出现局部瞬时神经元静默（off-states）的启发，作者希望检验类似的"时空集中型扰动"是否会对自回归大模型的序贯推理造成不成比例的影响，从而为Transformer架构的容错性提供实证基准。
AI.method: 采用配对设计，在GSM8K上对两个8B模型（Qwen3-8B、LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct）各评估250条配对推导。核心对照为：注意力头掩蔽的"簇状突发"（onset参数B=0.10，约覆盖5.7%易损头-词元体积）vs. 预算匹配的弥散i.i.d.丢弃；并通过分层五分位匹配把相同累计预算均匀分散到各生成步。另做探索性因子解离实验（N=100），分离单步丢弃密度与多词元连续性的贡献，并进行错误类型学分析。
AI.result: 突发式丢弃导致显著退化：Qwen3-8B从弥散噪声下的91.2%降至78.8%（Δ=-12.4pp，精确McNemar p=5.5e-6）；LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct从84.0%降至76.8%（Δ=-7.2pp，p=0.0198）。将同一累计预算经分层五分位均匀分散后，退化大幅减轻（Qwen保持91.2%，LLaMA保持84.0%）。因子实验中，单步丢弃密度与急性下降相关（Qwen -10.0pp，p_holm=0.0425），多词元连续性的累积趋势不确定（-7.0pp，p_holm=0.1892）。错误分析显示Qwen的失败主要为格式完整响应内的推导错误（条件准确率下降-11.4pp），而LLaMA有22.2%的不一致损失缺失最终答案格式行（条件差距收窄至-5.0pp）。
AI.conclusion: 自回归推理链对集中的结构性扰动尤为脆弱；扰动的空间-时间集中度而非其总量是决定推理退化的关键因素，且不同模型对同一扰动的失效模式不同（推导错误 vs. 输出格式崩溃）。该结果为Transformer架构的鲁棒性与容错设计提供了可复现的经验基准。

title: A Stage-Wise Explainable Pipeline for Arteriolar-to-Venular Ratio Estimation and Retinopathy Screening
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 23rd IEEE India Council International Conference (INDICON 2026)
summary: The arteriolar-to-venular diameter ratio (AVR) is a clinically motivated marker of retinal vascular health. We present a five-stage pipeline for AVR estimation and exploratory retinopathy screening from fundus images, with inspectable intermediate outputs at each stage. The pipeline combines vessel and artery-vein masks, optic-disc localization, vessel-calibre estimation using a minimal-chord boundary walk, and AVR computation from dominant arterial and venular branches. An explicit threshold-based rule produces the screening decision, enabling errors to be traced to individual processing stages. On an exploratory cohort of 30 HRF images, we report 96.7% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.968 and ROC-AUC of 0.978. Ablation studies and an exploratory comparison with VascX examine the effects of vessel pairing, calibre measurement and aggregation. Interpretation is limited by the small cohort, proxy disease labels and absence of independent reference calibre measurements. The pipeline provides a transparent framework for investigating retinal vascular biomarkers, with further validation needed on larger, clinically graded cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出五阶段可解释的AVR估计与探索性视网膜病变筛查流程，在30张HRF图像上取得96.7%准确率（F1=0.968，AUC=0.978），但样本量小、标签为代理标签，需进一步验证。
AI.motivation: 动静脉直径比（AVR）是临床关注的视网膜血管健康标志物，但现有方法多为端到端黑箱，难以将错误追溯到具体处理环节，缺乏可检查的中间输出和透明的筛查决策机制。
AI.method: 构建五阶段流水线：血管与动脉-静脉掩膜、视盘定位、基于最小弦边界游走的血管管径估计、由主引流动脉/静脉分支计算AVR；每阶段输出可检查的中间结果；采用显式阈值规则给出筛查决策，实现错误可追溯；并进行消融实验及与VascX的探索性对比，分析血管配对、管径测量与聚合方式的影响。
AI.result: 在30张HRF图像的探索性队列上，准确率96.7%、F1分数0.968、ROC-AUC 0.978；消融与对比实验揭示了血管配对、管径测量和聚合策略对AVR性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该流程为研究视网膜血管生物标志物提供了透明、可解释的框架；研究结论受限于小规模队列、代理疾病标签以及缺少独立参考管径测量，仍需在更大规模、经临床分级的队列上进一步验证。

title: Are Causal Neuron Circuits Unique and Transferable?
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code, data and results: https://github.com/omtekyav/causal-neuron-circuits
summary: Interpretability demonstrations often show that intervening on a group of neurons changes a model's answer. A recent example removes an 18-neuron group in Qwen3-32B and the model answers "Simba" instead of "Scar" to a two-hop Lion King riddle. Such a demonstration establishes that the group matters, but not how much of it is necessary, whether other groups could do the same, or whether the effect carries over to other inputs. We ask: when intervening on a group of neurons changes a model's answer, how much of that group is actually necessary? For every selected group we measure all 4,096 subsets of 12 MLP neurons. On a two-alternative capital task (Qwen3-0.6B), zero-ablating 12 selected neurons lowers the answer margin by 27% while random neurons barely change it, yet replacing the same neurons with their values from other questions also barely changes it: their activations are nearly constant across questions, and we find no evidence that they carry question-specific content. On two-hop relation chains, patching 12 neurons with activations from the first-hop question shifts the answer to the bridge entity (from Scar to Simba): the greedy answer starts with the bridge in 9/11 chains for Qwen3-1.7B, 9/11 for Llama-3.2-1B and 8/10 for Gemma-3-1B; random neurons never do. The full group is rarely necessary: a few neurons often suffice, and in many chains disjoint subsets each flip the answer on their own, in an exploratory analysis most often when the model is less confident. Group effects transfer to rephrasings of the same chain but are much weaker on other tested chains. We study neuron-level causal interventions and alternative subsets; we do not recover the full connectivity of circuits.

AI.tldr: 该文系统检验了"神经元组干预改变模型答案"这类可解释性演示中组内神经元的必要性：通过穷举12个MLP神经元组的全部4,096个子集，发现整组很少是必要的，少数神经元即可翻转答案，且存在多个互不相交的子集各自独立地产生同样效果。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性演示（如Qwen3-32B中移除18个神经元使模型把"Scar"答成"Simba"）只能证明"该组神经元有影响"，却无法回答三个关键问题：组内究竟有多少是必要的、是否存在其他可替代的神经元组、以及效应能否迁移到其他输入。作者希望把"组是否重要"这一弱结论升级为对组内必要性与冗余性的定量刻画。
AI.method: 对每个选定的12个MLP神经元组，穷举全部4,096个子集做因果干预。任务包括：(1) 二选一首都任务（Qwen3-0.6B），比较零消融与"用其他问题的激活替换"两种干预；(2) 两跳关系链任务，用第一跳问题的激活做patch，观察答案是否转向桥接实体，并在Qwen3-1.7B、Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-3-1B上重复，同时以随机神经元作对照；(3) 探索性分析模型置信度与多子集翻转的关系，并检验效应在改写句和其他关系链上的迁移性。
AI.result: 二选一首都任务中，零消融12个选定神经元使答案边际下降27%，随机神经元几乎无影响；但用其他问题的激活替换同组神经元也几乎不改变答案，说明这些激活跨问题近乎恒定，未发现其携带问题特异内容。两跳链中，patch 12个神经元使贪心答案转向桥接实体：Qwen3-1.7B为9/11、Llama-3.2-1B为9/11、Gemma-3-1B为8/10，随机神经元从不产生该效果。整组很少必要：少数神经元常已足够，且许多链上存在多个互不相交的子集各自独立翻转答案，探索性分析显示这多发生在模型置信度较低时。效应可迁移到同一链的改写句，但在其他测试链上明显减弱。
AI.conclusion: 组级干预效应并不能推出该组整体必要：效应高度冗余，可由少量神经元或互不相交的多个子集实现，并受模型置信度调制。效应具有一定输入内稳健性（改写句），但跨链泛化有限。作者强调本文聚焦神经元级因果干预与替代子集分析，并未恢复完整电路连接。

title: Interleaving anatomical inspection and diagnostic reasoning for explainable radiology report generation
summary: Automated radiology report generation can draft clinically plausible reports, yet the pathway from visual evidence to reported findings remains opaque, leaving the diagnostic basis of these reports unexplained and the generated reports difficult to review or revise. We introduce ARIVE (Anatomy-guided Reasoning with Interleaved Visual Evidence), an explainable report generation framework that interleaves anatomical inspection with diagnostic reasoning prior to final report composition. To support this process, we constructed 159,416 multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) trajectories from MIMIC-CXR, wherein visual evidence from inspected anatomical regions informs subsequent clinical interpretation. Trained on these trajectories and further optimized using anatomical and clinical-content rewards, ARIVE achieved superior clinical-efficacy performance compared with strong baselines on MIMIC-CXR and the abnormality-centered MIMIC-ABN. ARIVE's reports were competitive with those of leading models in blinded expert grading, and its MCoT trajectories earned high ratings for diagnostic traceability. Furthermore, a paired review evaluation suggests that access to MCoT can aid in identifying errors within generated reports.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的放射报告生成框架ARIVE，将解剖区域检查与诊断推理交错误导生成，并构建159,416条多模态思维链轨迹训练模型。
AI.motivation: 现有自动放射报告生成虽能产出临床看似合理的报告，但从视觉证据到结论的推理路径不透明，导致报告诊断依据不可解释、难以审阅和修改。
AI.method: 提出ARIVE框架，在最终报告撰写前将解剖结构检查与诊断推理交错进行；基于MIMIC-CXR构建159,416条多模态思维链（MCoT）轨迹，其中被检查解剖区域的视觉证据用于支撑后续临床解读；在轨迹上训练并采用解剖层面与临床内容奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR与以异常为中心的MIMIC-ABN上，临床效能指标优于强基线；盲评专家评分中报告质量与领先模型相当，MCoT轨迹在诊断可追溯性上获得高评分；配对审阅评估显示，可获取MCoT有助于识别生成报告中的错误。
AI.conclusion: ARIVE通过显式的解剖引导推理与视觉证据交错，提升了报告生成的临床效能与可解释性，并为报告审阅和纠错提供支持。

title: Conformal Risk Control for QoT-Aware Lightpath Feasibility Under Technology-Driven Domain Shift
comment: 8 pages; 4 figures; accepted for publication in the Journal of Lightwave Technology (JLT)
summary: Artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML)-based regression models support operational decision-making in optical networks but typically expose only point predictions, which carry no statistically controlled information about their reliability. This paper proposes a post-hoc conformal risk control (CRC) framework that keeps a pretrained AI/ML regressor fixed, provides a finite-sample guarantee on uncertainty band miscoverage, and maps the band to operational decisions through policy rules. The guarantee applies to interval miscoverage, while decision-error rates are evaluated empirically. We instantiate the framework for quality of transmission (QoT)-aware lightpath (LP) feasibility assessment, in which a regressor predicts optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) under domain shifts caused by fiber, amplifier, and switching upgrades. Feature shift contribution scores identify the LP features whose relation to QoT changes the most across a technology transition, and two policies translate the bands into feasibility decisions, allowing operators to tune the trade-off between conservatively rejecting or aggressively accepting LP realizations.
